project.name: katgpt-rs
project.description: A GOAT-proved neuro-symbolic micro-Transformer with speculative decoding, constraint pruning, and sigmoid-gated latent steering in Rust. Modelless inference only.

nodes.name: acceptance_variance.rs
nodes.summary: Online acceptance-variance tracker (Welford + EMA) that turns speculative-decode accept/reject events into an SNR-proxy RV signal for compute routing.
nodes.languageNotes: Welford online variance with EMA smoothing in ~48 bytes; O(1) per update.

nodes.name: belief_rank_pruner.rs
nodes.summary: ScreeningPruner that gates draft acceptance by the participation-ratio flatness of recent hidden states — peaked distributions accept, flat ones reject.
nodes.languageNotes: Approximates effective rank via participation ratio (Σh²)²/(n·Σh⁴) — O(n·k) instead of full SVD.

nodes.name: bfcf_types.rs
nodes.summary: Core types for the Borel Finite Connected Partition (BFCP): RegionLabel, HalfSpace, BorelRegion, BFCP partition, and piecewise-constant value function.
nodes.languageNotes: BFCP partitions token space into convex BorelRegions of equivalent accept/reject/maybe labels.

nodes.name: bfcp_lfu_shard.rs
nodes.summary: Top-level fusion of LFU region cache, shard map, and batcher with optional UCB1 ShardTierBandit (freq_bandit feature) adapting Hot/Warm/Cold tier decisions.
nodes.languageNotes: Pipeline: lookup → cache miss → compute → insert → shard → batch; papaya lock-free internals.

nodes.name: bfcp_lsh_cms.rs
nodes.summary: Three-level cache hierarchy (BLAKE3 exact L0 → LSH SimHash L1 → full compute L2) fused with Count-Min Sketch frequency and Roaring membership.
nodes.languageNotes: L0 exact / L1 approximate / L2 compute cache hierarchy with SIMD-friendly Roaring membership.

nodes.name: bfcp_preimage.rs
nodes.summary: Backward-reachability lookahead that refines BFCP maybe-regions by checking which tokens can extend an accepted prefix, lifting acceptance rate by ≥10%.
nodes.languageNotes: Plan 213 P2 backward reachability from accepted prefix reduces the maybe set.

nodes.name: bfcp_pruner.rs
nodes.summary: Region-level BFCP pruner built from a ScreeningPruner partition — skips reject regions and samples accept regions, turning O(vocab) into O(regions).
nodes.languageNotes: Thresholds: relevance ≥ 0.7 → Accept, ≤ 0.3 → Reject, otherwise Maybe.

nodes.name: bfcp_region_cache.rs
nodes.summary: Papaya lock-free LFU cache of BLAKE3-hashed BFCP partitions with sigmoid-gated admission, Hot/Warm/Cold frequency tiers, and region-transition detection.
nodes.languageNotes: Lock-free papaya HashMap + LFU eviction + sigmoid admission control; emotion-aware priority hook.

nodes.name: boundary_alignment.rs
nodes.summary: Federated boundary-alignment trait computing KL divergence between a local domain expert and the rest-of-ensemble mixture (Deep Manifold Part 2, §7.6).
nodes.languageNotes: Paper Eq. 163-164: cross-model KL coupling replaces gradient exchange.

nodes.name: AcceptanceVarianceTracker
nodes.summary: Welford + EMA variance tracker producing the RV signal for compute routing.

nodes.name: observe
nodes.summary: Records one acceptance event and updates Welford/EMA statistics in O(1).

nodes.name: with_params
nodes.summary: Constructs a tracker with a custom EMA alpha and min_samples threshold.

nodes.name: BeliefRankPruner
nodes.summary: ScreeningPruner gating draft acceptance by the participation-ratio flatness of recent hidden states.

nodes.name: effective_rank
nodes.summary: Computes the participation-ratio effective rank of the variance diagonal across a hidden-state buffer.

nodes.name: flatness
nodes.summary: Per-vector flatness = (Σh²)²/(n·Σh⁴); ~1 means flat/uncertain, ~0 means peaked/confident.

nodes.name: relevance
nodes.summary: Maps the current effective rank to a [0,1] relevance score for the ScreeningPruner trait.

nodes.name: BFCP
nodes.summary: Borel Finite Connected Partition — ordered list of BorelRegions with accept/reject/maybe labels.

nodes.name: BorelRegion
nodes.summary: Convex polytope of half-spaces plus the token IDs whose logits fall inside it.

nodes.name: PWCValueFunction
nodes.summary: Piecewise-constant value function indexed over a BfcpPartition for fast region lookups.

nodes.name: intersect
nodes.summary: Intersects two HalfSpace sets to derive the overlapping polytope face.

nodes.name: from_regions
nodes.summary: Builds a BFCP from an explicit list of BorelRegions, computing aggregate token counts.

nodes.name: precision_smooth_label
nodes.summary: Smooths a RegionLabel using precision-weighted smoothing across partition boundaries.

nodes.name: BfcpLfuShard
nodes.summary: Top-level LFU cache + shard map + batcher fusion with optional UCB1 tier bandit.

nodes.name: ShardTierBandit
nodes.summary: UCB1 bandit adapting Hot/Warm/Cold tier decisions from cache-hit rewards.

nodes.name: process_and_shard
nodes.summary: Full pipeline: lookup → cache miss → compute → insert → shard → batch in one call.

nodes.name: refine_tier
nodes.summary: Refines a static frequency tier using the bandit's learned tier preference.

nodes.name: process_with_hash
nodes.summary: Processes a pre-hashed logit vector through the LFU+shard pipeline.

nodes.name: derive_tier
nodes.summary: Maps an LFU frequency count to a Hot/Warm/Cold FreqTier.

nodes.name: BfcpLshCms
nodes.summary: Three-level LSH/CMS/Roaring cache fusion providing exact-then-approximate-then-compute lookups.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs the LSH+CMS fusion with configured hash seeds and CMS dimensions.

nodes.name: process
nodes.summary: Runs a logit vector through the L0→L1→L2 hierarchy and updates CMS frequencies.

nodes.name: update_membership
nodes.summary: Refreshes Roaring membership bits from the latest accepted/rejected token sets.

nodes.name: compute_preimage
nodes.summary: Backward-reachability pass that determines which maybe-region tokens can extend an accepted prefix.

nodes.name: classify_maybe_region
nodes.summary: Splits a maybe region into accept/reject sub-regions based on preimage reachability.

nodes.name: refine_partition
nodes.summary: Applies preimage refinement to an entire BFCP, returning a new partition with reduced maybe set.

nodes.name: BFCPPruner
nodes.summary: Region-level pruner built from a ScreeningPruner partition into BFCP accept/maybe/reject regions.

nodes.name: from_logits
nodes.summary: Builds a BFCPPruner by classifying each token via inner pruner relevance and grouping into regions.

nodes.name: relevance
nodes.summary: Returns the ScreeningPruner relevance for a token, looking up its region label.

nodes.name: BfcpRegionCache
nodes.summary: Papaya lock-free LFU cache of BLAKE3-hashed BFCP partitions with sigmoid admission and tier tracking.

nodes.name: RegionCaching
nodes.summary: Trait abstracting region-cache lookup/insert/decay for pluggable cache backends.

nodes.name: insert
nodes.summary: Inserts a partition under its BLAKE3 hash with sigmoid-gated admission and LFU eviction.

nodes.name: decay
nodes.summary: Applies frequency decay across all cached entries and recomputes Hot/Warm/Cold tiers.

nodes.name: lookup
nodes.summary: Exact-match (L0) lookup of a cached partition by its BLAKE3 logit hash.

nodes.name: from_shard_and_logits
nodes.summary: Builds a NeuronShardRegionKey from a shard id and logit hash for cross-shard cache keys.

nodes.name: detect_region_transitions
nodes.summary: Compares consecutive cached partitions to detect region-boundary transitions.

nodes.name: with_thresholds
nodes.summary: Builder configuring admission and eviction thresholds on the cache.

nodes.name: blake3_logit_hash
nodes.summary: Computes a BLAKE3 hash over a logit slice for use as a cache key.

nodes.name: BoundaryAlignment
nodes.summary: Trait defining federated KL-coupling boundary alignment between domain experts.

nodes.name: KlBoundaryAligner
nodes.summary: Default BoundaryAlignment implementation computing discrete KL divergence.

nodes.name: kl_divergence
nodes.summary: Computes KL(local ‖ ensemble) as the boundary-misalignment measure.

nodes.name: bt_rank.rs
nodes.summary: Bradley-Terry pairwise ranking model (distilled from OpenDeepThink) that fits latent scores via gradient ascent and internalizes opponent strength.
nodes.languageNotes: P(i ≻ j) = σ(sᵢ − sⱼ); regularized log-likelihood with λ=0.01.

nodes.name: cna.rs
nodes.summary: Contrastive Neuron Attribution — discovers sparse MLP neuron circuits from contrastive prompt pairs and modulates them at runtime for activation steering.
nodes.languageNotes: Top-k neurons by |δ_pos − δ_neg|; universal-neuron filter (≥80% presence); O(k_layer) modulation.

nodes.name: collapse_detector.rs
nodes.summary: S2F mid-reasoning collapse detector with ring-buffer hesitation counting, EMA threshold adaptation, derivative/TVP collapse signals, and freeze/thaw support.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements katgpt_core::traits::CollapseDetector; integrates with TemporalDerivativeKernel under temporal_deriv feature.

nodes.name: blind_spot.rs
nodes.summary: Estimates the committee proposer diversity ceiling B = 1 − lim p_oracle(k) via exponential convergence fits on best-of-k curves.
nodes.languageNotes: Plan 132 Phase 4; exponential asymptote fit on oracle best-of-k rates.

nodes.name: budget.rs
nodes.summary: Computes optimal committee protocol sizing (k proposers, m critics, r comparators) from Theorem 3 bounds (α₀, β₀, σ₀, L, δ).
nodes.languageNotes: arXiv:2605.14163 Theorem 3 closed-form (k, m, r) bounds guarantee success ≥ 1−δ over L rounds.

nodes.name: debiased_compare.rs
nodes.summary: Position-swap debiasing for Bradley-Terry comparisons — runs both A/B and B/A orders and counts a win only when both agree.
nodes.languageNotes: Eliminates lead-position bias; depends on crate::bt_rank::{BtComparison, BtOutcome}.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module re-exporting the four committee-boost phases: oracle-gap recovery, position-swap debiasing, budget sizing, and blind-spot floor.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Shared committee-boost types: FailureMode diagnosis, OracleGapRecovery fraction, and re-exports of budget/blind-spot diagnostics.
nodes.languageNotes: FailureMode enum distinguishes selection-limited vs coverage-limited failures.

nodes.name: concept_grounding.rs
nodes.summary: Template-based grounding that maps pruner states to human-readable ConceptMapping chains and PolicyExplanation summaries without any runtime LLM.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure string interpolation from static templates; depends on symbolic_distill feature.

nodes.name: BtScores

nodes.name: BtConfig

nodes.summary: Fits BT scores from a closure producing random pairwise comparisons.

nodes.name: rank
nodes.summary: Returns candidate indices sorted by descending BT score.

nodes.summary: ScreeningPruner that uses discovered CNA circuits to gate tokens by membership.

nodes.name: cna_modulate

nodes.name: constraint_miner.rs
nodes.summary: Background auto-constraint synthesis that mines frequent token sequences from accepted DDTree paths and emits ConstraintPruner-compatible SequenceConstraints.
nodes.languageNotes: blake3 pattern hashing for integrity audit; <100μs per 100-episode batch.

nodes.name: count_min_sketch.rs
nodes.summary: Compact 4×256 Count-Min Sketch with saturating u16 counters providing one-sided frequency overestimates safe for LFU eviction; O(1024) decay.
nodes.languageNotes: 2KB CMS; XOR-fold hash derivation from already-BLAKE3'd keys; never underestimates hot entries.

nodes.name: curvature_alloc.rs
nodes.summary: Curvature-Influence Allocation Bandit (CIAB) allocating DDTree budget across depth positions via modelless persistence × alignment proxies.
nodes.languageNotes: Persistence = EMA |loss − running_mean|; alignment = 1 − normalized_entropy(softmax(scores)).

nodes.name: decision_explainer.rs
nodes.summary: Sensitivity-analysis-based decision explainer that perturbs pruner scores to identify the primary driver of each DDTree token choice, with blake3-keyed caching.
nodes.languageNotes: <1ms for 100 tokens × 4 pruners; integrates with concept_grounding for semantic labels.

nodes.name: decision_trace.rs
nodes.summary: Opt-in debug/audit DecisionTrace builder that renders applied rules, rejected alternatives, and confidence as a human-readable trace.
nodes.languageNotes: Plan 209 T4; depends on rule_extractor::ExtractedRule.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module re-exporting the δ-mem substrate (DeltaMemoryState, FeatureHasher, MultiDomainMemory from katgpt-core) and the local composition-layer pruners.
nodes.languageNotes: Substrate lives in katgpt_core::delta_mem; composition (pruners) stays local due to root-only ScreeningPruner trait objects.

nodes.name: multi_pruner.rs

nodes.name: pruner.rs
nodes.summary: ScreeningPruner wrapper applying δ-mem low-rank attention corrections to relevance scores, with QuerySide/OutputSide correction modes and segment flushing.
nodes.languageNotes: Distilled from δ-mem L2283-2293: attn_output += delta_o; relevance_adjusted = relevance_inner + α·correction.

nodes.name: consolidator.rs
nodes.summary: Deterministic modelless Dreamer consolidator that clusters arms by Q-value proximity, merges similar ones, and forgets low-visit entries in O(n log n).
nodes.languageNotes: Sort-by-Q → merge-nearby → forget-low-visit pipeline.

nodes.name: editable_constraint.rs

nodes.name: emotion_vector.rs

nodes.name: entropy_bifurcated.rs
nodes.summary: Direction-adaptive screening wrapper that relaxes pruning for high-entropy 'forking' tokens and tightens it for low-entropy 'scaffolding' tokens, using only top-1 probability (no model access).
nodes.languageNotes: Plan 184; gated behind the `directional_credit` feature.

nodes.name: factorization.rs
nodes.summary: Forward/reverse factorization scoring for game traces based on the epiplexity paper (arXiv:2601.03220), demonstrating that reverse-order (state→actions) factorization yields higher structural information and better OOD accuracy.

nodes.name: loss_curve.rs
nodes.summary: Loss-curve tracker hooks for epiplexity estimation at two granularities — batch/epoch prequential estimate (LossCurveTracker) and per-token-position fine-grained scoring (PerPositionLossTracker).

nodes.name: mod.rs (epiplexity)

nodes.languageNotes: Barrel for the epiplexity/ subdirectory; Plan 130 / Research 090.

nodes.name: screening.rs
nodes.summary: EpiplexityScreeningPruner wraps any inner ScreeningPruner and blends its relevance with an epiplexity weight via `inner*(1-α) + epiplexity_signal*α`, with multiple weight-derivation strategies.
nodes.languageNotes: α=0 reduces to pure inner pruner (baseline sanity check).

nodes.name: episode_pruner.rs
nodes.summary: Episode-Guided Constraint Synthesis (EGCS): wraps an inner ConstraintPruner and, when a reference solution exists in the episode DB, synthesizes structural diff constraints to apply alongside the inner pruner; zero-cost on miss path.
nodes.languageNotes: Plan 206; gated behind `egcs`. MemoryEpisodeLookup is the in-memory implementation.

nodes.name: DungeonMap

nodes.name: DungeonState

nodes.name: PrunerSnapshot

nodes.name: EditableConstraintPruner
nodes.summary: Bidirectional read/write/enhance ConstraintPruner wrapping an inner pruner with snapshot-based divergence guardrails and a JSON rule-editing backend.

nodes.name: EmotionReading

nodes.name: TimeBoundedEntropy
nodes.summary: Companion time-bounded entropy estimator H_T paired with EpiplexityEstimator, exposing structural_fraction over a sliding window of observations.

nodes.name: EpiplexityScreeningPruner

nodes.name: EpisodePruner

nodes.name: freeze.rs

nodes.name: ExplorationBudget

nodes.name: ExpressionPruner

nodes.name: KernelScreeningPruner

nodes.name: LodestarAutomatonBuilder

nodes.name: LodestarPruner

nodes.name: BitVec

nodes.name: is_novel

nodes.name: divergence

nodes.name: close_intervals

nodes.name: valid_intervals_from_slice

nodes.name: simd_is_interval_closed

nodes.name: simd_close_intervals

nodes.name: simd_find_intervals
nodes.summary: SIMD-accelerated interval-list extraction: returns contiguous valid ranges by scanning lanes in bulk.

nodes.name: neon_is_interval_closed

nodes.name: avx2_is_interval_closed
nodes.summary: x86 AVX2-specific interval-closure check (32-byte lanes) — the x86_64 backend selected by AdaptiveConfig.

nodes.name: scalar_is_interval_closed

nodes.name: kernel_score

nodes.name: kernel_score_simd_gaussian
nodes.summary: SIMD-accelerated Gaussian-RBF kernel specialization for high-dimensional activation vectors.

nodes.name: relevance

nodes.name: precompute_distances

nodes.name: compute_singular_span
nodes.summary: Computes the singular span of a state — the longest accepting path reachable — used for budget-aware masking decisions.

nodes.name: is_valid

nodes.name: batch_is_valid

nodes.name: min_completion_distance

nodes.name: builder

nodes.summary: Pairwise-comparison (dueling) bandit that selects region indices via UCB1 over relative Q-values, with PWC-closure verification hooks.

nodes.name: RegionBandit
nodes.summary: Multi-region dueling bandit maintaining per-region Q-values and visit counts with UCB1 selection and PWC-closure verification.

nodes.name: select
nodes.summary: Selects the next region index via UCB1 over per-arm Q-values and visit counts.

nodes.name: update
nodes.summary: Updates the Q-value and visit count for a region's arm after observing a pairwise-comparison reward.

nodes.name: ucb1_score
nodes.summary: Computes the UCB1 score for a region's arm given total pulls and a confidence weight.

nodes.name: randopt.rs
nodes.summary: Random-search hyperparameter optimizer with weight sampling, discrete/continuous aggregation, and an ensemble session that runs perturb-evaluate-aggregate cycles.

nodes.name: RandOptConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for random-search optimization: sigma, arm count, perturbation strategy.

nodes.name: RandOptWeightSampler
nodes.summary: Sampler producing perturbed weight vectors around a baseline using Gaussian noise scaled per arm.

nodes.name: RandOptEnsemble
nodes.summary: Ensemble aggregator combining discrete and continuous evaluation outcomes across multiple arms.

nodes.name: RandOptResult
nodes.summary: Result record holding the best arm, its score, and per-arm statistics from a random-search session.

nodes.name: RandOptSession
nodes.summary: Top-level driver that runs perturb-evaluate-aggregate cycles for random-search optimization.

nodes.name: perturb
nodes.summary: Returns a perturbed copy of the input weights by adding Gaussian noise scaled by arm-specific sigma.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Runs the random-search loop, scoring perturbed candidates and aggregating results into a RandOptResult.

nodes.name: reflection.rs
nodes.summary: Reflection pipeline that extracts facts from game traces, consolidates them, verifies self-containment, and synthesizes cross-game reflections for the HL player's learning loop.

nodes.name: ReflectionStep
nodes.summary: Single step in a reflection chain: a question, observation, and derived rule.

nodes.name: ReflectionDomain
nodes.summary: Domain tag identifying which game/context a reflection belongs to (Bomberman, Go, Monopoly, etc.).

nodes.name: ReflectionQA
nodes.summary: Question-answer pair driving a single reflection step with supporting evidence.

nodes.name: GameStateSnapshot
nodes.summary: Compact snapshot of game state used as grounding context for reflection extraction.

nodes.name: ReflectionResult
nodes.summary: Final output of the reflection pipeline: extracted rules, confidence scores, and provenance back to the source trace.

nodes.name: extract_facts
nodes.summary: Extracts atomic facts from a game-state snapshot using pattern matching over the trace.

nodes.name: consolidate_facts
nodes.summary: Merges and deduplicates extracted facts into a coherent fact set, resolving conflicts.

nodes.name: verify_self_containment
nodes.summary: Checks that a reflection's conclusions are fully supported by its grounding facts without external references.

nodes.name: synthesize_cross_game
nodes.summary: Synthesizes cross-game insights by joining reflection outputs from multiple game domains into shared lessons.

nodes.name: synthesize_reflections
nodes.summary: Top-level reflection synthesis: runs extract/consolidate/verify and emits a ReflectionResult per domain.

nodes.name: regime_transition.rs
nodes.summary: Self-revising regime-transition inference: classifies DDTree failures, gates admission of new pruners via MDL, maintains a tamper-evident provenance chain, and schedules background transitions; feature-gated behind regime_transition.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses blake3 for commitment hashes; gated by #[cfg(feature = "regime_transition")] and depends on and_or_dtree, bandit, decision_trace, fol_constraints, rule_extraction.

nodes.name: CollapseType
nodes.summary: Enum classifying a DDTree failure as Search (transient) or Regime (needs new pruners).

nodes.name: CollapseClassifier
nodes.summary: Trait for classifiers that decide whether failures are search-phase or regime-phase.

nodes.name: RegimeCollapseClassifier
nodes.summary: Concrete classifier using uniform-failure-depth heuristic to distinguish search vs regime collapses.

nodes.name: RegimeTransitionGate
nodes.summary: Gate that admits candidate pruners into a new regime after passing MDL description-length and correctness checks.

nodes.name: ProvenanceChain
nodes.summary: Tamper-evident audit trail of AbsorbCompress episodes with blake3 commitment hashes and schema-transport verification.

nodes.name: FailurePatternHash
nodes.summary: Newtype wrapping a blake3 hash for a failure pattern with from_parts/from_parts_with_token constructors.

nodes.name: FailurePattern
nodes.summary: Recorded failure pattern with its hash key used by the adversarial breaker for hot-pattern tracking.

nodes.name: FailureRule
nodes.summary: Rule extracted from observed failure patterns that pruner admission can use to reject known-bad candidates.

nodes.name: AdversarialBreaker
nodes.summary: Generates synthetic failure patterns, tracks hot patterns, and verifies adversarial breakers against new candidates.

nodes.name: RegimeTransitionScheduler
nodes.summary: Background scheduler that acquires deferral slots and executes regime transitions when safe.

nodes.name: failure_depth_std
nodes.summary: Computes the standard deviation of failure depths in the DDTree as the regime-collapse signal.

nodes.name: description_length
nodes.summary: Computes a simplified MDL estimate (rules_applied*16 + alternatives_rejected*8) for a decision trace.

nodes.name: record_failure
nodes.summary: Records an observed failure into the adversarial breaker, updating hot-pattern counts.

nodes.name: extract_failure_rule
nodes.summary: Extracts a reusable failure rule from a recorded failure pattern's signature.

nodes.name: execute
nodes.summary: Executes a pending regime transition, performing absorb-compress and updating the provenance chain.

nodes.name: region_batch.rs
nodes.summary: Region-batching primitives that accept, reject-count, and refine batches of region tokens in a single pass for the multiplexed decoder.

nodes.name: RegionBatching
nodes.summary: Trait defining batch_accept, batch_reject_count, and batch_refine operations over region token batches.

nodes.name: RegionBatcher
nodes.summary: Concrete region batcher implementing batch accept, reject-count, and refine operations in bulk.

nodes.name: batch_refine
nodes.summary: Refines a batch of region masks by combining accept and reject signals with a configurable tie-breaker.

nodes.name: region_shard_map.rs
nodes.summary: Region-to-shard mapping that assigns regions to shards via hash-based or round-robin policies, with rebalancing when shard load diverges.

nodes.name: RegionShardMap
nodes.summary: Region-to-shard map with hash or round-robin assignment, rebalancing, and warm-shard selection.

nodes.name: RegionSharding
nodes.summary: Trait abstracting region-shard assignment and rebalancing for swappable sharding policies.

nodes.name: assign_shard
nodes.summary: Assigns a region to its target shard using the configured policy.

nodes.name: rebalance
nodes.summary: Rebalances region-to-shard assignments to even out shard load.

nodes.name: regression.rs
nodes.summary: Regression-test suite harness for pruner traces: replays golden traces, compares against stored expectations, and aggregates per-trial pass/fail results.

nodes.name: GoldenTrace
nodes.summary: Stored reference trace with expected outputs used as ground truth for regression checks.

nodes.name: RegressionFailure
nodes.summary: Record of a single regression failure with diff details and trace identifier.

nodes.name: RegressionResult
nodes.summary: Aggregate result of a regression run: total trials, failures, and pass/fail flag.

nodes.name: RegressionSuite
nodes.summary: Collection of golden traces with run/from_trials construction that executes replay comparisons and reports RegressionResult.

nodes.name: ReplayReward
nodes.summary: Reward signal derived from replaying a trace, used to score pruner variants during regression.

nodes.name: from_trials
nodes.summary: Builds a RegressionSuite from a list of named trials and their golden traces.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Executes the regression suite, replaying each golden trace and aggregating pass/fail outcomes.

nodes.name: resid_pruner.rs
nodes.summary: Residual-injection pruner that decides whether to inject a residual stream at a given depth based on magnitude thresholds and top-K gating.

nodes.name: ResidPruner
nodes.summary: Residual-injection pruner with configurable top-K and magnitude threshold for deciding injection per depth.

nodes.name: should_inject
nodes.summary: Decides whether to inject the residual stream at the given depth by checking magnitude against threshold and applying top-K gating.

nodes.name: reward_calibrator.rs
nodes.summary: Reward-gated calibrator that uses a bandit over parameter keys to decide whether to absorb new parameter sets, with rollback and regression verification.

nodes.name: ParameterKey
nodes.summary: Hashable parameter-set key used as the bandit arm identifier in the calibrator.

nodes.name: ParameterStats
nodes.summary: Per-parameter statistics (visits, mean reward) tracked by the calibration bandit.

nodes.name: CalibrationStep
nodes.summary: Single recorded calibration step: parameter key, observed reward, and timestamp.

nodes.name: CalibratorConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for the reward-gated calibrator: absorption threshold, bandit alpha, rollback window.

nodes.name: RewardGatedCalibrator
nodes.summary: Top-level calibrator that decides parameter absorption via a reward-gated bandit and supports rollback with regression verification.

nodes.name: compute_hash
nodes.summary: Hashes a parameter set into a stable key used for bandit arm lookup.

nodes.name: record_reward
nodes.summary: Records an observed reward for a parameter key and appends a CalibrationStep to the log.

nodes.name: bandit_update
nodes.summary: Updates the bandit statistics for a parameter key using the recorded reward.

nodes.name: should_absorb
nodes.summary: Decides whether a candidate parameter set should be absorbed based on the bandit's expected reward.

nodes.name: verify_regression
nodes.summary: Verifies that absorbing a new parameter set does not regress prior calibration outcomes.

nodes.name: reward_mem_pruner.rs
nodes.summary: Memory-backed reward pruner that hashes compile-outcome patterns to boost or suppress token paths based on historical reward signals.

nodes.name: CompileOutcome
nodes.summary: Outcome classification for a compiled candidate (success, failure type) used as the reward signal.

nodes.name: PatternHasher
nodes.summary: Hasher for token-path patterns used as keys in the reward-memory store.

nodes.name: RewardMemPruner
nodes.summary: ConstraintPruner that consults a pattern-keyed reward memory to boost or suppress candidate token paths.

nodes.name: hash
nodes.summary: Hashes a prompt-type + token-path pair into a u64 key for the reward-memory store.

nodes.name: reward_path
nodes.summary: Records a reward signal for a token path in the memory store for future boost decisions.

nodes.name: get_boost
nodes.summary: Retrieves the boost factor for a token path by looking up its historical reward in the memory store.

nodes.name: batch_is_valid
nodes.summary: Vectorized batch validity check that consults the reward memory once per batch instead of per token.

nodes.name: riir_feedback.rs
nodes.summary: RiIR feedback pipeline: ingests translation rules from external traces, learns which rules pay off via a bandit, and routes workloads based on observed success rates.

nodes.name: TranslationRule
nodes.summary: A single translation rule mapping a source pattern to a target representation with metadata.

nodes.name: CuratorRule
nodes.summary: Curated translation rule with its ingestion source and historical outcome statistics.

nodes.name: CuratorIngestion
nodes.summary: Ingests raw translation rules from external traces and queues them for curation.

nodes.name: RuleBandit
nodes.summary: Bandit over curated rules that learns which translation rules produce the best outcomes.

nodes.name: WorkloadRoute
nodes.summary: Enum tagging workload categories for rule-routing decisions.

nodes.name: extract_translation_rules
nodes.summary: Extracts translation rules from an ingested trace by pattern-matching over its AST.

nodes.name: success_rate
nodes.summary: Returns the success rate for a rule in the bandit given its observation history.

nodes.name: best_rule
nodes.summary: Returns the highest-performing rule from the bandit for a given workload category.

nodes.name: classify_workload
nodes.summary: Classifies a workload into a WorkloadRoute category used to select rules.

nodes.name: rmsd_relevance.rs
nodes.summary: RMSD-based relevance filtering for distillation: combines logprob-magnitude filtering, top-KL approximation, plateau detection, and teacher-continuation scoring to choose which student tokens to keep.

nodes.name: RmsdConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for RMSD relevance filtering: thresholds, top-K size, plateau patience.

nodes.name: RmsdMetrics
nodes.summary: Metrics tracker for RMSD filter: running loss, plateau count, best metric, update flag.

nodes.name: LogprobMagnitudeFilter
nodes.summary: Filter that retains only tokens whose logprob magnitude exceeds a configured threshold.

nodes.name: TopKlApproximator
nodes.summary: Approximates KL divergence over the top-K tokens between student and teacher distributions.

nodes.name: RelevanceMask
nodes.summary: Boolean mask over candidate tokens indicating which are considered relevant by the RMSD filter.

nodes.name: MagnitudeJudge
nodes.summary: Judge that combines magnitude-filter output with relevance scoring to decide token retention.

nodes.name: RmsdRelevanceFilter
nodes.summary: Top-level RMSD relevance filter combining magnitude filtering, KL approximation, and plateau detection into a single mask pipeline.

nodes.name: TeacherContinuation
nodes.summary: Teacher-continuation tracker that decides whether the teacher should continue generating based on plateau and metric signals.

nodes.name: kl_topk
nodes.summary: Computes the top-K KL divergence between student and teacher logprob distributions.

nodes.name: filter_actions
nodes.summary: Filters a candidate action set by relevance, applying magnitude and KL thresholds to produce a masked subset.

nodes.name: rmsd_loss
nodes.summary: Computes the RMSD loss between predicted and target distributions as the distillation objective.

nodes.name: check_plateau
nodes.summary: Checks whether the metric has plateaued over the patience window and signals early-stop.

nodes.name: roaring_membership.rs
nodes.summary: Custom Roaring-style two-level bitmap for region membership (accept/reject/maybe) that switches between sorted-array and bit-container representations based on cardinality, plus batching helpers.
nodes.languageNotes: Mimics Roaring's two-level layout without external deps: Array(Vec<u16>) for sparse (<4096 bits) and Bits(Box<[u64;1024]>) for dense chunks, with cardinality-driven promotion.

nodes.name: BitmapContainer
nodes.summary: Container for one 65536-key chunk: either sorted Array(Vec<u16>) or dense Bits(Box<[u64;1024]>).

nodes.name: BitmapContainerIter
nodes.summary: Enum-based iterator over a BitmapContainer avoiding Box<dyn Iterator> allocations per container.

nodes.name: CompactBitmap
nodes.summary: Top-level compact bitmap holding multiple containers with insert/contains/iter/set-difference and union operations.

nodes.name: RoaringBatching
nodes.summary: Batching helper that groups multiple membership bitmaps for vectorized accept/reject/refine operations.

nodes.name: RoaringMembership
nodes.summary: Facade over multiple CompactBitmaps providing accept-count, reject-count, and diff operations for the multiplexed decoder.

nodes.name: insert
nodes.summary: Inserts a key into a BitmapContainer, promoting from Array to Bits when cardinality crosses the Roaring threshold.

nodes.name: contains
nodes.summary: Membership test dispatching to sorted-array or bit lookup depending on container variant.

nodes.name: maybe_promote
nodes.summary: Promotes an Array container to a Bits container once cardinality exceeds the Roaring spec threshold.

nodes.name: difference
nodes.summary: Computes the set difference between two CompactBitmaps, returning keys present in self but not other.

nodes.name: roaring_accept_tokens
nodes.summary: Returns the set of accepted tokens by intersecting the membership bitmaps with the candidate set.

nodes.name: rosetta.rs
nodes.summary: Universal cross-domain meta-pruner (Plan 201) that mines agreement concepts across multiple ConstraintPruners via a papaya lock-free HashMap, with a fast O(1) lookup path when all pruners agree and a slow majority-vote fallback when they disagree.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses papaya lock-free HashMap; gated behind the `rosetta_pruner` feature flag.

nodes.name: rule_extractor.rs
nodes.summary: DDTree path-to-rule extractor (Plan 209 T2) that walks an AND-OR tree forest and emits the top-K highest-scoring paths as FOL-like logical rules, deduplicating near-duplicates via Hamming distance.
nodes.languageNotes: Hamming-distance deduplication keeps the rule set canonical.

nodes.name: safe_phased.rs
nodes.summary: PrudentBanker safe-phased bandit state (Plan 137) implementing delay-calibrated phased aggression that mixes an active learner with a safe baseline arm, escalating exploration only when accumulated evidence certifies the baseline is suboptimal.
nodes.languageNotes: Phase transitions (warm-up → certify → exploit) are driven by regret-budget formulas; supports soft/hard restart.

nodes.name: self_advantage.rs
nodes.summary: Self-advantage computation from latent recursion pre/post logits (Plan 283, distilled from arXiv:2511.16886): a single model run twice yields a log-ratio self-improvement signal with no teacher or value function, plus BLAKE3-hashed accumulator snapshots for freeze/thaw.
nodes.languageNotes: Math mirrors SDPG's centered_log_ratio but sources both distributions from the same model's two passes.

nodes.name: self_distilling_bandit.rs
nodes.summary: Episode-guided self-distilling pruner bandit (Plan 208) that wraps any BanditPruner with a per-domain Q-table, blending match-ratio reward (generated vs reference) with acceptance reward to update arm preferences per prompt hash.
nodes.languageNotes: Domain-keyed Q-table enables per-prompt-hash specialization; convergence metrics track warm-domain count.

nodes.name: self_refining.rs
nodes.summary: Self-refining pruner (Plan 214 P2) tracking per-slot TP/TN/FP/FN accuracy and applying sigmoid-based threshold adjustment plus topology pruning/expansion, bounded by TED-Lite divergence from the golden reference.
nodes.languageNotes: Feature-gated under `coexplain_pruner`; uses ted_lite::PrunerDivergence as a drift clamp.

nodes.name: skill_catalog.rs
nodes.summary: Progressive-disclosure skill registry holding lightweight SkillDescriptor entries in memory while full pruners load lazily on arm selection, reducing memory pressure when many skills are registered but few are active.
nodes.languageNotes: FileSkillLoader persists arm payloads under a base_dir for hot-swap reload.

nodes.name: skill_memory.rs
nodes.summary: Per-pruner append-only ring buffer (MUSE learn stage) for experience accumulation, bounded to power-of-2 capacity with O(1) atomic-cursor append and O(k) recent-k retrieval, plus blake3-hashed freeze/thaw for persistence.
nodes.languageNotes: FrozenPrunerMemory validates blake3 integrity on thaw to detect tampering.

nodes.name: skill_test.rs
nodes.summary: Test-gated registration suite (MUSE validate stage) with multiple gate implementations — BomberTestGate (known-death states), SimpleTestGate, WasmTestGate (sandbox safety), and NoveltyTestGate — that a pruner arm must pass before promotion.
nodes.languageNotes: SandboxVerdict encodes a structured allow/deny decision rather than a boolean.

nodes.name: soft_reject.rs
nodes.summary: SoftReject sigmoid-graded relax-and-retry caller (Plan 310 T1.4) that consumes a pruner's reject_confidence and routes borderline candidates through a relaxed retry pass, exploiting the empirical fact that false-reject cost exceeds false-pass cost.
nodes.languageNotes: RelaxationStrategy trait lets callers plug in NoRelaxation for strict mode.

nodes.name: ss_pruner.rs
nodes.summary: SemiseparablePruner (Plan 263 Phase 3) exploiting diagonal SSM structure: precomputes the cumulative decay-product influence cache at construction so is_valid becomes a zero-allocation O(1) slice lookup that prunes branches whose cumulative influence has dropped below threshold.
nodes.languageNotes: Separates construction-time O(seq_len) precomputation from query-time O(1) validation.

nodes.name: continuation.rs
nodes.summary: Modelless OPD analogue (Plan 142): the ContinuationScorer trait lets game-specific validators score short validated continuations from student-sampled prefixes with no model required — validity is checked by game rules alone.
nodes.languageNotes: Trait-based design: each game implements its own validator; beam_score ranks prefixes.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: state_source package barrel (Plan 142 + 143) re-exporting the modelless OPD analogue components: ContinuationScorer, PUCBSelector, RetentionMetric, and StateVisitationTracker.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust mod.rs barrel: declares submodules and re-exports their primary types.

nodes.name: pucb_selector.rs
nodes.summary: Generic P-UCB selector distilled from AlphaProof Nexus (arXiv:2605.22763, Plan 143 Phase 2) that balances exploitation (high Elo) with exploration (low visits) via an upper confidence bound on normalized scores, with adaptive exploration constant annealed by solve rate.
nodes.languageNotes: Adaptive_c lowers exploration once solve_rate exceeds 50%.

nodes.name: retention.rs
nodes.summary: Retention metric for GOAT proofs: computes entropy and exp(-KL(post || baseline)) to quantify how much of the baseline action diversity is preserved by a method (1.0 = perfect retention, → 0 as divergence grows).
nodes.languageNotes: KL terms with zero probabilities are skipped to avoid log(0).

nodes.name: visitation.rs
nodes.summary: State-visitation entropy tracker for bandit rollouts: counts blake3 prefix hashes of visited states and reports entropy-based coverage metrics with a configurable coverage_threshold for exploration-boost signalling.
nodes.languageNotes: Zero-cost when the caller never invokes observe.

nodes.name: step_attribution_qualifier.rs
nodes.summary: Step-attribution Δ-qualification primitive (Plan 381, Research 381) — generic modelless instantiation of SkillAdaptor's eq. 8: commits a candidate state K+ iff Δ = E[M(q;K+)] - E[M(q;K)] ≥ threshold, with pluggable ReplayExecutor, ScoreAggregator (sum/mean), and StepLocalizer (dot-product with sigmoid floor) strategies.
nodes.languageNotes: Strategy pattern: SumAggregator/MeanAggregator and DotProductLocalizer compose into the qualifier.

nodes.name: stepcode.rs
nodes.summary: Intra-trajectory reward shaping distilled from StepCodeReasoner (arXiv:2605.11922): after DDTree verification, computes shaped rewards per arm based on how many subsequent arms were also correct, preserving the paper properties that only correct arms get non-zero reward and enabling arms get boosted.
nodes.languageNotes: Paper Eq. 11 adapted to discrete arm sequences rather than continuous logits.

nodes.name: RosettaPruner
nodes.summary: The Rosetta universal meta-pruner type holding the inner pruner slice, threshold, and concept-mining scratch state; impl block provides mine_concepts, batch_is_valid, lookup_concept, and relevance scoring.

nodes.name: ExtractedRule
nodes.summary: A single FOL-like extracted rule with conditions (token-indexed path), action, score, and support count.

nodes.name: RuleExtractor
nodes.summary: Top-K rule extractor with configurable top_k and min_score; walks TreeNode forests via PathAccumulator/WalkState and deduplicates via hamming_distance.

nodes.name: SafePhasedState
nodes.summary: State machine for the PrudentBanker safe-phased bandit: tracks phase, alpha, regret_budget, delay_estimate, and phase_gap with precision-gated alpha mixing, soft/hard restart, and select_with_safe_mixture.

nodes.name: AdvantageMarginGate
nodes.summary: Margin-threshold gate deciding whether to recurse on a candidate based on self_advantage_margin between pre/post logits.

nodes.name: AdvantageDirectionAccumulator
nodes.summary: Maintains an exponentially-weighted direction vector updated from per-step advantages, with snapshot/restore via BLAKE3-hashed blobs for freeze/thaw.

nodes.name: DomainQTable
nodes.summary: Per-domain-keyed Q-table tracking per-arm rewards with a min_domain_samples warm-up threshold before domain specialization kicks in.

nodes.name: SelfDistillingBandit
nodes.summary: BanditPruner wrapper that runs episode_update after generation, blending match-ratio reward with acceptance reward and routing updates through the inner bandit and DomainQTable.

nodes.name: PrunerAccuracy
nodes.summary: Per-slot TP/TN/FP/FN confusion accumulator exposing precision, recall, f1, and acceptance_rate used to drive threshold_adjustment and topology action decisions.

nodes.name: SkillCatalog
nodes.summary: Progressive-disclosure skill registry: holds SkillDescriptors in memory, lazily loads full pruners on arm selection via a pluggable LazySkillLoader, and tracks active_count status.

nodes.name: PrunerMemory
nodes.summary: Power-of-2 bounded append-only ring buffer accumulating per-pruner MemoryEntry records with O(1) atomic-cursor append, O(k) recent-k retrieval, and pruner identity hash for tamper detection.

nodes.name: FrozenPrunerMemory
nodes.summary: Portable freeze/thaw envelope for PrunerMemory with blake3 integrity hash, validate-on-thaw, and save_to/load_from helpers for cross-session persistence.

nodes.name: BomberTestGate
nodes.summary: Test gate validating pruner arms against known-death and known-safe bomber states with configurable min_coverage; promote-on-pass.

nodes.name: WasmTestGate
nodes.summary: WASM-target test gate that runs sandbox_check on each test case and produces a structured SandboxVerdict (allow/deny) rather than a bare boolean.

nodes.name: NoveltyTestGate
nodes.summary: Test gate that validates a candidate's scores against existing score distributions to ensure novelty, blocking promotion of redundant arms.

nodes.name: SoftRejectConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for soft-reject decisions holding tau_low and tau_high sigmoid bounds that separate hard-accept, soft-reject (retry), and hard-reject regions of reject_confidence.

nodes.name: SemiseparablePruner
nodes.summary: Cumulative-influence constraint pruner precomputing decay-product influence_cache at construction so is_valid is O(1) slice lookup; exposes influence_at and manifold_score for downstream scoring.

nodes.name: ContinuationScorer
nodes.summary: Trait for modelless continuation scoring: game-specific validators implement is_valid_step, n_actions, score_continuations, and beam_score to rank student-sampled prefixes without any model.

nodes.name: PUCBSelector
nodes.summary: Generic P-UCB selector balancing normalized-score exploitation against visit-count exploration with adaptive_c annealing based on solve_rate; returns top-K items from any (id, score, visits) population.

nodes.name: RetentionMetric
nodes.summary: GOAT-proof retention metric capturing baseline/post entropy and exp(-KL(post||baseline)) retention ratio in a single Copy struct.

nodes.name: StateVisitationTracker
nodes.summary: Hashmap-backed state-visitation counter reporting entropy and coverage_ok against a coverage_threshold for bandit rollout exploration signalling.

nodes.name: StepAttributionQualifier
nodes.summary: Generic Δ-qualifier composing a ReplayExecutor, ScoreAggregator, and threshold to decide whether a candidate mutation K+ improves expected measurement over the baseline K.

nodes.name: DotProductLocalizer
nodes.summary: Step localizer that localizes responsibility via dot-product of trajectory deltas against score directions, with a configurable projection floor and stable_sigmoid normalization.

nodes.name: WasmTestGateAdapter
nodes.summary: Adapter wrapping the skill_test WasmTestGate as a StepAttributionQualifier-style threshold-based qualifier between baseline and candidate average rewards.

nodes.name: ShapedPath
nodes.summary: StepCodeReasoner-shaped reward path applying per-arm shaped rewards to bandit, delta-bandit, and absorb layers based on downstream-correct arm counts.

nodes.name: substrate_ddtree.rs
nodes.summary: SubstrateGate DDTree integration (Plan 216 T6-T7) extending branch scoring with substrate recovery: score = logprob × sigmoid(recovery) × constraint_validity, enabling capability-routed speculative decoding where each branch can specify a capability name and use a different SubstrateMask.
nodes.languageNotes: Branch-level capability mask selection differentiates this from scalar scoring.

nodes.name: substrate_execution.rs
nodes.summary: SubstrateGate dual-sparsity execution (Plan 216 T4-T5): intersects the ReLU-active channel set with the substrate mask before the w2 down-projection, then routes the resulting sparse matmul through CPU sparse, GPU batched, or auto-selected paths based on workload and hardware.
nodes.languageNotes: Auto-router picks CPU sparse vs GPU batched based on gpu_available and n_branches heuristics.

nodes.name: substrate_loader.rs
nodes.summary: SubstrateGate mask loader (Plan 216 T9-T10) for the `.mask` binary format: magic bytes + version + postcard-serialized payload with per-layer packed bitmasks, recovery score, capability name, model ID, and BLAKE3 hash for provenance integrity.
nodes.languageNotes: Postcard encoding keeps masks compact; blake3 guards against silent corruption.

nodes.name: substrate_pruner.rs
nodes.summary: SubstrateGate ScreeningPruner extension (Plan 216 T8) using substrate mask activation concentration as a relevance signal — tokens aligning with active substrate channels get sigmoid-gated higher relevance (never softmax).
nodes.languageNotes: Builder pattern (SubstratePrunerBuilder) configures sigmoid center/steepness fluently.

nodes.name: substrate_types.rs
nodes.summary: Core SubstrateGate types — SubstrateMask (per-layer channel bitmask with active-count, intersection, and blake3-hashed identity), SubstrateRouter trait with NoOp/Simple implementations, and SubstrateConfig validation.
nodes.languageNotes: Intersect operation produces a recovery-scored combined mask for dual-sparsity pipelines.

nodes.name: sudoku_pruner.rs
nodes.summary: Sudoku constraint pruner mapping DDTree depth to (row, col) and validating drafted digits against Sudoku row/col/box rules; provides MRV-based empty-cell ordering and latent marginal lookahead, gated behind the `sudoku` feature.
nodes.languageNotes: Bridges speculative decoding to a Deterministic Validator via the Sudoku9x9 board.

nodes.name: symbolic_expression.rs
nodes.summary: Symbolic expression distillation (EQL analogue without training): greedy forward selection with sparsity budget fits a SymbolicExpression (sum of basis × coefficient terms) to accept/reject labels recorded via TraceRecorder, serializable to/from bytes.
nodes.languageNotes: from_bytes/to_bytes round-trip enables frozen expression shipping.

nodes.name: tactical_pruner.rs
nodes.summary: Grid-based tactical puzzle constraint pruner: deterministic rules engine for wall collisions, monsters with item drops, locked treasures requiring inventory, and a goal locked until all treasures are collected — used with DDTree as a pure A*/Best-First search engine.
nodes.languageNotes: apply_action + replay_state support deterministic re-simulation for search.

nodes.name: ted_lite.rs
nodes.summary: TED-Lite divergence metric (Plan 214 P1) measuring pruner drift from a golden reference: threshold divergence (L1 over threshold vectors) and topology divergence (Hamming over branch existence), bounded by a configurable lambda_t clamp.
nodes.languageNotes: clamp_adjustment caps proposed deltas to bound drift; emit_diagnostic logs periodic snapshots.

nodes.name: thicket_variance_probe.rs
nodes.summary: Thicket Variance Probe (TVP, Plan 267 / Research 235) — lifts Neural Thickets' variance-structure insight from weight-space to decoding-config-space, sampling K cheap probe perturbations of inference knobs (temperature, top-p, drafter seed, KV noise) and aggregating their disagreement into substrate-tier promotion/demotion signals.
nodes.languageNotes: TvpProbeCountBandit picks K adaptively; TvpSignalFrozen supports freeze/thaw of thresholds.

nodes.name: three_mode_bandit.rs
nodes.summary: Three-mode neuro-symbolic bandit router (Plan 211): UCB1 bandit over L4R/R4L/LR modes with sigmoid-gated mixing, selecting the dominant mode per decode step from constraint density, marginal entropy, episode hit rate, and verification history.
nodes.languageNotes: ModeFeatures.with_grounding feeds pruned-vs-unpruned deltas into context_boost.

nodes.name: trajectory_doctor.rs
nodes.summary: TrajectoryDoctor (Plan 223 Phase 3) for failure localization in DDTree paths: BracketTrajectoryDoctor does bracket-depth bisection, HoareTrajectoryDoctor uses HoarePruner predicates, and FailureEpisodeStore persists failure sites indexed by prompt hash for flywheel learning.
nodes.languageNotes: Two strategies share the localize_failure API via the TrajectoryDoctor trait.

nodes.name: trial_log.rs
nodes.summary: Trial persistence for heuristic learning: records every bandit episode as length-prefixed binary (postcard) for offline analysis, absorb-compress decisions, and regression testing, with SharedTrialLog providing an Arc-Mutex cloneable handle.
nodes.languageNotes: summary aggregation produces TrialSummary for review metrics dashboards.

nodes.name: variance_minimizer.rs
nodes.summary: Variance-minimized schedule optimizer (RePlaid Prop 1 adaptation): tracks per-step scalar cost online and adapts a schedule parameter to flatten Monte-Carlo variance of per-timestep loss, yielding a constant-difficulty schedule with no teacher and no gradients.
nodes.languageNotes: observe_and_adapt fuses observation and adaptation into a single call site.

nodes.name: vr_loop.rs
nodes.summary: Verify-Refine loop driver (Plan 206): iterative generate → verify → extract-failures → re-generate loop where each round the generator produces candidates, the verifier checks them, and failure patterns are extracted into SynthesizedConstraints for the next round, bounded by max_rounds.
nodes.languageNotes: VrVerifier / VrGenerator traits decouple the loop from concrete model implementations.

nodes.name: wealth_bandit.rs
nodes.summary: WealthBanditPruner — economic bandit arms via Hayek market selection (modelless): arms accumulate wealth from rewards, spend wealth on bids, bankrupt arms get rebirthed from successful arm mutations, and ChainCreditAssigner distributes delayed chain-level rewards across a sliding window of arm pulls.
nodes.languageNotes: Rebirth mechanism injects exploration when arms go bankrupt; rent charge prevents wealth hoarding.

nodes.name: workflow_lattice.rs
nodes.summary: WorkflowLattice (Plan 223 Phase 4): builds a lattice of predicates with implication ordering and sigmoid-graded satisfaction that propagates incrementally across DDTree levels, exposed as a ScreeningPruner.
nodes.languageNotes: propagate_level pushes satisfaction scores through implication edges level-by-level.

nodes.name: SubstrateBranch
nodes.summary: DDTree branch carrying a capability_name, mask, logprob, and constraint_validity; score combines logprob with sigmoid(recovery) and validity for capability-routed speculative decoding.

nodes.name: SubstrateExecutionContext
nodes.summary: Execution context binding a SubstrateRouter to apply_substrate_mask pipelines, with select_for_sequence + apply_to_layer glue and CPU/GPU/auto routing.

nodes.name: SubstrateMaskFile
nodes.summary: Portable `.mask` binary envelope: magic bytes, version, postcard payload, and blake3 provenance hash for round-trip save/load of SubstrateMasks.

nodes.name: SubstrateScreeningPruner
nodes.summary: ScreeningPruner using substrate mask activation concentration as a sigmoid-gated relevance signal — tokens aligned with active substrate channels score higher.

nodes.name: SubstratePrunerBuilder
nodes.summary: Builder for SubstrateScreeningPruner configuring mask, sigmoid_center, and sigmoid_steepness before build().

nodes.name: SubstrateMask
nodes.summary: Per-layer channel bitmask with active_count/active_ratio, set/get, intersect (recovery-scored), layer_bitmask, and blake3-hashed identity for provenance.

nodes.name: SubstrateRouter
nodes.summary: Trait for selecting a SubstrateMask per (tokens, config); implementations include NoSubstrateRouter and SimpleSubstrateRouter.

nodes.name: SudokuPruner
nodes.summary: Constraint pruner bridging DDTree depth to (row, col) on a 9x9 board, validating drafted digits against row/col/box rules with MRV ordering and latent_marginals lookahead.

nodes.name: SymbolicExpression
nodes.summary: Compact polynomial expression (sum of basis × coefficient terms) with evaluate, to_string (named features), and to_bytes/from_bytes round-trip for portable shipping.

nodes.name: SymbolicExpressionFitter
nodes.summary: Greedy forward-selection fitter with sparsity budget that fits a SymbolicExpression to a TraceDataset of accept/reject labels, minimizing mean squared error.

nodes.name: TraceRecorder
nodes.summary: Recorder accumulating (depth, token_idx, features, scores, accepted) tuples into a TraceDataset for offline fitting by the SymbolicExpressionFitter.

nodes.name: TacticalPruner
nodes.summary: Grid-based tactical puzzle constraint pruner with terrain costs, action application, and replay_state for deterministic re-simulation during A*/Best-First DDTree search.

nodes.name: PrunerDivergence
nodes.summary: TED-Lite divergence metric computing threshold (L1) and topology (Hamming) divergence against a golden reference, with clamp_adjustment to bound drift and emit_diagnostic for periodic snapshots.

nodes.name: TvpAggregator
nodes.summary: Aggregator combining K probe outputs into a TvpSignal via max_token_share, max_format_share, and mean_pairwise_kl statistics over the probe distribution.

nodes.name: TvpThresholdAdapter
nodes.summary: Threshold adapter that observes signal/correct outcomes and adjusts promote_at / demote_at tier boundaries over time, resettable to a fresh config.

nodes.name: TvpProbeCountBandit
nodes.summary: Bandit selecting the number of probes K to run per decode based on per-K reward pull history, trading probe cost against signal quality.

nodes.name: ThreeModeBandit
nodes.summary: UCB1 bandit over L4R/R4L/LR neuro-symbolic modes with sigmoid-gated mixing, selecting the dominant mode per decode step from ModeFeatures and updating rewards via update(mode, reward).

nodes.name: HoareTrajectoryDoctor
nodes.summary: Predicate-based trajectory doctor using Hoare-style precondition/postcondition checks to localize the first violating depth in a DDTree path.

nodes.name: BracketTrajectoryDoctor
nodes.summary: Bracket-depth trajectory doctor localizing the first failure depth via bracket bisection up to max_depth, without requiring predicates.

nodes.name: TrialLog
nodes.summary: Length-prefixed binary trial logger recording TrialRecord episodes with append, flush, count, summary, and load helpers; integrates review-metrics side channels.

nodes.name: SharedTrialLog
nodes.summary: Arc-Mutex cloneable handle around TrialLog enabling concurrent append/flush/count from multiple bandit drivers.

nodes.name: VarianceMinimizer
nodes.summary: Online variance-minimized schedule optimizer tracking per-step cost statistics and adapting a schedule parameter to flatten Monte-Carlo variance, with reset and inspect helpers.

nodes.name: VrLoop
nodes.summary: Verify-Refine loop driver composing a VrGenerator and VrVerifier with max_rounds/seq_len/candidates_per_round tuning, extracting SynthesizedConstraints from per-round feedback.

nodes.name: WealthArm
nodes.summary: Per-arm economic state: wealth, Q-value, pull count, with is_bankrupt check and rebirth_from(parent) mutation to spawn successor arms from successful parents.

nodes.name: WealthBanditPruner
nodes.summary: ScreeningPruner wrapping bandit arms with wealth-based selection: rent charges, bankruptcy-triggered rebirth, episode bookkeeping, and wealth_score relevance scoring.

nodes.name: ChainCreditAssigner
nodes.summary: Sliding-window credit assigner distributing delayed chain-level rewards back across the arm pulls that produced them.

nodes.name: WorkflowLattice
nodes.summary: Lattice of PredicateNodes with implication ordering; propagate pushes sigmoid-graded satisfaction level-by-level and exposes overall_satisfaction as a ScreeningPruner relevance signal.

nodes.name: forward.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the ForwardForAcPrefix trait abstracting how AC-prefix augmented sequences are forwarded through a model, plus helpers that drive conditional log-prob and sampling via any such forwarder.
nodes.languageNotes: Trait with two required methods (forward_for_ac_prefix, forward_logits_at) plus free helper functions that bound the trait object — a common Rust pattern for abstracting inference backends.

nodes.name: ForwardForAcPrefix
nodes.summary: Trait that any inference backend implements to expose logits over AC-prefix-augmented token sequences at a specific position.

nodes.name: conditional_logprob_via
nodes.summary: Computes the conditional log-probability of the prefix's target token by delegating logits lookup to a ForwardForAcPrefix implementor.

nodes.name: conditional_sample_via
nodes.summary: Samples a token from the conditional distribution induced by forwarding the AC-prefix through the supplied forwarder, using the provided RNG.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel for the ac_prefix subsystem — re-exports the ForwardForAcPrefix trait, helpers, and the AcPrefix / AcPrefixMask types.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Core data model for AC-prefix (attends-conditional) augmentation: the AcPrefix carrier, its dedup-aware mask, attention predicates, and conditional log-prob / Gumbel-max sampling routines.
nodes.languageNotes: Mixes struct/enum types with inherent impl blocks — Rust idiom of grouping a type and its domain logic in one module.

nodes.name: AcPrefix
nodes.summary: Holds the base token slice plus the list of conditioning positions that define an AC-prefix augmented sequence.

nodes.name: AcPrefixMask
nodes.summary: Bit-packed attention mask materialized from an AcPrefix, supporting both dedup and rule-based materialization strategies.

nodes.name: conditional_logprob
nodes.summary: Computes the conditional log-prob of the prefix's target by constructing augmented tokens, invoking the forwarder, and reading off the correct logits row.

nodes.name: conditional_sample
nodes.summary: Draws a token from the conditional distribution over the AC-prefix target, using Gumbel-max sampling for categorical correctness.

nodes.name: gumbel_max_sample
nodes.summary: Performs a numerically stable Gumbel-max draw over a logits slice, returning the sampled index without computing a full softmax.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel for the algebra subsystem, currently re-exporting the tropical semiring implementation.

nodes.name: tropical.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the tropical (max-plus) semiring: matrix-vector products, exterior derivative, codifferential, and line integrals over the resulting idempotent algebra, with a NEON-accelerated fast path.
nodes.languageNotes: Contains both a portable scalar path and an explicit NEON SIMD path (neon_tropical_row_max_sum) gated by target_feature — typical Rust pattern for ARM-specific inference kernels.

nodes.name: tropical_matvec_into
nodes.summary: Computes the tropical (max-plus) matrix-vector product y_i = max_j (W_ij + x_j) in row-major form, writing into a caller-supplied buffer.

nodes.name: neon_tropical_row_max_sum
nodes.summary: NEON SIMD kernel that computes the per-row max-plus reduction in four-lane batches, used as the inner loop of tropical_matvec_into on ARM targets.

nodes.name: tropical_exterior_derivative
nodes.summary: Computes the tropical exterior derivative of an input form, yielding the max-plus analog of the classical d operator used in discrete differential geometry.

nodes.name: tropical_codifferential
nodes.summary: Computes the tropical codifferential — the adjoint of the tropical exterior derivative under the max-plus inner product.

nodes.name: alloc.rs
nodes.summary: Global allocator wrapper that tracks live bytes and allocation counts, exposing reset/get_alloc_stats helpers used by benchmarks and inference cost accounting.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements the std::alloc::GlobalAlloc trait — wrapping the system allocator with atomic counters is a common Rust instrumentation pattern.

nodes.name: TrackingAllocator
nodes.summary: Zero-overhead GlobalAlloc wrapper that increments atomic byte/count statistics on every alloc and dealloc, delegating the real work to the system allocator.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel for the AND-OR goal decomposition subsystem, re-exporting the AndOrNode type and its constructors.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Defines AndOrNode — the recursive goal tree used by the inference planner — with full traversal, marking, statistics, and Display pretty-printing of solved/unsolved branches.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a single recursive enum (Or/And/Leaf variants) with inherent impl rather than separate node types — typical Rust sum-type modeling for trees.

nodes.name: AndOrNode
nodes.summary: Recursive enum representing a node in an AND-OR goal decomposition tree: OR branches seek any solved child, AND branches require all children solved, leaves carry a goal plus an optional solution.

nodes.name: is_solved
nodes.summary: Recursively determines whether a node is solved: a leaf checks its own solution, an OR node requires at least one solved child, an AND node requires all children solved.

nodes.name: fmt
nodes.summary: Display impl that pretty-prints an AND-OR tree with indentation, marking solved and unsolved branches for human inspection of the inference plan.

nodes.name: ane_roofline.rs
nodes.summary: Apple Neural Engine roofline cost model: detects the ANE family, exposes per-family peak FLOPs/bandwidth, and estimates per-op runtime, working-set bound, and dispatch floor for GEMV/GEMM/Conv3x3 shapes.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy use of enums with associated data (AneBound, AneCost, Device) and enum_dispatch-style impls on the enums themselves — a common Rust pattern for closed variant sets.

nodes.name: AneFamily
nodes.summary: Enum of supported Apple Neural Engine generations (A11 legacy through A18), with runtime detection from the host CPU model identifier.

nodes.name: AnePeaks
nodes.summary: Captures the roofline peak parameters (compute TFLOPS, memory bandwidth, dispatch floor, working set threshold, ridge point) for one ANE family, with constructors for each supported generation.

nodes.name: AneOpShape
nodes.summary: Describes a candidate op (GEMV, GEMM, 3x3 conv, or elementwise) by its flops, bytes moved, largest operand, and minimum ANE family required — the inputs to the cost estimator.

nodes.name: AneCost
nodes.summary: Result of an ANE cost estimate: runtime in ms, the binding regime (compute/memory/working-set/dispatch/family-gated), plus the flops and bytes that produced it, and a CPU-vs-ANE-vs-GPU device recommendation.

nodes.name: ane_estimate
nodes.summary: Core roofline estimator that combines AneOpShape and AnePeaks into an AneCost, classifying the op as compute-bound, memory-bound, working-set-bound, or below the ANE dispatch floor.

nodes.name: candidate.rs
nodes.summary: ARG Protocol Step C: defines the typed offline candidate — the structural delta (Split/Merge/Edge/Taxonomy/NewNode/RegistryDedup) plus its target label, before/after state, and evidence references.

nodes.name: CandidateKind
nodes.summary: Enum of the six structural candidate kinds the ARG protocol permits, each carrying whether it mints a new label or retires an existing one.

nodes.name: TypedOfflineCandidate
nodes.summary: Pairs a CandidateIntent (the structural delta) with its computed score, the unit the ARG scorer produces and the registry may auto-commit.

nodes.name: bare
nodes.summary: Constructs a TypedOfflineCandidate with zero score directly from a kind, target label, and evidence reference slice — skipping the full intent envelope.

nodes.name: lifecycle.rs
nodes.summary: ARG Protocol Step E: LifecycleState (Active/Shadow/Deprecated/Removed) and RedirectTable preserving episodic-record interpretability under label split/merge.

nodes.name: RedirectTable
nodes.summary: Persistent map from retired label id to its replacement, supporting transitive redirect chains so historical episodes remain queryable after split/merge.

nodes.name: insert_redirect
nodes.summary: Registers a (old_id -> new_id) redirect, detecting and rejecting cycles that would create infinite redirect chains.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: ARG Protocol module root — declares the six primitive submodules (candidate, lifecycle, policy, registry, scorer, taxonomy) and re-exports their public types.

nodes.name: policy.rs
nodes.summary: ARG Protocol Step 1 hard gate: PolicyEnvelope combining PolicyState, ResponseMode, and PolicyConstraints, with evaluate() that maps a requested label to a Continue/Refocus/Stop decision.

nodes.name: PolicyEnvelope
nodes.summary: Aggregate of PolicyState, PolicyConstraints, and ResponseMode — the full runtime policy bundle consulted at every inference step.

nodes.name: PolicyDecision
nodes.summary: Outcome of a policy evaluation: a ShouldProceed (Continue/Refocus/Stop) plus the constraints that must be enforced if execution proceeds.

nodes.name: evaluate
nodes.summary: Core gate logic: given a requested label, consults forbidden/allowed lists, max-hops, max-depth, and max-complexity limits to produce a PolicyDecision.

nodes.name: registry.rs
nodes.summary: ARG Protocol Steps 9+C: InfoRegistry implementing two-phase dedup with a primary InfoKey index plus a secondary payload-hash collision index and grey-zone review scratch space.

nodes.name: InfoRegistry
nodes.summary: Two-index store (by InfoKey and by payload hash) for InfoUnits, exposing canonicalize_with to dedup incoming units against existing entries with grey-zone review.

nodes.name: InfoUnit
nodes.summary: Single registered information unit: its key, payload hash, information-theoretic content, outcome status, provenance, and timestamp.

nodes.name: canonicalize_with
nodes.summary: Two-phase dedup core: looks up the unit by primary key, then falls back to payload-hash comparison; ambiguous matches go into the grey-zone scratch for human/async review.

nodes.name: scorer.rs
nodes.summary: ARG Protocol Step C scorer: OfflineCandidateScorer combining nominal gain, evidence-weighted confidence, and the G5 silence-bias penalty into a single score with an auto-commit threshold.

nodes.name: OfflineCandidateScorer
nodes.summary: Stateless scorer that maps a TypedOfflineCandidate and its evidence slice to a single score, applying the lambda-weighted silence-bias penalty and exposing can_auto_commit against a configurable threshold.

nodes.name: ScoredCandidate
nodes.summary: Pairs a candidate with its computed score, gain components, nominal gain, and silence penalty — the artifact the registry consumes for auto-commit decisions.

nodes.name: taxonomy.rs
nodes.summary: ARG Protocol Step 3: TaxonomyNode tree plus LabelSet and TaxonomyValidator that deterministically validate a candidate label set, producing rejections for missing parents, incompatible siblings, and removed labels.

nodes.name: TaxonomyValidator
nodes.summary: Holds the taxonomy node slice and exposes validate_label_set plus expand_ascending to produce the deterministic L_final label set the protocol requires.

nodes.name: LabelSet
nodes.summary: Ordered set of LabelIds with insert/remove and dedup, the working structure used during label-set validation and expansion.

nodes.name: validate_label_set
nodes.summary: Deterministic validation of a candidate label set against the taxonomy: every label must exist, not be removed, have a present parent, and not conflict with declared incompatibilities.

nodes.name: attention.rs
nodes.summary: Tiled multi-head attention forward pass with optional sigmoid softmax, attention-score capture, batched dispatch, and a portable fallback for shapes that exceed the tiled fast path.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a tile-loop nest with explicit scratch buffers; tiled_attention_inner is the hot kernel and attention_fallback is the conservative reference path.

nodes.name: tiled_attention_inner
nodes.summary: Inner Q*K*V tile kernel that walks query/key/value tiles, accumulates scaled scores, applies the softmax (or sigmoid variant), and writes one output tile.

nodes.name: tiled_attention_batched
nodes.summary: Top-level entry point that fans tiled attention across a (batch, heads, seq, head_dim) tensor, dispatching each head through the tiled fast path or the conservative fallback based on shape.

nodes.name: attention_fallback
nodes.summary: Portable reference attention path used when the tiled kernel cannot handle the requested shape — slower but correct for arbitrary seq_len/head_dim.

nodes.name: commitment.rs
nodes.summary: BLAKE3-based commitment newtype over compressed codec bytes — the independently-retained primitive left after the LatCal chain bridge (Plan 331 G2) was closed as moot.

nodes.name: BabelCommitment
nodes.summary: Wrap type over a 32-byte BLAKE3 digest of compressed codec output, with constructors from raw bytes, equality/matches checks, and a zero sentinel.

nodes.name: fixed_rule.rs
nodes.summary: Deterministic BT-P8 fixed-rule text codec (Plan 331, Research 312) — parses BabelTele records (KG triples, attributes, configs, conditionals, comparisons, pipelines) into a typed AST and emits a bijective compressed or verbose form.
nodes.languageNotes: Hand-written recursive descent parser (parse_line dispatches by line prefix) — no external parser combinator dependency.

nodes.name: FixedRuleTextCodec
nodes.summary: Stateful codec that parses text into a BabelAst and emits compressed or verbose bytes, tracking the last compression ratio and BLAKE3 commitment.

nodes.name: BabelRecord
nodes.summary: Sum type of the seven BabelTele record kinds (Section, Attribute, Config, Pipeline, Conditional, Exception, Comparison) plus a Raw escape hatch for unsupported lines.

nodes.name: parse_line
nodes.summary: Single-line parser dispatcher: inspects the leading token of a BabelTele line and routes to the appropriate record parser (Section/Attribute/Config/Conditional/Exception/Comparison/Pipeline).

nodes.name: emit_record_compressed
nodes.summary: Serializes one BabelRecord into the compact binary wire form, writing tag byte plus packed payload into the output buffer.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: BabelCodec module root — defines the generic BabelCodec trait (compress/decompress/last_ratio/commit/verify) and the BabelPair compressor+reader bundle that the fixed-rule and sigmoid-latent codecs implement.

nodes.name: BabelCodec
nodes.summary: Trait unifying the deterministic fixed-rule codec and the latent-projection codec behind a common compress/decompress/commit/verify interface.

nodes.name: BabelPair
nodes.summary: Bundles a BabelCodec compressor with its inverse reader — the analog of LoraPair from Plan 025.

nodes.name: sigmoid_latent.rs
nodes.summary: SigmoidLatentCodec — generic-trait facade over the existing DensityBudget latent-projection pattern (Plan 311, Research 133): top-k sparse projection of latent activations with sigmoid scoring, BLAKE3 commitment, and full reconstruct path.
nodes.languageNotes: Stable sigmoid implementation (overflow-guarded branching) — the project-wide squash choice per AGENTS.md (sigmoid NOT softmax).

nodes.name: SigmoidLatentCodec
nodes.summary: Top-k sparse latent codec parameterized by projection directions, bias, and softmax-style temperature tau — implements BabelCodec via compress/decompress/commit/verify over a CompressedLatent payload.

nodes.name: CompressedLatent
nodes.summary: Wire payload of a sigmoid-latent compression: top-k indices plus their sigmoid scores plus the retained length.

nodes.name: compress
nodes.summary: Projects the input latent through the codec directions, applies the stable sigmoid, selects the top-k retained components, and packs them into a CompressedLatent.

nodes.name: sigmoid
nodes.summary: Numerically stable logistic sigmoid with explicit overflow guard, the project-wide squash function.

nodes.name: best_belief.rs
nodes.summary: Best-Belief selection — closed-form Beta-Binomial posterior score with a fast lookup-table path for small (successes, failures) and a continued-fraction path for larger inputs, plus the supporting ln_gamma, incomplete beta, and inverse normal CDF primitives.
nodes.languageNotes: Includes both a LUT-based fast path and a continued-fraction (betacf) reference path — common numerical-rust pattern for trading memory for speed on small inputs.

nodes.name: best_belief_score_cf
nodes.summary: Reference continued-fraction path for the Beta-Binomial best-belief score, used when (successes, failures) exceed the LUT horizon.

nodes.name: select_best_belief
nodes.summary: Picks the candidate with the highest best-belief score using the Beta-Binomial posterior, optionally warm-started from an incumbent index.

nodes.name: betacf
nodes.summary: Lentz continued-fraction evaluation of the incomplete beta function — the inner numerical kernel powering the Beta-Binomial score.

nodes.name: inv_normal_cdf
nodes.summary: Inverse normal CDF via the Acklam algorithm — used to seed Newton/bisection in the best-belief confidence-interval path.

nodes.name: graph.rs
nodes.summary: TransitionGraph — CSR-style transition system with state list, edge slice, and a per-state adjacency index, plus a builder that deduplicates states and edges during construction.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses CSR (Compressed Sparse Row) layout via edge_index — a common Rust pattern for memory-tight graph storage.

nodes.name: TransitionGraph
nodes.summary: Immutable CSR-form transition system: states, edges (from/to/op triples), and a per-state index giving the edge-window for adjacency queries.

nodes.name: TransitionGraphBuilder
nodes.summary: Incremental builder that accumulates state and edge push calls, deduplicates via seen_states, and finalizes into a frozen TransitionGraph via build.

nodes.name: build
nodes.summary: Finalizes the builder: sorts edges, compacts the state list, and constructs the CSR edge_index that enables O(1) adjacency-window lookup per state.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Bisimulation module root — re-exports the transition graph, partition refinement, operator inference, planner, and supporting types that compose the symbolic bisimulation subsystem.

nodes.name: operator.rs
nodes.summary: OperatorSchema and infer_operators — infers the minimal operator set consistent with a bisimulation quotient, commits the schema via BLAKE3, and exposes cover checks plus the first spurious operator.

nodes.name: OperatorSchema
nodes.summary: Schema over inferred OperatorDefs plus a BLAKE3 commitment, with cover-verification and spurious-operator queries against a quotient.

nodes.name: infer_operators
nodes.summary: Scans a bisimulation quotient, derives the per-class transition preconditions/effects, and emits the minimal OperatorDef set that explains the observed transitions.

nodes.name: planner.rs
nodes.summary: Symbolic planner over a bisimulation quotient — BFS over state classes from start to goal, reconstructs the abstract plan, and replays it for verification.

nodes.name: plan
nodes.summary: BFS planner over the quotient graph from start to goal state class, returning the operator sequence that lifts back to a concrete plan via reconstruct_plan.

nodes.name: refine.rs
nodes.summary: Partition-refinement bisimulation: iteratively splits the state partition until each class is stable under the operator signature, then produces the quotient graph with canonical labels and a BLAKE3 commitment.

nodes.name: BisimulationQuotient
nodes.summary: Result of partition refinement: number of classes, the state-to-class map, quotient-level edges, and a BLAKE3 commitment over the canonical labeling.

nodes.name: partition_refine
nodes.summary: Core refinement loop — repeatedly splits each class by the multiset of (operator, target-class) signatures until a fixed point is reached, then canonicalizes labels and emits a BisimulationQuotient.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Bisimulation primitive types — StateId, StateClassId, OperatorLabel enum, Transition and QuotientEdge records, plus Hash writers that produce canonical BLAKE3 digests over states and classes.

nodes.name: StateId
nodes.summary: Newtype over the raw state identifier with a sentinel value, used throughout the bisimulation subsystem as a typed state handle.

nodes.name: Transition
nodes.summary: Concrete transition triple (from-state, to-state, operator-label) with total Ord for deterministic sorting during graph construction.

nodes.name: QuotientEdge
nodes.summary: Quotient-level edge triple (from-class, to-class, operator-label) — the post-refinement analog of Transition at the partition-class granularity.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Branch routing subsystem — PostCandidateRouter trait plus DotProductRouter, ColliderRouterAdapter, and PreservationScorer implementations that pick which child branch the inference should descend into, with argmax or perturbed-logistic sampling.

nodes.name: PostCandidateRouter
nodes.summary: Trait abstracting how a parent node routes to one of its candidate children — implementations provide both greedy argmax and temperature-sampled selection.

nodes.name: DotProductRouter
nodes.summary: Concrete PostCandidateRouter that scores each candidate by dot product against a learned direction vector, then routes via argmax or perturbed sampling.

nodes.name: perturbed_argmax
