nodes.summary: Gumbel-style perturbation: adds logistic noise scaled by temperature to the top-k scores and returns the argmax — the stochastic routing primitive shared by both routers.

nodes.name: fidelity.rs
nodes.summary: FidelityMatcher — calibrates a per-position cross-entropy baseline, sweeps compression levels (none/8/4/3/2-bit), and reports the smallest level whose error delta stays under the configured target_delta.

nodes.name: FidelityMatcher
nodes.summary: Stateful matcher that records baseline and per-level compressed logits, finalizes the calibration and sweep, then answers the minimum acceptable compression level per position.

nodes.name: CompressionLevel
nodes.summary: Enum of the five supported precision levels (None, Bit8, Bit4, Bit3, Bit2) with bits() and compression_ratio() accessors.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Breakeven analysis subsystem — BreakevenTracker (per-tier-pair EMA cost tracker) and BreakevenBandit (selects which compute tier to use next, amortizing upfront compile cost against baseline token cost via a sigmoid decision boundary).
nodes.languageNotes: Wires together with the trigger_gate subsystem (TriggerGate, batch 10) — select_tier is the policy head and TriggerGate supplies the runtime QPS/tier telemetry.

nodes.name: BreakevenBandit
nodes.summary: Multi-armed bandit over the four tier-pair transitions (CPU↔GPU, GPU↔ANE, *→Speculative): observes per-token timing, then selects the next tier via a sigmoid over the amortized breakeven confidence.

nodes.name: BreakevenTracker
nodes.summary: Tracks EMA cost for one tier-pair transition: baseline cost, target-tier cost, upfront cost, total tokens, and derived breakeven-n / amortization-confidence metrics.

nodes.name: BreakevenTierPair
nodes.summary: Enum of the four tracked tier transitions: CpuToGpu, GpuToAne, CpuToSpeculative, GpuToSpeculative.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: ActionBridge — sigmoid-gated Q-value bridge that selects one action from a learned direction basis, exposing select_action (single best) and select_top_k (top-k pruned output) with a configurable activation threshold.

nodes.name: ActionBridge
nodes.summary: Bundles a set of action direction vectors with an activation threshold; used to project Q-values onto a compact action subspace and gate low-magnitude actions to zero.

nodes.name: select_top_k
nodes.summary: Computes the bridge-projected scores, applies the sigmoid gate, and writes the top-k surviving (index, score) pairs into the caller's output buffer in descending order.

nodes.name: mask.rs
nodes.summary: Canvas attention and loss-weight mask builder — turns a region topology plus region_indices layout into a dense attention mask honoring temporal alignment, and a parallel loss-weight mask that reweights per-region contributions.

nodes.name: build_attention_mask
nodes.summary: Constructs the (dst_seq × src_seq) attention mask from a region topology and region index layout, applying temporal_aligns at the cell level to permit or block attention.

nodes.name: build_loss_weight_mask
nodes.summary: Builds a per-position loss-weight mask that scales gradient contributions by region role, derived from the same layout used for the attention mask.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Canvas Schema Compiler entry point — declares a typed causal topology (regions + directed edges) and lowers it into attention/loss masks with provable reachability-based marginal independence guarantees.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust module barrel that re-exports the canvas sub-modules (mask, reachability, transfer, types) and ships topology constructors (causal_chain, hub_spoke, causal_temporal).

nodes.name: causal_chain
nodes.summary: Builds a linear chain topology where each region flows information only to its immediate successor.

nodes.name: hub_spoke
nodes.summary: Builds a hub-and-spoke topology where a single hub region broadcasts to and gathers from all spoke regions.

nodes.name: causal_temporal
nodes.summary: Builds a temporally-causal topology where each time-step region may only attend to itself and earlier regions.

nodes.name: reachability.rs
nodes.summary: Reachability semantics for the canvas compiler — proves that for binary masks, absent directed paths imply exact marginal independence between regions (the load-bearing correctness guarantee, paper §2.3).
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a CSR-style FlowGraph (offsets + neighbors) and a bitmap-backed TransitiveClosure for O(horizon · |E|) reachability checks.

nodes.name: FlowGraph
nodes.summary: CSR-encoded directed graph (offsets + flattened neighbors) exposing for_each_out / out_degree for traversal.

nodes.name: TransitiveClosure
nodes.summary: Bitmap-backed transitive closure over a FlowGraph bounded by an information-flow horizon; reaches(a,b) is the marginal-independence oracle.

nodes.name: build_flow_graph
nodes.summary: Compiles a declared region topology into a CSR FlowGraph suitable for reachability analysis.

nodes.name: can_reach
nodes.summary: Horizon-bounded reachability predicate — true iff a directed path of length ≤ horizon exists from source to target in the flow graph.

nodes.name: transfer.rs
nodes.summary: Semantic-type compatibility for the canvas compiler — computes frozen-embedding cosine distance to decide whether two regions can exchange latents without retraining (paper §2.4 Table 1).

nodes.name: cosine_distance
nodes.summary: Computes 1 - cosine(a,b) over frozen embeddings — identical types → 0, orthogonal → 1, opposite → 2.

nodes.name: compatible_regions_in_layout
nodes.summary: Enumerates all pairs of regions in a layout whose transfer distance is within a max-distance threshold.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: POD types for the Canvas Schema Compiler — CanvasBounds, RegionId, SemanticType, and CanvasSchema — modeling the declared T×H×W latent volume and its directed region topology.

nodes.name: CanvasBounds
nodes.summary: Half-open T×H×W bounding box for a canvas region with volume() and per-axis extent helpers.

nodes.name: SemanticType
nodes.summary: Named semantic type carrying a frozen basis embedding used by transfer_distance for routing decisions.

nodes.name: adaptive.rs
nodes.summary: Adaptive causal calibration — cheap OV-circuit proxy that flags bystander-suspect heads in a single observational pass so callers escalate to expensive patching only on the k suspects (Proposal 004).

nodes.name: adaptive_partition
nodes.summary: Combines the cheap OV-circuit suspect list with expensive causal patching scores on those suspects only, producing a critical/convertible partition.

nodes.name: suspect_indices
nodes.summary: Single-pass OV-circuit proxy that returns the k head indices most likely to be causal bystanders, ranked by attention-mass × OV-output-norm threshold.

nodes.name: fusion.rs
nodes.summary: Scale-normalized heterogeneous-branch fusion — RMSNorms each branch independently then applies a learnable per-head scalar γ to fuse outputs from FA/GDN-style branches (paper Eq 13–14).

nodes.name: ScaleNormalizedFusion
nodes.summary: Per-head fusion operator with learnable γ and ε smoothing; static γ beats dynamic softmax gate per paper Table 5.

nodes.name: fuse_into
nodes.summary: Fuses per-head outputs from two heterogeneous branches via independent RMSNorm × γ into the index-preserving output slot.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel re-exporting causal head-importance primitives distilled from HydraHead (scorer, fusion, patching, readout, adaptive calibration).

nodes.name: patching.rs
nodes.summary: Activation/path-patching importance scores — direct-effect (Eq 10, receiver) and indirect-effect (Eq 11, sender) normalized logit-difference scores for causal head ranking.

nodes.name: direct_effect_importance
nodes.summary: Normalized logit-difference score from activation patching — the head's own output is swapped for its corrupted-run value.

nodes.name: indirect_effect_importance
nodes.summary: Normalized logit-difference score from path patching — an upstream head's recorded output is replayed while freezing downstream attention.

nodes.name: readout.rs
nodes.summary: Span-level logit-difference readout (paper Eq 9) — aggregates per-position correct-vs-counterfactual answer logit gaps with exponential recency weighting.

nodes.name: SpanLogitDiffReadout
nodes.summary: Readout policy carrying exponential-decay λ; default() yields the paper's recommended decay schedule.

nodes.name: readout
nodes.summary: Aggregates per-position logit differences across the answer span with exponential recency weighting, returning the capability-expression scalar m(x).

nodes.name: scorer.rs
nodes.summary: Per-capability head scoring, cross-capability min-max fusion, and critical/convertible head partition mirroring RTPurbo's HeadCalibration shape (paper Eq 11–12).

nodes.name: partition_by_causal_score
nodes.summary: Turns the fused per-head ranking into a critical/convertible split at a configurable critical-ratio threshold, guaranteeing ≥1 head per layer.

nodes.name: fuse_across_capabilities
nodes.summary: Min-max normalizes per-capability head scores and weighted-means them across capabilities into one fused ranking.

nodes.name: channel_simd.rs
nodes.summary: Cache-line-aligned storage for ternary weights — pads weight rows to 64-byte boundaries for SIMD-friendly dot_row and from_ternary decomposition (feature-gated behind channel_simd_align).
nodes.languageNotes: Stores offsets[] parallel to padded data[] for O(1) row access; from_ternary unpacks bit-packed +1/-1/0 rows into padded f32 storage.

nodes.name: AlignedWeightMatrix
nodes.summary: Cache-line-padded weight matrix exposing row_ptr/row/dot_row for SIMD-friendly ternary-weight dot products.

nodes.name: from_ternary
nodes.summary: Unpacks bit-packed ternary (+1/-1/0) rows into a cache-line-padded AlignedWeightMatrix.

nodes.name: from_rows
nodes.summary: Constructs an AlignedWeightMatrix from dense f32 rows, padding each to a 64-byte boundary and recording offsets.

nodes.name: coda.rs
nodes.summary: CODA-inspired fused SIMD kernels — algebraic reparameterization that fuses matmul + residual + RMSNorm + activation into single-pass loops, eliminating ~8 intermediate buffer writes per layer (Research 67).
nodes.languageNotes: Key identity RMSNorm(x@W + z) * gamma @ W' = r * ((x@W + z) * gamma) @ W' lets the row-wise RMSNorm scale be delayed past the next GEMM.

nodes.name: GateActivation
nodes.summary: Tagged enum of fused gate activations (Relu / Silu / GegeluTanh / Gegelu) dispatched inside the fused SIMD matmul loops.

nodes.name: MoaActivation
nodes.summary: Tagged enum of MoA (mixture-of-attention) closures (Id / Relu / Relu2 / LeakyRelu / Gelu) with activate / all helpers.

nodes.name: MoaConfig
nodes.summary: Moa block configuration capturing gate_gating / up_gating / d_model for the fused MoA-SwiGLU kernels.

nodes.name: simd_matmul_residual_partial_rms
nodes.summary: Fused matmul + residual add + partial RMSNorm over a configurable row block size, emitting both the output and per-row partial sums for downstream reduction.

nodes.name: simd_matmul_rmsnorm_rope
nodes.summary: Fused matmul + RMSNorm + rotary positional embedding (RoPE) application over cos/sin tables in a single SIMD pass.

nodes.name: simd_matmul_rmsnorm_moa_swiglu
nodes.summary: Fused matmul + RMSNorm + MoA-style SwiGLU activation across configurable output/input dims in one SIMD pass.

nodes.name: committed_field_blend.rs
nodes.summary: Sampling-invariant per-entity MoE composition — frozen sigmoid-gated convex blend of N operator fields with BLAKE3 commitment, guaranteeing observation-density invariance (FAME Proposition 3, Plan 321).
nodes.languageNotes: Computes blend weights pi ONCE at commit then applies sigmoid(pi/tau) every tick; both pi and the field snapshots are frozen so f_pi(z) is a pure function of z.

nodes.name: ArchetypeFieldSource
nodes.summary: Trait for frozen archetype fields exposing evolve / commitment / lipschitz_bound — the per-entity operator snapshots the blend mixes over.

nodes.name: CommittedFieldBlend
nodes.summary: Holds the committed pi weights, temperature tau, clamp bound pi_max, BLAKE3 digest, and version stamp for a per-entity blend.

nodes.name: apply_blended_with_pi
nodes.summary: Applies the frozen blend f_pi(z) = Σ sigmoid(pi_k/tau) · f_k(z) to a state vector, writing both dz_scratch and dz_out for chain-rule callers.

nodes.name: commit
nodes.summary: Computes pi = clamp(dot(summary, dir_k), ±pi_max) ONCE from a trajectory summary, BLAKE3-commits the result, and stamps a version.

nodes.name: apply_blended
nodes.summary: Convenience wrapper around apply_blended_with_pi using the blend's stored pi/tau rather than a caller-supplied pi.

nodes.name: compression_drafter.rs
nodes.summary: Compression-based speculative drafter (gzip-lm distillation) — scores candidate continuations by compressed length under an appendable LZ4 corpus; the compressor IS the model (Plan 285, Research 256).
nodes.languageNotes: score(ctx, candidate) = compressed_len(ctx) - compressed_len(ctx + candidate); higher = more compressible = more likely under the corpus distribution.

nodes.name: CompressionDrafter
nodes.summary: Trait for compressor-backed draft scorers — exposes corpus(), score(), score_batch(), and append() for online corpus growth (freeze/thaw semantics on Vec<u8>).

nodes.name: Lz4FlexDrafter
nodes.summary: Concrete CompressionDrafter backed by lz4_flex — owns the corpus Vec<u8> and a reusable scratch buffer.

nodes.name: MatchScorer
nodes.summary: Pure LZ77-match-based scorer used inside beam_search to rank candidates by raw match length without compression overhead.

nodes.name: beam_search
nodes.summary: Beam-search decoder that expands candidate continuations under a CompressionDrafter scorer up to a horizon, keeping the top beam_width by suffix-match score.

nodes.name: suffix_match_len
nodes.summary: Computes the longest LZ77-style suffix match between a context and a candidate — the inner loop of MatchScorer.

nodes.name: score_batch
nodes.summary: Default batch scorer — applies score() to each candidate in a context and returns the score vector.

nodes.name: floor_harness.rs
nodes.summary: Report-the-Floor comparison harness (Issue 010 T2) — wraps any UQ primitive, runs it on a trajectory corpus, and compares CRPS / coverage / Winkler against the conformal-naive floor.

nodes.name: PredictiveOutput
nodes.summary: Tagged union of a primitive's predictive output — samples, interval, or both — with into_interval normalization for the metric pipeline.

nodes.name: UqPrimitiveUnderTest
nodes.summary: Trait for UQ primitives under benchmark — exposes name, predict_next, and observe so the harness can drive them uniformly.

nodes.name: FloorAdapter
nodes.summary: Wraps a ConformalIntervalCalibrator as a UqPrimitiveUnderTest so the conformal-naive floor can be benchmarked alongside custom primitives.

nodes.name: run_floor_comparison
nodes.summary: Runs a primitive and the conformal-naive floor over a corpus with warmup, collecting per-step predictive outputs for downstream CRPS / Winkler / coverage comparison.

nodes.name: compute_verdict
nodes.summary: Computes the GOAT-gate verdict from CRPS ratio, Winkler ratio, and primitive/floor coverage — Pass only if the primitive beats the floor on every metric.

nodes.name: karc_adapter.rs
nodes.summary: Adapter exposing one output channel of a fitted KarcForecaster as a single-channel PointForecaster so the conformal overlay can wrap KARC for type-level composition (Plan 340 Phase 2).
nodes.languageNotes: Adapter is required because PointForecaster::forecast_into writes one f32 while KARC writes the full D-channel vector — runs the matvec once and projects out the configured channel.

nodes.name: KarcChannelForecaster
nodes.summary: Holds an Arc<KarcForecaster>, a target channel index, and a scratch output buffer — projects the configured channel from KARC's full-vector forecast.

nodes.name: forecast_into
nodes.summary: Runs KARC's full-vector matvec once and writes the configured channel's scalar into the caller's output slot.

nodes.name: metrics.rs
nodes.summary: Conformal UQ metrics — CRPS, Winkler interval score, and empirical coverage — the GOAT-gate scoring functions for any UQ-bearing primitive per the Report-the-Floor rule.

nodes.name: crps
nodes.summary: Continuous Ranked Probability Score between a predictive sample set and an observed actual — lower is better.

nodes.name: winkler_score
nodes.summary: Winkler interval score rewarding narrow intervals that cover the actual, penalizing misses asymmetrically by alpha.

nodes.name: empirical_coverage
nodes.summary: Empirical coverage — fraction of intervals that contain their corresponding actuals.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Conformal Predictive Intervals overlay (Plan 340) — wraps any PointForecaster and produces coverage-guaranteed predictive intervals via a per-channel residual pool with exponential recency and horizon bucketing.

nodes.name: PointForecaster
nodes.summary: Trait for single-channel point forecasters — exposes forecast_into; ship impls are SeasonalPoolForecaster and the KARC adapter.

nodes.name: ResidualMode
nodes.summary: Enum selecting how residuals are bucketed by horizon — Paper (m·⌈h/m⌉) or HStep (per-horizon).

nodes.name: DecayUnit
nodes.summary: Enum selecting exponential recency decay granularity — Step (per-tick) or Cycle (per-period of length m).

nodes.name: weighted_quantile
nodes.summary: Computes a single weighted quantile at probability p over a (channel, bucket)-indexed residual slice — the inner loop of the conformal interval builder.

nodes.name: weighted_quantile_pair
nodes.summary: Computes the (lo, hi) quantile pair needed to construct a two-sided predictive interval in one pass over the residual slice.

nodes.name: sample_predictive_distribution
nodes.summary: Samples n draws from the calibrated predictive distribution at horizon h by inverse-quantile sampling over the residual pool.

nodes.name: ring.rs
nodes.summary: Ring buffers for the conformal residual pool — SortedRing keeps (value, tick) pairs sorted ascending for O(n) quantile extraction; ResidualRingBuffer indexes them by channel × horizon bucket.
nodes.languageNotes: Insertion is O(n) (linear scan + shift) rather than O(log n) — the buffer is small (capacity ≤ 256) and the linear shift vectorizes well.

nodes.name: SortedRing
nodes.summary: Single-channel sorted ring buffer of (value, tick) pairs kept ascending by value; evicts the oldest-tick entry on push when full.

nodes.name: ResidualRingBuffer
nodes.summary: Multi-channel × multi-bucket grid of SortedRings; indexes residuals by channel and horizon bucket for the conformal overlay.

nodes.name: RingView
nodes.summary: Borrow-only view over a SortedRing exposing the sorted slice without granting push access.

nodes.name: push
nodes.summary: Inserts (value, tick) into a SortedRing in sorted position, evicting the oldest-tick entry when at capacity.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a ResidualRingBuffer sized for n_channels × n_buckets, each bucket with the given per-channel capacity.

nodes.name: seasonal.rs
nodes.summary: CSP seasonal-pool forecaster — pure seasonal-naive mixing with exponential recency, no learned Wout or ridge solve (a special case of KARC with periodic delay-basis).

nodes.name: SeasonalPoolForecaster
nodes.summary: Same-phase history weighted by exponential recency; pure reservoir mixing with seasonality m, decay exp_lambda, and pooled-history weight.

nodes.name: forecast
nodes.summary: Predicts h steps ahead by exponentially-weighted averaging of all same-phase history entries.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a SeasonalPoolForecaster with capacity, period m, decay exp_lambda, and pooled-history pool_weight.

nodes.name: chunker.rs
nodes.summary: Chunking strategies for the content store — FixedSizeChunker for non-overlapping slices and FastCdcChunker (Xia et al. 2016) for content-defined cuts that preserve dedup under byte insertion.

nodes.name: FixedSizeChunker
nodes.summary: Splits input into non-overlapping fixed-size slices — simple and fast, but a 1-byte insertion shifts every subsequent boundary and collapses dedup.

nodes.name: FastCdcChunker
nodes.summary: Content-defined chunker using a rolling gear hash with two-mask FastCDC cut-point search; boundaries track byte content so insertions only affect the modified chunk.

nodes.name: ChunkerConfig
nodes.summary: Configurable min/max/normalization levels for FastCDC cut-point selection, with a fast_cdc_chunker() builder.

nodes.name: find_cut_point
nodes.summary: Two-mask FastCDC cut-point search — scans bytes between min_size and max_size using a gear hash, picking the normalization-masked argmax as the cut.

nodes.name: with_config
nodes.summary: Constructs a FastCdcChunker from a ChunkerConfig, deriving the normal/min/max gear masks from the configured levels.

nodes.name: chunk
nodes.summary: Iterator-style entry point — yields successive owned chunk byte-vectors by repeatedly finding cut points until input is exhausted.

nodes.name: fetcher.rs
nodes.summary: Chunk fetcher backends (Plan 272 Phase 3) — InMemoryChunkFetcher (papaya lock-free), FsChunkFetcher (sharded filesystem), and TieredChunkFetcher (composite local→fallback with write-back).

nodes.name: InMemoryChunkFetcher
nodes.summary: papaya lock-free HashMap-backed fetcher for test/single-process use — put/fetch/len/is_empty with default construction.

nodes.name: FsChunkFetcher
nodes.summary: Sharded-filesystem fetcher for production local cache — put writes to a sharded path, fetch reads via direct I/O.

nodes.name: TieredChunkFetcher
nodes.summary: Composite local→fallback fetcher with optional write-back to the local tier on fallback hits.

nodes.name: put
nodes.summary: Writes a chunk under its content hash to the configured storage backend (FsChunkFetcher sharded path layout).

nodes.name: fetch
nodes.summary: Reads a chunk by content hash from the configured backend, returning None on miss.

nodes.name: sharded_path
nodes.summary: Computes the sharded filesystem path for a chunk hash — uses leading bytes of the hash as directory prefixes to spread inode pressure.

nodes.name: goat.rs
nodes.summary: GOAT gate benchmarks for the chunked content store (Plan 272 Phase 4) — G1 dedup ratio, G4 light-client verify, G7 tamper detection — implemented as inline #[test] functions following codebase convention.

nodes.name: in_memory.rs
nodes.summary: In-memory chunked content store (Phase 1 reference impl, Plan 272 T1.7) — papaya::HashMap backend with zero-alloc get_chunk hot path and Box-leaked chunks reclaimed on Drop.
nodes.languageNotes: Chunks are stored as leaked Box<[u8]> (=> &'static [u8]) to give papaya a 'static lifetime; a manual Drop impl tracks and frees them.

nodes.name: BlobMetadata
nodes.summary: Per-blob index record — chunk hash list, Merkle levels, and total byte count keyed by Merkle root.

nodes.name: InMemoryChunkedStore
nodes.summary: papaya-backed chunked store — chunks and blobs maps, swappable Chunker strategy, and counters for stored chunks and indexed blobs.

nodes.name: put
nodes.summary: Inserts a byte blob — chunks it, BLAKE3-hashes each chunk, dedups against the chunk map, and indexes the blob by its binary Merkle root.

nodes.name: insert_chunk_if_absent
nodes.summary: Inserts a chunk under its hash only if absent, returning whether the insertion happened — the dedup hot path.

nodes.name: merkle.rs
nodes.summary: Binary Merkle tree helpers (Plan 272 T1.8) — pure BLAKE3 root, levels, and inclusion-proof builders for linear chunk arrays; separate from the crate-root octree-shaped merkle module.

nodes.name: build_binary_merkle_root
nodes.summary: Computes the binary BLAKE3 Merkle root over a leaf hash slice using domain-separated internal/leaf tags.

nodes.name: build_binary_merkle_proof
nodes.summary: Builds an O(log n) inclusion proof (sibling hash chain) for a given leaf index against an expected root — light-client friendly, no store access.

nodes.name: build_merkle_levels
nodes.summary: Builds the full level-by-level Merkle tree (leaf level + each internal level) up to the root — used for visualization and proof construction.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel for the chunked content-addressed Merkle store (Lore-distilled, Plan 272) — re-exports chunker, fetcher, in-memory store, Merkle helpers, GOAT gates, and POD types.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Decoupled POD types for the chunked content store (Plan 272 T1.4) — BlobId, ChunkRange, MerkleProof, DedupStats — with pure helper methods and no backing-store behavior.

nodes.name: BlobId
nodes.summary: Transparent BLAKE3-digest newtype (32 bytes) identifying a blob by its Merkle root — Pod + Zeroable for bytemuck casts.

nodes.name: ChunkRange
nodes.summary: Half-open byte range (offset, length) locating a chunk within a blob — new/end helpers for iteration.

nodes.name: MerkleProof
nodes.summary: Inclusion proof record — leaf index, sibling hash chain, and expected root — verifiable without store access.

nodes.name: compute_dedup_ratio
nodes.summary: Computes the dedup ratio (unique bytes / total bytes) over a DedupStats counter — the G1 GOAT-gate metric.

nodes.name: cross_resolution.rs
nodes.summary: Cross-Resolution Spectral Transport — asymmetric-basis FUNCATTN generalization enabling train-on-small-deploy-on-large latent transfer via frozen column-orthonormal basis pairs (Plan 310, Research 291).
nodes.languageNotes: Two matmuls over a frozen asymmetric basis pair Φ_src ∈ R^{d_src×k}, Ψ_dst ∈ R^{d_dst×k}: project to k-dim spectral, reconstruct at destination resolution. Exact for band-limited fields (Parseval).

nodes.name: CrossResolutionError
nodes.summary: Error enum — RankDeficient (basis not full column rank) and ShapeMismatch (incompatible d_src/d_dst/k).

nodes.name: CrossResolutionBases
nodes.summary: Frozen column-orthonormal basis pair (phi_src, psi_dst) with verify_commitment and verify_orthonormal integrity checks.

nodes.name: CrossResScratch
nodes.summary: Reusable scratch buffers (spectral, spectral_dst, cached_k) for the transport matmul pair — avoid per-call allocation.

nodes.name: transport_cross_domain_cross_resolution_into
nodes.summary: Applies the two-matmul transport — project src_state to k-dim spectral via Φ_src, reconstruct at destination via Ψ_dst — writing into dst_state using the supplied scratch.

nodes.name: compute_commitment
nodes.summary: Computes a BLAKE3 commitment over the frozen basis pair for tamper detection across train/deploy environments.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a CrossResolutionBases from raw phi_src/psi_dst matrices — validates column-orthonormality and shapes, returning CrossResolutionError on failure.

nodes.name: cache.rs
nodes.summary: Bridge from CAT(0) geodesic to zone-level navigation with cached ⊞[L] computation (T19/T20) — NerveFlowField converts paths into navigation hints; NerveCache precomputes the cubical nerve on map load.

nodes.name: NavigationHint
nodes.summary: Tagged enum — AtGoal / EnRoute / OffPath — the result of querying a NerveFlowField at a zone.

nodes.name: NerveFlowField
nodes.summary: Converts a GeodesicPath into a queryable navigation structure — next_zone and direction_to_goal provide zero-alloc read-time navigation.

nodes.name: NerveCache
nodes.summary: Pre-computes the cubical nerve ⊞[L] and poset on map load; invalidate bumps the version counter on map mutation.

nodes.name: from_geodesic
nodes.summary: Constructs a NerveFlowField from a GeodesicPath, pre-indexing vertices for O(1) zone lookup.

nodes.name: direction_to_goal
nodes.summary: Returns the next zone on the geodesic toward the goal from a current zone, or OffPath if the current zone is not on the path.

nodes.name: next_zone
nodes.summary: Returns the zone immediately following the current zone along the cached geodesic path.

nodes.name: cat0.rs
nodes.summary: CAT(0) geodesic computation on cubical complexes — BFS on the 1-skeleton finds unique shortest paths, guaranteeing deterministic NPC navigation with no tie-breaking.
nodes.languageNotes: In a CAT(0) cube complex, BFS finds exactly one shortest path between any two vertices — the uniqueness is what removes navigation ambiguity.

nodes.name: GeodesicPath
nodes.summary: Vertex sequence representing the unique shortest path between two zones — exposes start/end/is_empty/length.

nodes.name: cat0_geodesic_with_adj
nodes.summary: Computes the unique CAT(0) geodesic between two vertices using a caller-supplied adjacency oracle — BFS over the 1-skeleton.

nodes.name: is_cat0
nodes.summary: Predicate testing whether a cubical complex over a lattice satisfies the CAT(0) property — required for unique-geodesic navigation.

nodes.name: build_adjacency
nodes.summary: Constructs an adjacency oracle (CSR or HashMap) from the covering edges of a cubical complex for use by cat0_geodesic_with_adj.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel for the cubical nerve (arXiv:2503.13663) — re-exports CAT(0) cubical complex, geodesic, poset, navigation cache, and flow-field primitives distilled from the nerve functor.

nodes.name: nerve.rs
nodes.summary: Cubical nerve construction — sends a distributive meet-semilattice L to a cubical set ⊞[L] whose realization is a CAT(0) cube complex, with optimized covering-edge and face builders.

nodes.name: CubicalComplex
nodes.summary: Container for the cubical set ⊞[L] — vertices, edges, faces, and cubes of the complex with per-dimension counts.

nodes.name: CubicalCube
nodes.summary: Tagged enum of cube dimensions — Vertex (0-cube), Edge (1-cube), Face (2-cube), Cube (3-cube) — used throughout the nerve builder.

nodes.name: build_covering_edges_optimized
nodes.summary: Optimized builder for the 1-skeleton — computes covering pairs (a < b with no intermediate c) in a single pass over the lattice elements.

nodes.name: build_faces
nodes.summary: Builds the 2-faces of the cubical complex from its 1-skeleton edges, identifying squares of mutually-covering pairs.

nodes.name: cubical_nerve_with_threshold
nodes.summary: Constructs the cubical nerve ⊞[L] with a configurable complexity threshold for early termination on large lattices.

nodes.name: poset.rs
nodes.summary: Zone poset and distributive meet-semilattice implementation — the input domain for the cubical nerve functor, with from_edges constructor and meet/leq operations.

nodes.name: ZoneId
nodes.summary: Newtype over usize identifying a zone — new/as_usize/fmt helpers for type-safe poset indexing.

nodes.name: ZonePoset
nodes.summary: Partially ordered set of game zones — from_edges constructor, zones accessor, leq predicate, and meet operation; the standard input to the cubical nerve functor.

nodes.name: DistributiveMeetSemilattice
nodes.summary: Trait capturing meet, leq, and elements — the algebraic structure required by the cubical nerve functor to guarantee CAT(0) output.

nodes.name: from_edges
nodes.summary: ZonePoset constructor — takes zones and order pairs (a < b), validates acyclicity, and computes ancestor sets for leq/meet.

nodes.name: meet
nodes.summary: Computes the meet (greatest lower bound) of two zones via the precomputed ancestor sets — required for the cubical nerve functor input.

nodes.name: leq
nodes.summary: Partial-order predicate — true iff zone a ≤ zone b in the poset (b is in a's ancestor set).

nodes.name: cumprodsum.rs
nodes.summary: Cumulative product-sum (cumprodsum) kernels and segment-sum helpers for the SSD block, including scalar, batched, and hand-tuned SIMD vectorized variants.
nodes.languageNotes: Contains three SIMD specializations of cumprodsum (a generic-wide impl, an explicit fallback, and a target-feature-gated one) selected via #[target_feature].

nodes.name: curator.rs
nodes.summary: Curator-based freeze/thaw verification: spectral-direction dot-product checks on module weights plus a multi-armed bandit (CuratorBandit) that learns which curator arms to trust, with Merkle-rooted frozen envelopes.

nodes.name: claim.rs
nodes.summary: Small data-model module defining ClaimCard, Intervention, and ValidityVerdict value types used to package data-probe diagnostic results into a single verdict.

nodes.name: dirichlet_energy.rs
nodes.summary: Feature-gated re-export and test module for the Dirichlet energy structural-alignment diagnostic (Research 111), exposing dirichlet_energy helpers and spectral-hierarchy primitives when their features are enabled.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses #[cfg(feature = ...)] to gate re-exports of two upstream modules; the file body is exclusively re-exports plus a feature-gated tests module.

nodes.name: geometry.rs
nodes.summary: Representation-geometry probes for hidden states: effective rank, average cosine similarity, layer sink summaries, and within-class geometry reports, all computed via a hand-rolled Jacobi eigensolver.

nodes.name: gold_share.rs
nodes.summary: Gold-token share diagnostics: measures how much attention output mass lands on a designated 'gold' token subset, with scratch-backed flat and structured variants plus an output-norm helper.

nodes.name: markov.rs
nodes.summary: Discrete Markov-chain utilities used as synthetic data for the data-probe suite: Dirichlet sampling, stationary-distribution power iteration, entropy-rate computation, and chain generation targeting a desired entropy.

nodes.name: cumprodsum_scalar
nodes.summary: Reference scalar cumprodsum: folds h = a*h + x along the sequence for a single channel.

nodes.name: cumprodsum_batched
nodes.summary: Batched scalar cumprodsum loop over channels and sequence positions.

nodes.name: segsum
nodes.summary: Segment-sum matrix builder producing the causal mask of inter-position sums used by the SSD chunked attention.

nodes.name: influence
nodes.summary: Returns the discrete decay influence weight a^{from-to} between two positions.

nodes.name: context_freshness
nodes.summary: Computes a per-position freshness weight from the decay factors, quantifying how much context each position retains.

nodes.name: cumprodsum_batched_simd
nodes.summary: SIMD-vectorized entry point that dispatches cumprodsum over groups of channels using target-feature detection.

nodes.name: simd_cumprodsum_channel_group
nodes.summary: Hand-vectorized (target_feature=avx2.etc) inner loop computing cumprodsum across a channel group with fat SIMD lanes.

nodes.name: CuratorVerifier
nodes.summary: Verifier that checks a candidate module against a Merkle-rooted snapshot by computing a spectral direction dot product and comparing to a floor.

nodes.name: MerkleFrozenStore
nodes.summary: Keyed store of Merkle-enveloped frozen module snapshots supporting freeze_with_root and thaw_and_verify.

nodes.name: CuratorBandit
nodes.summary: Multi-armed bandit over curator arms that samples which curator to trust, updates reputations on correct/incorrect verdicts, and applies exponential decay.

nodes.name: verify_module
nodes.summary: Verifies a module tensor against its stored snapshot, returning a boolean verdict and emitting diagnostic checks.

nodes.name: check_spectral
nodes.summary: Spectral-floor check that the dot product of the candidate direction with itself exceeds the configured floor.

nodes.name: freeze_with_root
nodes.summary: Freezes a target tensor under a Merkle root, storing a keyed envelope for later verification.

nodes.name: thaw_and_verify
nodes.summary: Thaws a previously frozen target and verifies its current tensor matches the stored Merkle root.

nodes.name: sample
nodes.summary: Samples a curator arm from the bandit proportional to current reputation weights.

nodes.name: verification_weight
nodes.summary: Computes the verification weight contributed by a curator of a given reputation (sigmoid-scaled).

nodes.name: ClaimCard
nodes.summary: Aggregated claim container bundling a validity verdict with an optional intervention recommendation for a data-probe run.

nodes.name: verdict
nodes.summary: Returns the validity verdict stored on a ClaimCard.

nodes.name: GeometryReport
nodes.summary: Summary struct holding effective rank and cosine similarity metrics for a hidden-state tensor.

nodes.name: LayerSinkSummary
nodes.summary: Per-layer sink summary capturing how much attention mass concentrates on sink tokens per head.

nodes.name: WithinClassGeometryReport
nodes.summary: Aggregated within-class geometry report comparing effective rank across class partitions.

nodes.name: effective_rank
nodes.summary: Computes the effective (numerical) rank of a hidden-state matrix from its singular-value spectrum via Jacobi eigendecomposition.

nodes.name: avg_cosine_similarity
nodes.summary: Computes the mean pairwise cosine similarity across rows of a hidden-state matrix as a redundancy measure.

nodes.name: summarize_layer_sinks
nodes.summary: Per-head sink summarization: aggregates attention and value mass into a LayerSinkSummary for a given layer.

nodes.name: within_class_effective_rank
nodes.summary: Computes within-class effective rank by partitioning hidden states by class label and summing per-class rank contributions.

nodes.name: within_class_geometry_report
nodes.summary: Builds a WithinClassGeometryReport combining per-class effective ranks into a single comparative report.

nodes.name: jacobi_eigenvalues
nodes.summary: Classical Jacobi eigenvalue algorithm for symmetric matrices, used as the fallback eigensolver throughout the geometry probe.

nodes.name: GoldShareReport
nodes.summary: Report struct capturing gold-token vs total output-norm share after an attention pass.

nodes.name: GoldShareScratch
nodes.summary: Preallocated scratch space for gold_share computations, grown on demand via ensure_capacity.

nodes.name: ensure_capacity
nodes.summary: Grows the GoldShareScratch buffers to fit the requested concat_len and d_model.

nodes.name: gold_share
nodes.summary: Computes the gold-token share of attention output norm using structured (non-flat) inputs.

nodes.name: gold_share_flat
nodes.summary: Flat (AoS) implementation of gold_share operating on raw contiguous slices for cache efficiency.

nodes.name: compute_output_norm
nodes.summary: Helper computing the output norm with optional restriction to the gold-token subset.

nodes.name: MarkovChain
nodes.summary: Discrete-time Markov chain: transition matrix and number of states, queried for stationary distribution and entropy rate.

nodes.name: sample_dirichlet
nodes.summary: Samples a probability vector of length k from a Dirichlet distribution with the given concentration alpha.

nodes.name: stationary_distribution
nodes.summary: Power-iteration estimator of the stationary distribution of a transition matrix.

nodes.name: entropy_rate
nodes.summary: Computes the per-step entropy rate H = -sum pi_i P_ij log P_ij of a Markov chain given its stationary distribution.

nodes.name: generate_markov_chain
nodes.summary: Synthesizes a random k-state Markov chain with entropy rate close to a target by candidate rejection over Dirichlet samples.

nodes.name: sample_sequence
nodes.summary: Rolls out a length-n sample path from the Markov chain given an RNG.

nodes.name: sample_categorical
nodes.summary: Inverse-CDF sampler drawing an index from a probability vector.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module that re-exports the eight data_probe sub-modules (claim, dirichlet_energy, geometry, gold_share, markov, nll, sink_classify, typical_set) as the public surface of the data-probe subsystem.

nodes.name: nll.rs
nodes.summary: Negative-log-likelihood probes over a Markov chain: average NLL and per-position NLL profiles (owning and into-buffer variants) used by the typical-set/regime classifiers.

nodes.name: sink_classify.rs
nodes.summary: Sink-token classifier for attention: maintains a stable-rank estimate of the value matrix O, classifies each position's sink kind, and applies a dual-policy gate (with cached and flat AoS/SOA variants) to suppress attention mass on spurious sinks.

nodes.name: typical_set.rs
nodes.summary: Typical-set regime classifier: given a Markov chain's entropy rate and observed sequences, classifies each position into under/critical/over regimes and aggregates a distribution across many sequences.

nodes.name: hash.rs
nodes.summary: Feature hashing primitives for the delta-memory subsystem: a seedable FeatureHasher that projects context/outcome feature vectors into low-rank hashed keys/values, plus ContextFeatures and OutcomeFeatures builders (including tree-context construction).

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module re-exporting the delta_mem sub-modules (hash, multi, state) as the public surface of the delta-memory subsystem.

nodes.name: multi.rs
nodes.summary: Multi-domain memory wrapper around DeltaMemoryState: routes keyed reads/writes across named domains and supports cross-domain aggregation strategies (mean / max / sum).

nodes.name: average_nll
nodes.summary: Computes the average per-token negative log-likelihood of an observed sequence under a Markov chain.

nodes.name: nll_profile
nodes.summary: Returns the per-position NLL profile of a sequence under a Markov chain as an owned Vec.

nodes.name: nll_profile_into
nodes.summary: into-buffer variant of nll_profile that writes the per-position NLLs into a caller-supplied slice.

nodes.name: SinkClassifierConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration struct controlling stable-rank iteration count, sink-kind thresholds, and dual-policy gate behavior.

nodes.name: StableRankScratch
nodes.summary: Preallocated scratch buffers (matrices, vectors) backing the stable-rank update loop, with capacity-growth helpers.

nodes.name: SinkAwarePolicy
nodes.summary: Policy struct carrying per-sink-kind scales applied by the dual-policy gate.

nodes.name: CachedSinkClassification
nodes.summary: Cache wrapper that memoizes a sink classification across iterations, with explicit invalidation.

nodes.name: stable_rank_update_into
nodes.summary: Performs one round of stable-rank estimation, writing the updated basis into the provided scratch buffers.

nodes.name: classify_sink_at
nodes.summary: Classifies the sink kind at a single position from its attention column and the running O matrix estimate.

nodes.name: classify_all_sinks
nodes.summary: Bulk wrapper that classifies the sink kind at every position in an attention matrix.

nodes.name: apply_dual_policy_gate
nodes.summary: Applies the dual-policy gate in-place to attention outputs using the per-sink-kind policy scales.

nodes.name: apply_dual_policy_gate_cached
nodes.summary: Cached variant of apply_dual_policy_gate that reuses a CachedSinkClassification when still valid.

nodes.name: stable_rank_update_into_flat
nodes.summary: Flat-AoS implementation of stable_rank_update_into operating on raw contiguous slices.

nodes.name: classify_all_sinks_flat
nodes.summary: Flat-AoS implementation of classify_all_sinks.

nodes.name: Regime
nodes.summary: Enum tagging a position as Under, Critical, or Over the typical-set entropy threshold.

nodes.name: RegimeDistribution
nodes.summary: Aggregate counts/fractions of each Regime across many sampled sequences.

nodes.name: is_critical
nodes.summary: Predicate returning true if the per-position entropy is within epsilon of the critical threshold.

nodes.name: classify_regime
nodes.summary: Classifies a single position into a Regime given the chain entropy rate, observed NLL, and tolerance epsilon.

nodes.name: regime_distribution
nodes.summary: Computes the empirical regime distribution across a corpus of sequences under a Markov chain model.

nodes.name: FeatureHasher
nodes.summary: Seedable feature hasher holding rank, feature_dim, and projection seed; produces hashed keys/values from feature vectors.

nodes.name: ContextFeatures
nodes.summary: Builder that flattens tree-context features (depth, token_idx, parent tokens) into a vector for hashing.

nodes.name: OutcomeFeatures
nodes.summary: Builder that flattens outcome features into a vector for hashing into the delta-memory value slot.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a FeatureHasher with the given rank, feature_dim, and seed, precomputing projection matrices.

nodes.name: hash_key_into
nodes.summary: Projects features through the key projection matrix and writes the hashed key into a caller-supplied buffer.

nodes.name: hash_value_into
nodes.summary: Projects features through the value projection matrix into a caller-supplied buffer.

nodes.name: project_into
nodes.summary: Generic projection of a feature vector through a stored matrix into an output buffer.

nodes.name: from_tree_context
nodes.summary: Builds a ContextFeatures vector from a tree position (depth, token_idx, parent token list).

nodes.name: AggregationStrategy
nodes.summary: Enum selecting how read_aggregated combines values across domains: Mean, Max, or Sum.

nodes.name: MultiDomainMemory
nodes.summary: Multi-domain memory wrapper that owns per-domain DeltaMemoryState instances and routes keyed reads/writes.

nodes.name: read_domain_into
nodes.summary: Reads a value from a named domain into a caller-supplied buffer, lazily ensuring the domain exists.

nodes.name: write_domain
nodes.summary: Writes a (key, value) entry into the specified domain.

nodes.name: ensure_domain
nodes.summary: Lazily creates a domain if absent, seeding it with the shared config.

nodes.name: snapshot_all
nodes.summary: Snapshots every domain's state for later restore.

nodes.name: read_aggregated
nodes.summary: Reads a key across all domains and aggregates the resulting values using the chosen strategy.

nodes.name: state.rs
nodes.summary: Core DeltaMemoryState: a feature-hashed key/value store with adaptive surprise-gating (fast/slow alpha EMA of prediction error), snapshot/restore, error-history tracking, and bulk write_segment helpers.

nodes.name: dendritic_gate.rs
nodes.summary: Dendritic-gated early-exit controller: combines entropy and a coincidence signal through a smooth sigmoid to decide whether a transformer layer should short-circuit, modeled on biological dendritic nonlinear integration.

nodes.name: dirichlet.rs
nodes.summary: Dirichlet energy computation E(E) = sum A_ij * ||h_i - h_j||^2 over embeddings with a sparse adjacency graph, plus adjacency constructors (functor passthrough, consecutive-position) and a KV-cache variant.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module re-exporting the diversity sub-modules (currently just temp) as the public surface of the diversity subsystem.

nodes.name: temp.rs
nodes.summary: Diversity-aware snapshot scheduling and Lipschitz-aware loss-vector selection: extrapolated snapshot schedules (with BLAKE3 / QMC noise), pairwise Lipschitz bounds, and farthest-point-style diverse-subset selection with hand-tuned SIMD block-max kernels.

nodes.name: dllm_solver.rs
nodes.summary: Discrete latent LLM (dLLM) solver core: entropy-based critical-interval detection, adaptive decision-tree construction, q-sampling refine step, self-conditioned draft store/blend, and three-state residual reuse with MBR selection.

nodes.name: codebook.rs
nodes.summary: Effect codebook fitting and patch extraction for factorized actions: a SplitMix64-seeded k-means into a codebook of 1-D observed-transition patches, plus motion/velocity patch construction.

nodes.name: DeltaMemoryConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for a DeltaMemoryState: rank, feature dims, surprise-gate parameters, and EMA alphas.

nodes.name: DeltaMemoryState
nodes.summary: Core stateful delta-memory: feature-hashed key/value store with adaptive surprise-gating, snapshot/restore, and error-history tracking.

nodes.name: DeltaMemorySnapshot
nodes.summary: Snapshot value capturing all mutable state of DeltaMemoryState for restore.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a fresh DeltaMemoryState from a DeltaMemoryConfig, preallocating buffers.

nodes.name: write
nodes.summary: Writes a (key, value) entry, applying the surprise gate when enabled and recording the prediction error.

nodes.name: write_segment
nodes.summary: Bulk write of a segment of (key, value) pairs from owned vectors.

nodes.name: write_segment_slices
nodes.summary: Bulk write of (key, value) pairs from borrowed slices, avoiding allocations.

nodes.name: adapt_gates
nodes.summary: Adapts the surprise-gate threshold from recent prediction errors via fast/slow EMA.

nodes.name: enable_surprise_gate_with_alphas
nodes.summary: Enables surprise-gating with caller-supplied fast and slow EMA alphas.

nodes.name: mean_prediction_error
nodes.summary: Returns the running mean prediction error observed across writes.

nodes.name: write_suppression_rate
nodes.summary: Fraction of writes that the surprise gate has suppressed so far.

nodes.name: DendriticGate
nodes.summary: Stateful controller that decides whether a transformer layer should short-circuit based on entropy and a coincidence signal, using a smooth dendritic nonlinearity.

nodes.name: with_params
nodes.summary: Constructs a DendriticGate with a custom threshold, voltage sensitivity, and coincidence window.

nodes.name: compute_gate
nodes.summary: Returns the gate opening value in [0,1] given current entropy and coincidence.

nodes.name: should_exit_early
nodes.summary: Boolean early-exit decision derived from the gate value crossing the threshold.

nodes.name: dendritic_sigmoid
nodes.summary: Smoothed sigmoid approximation used as the dendritic nonlinearity.

nodes.name: dirichlet_energy
nodes.summary: Computes E(E) = sum A_ij ||h_i - h_j||^2 over flat embeddings and a sparse adjacency graph.

nodes.name: functor_adjacency
nodes.summary: Identity-style adjacency that passes through the given pair list unchanged.

nodes.name: consecutive_adjacency
nodes.summary: Builds an adjacency graph linking each position to its immediate neighbor (i, i+1).

nodes.name: kv_cache_dirichlet_energy
nodes.summary: Dirichlet energy specialized to a KV cache, measuring alignment across cached key vectors.

nodes.name: LossKernel
nodes.summary: Trait-like kernel abstraction exposing a short-prefix-loss computation used by diversity selection.

nodes.name: extrapolated_snapshot_schedule
nodes.summary: Linearly interpolates a schedule of snapshots between s0 and s1 with BLAKE3-seeded Gaussian noise.

nodes.name: extrapolated_snapshot_schedule_with_noise
nodes.summary: Generic snapshot schedule variant that accepts a caller-supplied noise function.

nodes.name: blake3_noise
nodes.summary: Deterministic Gaussian-like noise derived from a BLAKE3 hash of the seed, used by extrapolated schedules.

nodes.name: extrapolated_snapshot_schedule_qmc
nodes.summary: Quasi-Monte-Carlo variant of the snapshot schedule that consumes a low-discrepancy uniform sequence.

nodes.name: perturbed_loss_vector
nodes.summary: Computes a perturbed loss vector for a given prefix under the loss kernel.

nodes.name: lipschitz_gradient_bound
nodes.summary: Closed-form Lipschitz bound on the gradient given delta, lambda, g, tau, c_h, and epsilon.

nodes.name: pairwise_bound
nodes.summary: Computes pairwise Lipschitz bounds across a set of loss vectors into an output buffer.

nodes.name: select_diverse_subset_into
nodes.summary: Farthest-point-style selection of a maximally diverse k-subset of loss vectors using L-inf distance, writing results into a caller buffer.

nodes.name: argmax_pair
nodes.summary: Finds the pair of candidate loss vectors maximizing pairwise L-inf distance, used to seed diverse selection.

nodes.name: block_max_l_inf_distance
nodes.summary: Block-SIMD helper computing the maximum L-inf distance between a base vector and four candidates.

nodes.name: avx2_block_max_l_inf_distance
nodes.summary: Explicit AVX2 target-feature implementation of the block-max L-inf distance kernel.

nodes.name: CriticalIntervalConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for the entropy thresholds that define the critical interval where the dLLM solver activates.

nodes.name: CriticalTierDecision
nodes.summary: Decision struct capturing whether the solver escalates to a higher tier on a critical interval.

nodes.name: SelfCondDraft
nodes.summary: Self-conditioned draft store: buffers marginals from pass 1 and blends them into pass 2 to produce a draft sequence.

nodes.name: RcdConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for the residual-conditional-draft (RCD) path of the solver.

nodes.name: ThreeStateReuseConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for the three-state residual reuse policy that decides how to combine visible, masked, and hidden states.

nodes.name: ResidualMode
nodes.summary: Enum selecting how residuals are injected (zero, full, lerp) per tier.

nodes.name: is_critical_interval
nodes.summary: Predicate: is the current entropy within the critical interval defined by config?

nodes.name: select_solver
nodes.summary: Picks a SolverKind for the current entropy regime.

nodes.name: shannon_entropy
nodes.summary: Computes the Shannon entropy (in nats) of a marginal distribution.

nodes.name: build_dd_tree_adaptive
nodes.summary: Builds an adaptive decision tree over per-depth marginals up to a critical entropy threshold, parameterized by solver kind.

nodes.name: critical_tier_decision
nodes.summary: Decides whether to escalate the solver tier given entropy, config, current tier, and GPU availability.

nodes.name: q_sample_step
nodes.summary: Single q-sampling step: x_t = sqrt(alpha_prev)*x0_hat + sqrt(1-alpha_prev)*noise.

nodes.name: q_sample_refine
nodes.summary: Refinement pass that blends marginals across alpha and alpha_prev with noise to produce refined marginals.

nodes.name: store_pass1
nodes.summary: Stores the pass-1 marginals into the SelfCondDraft buffer for blending in pass 2.

nodes.name: blend_pass2
nodes.summary: Blends pass-2 marginals with the stored pass-1 marginals using a blend factor.

nodes.name: draft
nodes.summary: Produces the final draft sequence by combining the two passes through the configured blend.

nodes.name: mbr_select
nodes.summary: Minimum-Bayes-Risk selection over candidate paths and scores, returning the highest-scoring path of length k.

nodes.name: classify_transitions
nodes.summary: Classifies token transitions as visible, masked, or hidden for the three-state reuse policy.

nodes.name: compute_gammas
nodes.summary: Computes per-position interpolation gammas from transition types and visible fraction.

nodes.name: warm_start_lerp
nodes.summary: Warm-starts h_t by lerping between h_star_next and h_pre_t using the computed gammas.

nodes.name: compute_residual
nodes.summary: Computes the residual embedding from marginals and the token embedding matrix.

nodes.name: interpolate_residual
nodes.summary: Lerps between the mask embedding and the computed residual by alpha.

nodes.name: compute_entropy_weights
nodes.summary: Computes per-token entropy weights from logits, used to weight residual contributions.

nodes.name: normalized_entropy
nodes.summary: Normalizes entropy by log(vocab_size) into [0,1].

nodes.name: SplitMix64
nodes.summary: Seedable SplitMix64 RNG providing next_u64 and next_f64 for deterministic codebook initialization.

nodes.name: sq_dist
nodes.summary: Squared Euclidean distance between two equal-length slices.

nodes.name: fit_codebook_kmeans_into
nodes.summary: Lloyd's k-means clustering fitting the effect codebook into a caller-supplied buffer, using SplitMix64 seeding.

nodes.name: patchify_1d
nodes.summary: Extracts overlapping length-patch_size patches from a 1-D observation tensor.

nodes.name: motion_input_velocity_into
nodes.summary: Computes the per-step velocity (delta) between two consecutive observations into a caller buffer.

nodes.name: from_observed_transitions
nodes.summary: Top-level constructor: builds an effect codebook from observed (state, next-state) transitions via patch extraction and k-means.

nodes.name: kernel.rs
nodes.summary: Factorized-action kernel ops: assign patches into factor buffers, finalize factor lists, decode a token into per-patch factors via the codebook+FiLM projections, score per-token relevance, and aggregate into an action latent under gate scales.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module re-exporting the factorized_action sub-modules (codebook, kernel, types) as the public surface of the factorized-action subsystem.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Type definitions for the factorized-action subsystem: EffectCodebook, TransitionFactors (with zeroed/reset), the FactorizedActionLatent alias, AggregatorType enum, and the FilmProjectionBank layout with projection slices.

nodes.name: freeze.rs
nodes.summary: Tiny on-disk freeze/thaw helpers: save_frozen serializes a bincode payload to a file and load_frozen reads it back, used by the curator/Merkelized freeze pipeline.

nodes.name: funcattn.rs
nodes.summary: Functional attention: replaces learned Q/K projections with a fixed functional basis (DCT-log or Haar packet), solves a convex combination (with Cholesky-based linear solve) for value mixing, and forward-evaluates a basis-rotated attention pass.

nodes.name: gain_cost_halt.rs
nodes.summary: Adaptive loop halter for iterative inference: tracks gain/cost and an angular-change signal on each step, computes hidden-state effective rank via Jacobi eigensolver, and decides whether to halt based on oscillation patience, step size, and rank change.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Generalized divisive-normalization (GDN) tree verifier: builds tree topology from parents/alphas, constructs the lower-triangular linear system per node, solves via forward-substitution, and verifies/commits accepted leaves and full paths (with multi-head variants).

nodes.name: assign_patch_into
nodes.summary: Copies a patch into the factor buffer at a given patch index with strided writes.

nodes.name: finalize_factors
nodes.summary: Finalizes the factor list after all patches are assigned (e.g., normalization or padding).

nodes.name: factor_token_into
nodes.summary: Decodes a single token into per-patch factors by querying the codebook and applying FiLM projections.

nodes.name: relevance_score
nodes.summary: Computes a relevance score per token used to gate its contribution to the aggregated action latent.

nodes.name: aggregate_action_latent_into
nodes.summary: Aggregates per-token factor contributions into a single action latent under gate_beta/gate_tau scaling.

nodes.name: EffectCodebook
nodes.summary: Storage for the learned effect-codebook centroids and patch shape metadata.

nodes.name: TransitionFactors
nodes.summary: Per-token transition factor buffer with zeroed/reset/default constructors.

nodes.name: FilmProjectionBank
nodes.summary: Bank of FiLM projection matrices and biases, exposing g_proj and b_proj slices per factor index.

nodes.name: save_frozen
nodes.summary: Serializes a bincode payload to a file at the given path, creating or truncating it.

nodes.name: load_frozen
nodes.summary: Reads and deserializes a bincode payload previously written by save_frozen.

nodes.name: FuncAttnConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for functional attention: basis kind, temperature, k dimension, regularization, jitter, and Cholesky fallback flags.

nodes.name: FuncAttnScratch
nodes.summary: Preallocated scratch space (basis matrix, Gram, buffers) backing the functional attention forward pass.

nodes.name: FuncAttnBasis
nodes.summary: Enum selecting the functional basis kind (e.g., DCT-log or Haar packet).

nodes.name: FuncAttnError
nodes.summary: Error enum for functional attention failures (singular Gram, mismatched dims, etc.).

nodes.name: compute_basis_into
nodes.summary: Evaluates the chosen functional basis (DCT-log, Haar packet, etc.) for each query/key position into a matrix buffer.

nodes.name: cholesky_inplace
nodes.summary: In-place Cholesky factorization of a symmetric positive-definite matrix used by the convex-combo solve.

nodes.name: cholesky_solve_into
nodes.summary: Solves L y = b then L^T x = y given a precomputed Cholesky factor, writing x into a caller buffer.

nodes.name: solve_convex_combo_dual
nodes.summary: Solves the convex-combination dual problem (with optional jitter regularization) for the functional attention mixing weights.

nodes.name: pre_rotate_basis_weights_into
nodes.summary: Pre-rotates the basis weight matrix by the eigenvector matrix to align subsequent attention.

nodes.name: gram_schmidt_rows
nodes.summary: Row-wise Gram-Schmidt orthonormalization of a (k, d) matrix in place.

nodes.name: make_dct_log_basis
nodes.summary: Constructs a DCT basis with logarithmically-spaced frequencies for the functional attention basis matrix.

nodes.name: make_haar_packet_basis
nodes.summary: Constructs a Haar wavelet packet basis matrix for functional attention.

nodes.name: funcattn_forward
nodes.summary: End-to-end functional attention forward pass: project x into basis/value space, solve convex-combo weights, and produce the attention output.

nodes.name: GainCostLoopHalter
nodes.summary: Stateful adaptive halter that decides whether to continue iterating based on gain, cost, angular change, and hidden-state effective rank.

nodes.name: HaltDecision
nodes.summary: Result of a halt check: a boolean should_halt plus the HaltReason that triggered it.

nodes.name: HaltReason
nodes.summary: Enum tagging why the halter decided to stop (gain below floor, oscillation, rank collapse, etc.).

nodes.name: halt_decision
nodes.summary: Computes a HaltDecision for the current loop step given gain, cost, and angular change against the previous step.

nodes.name: step_size
nodes.summary: Computes the step size between consecutive hidden states as the L2 norm of their difference.

nodes.name: angular_change
nodes.summary: Computes the angular change (via cosine similarity) between the current and previous step directions.

nodes.name: hidden_erank
nodes.summary: Computes the effective rank of a hidden-state matrix from its eigenvalue spectrum (Jacobi eigensolver) for the halter.

nodes.name: jacobi_eigenvalues_inplace
nodes.summary: In-place Jacobi eigenvalue algorithm used by hidden_erank.

nodes.name: TreeTopology

nodes.name: predictor_with_scratch

nodes.name: phase_safe_cos_sin

nodes.name: pipeline_pruner.rs

nodes.name: QueryClassifier

nodes.name: classify

nodes.name: classify_prompt

nodes.name: region_subspace.rs

nodes.name: RegionSubspaceField

nodes.name: invert_rxr

nodes.name: config.rs

nodes.name: enums.rs

nodes.languageNotes: Mostly marker enums with a handful of impls; provides the discriminated union vocabulary shared across the workspace.

nodes.name: simd_add_inplace

nodes.name: simd_scale_mul_inplace
nodes.summary: Fused scale-multiply in place (x *= gamma*scale).

nodes.name: research.rs

nodes.name: sparse.rs
nodes.summary: SIMD sparse dot product and sparse matmul over (indices, values) CSR-style inputs; the kernel used by pruned and ternary-aware linear layers.

nodes.name: tests_sense.rs
nodes.summary: Focused tests for the ternary dot product and the ternary projection helper used by the sense module.

nodes.name: slod.rs

nodes.name: ternary.rs

nodes.name: tests_types.rs
nodes.summary: Integration tests for katgpt-types: config overrides, DomainLatent round-trip and checksum failures, GpartAdapter correctness/commitment/save-load/determinism/masking, and LoRA adapter loading.

nodes.name: maxsim_score
nodes.summary: ColBERT-style MaxSim score between a set of query vectors and a set of document vectors.

nodes.name: maxsim_score_packed
nodes.summary: Packed-indices variant of maxsim_score that streams queries and documents through offset arrays.

nodes.name: SimdLevel

nodes.name: is_avx2_fma_available

nodes.name: sigmoid_margin_loss

nodes.name: compute_retrieval_margin
nodes.summary: Computes the retrieval margin between query/document neighborhoods; the metric used to evaluate retrieval-head quality.

nodes.name: dim_sufficiency_bound
nodes.summary: Computes a Johnson-Lindenstrauss-style dimension sufficiency bound for k neighborhoods in n points.

nodes.name: simd_sum_sq
nodes.summary: Vectorized sum-of-squares over an f32 slice with NEON/AVX2/Wasm backends.

nodes.name: simd_dist_sq

nodes.name: simd_l_inf_distance_f32
nodes.summary: Vectorized L-infinity (Chebyshev) distance between two f32 slices.

nodes.name: simd_gram_f32
nodes.summary: Vectorized Gram matrix computation X^T X over a sequence of d_h-dim vectors.

nodes.name: entropy_f32
nodes.summary: Computes Shannon entropy (in nats) from a slice of log-probabilities.

nodes.name: coincidence_score

nodes.name: simd_sum_abs_f32
nodes.summary: Vectorized sum-of-absolute-values over an f32 slice (L1 norm).

nodes.name: simd_sparse_dot_f32
nodes.summary: Vectorized sparse dot product over (active_indices, active_values) CSR-style inputs with NEON/AVX2/Wasm backends.

nodes.name: simd_sparse_matmul_rows
nodes.summary: Row-wise sparse matmul: output = weight * input restricted to alive (index, value) entries.

nodes.name: simd_ternary_matvec
nodes.summary: Vectorized ternary (1.58-bit) matrix-vector product using bit-packed pos/neg weight nibbles.

nodes.name: simd_ternary_dot_f32
nodes.summary: Dot product between a ternary direction vector and an f32 state; used by ternary projection.

nodes.name: project_ternary_simd
nodes.summary: Projects an f32 input onto the ternary lattice defined by positive/negative bit masks, using SIMD.

nodes.name: TemporalDerivativeKernel

nodes.name: surprise_norm
nodes.summary: Returns a normalized surprise magnitude derived from the current fast/slow derivative.

nodes.name: sigmoid_surprise_gate
nodes.summary: Computes a sigmoid gating value from the derivative and a beta scaling.

nodes.name: validate_alphas
nodes.summary: Validates that EMA decay rates satisfy 0 < alpha_fast < alpha_slow < 1.

nodes.name: TernaryWeights
nodes.summary: Packed 1.58-bit weight matrix with new/set/get, f32-to-ternary quantization and a checksum; the storage side paired with the ternary SIMD kernels.

nodes.name: quantize_from_f32
nodes.summary: Quantizes an f32 weight matrix into packed ternary {-1,0,+1} values with sign-rounding.

nodes.name: checksum
nodes.summary: Computes a checksum over the packed ternary weights for tamper detection.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Allocates a new zeroed TernaryWeights matrix of the given shape.

nodes.name: roofline.rs
nodes.summary: Roofline cost model (Plan 159, port of FlashLib's roofline.py) predicting GPU/ANE operator runtime in microseconds CPU-side, replacing ~100ms GemvAutotune benchmarking.

nodes.name: ComputeBound
nodes.summary: Enumerates whether an operator is bottlenecked by FLOP throughput, memory bandwidth, or kernel launch overhead.

nodes.name: RooflineCost
nodes.summary: Result struct carrying flops, bytes moved, predicted runtime, and the dominant ComputeBound classification.

nodes.name: Dtype
nodes.summary: Compact enum tagging tensor dtype as F32 or F16, with elem_size() returning bytes per element.

nodes.name: OpType

nodes.name: HardwarePeaks
nodes.summary: Calibrated hardware peak throughput (F32/F16 GFLOPS, bandwidth, launch overhead) with presets for Apple M1 through M4 Pro.

nodes.name: roofline_estimate
nodes.summary: Predicts operator runtime and bottleneck class from FLOP/byte counts and HardwarePeaks, replacing ~100ms autotuner benchmarks with a ~5us CPU estimate.

nodes.name: gram_cost
nodes.summary: Convenience wrapper computing the roofline cost of building a Gram matrix for a sequence of hidden dimension d_h.

nodes.name: rtdc.rs
nodes.summary: Rootless Tiered Depth Commitment (RTDC) primitive: a depth-tiered Merkle octree that commits leaves at variable depths keyed by sigma, with single-leaf and k-of-n subtree inclusion proofs for tamper detection.

nodes.name: DepthSelector
nodes.summary: Sigma-threshold classifier picking the Merkle octree depth at which a given sigma becomes admissible.

nodes.name: DepthTieredMerkleOctree
nodes.summary: Rootless depth-tiered Merkle octree committing leaves at variable depths by sigma, with prove/verify at depth and subtree inclusion proofs.

nodes.name: RtdcProof
nodes.summary: Inclusion proof bundle: leaf hash, sibling hashes at the proof depth, and expected root for a single leaf.

nodes.name: SubtreeProof
nodes.summary: Subtree-inclusion proof carrying shallow/deep depths, seed, k, and the octree hashes needed for k-of-n tamper detection.

nodes.name: DeterministicLeafEncode
nodes.summary: Trait abstracting deterministic leaf-to-hash encoding so callers can plug their own commitment scheme.

nodes.name: RtdcError
nodes.summary: Error enum for RTDC operations: insufficient boundaries, depth out of range, leaf out of range.

nodes.name: build
nodes.summary: Constructs a DepthTieredMerkleOctree by tiering leaves across depths according to the DepthSelector's sigma boundaries.

nodes.name: verify_at_depth
nodes.summary: Verifies a single-leaf inclusion proof against the cached root at the proof's depth.

nodes.name: verify_subtree_inclusion
nodes.summary: Verifies a subtree-inclusion proof, checking that k-of-n leaves match the committed octree hashes for tamper detection.

nodes.name: min_k_for_95pct_confidence
nodes.summary: Computes the minimum k (samples) needed to reach 95% tamper-detection confidence given a corrupt fraction f.

nodes.name: tamper_detection_probability
nodes.summary: Closed-form probability that k sampled leaves detect at least one tampered entry out of a corrupt fraction f.

nodes.name: salience/gate.rs

nodes.languageNotes: Two stacked sigmoids (never softmax) per the project's AGENTS.md rule; Silent is a first-class variant.

nodes.name: SalienceTriGate
nodes.summary: Per-tick tri-gate emitting Speak/Silent/Delegate via two stacked sigmoids over activation z and context c, with zero-allocation hot path.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Configures a SalienceTriGate: speak/delegate dimensions, direction vectors w_z/w_c, beta/tau thresholds, and floor/ceil clamps.

nodes.name: decide

nodes.name: decide_batch
nodes.summary: Vectorised decide over a batch of activations writing results into a caller-supplied output slice.

nodes.name: decide_batch_with_nudge
nodes.summary: Batch decide variant applying per-row delegate nudges before the gate decision.

nodes.name: build_delegate_token
nodes.summary: Constructs a DelegateToken carrying the payload, issue tick, holding-reply index, and foldback target.

nodes.name: salience/mod.rs

nodes.name: salience/pending.rs
nodes.summary: Bounded pending-delegate queue holding SalienceTriGate-issued DelegateTokens until their foldback target is resolved.

nodes.name: PendingDelegateQueue
nodes.summary: Bounded ring buffer holding delegate tokens issued but not yet foldback-resolved, with head/len cursor tracking.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs an empty PendingDelegateQueue with fixed capacity.

nodes.name: push
nodes.summary: Appends a delegate token to the queue tail, overwriting the oldest entry when full.

nodes.name: pop

nodes.name: salience/types.rs

nodes.name: SilenceToken

nodes.name: FoldbackTarget

nodes.name: DelegateToken

nodes.name: SpectralThreatFeatures
nodes.summary: Feature bundle extracted per entity: combo frequency, vulnerability phase, burst decay, and rhythm confidence.

nodes.name: auto_calibrate
nodes.summary: Tunes the tracker's max-damage and confidence-ramp parameters from observed damage statistics for a given entity.

nodes.name: set_attention.rs

nodes.name: SetAttentionConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for set-sigmoid attention: beta/gamma thresholds and optional top-k cap.

nodes.name: SetAttentionError
nodes.summary: Error enum covering shape mismatches on states/weights/scratch buffers and zero-dimension inputs.

nodes.summary: Core set-attention kernel: computes sigmoid-gated attention over a set of states with Q/K/V projections, writing into a caller-supplied output buffer with optional top-k pruning.

nodes.summary: Dense (full-set) attention accumulation path: computes softmax-style weights and weighted V sums without pruning.

nodes.summary: Builds a (d x k) identity projection matrix (truncated/padded) into a caller-supplied buffer, used as a default Q/K projection.

nodes.summary: Diffusion reveal schedule over positions: encapsulates offset function w, mode (AR/diffusion), and shaped variants, plus sample/reveal-time generation.

nodes.summary: Computes the position-dependent reveal offset for absolute position ell in a length-l sequence under this schedule.

nodes.summary: Converts a sample order into generation steps suitable for a diffusion decoder loop.

nodes.name: mobius_add_into

nodes.name: exp_map_into

nodes.name: log_map_into
nodes.summary: Poincare-ball logarithmic map from base to point, producing the tangent vector at base.

nodes.name: build_laplacian
nodes.summary: Constructs the graph Laplacian (via kNN + Poincare distances) over a set of hyperbolic embeddings, writing eigen-ready symmetric entries.

nodes.name: boundary_scan
nodes.summary: Scans eigenvalues/eigenvectors for spectral boundaries (clusters/gaps) and returns boundary indices for downstream pruning.

nodes.name: frechet_mean
nodes.summary: Computes the weighted Frechet (Karcher) mean of hyperbolic embeddings on the Poincare ball via gradient descent in the tangent space.

nodes.name: mad_peak_picker

nodes.name: FcScratch

nodes.name: fourier_continue_into

nodes.name: spectral/mod.rs

nodes.name: ensure_capacity
