nodes.summary: Computes a von Mises-Fisher confidence gate from a steering strength s_t, concentration kappa, and gate parameters alpha/beta.

nodes.name: spherical_steering_into
nodes.summary: Top-level spherical steering: SLERP plus a vMF confidence gate that scales the update by directional certainty.

nodes.name: ssd_block.rs
nodes.summary: State-Space Duality (SSD) block implementation: blockwise chunked attention with cumprodsum decay and inter-chunk state propagation, plus a naive reference path for correctness validation.
nodes.languageNotes: Blockwise SSD from Mamba-2; uses the shared cumprodsum primitive for chunk-level decay.

nodes.name: SsdBlockConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for the SSD block: chunk/block length, state dimension, and head dimension.

nodes.name: SsdScratch
nodes.summary: Scratch holding chunk outputs, inter-chunk states, decay buffers, and segsum buffers for the SSD blockwise forward pass.

nodes.name: default_cpu
nodes.summary: Returns a CPU-tuned default SsdBlockConfig with smaller block length suitable for cache-friendly execution.

nodes.name: auto_block_len
nodes.summary: Picks an SSD block length automatically from the sequence length to balance chunking overhead vs. memory.

nodes.name: ssd_block_forward
nodes.summary: Blockwise SSD (State-Space Duality) forward pass: chunked intra-block attention with cumprodsum decay and inter-block state propagation, into a caller buffer.

nodes.name: ssd_naive
nodes.summary: Reference naive (O(n^2)) SSD forward used for correctness checking against the blockwise fast path.

nodes.name: ssmax.rs
nodes.summary: Ssmax (sigmoid-gated sparsemax) projection with fixed and adaptive sparsity modes, backed by a rolling EMA estimator that derives the sparsity budget from observed logit statistics.

nodes.name: SsmaxMode
nodes.summary: Enum selecting Smax (sparsemax-style) sparsity mode: Fixed (s_l fixed) or Adaptive (s_l derived from log n).

nodes.name: SsmaxConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration holding the resolved sparsity parameter s_l and log_n for the Ssmax projection.

nodes.name: RollingDeltaEstimator
nodes.summary: Rolling EMA-based estimator that observes row logits and adaptively derives a sparsity delta for the Adaptive mode.

nodes.name: apply_ssmax_inplace
nodes.summary: Applies the Ssmax (sigmoid-gated sparsemax variant) projection to a row of logits in place, given mode and log_n.

nodes.name: update_ema
nodes.summary: Updates the rolling EMA of observed bit-budget statistics from a new row of logits.

nodes.name: subspace_phase_gate.rs
nodes.summary: Subspace phase-transition gate: estimates intrinsic dimension (participation ratio / numerical rank), computes the random-matrix phase-transition threshold, and provides a from-scratch one-sided Jacobi SVD including Jacobian-based SVD at a point.
nodes.languageNotes: Ships a self-contained one-sided Jacobi SVD so the phase-transition gate has no external LAPACK dependency.

nodes.name: IntrinsicDimMethod
nodes.summary: Enum selecting intrinsic-dimension estimator: participation ratio or numerical rank.

nodes.name: JacobianSvdScratch
nodes.summary: Scratch for Jacobian-based SVD: holds perturbation buffers, Jacobian matrix, and nested SvdScratch for the one-sided Jacobi sweep.

nodes.name: SvdResult
nodes.summary: Result bundle carrying singular values, right/left singular vectors, and numerical rank from an SVD computation.

nodes.name: SvdResultScratch
nodes.summary: Resizable scratch view over singular values/vectors with accessor methods and clear_for() reset.

nodes.name: SvdScratch
nodes.summary: Scratch for the one-sided Jacobi SVD holding the working matrix A, right-vector accumulator V, column norms, and permutation/sort buffers.

nodes.name: participation_ratio
nodes.summary: Computes the participation ratio intrinsic-dimension estimate from a normalized eigenvalue spectrum.

nodes.name: numerical_rank
nodes.summary: Computes numerical rank of a descending-sorted spectrum above threshold eta.

nodes.name: estimate_intrinsic_dim
nodes.summary: Dispatches to participation_ratio or numerical_rank per IntrinsicDimMethod.

nodes.name: phase_transition_gate
nodes.summary: Boolean gate deciding whether (n_samples, intrinsic_dim) sits above the random-matrix phase transition threshold for reliable subspace recovery.

nodes.name: jacobian_svd_at_into
nodes.summary: Computes the Jacobian of vector function f at point x via finite differences, then SVDs the Jacobian, writing the result into a caller-supplied scratch.

nodes.name: one_sided_jacobi_svd_into
nodes.summary: One-sided Jacobi SVD rotation sweep over columns of an m x n matrix, producing singular values and right singular vectors.

nodes.name: thin_svd_into
nodes.summary: Thin (economy-size) SVD entry point dispatching to one-sided Jacobi for rectangular matrices.

nodes.name: subspace_steering.rs
nodes.summary: Subspace steering primitive: applies an orthonormal block of directions with per-direction strengths (alpha) to latent states, with commitment-hash verifiability and a manifold-walk explorer.

nodes.name: SubspaceSteeringError
nodes.summary: Error enum for subspace steering: basis not orthonormal, alpha out of range.

nodes.name: SubspaceSteeringField
nodes.summary: Steering field over an orthonormal block of directions with per-direction strengths alpha and a commitment hash.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a SubspaceSteeringField from a block of directions and alphas, verifying orthonormality within the supplied tolerance.

nodes.name: from_directions_orthonormalize
nodes.summary: Orthonormalizes a set of directions (Gram-Schmidt) and then constructs the SubspaceSteeringField from the result.

nodes.name: verify
nodes.summary: Re-checks orthonormality of the field's block within the given tolerance.

nodes.name: apply
nodes.summary: Applies the steering field to a latent state, producing the steered state by linear combination of block directions weighted by alpha.

nodes.name: apply_subspace_steering
nodes.summary: Free-function shorthand: applies a SubspaceSteeringField to a state and returns the steered state.

nodes.name: compute_block_commitment
nodes.summary: Computes a commitment hash over the block and alphas for freeze/thaw-style verifiability.

nodes.name: block_energy
nodes.summary: Computes the energy (block-weighted norm) of a state under the steering field.

nodes.name: walk_manifold
nodes.summary: Walks the steering manifold over a grid of alpha values, writing each steered state into out_grid for exploration.

nodes.name: temporal_deriv.rs
nodes.summary: Thin re-export shim for the Temporal Derivative Kernel (Plan 277, co-extracted to katgpt_types::temporal to break the katgpt-core cycle); preserves katgpt_core::temporal_deriv::* paths bit-for-bit.
nodes.languageNotes: Kernel lives in katgpt_types::temporal; this file preserves the old paths via pub use.

nodes.name: thinking_mode.rs
nodes.summary: Canonical per-query ThinkingMode tag (Plan 388 Phase 3), extracted to katgpt-core to break the katgpt-pruners/katgpt-speculative cycle; both consumers re-export this single definition.
nodes.languageNotes: Defined at the lowest crate to break a cycle; crosses the crate boundary as plain u8 via repr(u8).

nodes.name: ThinkingMode
nodes.summary: Canonical per-query thinking-mode enum (Direct/Latent/CpuResample/Dendritic), repr(u8) for FFI/persistence, shared across katgpt-pruners and katgpt-speculative.

nodes.name: tiered_kv/in_memory.rs
nodes.summary: In-memory backing store for the tiered KV cache: chunked hot/cold tiers with per-group summaries and a working-set fetch driven by sink-local plus group selections.

nodes.name: ChunkKv
nodes.summary: Per-chunk KV record holding flat keys, values, and positions arrays.

nodes.name: GroupSummary
nodes.summary: Per-group summary payload computed by a group_summarizer over a chunk's tokens.

nodes.name: InMemoryTieredKvStore
nodes.summary: In-memory tiered KV store: hot/cold chunks plus per-group summaries, with chunk appends and working-set fetch driven by sink-local and group selections.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs an InMemoryTieredKvStore with the given head_dim, chunk_size, group_size, and group_summarizer closure.

nodes.name: append_chunk
nodes.summary: Appends a chunk of keys/values/positions to the store, computing per-group summaries on the fly.

nodes.name: fetch_working_set
nodes.summary: Fetches the working set of tokens for attention: always-pulled sink/local chunks plus per-group-selected tokens from cold chunks.

nodes.name: tiered_kv/mod.rs
nodes.summary: Tiered KV cache module root: defines the TieredKvStore trait, sink/local set, route budget, working set, and group selection types used by the in-memory backend and re-exports the in_memory and tests submodules.

nodes.name: SinkLocalSet
nodes.summary: Set of always-fetched sink and local chunk indices used to seed the working-set fetch.

nodes.name: RouteBudget
nodes.summary: Budget pair (k_c, k_g) capping per-chunk and per-group token routing during fetch.

nodes.name: WorkingSet
nodes.summary: Accumulating working set of keys/values/positions built up token-by-token during fetch.

nodes.name: GroupSelection
nodes.summary: Per-chunk group selection recording which groups within each chunk are pulled into the working set.

nodes.name: TieredKvStore
nodes.summary: Trait abstracting a tiered KV store: exposes dimensions, chunk counts, append_chunk, and fetch_working_set for pluggable backends.

nodes.name: tiered_kv/tests.rs
nodes.summary: Test module for the tiered KV in-memory store: exercises full-fetch round-trip, partial group-based fetch, and the always-fetched sink/local invariant with a mean-summarizer fixture.

nodes.name: mean_summarizer
nodes.summary: Test fixture summarizer computing the mean of group keys for use in the in-memory store tests.

nodes.name: in_memory_store_append_and_fetch_full
nodes.summary: Integration test appending chunks to the in-memory store and fetching the full working set, verifying round-trip integrity.

nodes.name: in_memory_store_partial_fetch_by_group
nodes.summary: Test verifying that group-level selection correctly routes only the requested groups into the working set.

nodes.name: in_memory_store_sink_local_always_fetched
nodes.summary: Test asserting that sink/local chunks are always pulled into the working set regardless of group selection.

nodes.name: tilr.rs
nodes.summary: TILR (Targeted Invariant Linear Refinement): refines latent states by projecting onto an orthonormal invariant-subspace basis and applying an eta-scaled update; includes invariant-subspace discovery from state-difference sequences.

nodes.name: TilrError
nodes.summary: Error enum for TILR refinement: basis not orthonormal, eta out of range, dimension mismatch, invalid tau, zero variance.

nodes.name: TilrScratch
nodes.summary: Scratch holding coefficients and projected-state buffers for the TILR refinement step.

nodes.name: with_capacity
nodes.summary: Constructs a TilrScratch sized for hidden dimension d and rank r.

nodes.name: check_orthonormal
nodes.summary: Verifies that an r x d basis matrix is orthonormal within the supplied tolerance.

nodes.name: tilr_refine_into
nodes.summary: TILR (Targeted Invariant Linear Refinement) step: projects the state-direction onto an invariant subspace basis and applies an eta-scaled refinement, into a caller buffer.

nodes.name: tilr_refine_apply
nodes.summary: Apply variant of TILR refinement that mutates the state in place after projecting onto the basis.

nodes.name: discover_invariant_subspace
nodes.summary: Discovers an invariant subspace from a sequence of state differences by extracting the dominant rank-r directions above variance threshold tau.

nodes.name: trigger_gate.rs
nodes.summary: Hysteresis-based compute trigger gate (Plan from breakeven primitive): promotes/demotes between CpuOnly/CpuGpu/CpuGpuAne tiers using rolling QPS, queue depth, p99 latency, and rim-vector novelty boosts; ships a background monitor wrapper.

nodes.name: ComputeTier
nodes.summary: Enum of compute tiers the system can promote to: CpuOnly, CpuGpu, CpuGpuAne.

nodes.name: TriggerGateConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for the trigger gate: QPS thresholds to activate GPU/ANE, hysteresis factor, queue-depth trigger, p99 latency trigger, and min tier-change interval.

nodes.name: RvThresholds
nodes.summary: Rim-vector (RV) thresholds (high/low) used to boost tier transitions based on novelty.

nodes.name: TriggerGate
nodes.summary: Hysteresis-based trigger gate that promotes/demotes between ComputeTiers using rolling QPS, queue depth, p99 latency, and RV-threshold boosts.

nodes.name: TriggerGateMonitor
nodes.summary: Background monitor that periodically evaluates the TriggerGate on a fixed interval and exposes a stop handle.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a TriggerGate from configuration plus current GPU/ANE availability flags.

nodes.name: evaluate
nodes.summary: Evaluates the gate against current load statistics and returns the recommended ComputeTier transition (if any), respecting hysteresis and min-interval cooldown.

nodes.name: should_promote
nodes.summary: Returns whether accumulated statistics justify promoting to a higher ComputeTier.

nodes.name: should_demote
nodes.summary: Returns whether accumulated statistics justify demoting to a lower ComputeTier.

nodes.name: estimated_qps
nodes.summary: Computes the estimated queries-per-second over the current observation window.

nodes.name: velocity_field_ensemble.rs
nodes.summary: Velocity-field ensemble for stochastic-interpolant sampling: combines homogeneous and heterogeneous (cross-resolution) velocity fields via ridge-regressed weights eta, with Cholesky-based fitting and ODE-step integration.
nodes.languageNotes: Homogeneous path uses ambient-space ridge solve; heterogeneous path projects samples through cross-resolution bases before fitting.

nodes.name: VelocityField
nodes.summary: Trait for a velocity field v(x) used in stochastic-interpolant sampling; implementers supply eval_into and a field id.

nodes.name: ClosureField
nodes.summary: Closure-backed velocity field wrapping a caller-supplied function f and an id.

nodes.name: VelocityFieldEnsemble
nodes.summary: Homogeneous ensemble of velocity fields combined via ridge-regressed weights eta, fit from dot(i_t, v_j) samples.

nodes.name: EnsembleFitScratch
nodes.summary: Scratch for the homogeneous ensemble fit: gram matrix, rhs, regularized gram, Cholesky factor, and solve buffers.

nodes.name: Schedule
nodes.summary: Interpolant schedule enum (Linear/Trigonometric) exposing alpha/beta/gamma and optimal_diffusion hooks for the sampling ODE.

nodes.name: HeterogeneousVelocityField
nodes.summary: Trait for velocity fields with a native (non ambient) dimension, used by the heterogeneous ensemble to handle cross-resolution fields.

nodes.name: HeterogeneousClosureField
nodes.summary: Closure-backed heterogeneous field carrying its native dimension alongside the closure.

nodes.name: HeterogeneousEntry
nodes.summary: Entry pairing a heterogeneous field with its cross-resolution bases in the heterogeneous ensemble.

nodes.name: HeterogeneousEnsemble
nodes.summary: Ensemble of heterogeneous velocity fields, fit via ridge regression on spectral/native projections and evaluated through per-field bases.

nodes.name: HeterogeneousFitScratch
nodes.summary: Scratch for the heterogeneous fit: extended gram/rhs/Cholesky buffers plus spectral and per-field native projection buffers.

nodes.name: fit_into
nodes.summary: Fits the homogeneous ensemble weights eta by ridge regression on dot(i_t, v_j) samples, writing weights into the caller-supplied eta buffer.

nodes.name: accumulate_pair_into
nodes.summary: Accumulates one pair (i,j) of the Gram matrix from a sampled i_t and its dot products with fields i and j.

nodes.name: solve_ridge_eta_into
nodes.summary: Solves the ridge-regularized linear system (gram + lambda I) eta = rhs via Cholesky into the eta buffer.

nodes.name: stochastic_interpolant_step_into
nodes.summary: Performs one stochastic-interpolant ODE step from x_t to x_out using the schedule, drift, and a noise sample.

nodes.name: eval_into
nodes.summary: Evaluates the homogeneous ensemble at x by eta-weighted combination of field outputs into a caller buffer.

nodes.name: accumulate_pair_heterogeneous_into
nodes.summary: Heterogeneous variant of pair Gram accumulation: projects i_t through per-field cross-resolution bases before forming dot products.

nodes.name: viable_manifold_graph.rs
nodes.summary: Viable-manifold graph builder: constructs a CSR graph over latent samples that satisfy a viability predicate (pullback-volume + midpoint checks), and ships geodesic, random-walk, and curiosity-walk traversals over it.

nodes.name: VolumeFieldConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for pullback-volume estimation: log epsilon and Jacobian finite-difference epsilon.

nodes.name: SafeManifoldGraph
nodes.summary: CSR-backed graph over viable latent samples with nearest-node lookup, neighbor iteration, and node-latent access.

nodes.name: GraphBuildConfig
nodes.summary: Build configuration: volume threshold, edge-midpoint viability check flag, and k-nearest connectivity.

nodes.name: ViabilityPredicate
nodes.summary: Trait abstracting viability checks: given a latent z, decide if it lies in the safe set.

nodes.name: ClosurePredicate
nodes.summary: Closure-backed viability predicate wrapping a caller-supplied function.

nodes.name: pullback_volume
nodes.summary: Estimates the pullback volume under map f at point z via numerical Jacobian and log-det, using the configured epsilons.

nodes.name: build_safe_manifold_graph
nodes.summary: Builds a SafeManifoldGraph over viable samples: tests pullback volume, edges by midpoint viability, and k-nearest connectivity.

nodes.name: manifold_geodesic
nodes.summary: Computes a geodesic (shortest path) over the SafeManifoldGraph between source and destination latents using edge weights.

nodes.name: manifold_random_walk
nodes.summary: Performs a random walk of m steps over the manifold graph from a source latent, using the supplied RNG.

nodes.name: manifold_curiosity_walk
nodes.summary: Weighted random walk biased by a caller-supplied weight function, used for curiosity-driven exploration of the manifold.

nodes.name: zone_density.rs
nodes.summary: Zone-density classifier and TTL cache: assigns each zone sample a Sparse/Transitional/Dense tier via sigmoid smooth transitions, exposes a mobility statistic and cache key per sample, and caches results with delta-driven invalidation.

nodes.name: DensityTier
nodes.summary: Enum of population-density tiers (Sparse/Transitional/Dense) used to route zone processing.

nodes.name: DensityClassifyConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for zone-density classification: rho0 baseline, beta sharpness, tier high/low thresholds, and cache invalidation delta.

nodes.name: DensityClassifyReport
nodes.summary: Report summarizing a classification pass: counts per tier and mean mobility across the population.

nodes.name: ZoneDensityCache
nodes.summary: TTL-bounded cache mapping zone id to a cached density/tier/value entry, with invalidation on density drift beyond a delta.

nodes.name: CacheEntry
nodes.summary: Cache entry holding the cached value, density, tier, and the tick at which the entry was cached.

nodes.name: zone_density_classify
nodes.summary: Classifies a population of zone samples into Sparse/Transitional/Dense tiers using sigmoid smooth transitions, writing mobility, tier, and a cache key per sample.

nodes.name: schedule_outer_first
nodes.summary: Reorders a population so that outermost (lowest-density) zones are scheduled first into the output buffer.

nodes.name: get_or_invalidate
nodes.summary: Cache lookup returning the stored value if still valid, or signalling invalidation when density has drifted beyond the configured delta.

nodes.name: zone_manifold.rs
nodes.summary: Zone-affective manifold primitive: PCA-style extraction of k principal axes from a crowd HLA matrix via power iteration with deflation, with grouped and ungrouped computation paths and a sign-fix strategy.
nodes.languageNotes: Replaces full eigendecomposition with iterative power iteration + deflation for a controlled-cost k-axis extraction.

nodes.name: ZoneManifoldReport
nodes.summary: Report bundle carrying zone axes, NPC projections, eigenvalues, explained variance ratios, and the n/d/k shapes from a manifold computation.

nodes.name: ZoneManifoldScratch
nodes.summary: Scratch holding covariance, backup, power-iteration v/w vectors, mean, and chunked covariance buffers, cached by (d, k).

nodes.name: ZoneManifoldConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for zone-affective manifold computation: iteration count, centering, parallel threshold, sign-fix strategy, and grouping parameters.

nodes.name: ZoneManifoldError
nodes.summary: Error enum: dimension mismatch, axes/projection/eigenvalue buffers too small, invalid k or d.

nodes.name: zone_affective_manifold
nodes.summary: Top-level entry point: computes the zone-affective manifold (k principal NPC axes) for a crowd HLA matrix, dispatching to grouped or ungrouped paths.

nodes.name: compute_grouped
nodes.summary: Grouped computation path: splits the crowd into g groups, computes per-group covariance, and merges for the k principal axes.

nodes.name: compute_mean_and_covariance
nodes.summary: Computes the mean and upper-triangular covariance of the crowd matrix into the scratch buffers.

nodes.name: accumulate_triangle
nodes.summary: Accumulates one triangle block of the covariance from a slice of centered crowd rows.

nodes.name: power_iteration_deflate
nodes.summary: Extracts one principal axis via power iteration on the covariance and then deflates the covariance by the outer product of the result.

nodes.name: context.rs
nodes.summary: Pre-allocated context buffers (PrefillContext, WallPrefixState, GateStatistics) for bidirectional prefill and Wall attention gating, reused across forward passes for zero-allocation request handling.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure-data substrate types with reset() / new() allocator helpers — forward logic lives in the katgpt-rs root crate.

nodes.name: PrefillContext
nodes.summary: Pre-allocated hidden-state and query buffers for the bidirectional prefill phase, created once at startup and reused across all requests.

nodes.name: WallPrefixState
nodes.summary: Mutable Wall-attention prefix state: tracks gates, retention, and per-block statistics during prefill, with helpers to compute gates from keys and rescale queries/keys.

nodes.name: compute_gate_and_update
nodes.summary: Computes a Wall-attention gate from a key slice and updates the prefix state in place.

nodes.name: rescale_query
nodes.summary: Rescales query rows for a given layer using the kv-group lookup table and accumulated Wall gates.

nodes.name: rescale_key
nodes.summary: Rescales key rows for a given layer under the Wall attention scheme.

nodes.name: compute_gate_from_key
nodes.summary: Pure helper that derives a Wall gate vector from a key slice, gate weights, bias, and running gate maximum.

nodes.name: min_retention_at_block
nodes.summary: Computes the minimum retention value over a kv-head block — used to decide which prefix positions stay cached under Wall attention.

nodes.name: gate_statistics
nodes.summary: Summarises Wall gate statistics (mean, min, max, retention histogram) for diagnostics and tuning.

nodes.name: contiguous.rs
nodes.summary: Single-buffer contiguous weight allocator that packs all model parameters into one aligned allocation for better L2 cache locality (Plan 102 / TileRT D2).
nodes.languageNotes: Uses C-repr WeightSlice descriptors so the same buffer can be reparsed across runs without re-walking the model graph.

nodes.name: ContiguousWeights
nodes.summary: Owner of the contiguous weight buffer plus per-layer slice descriptors, exposing typed accessors (wte, wpe, lm_head, layer_wq…) and load helpers.

nodes.name: from_weights
nodes.summary: Builds a ContiguousWeights buffer by aligning and copying all weight matrices from a TransformerWeights instance into a single allocation.

nodes.name: load_ternary_bits
nodes.summary: Loads ternary-packed weight bits from disk and expands them into the contiguous f32 weight buffer for bitnet-style quantised models.

nodes.name: kv_cache.rs
nodes.summary: KV cache substrate: per-layer KVCache, MultiLayerKVCache with snapshot/restore, PagedKVCache with fork/rollback for speculative branching, and RavenKVCache router state — pure data + allocator helpers.
nodes.languageNotes: Three distinct cache strategies share the file: flat per-layer (KVCache), stacked with snapshot (MultiLayerKVCache), and paged with fork/rollback (PagedKVCache).

nodes.name: KVCache
nodes.summary: Single-layer key/value cache for autoregressive generation, allocated as flat f32 vectors sized to block_size × kv_dim.

nodes.name: MultiLayerKVCache
nodes.summary: Stack of per-layer KV caches with position tracking, snapshot/restore, and invalidation helpers used by the speculative decode loop.

nodes.name: PagedKVCache
nodes.summary: Paged KV cache with page allocation, per-sequence page tables, and fork/rollback primitives for branching speculative decoding.

nodes.name: RavenKVCache
nodes.summary: Raven-routing KV cache state that maintains router logits, top-k slots, and selection helpers for retrieval-augmented decode paths.

nodes.name: snapshot_into
nodes.summary: Snapshots the multi-layer cache state at a position into a caller-provided buffer, avoiding allocation on the speculative-decode hot path.

nodes.name: restore
nodes.summary: Restores the multi-layer cache from a snapshot — used to roll back a rejected speculative draft.

nodes.name: preload_kv_cache
nodes.summary: Copies KV state from a target cache into a drafter cache at a position, bridging the MTP drafter/verifier hidden-state handoff.

nodes.name: alloc_page
nodes.summary: Allocates a fresh KV page from the pool or grows the pool, returning a page id for the paged cache.

nodes.name: ensure_pages
nodes.summary: Ensures the page table for a sequence covers a target position, allocating and linking pages as needed.

nodes.name: write_kv
nodes.summary: Writes a key/value pair into a paged cache slot at a given layer, sequence, and position.

nodes.name: read_kv
nodes.summary: Reads a key/value pair from a paged cache slot, chasing the per-sequence page table.

nodes.name: fork
nodes.summary: Creates a new sequence sharing pages with its parent up to fork_at_pos — used to branch speculative drafts cheaply.

nodes.name: rollback
nodes.summary: Rolls a sequence back to an earlier position, freeing any pages allocated after the rollback target.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: katgpt-transformer crate root: pure-data substrate types (KV cache, weights, context, contiguous layout) plus feature-gated cognitive modules (dense_mesh, mbu, swir, tf_loop, thinking_cot) shared between katgpt-rs root and riir-engine.
nodes.languageNotes: Each cognitive module is gated behind a cargo feature flag (dense_mesh, kog_cpu_fusion, swir_switch_thinking, tf_loop, thinking_cot) so consumers compile only what they use.

nodes.name: DecodeStage
nodes.summary: Enum of decode-loop phases (Prefill, Draft, Verify, Sample, BeliefDraft) shared between the transformer substrate and host decode drivers.

nodes.name: mbu.rs
nodes.summary: Memory Bandwidth Utilization (MBU) diagnostics: MbuCounter accumulates weight bytes read, MbuReport reports per-token bandwidth and utilisation percentage against peak (Plan 160 T9).

nodes.name: MbuCounter
nodes.summary: Accumulator of bytes read from weight buffers during a forward pass, with reset and weight-matrix helpers.

nodes.name: MbuReport
nodes.summary: Computes per-token byte cost, achieved bandwidth (GB/s), and MBU percentage against peak, with a formatted report string.

nodes.name: per_layer_weight_bytes
nodes.summary: Computes the total byte footprint of one transformer layer's weight matrices from a Config.

nodes.name: per_token_weight_bytes
nodes.summary: Computes the per-token weight byte cost (total weight bytes / seq_len) for MBU estimation.

nodes.name: fmt_benchmark_line
nodes.summary: Formats a one-line benchmark summary (throughput, latency, MBU pct) for stdout or logs.

nodes.name: mtp.rs
nodes.summary: Multi-Token Prediction projector: projects target hidden state into the drafter's embedding space via learned matmul or truncate/pad fallback, plus a binary MTP projection loader (Plan 016/055).

nodes.name: MtpProjection
nodes.summary: Holds the loaded MTP projection matrix and dimension metadata used to map target activations into the drafter's embedding space.

nodes.name: project_target_activation
nodes.summary: Projects a target hidden vector into the drafter's embedding space via learned matmul, or falls back to truncate/pad when no projection matrix is present.

nodes.name: load_mtp_projection
nodes.summary: Loads an MTP projection matrix from a binary file with header validation, returning None cleanly when the file is absent (truncate/pad fallback).

nodes.name: tf_loop.rs
nodes.summary: Training-Free Loop Wrapper (Plan 136): ODE-motivated damped sub-stepping re-application of a contiguous mid-stack layer window with anchor blend and KV cache snapshot/restore — pure inference-time retrofit.
nodes.languageNotes: Bounded-acceleration guard (AccelBoundConfig) clamps the damped Euler sub-step when consecutive iterates diverge, preventing ODE blow-ups at high step counts.

nodes.name: AccelBoundConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration bounds (absolute and relative) for the bounded-acceleration guard that clamps damped Euler sub-steps.

nodes.name: default_loop_window
nodes.summary: Heuristic that picks the default contiguous layer window for the loop based on total layer count.

nodes.name: sub_step_damped_euler_bounded
nodes.summary: Applies one bounded-acceleration damped Euler sub-step, clamping the update against the previous iterate when acceleration exceeds the configured bound.

nodes.name: anchor_blend
nodes.summary: Blends the looped state with the one-shot anchor state by factor beta to stabilise the final output of the loop window.

nodes.name: snapshot_cache_lengths
nodes.summary: Snapshots per-layer KV cache lengths before the loop so the post-loop restore can trim any extra positions the loop wrote.

nodes.name: restore_cache_lengths
nodes.summary: Restores per-layer KV cache lengths from a snapshot, trimming any extra positions appended during the loop.

nodes.name: restore_cache_positions
nodes.summary: Rewinds per-layer KV cache positions to a target position after a loop run, mirroring the hidden-state rollback.

nodes.name: weights.rs
nodes.summary: Transformer weight structures: per-layer LayerWeights (attention QKVO, MLP w1/w2, Wall gates) and TransformerWeights with seed-init, Wall-gate init, RMSNorm gamma folding, and QKV interleave helpers.

nodes.name: LayerWeights
nodes.summary: Per-layer transformer weights: attention Q, K, V, O matrices, MLP w1/w2, optional Wall gates, and RMSNorm gains.

nodes.name: TransformerWeights
nodes.summary: Top-level weight bundle: token/position embeddings, LM head (optional), per-layer LayerWeights vector, and Wall-gate state, with seed-based init and fusion helpers.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a TransformerWeights from a Config and RNG, allocating and initialising every per-layer matrix and embedding in one pass.

nodes.name: fold_gamma
nodes.summary: Folds RMSNorm gamma scales into the preceding weight matrices to eliminate an extra per-step multiplication at inference time.

nodes.name: interleave_qkv
nodes.summary: Interleaves per-head Q, K, V weight rows into a single packed matrix for fused attention matmul.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel for thinking_cot: re-exports the ThinkingStrategy trait, StepContext, StepDirective, and ControlTokenIds integration primitives consumed by swir, CollapseAware, and ChainFold (Plan 194/275).

nodes.name: strategy.rs
nodes.summary: Thinking-strategy trait and integration primitives: StepContext input bundle, StepDirective output (EmitToken / EmitSoftEmbedding / ForceAnswerPrefix), ControlTokenIds, and the ThinkingStrategy trait consumed by adaptive decode-loop controllers.

nodes.name: ThinkingStrategy
nodes.summary: Trait that adaptive decode-loop controllers implement to translate per-step logits into a StepDirective for the host loop.

nodes.name: StepContext
nodes.summary: Input bundle handed to a ThinkingStrategy each step: logits, soft-embedding scratch, token id state, and step index.

nodes.name: StepDirective
nodes.summary: Enum of strategy decisions (EmitToken, EmitSoftEmbedding, ForceAnswerPrefix, ContinueLatent) returned each step.

nodes.name: ControlTokenIds
nodes.summary: Token-id triple (think-open, think-close, answer-prefix) used by strategies to anchor mode transitions.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel for dense_mesh: re-exports the DenseNode/DenseEdge trait abstractions, LayerwiseTopology orchestrator, EdgeBandit, edge variants (identity/LoRA/projection), AdaptiveWidthController, and supporting types of the latent node network (LMNet distillation).
nodes.languageNotes: Module-level doc enforces the latent/raw domain split: DenseHidden is latent-only and must never cross SyncBlock or chain quorum.

nodes.name: adaptive_width.rs
nodes.summary: Adaptive width controller for DenseMesh that selects narrow vs. wide topology per query based on CollapseAware hesitation signals and BreakevenRouter CPU→GPU amortisation (Plan 266 Phase 5).
nodes.languageNotes: Decision rule prioritises the collapse signal (observed model state) over the breakeven signal (cost amortisation); sigmoid gates map continuous ratios to discrete Expand/Contract/Neutral.

nodes.name: AdaptiveWidthConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for the adaptive width controller: collapse thresholds, breakeven snapshot path, and selectors that combine both signals into a final WidthDecision.

nodes.name: WidthDecision
nodes.summary: Result of combining collapse and breakeven signals into a single Expand/Contract/Neutral directive plus selected topology width.

nodes.name: collapse_signal
nodes.summary: Maps a CollapseDetector's hesitation ratio against a config to an Expand/Contract/Neutral signal via sigmoid activation bands.

nodes.name: breakeven_signal
nodes.summary: Reads a BreakevenSnapshot and returns whether the CPU→GPU upgrade has amortised, gating wide-topology eligibility.

nodes.name: compute_router.rs
nodes.summary: Compute-target selector that maps a DenseMesh layer's width and role to CPU, GPU, or ANE based on a GPU width threshold and ANE preference flag.

nodes.name: pick_compute
nodes.summary: Returns the ComputeTarget for a layer given its width, role, GPU width threshold, and ANE preference.

nodes.name: edge_bandit.rs
nodes.summary: Thompson-sampling EdgeBandit over (topology, edge_set) pairs with Beta and Gamma posterior samplers, providing self-learning adaptive topology selection without LLM training.
nodes.languageNotes: Includes a Gamma-distributed posterior sampler implemented from scratch (no rand_distr dependency) for arms with non-binary reward shapes.

nodes.name: EdgeBandit
nodes.summary: Multi-armed bandit over topology/edge-set arms: samples an arm via Thompson sampling, updates posteriors from observed reward.

nodes.name: EdgeBanditArm
nodes.summary: One bandit arm: a labelled topology shape (widths) plus an edge subset, with Beta/Gamma posterior state.

nodes.name: sample_gamma
nodes.summary: Samples from a Gamma(shape) distribution via Marsaglia–Tsang rejection sampling, used for non-binary-reward arms.

nodes.name: edge_identity.rs
nodes.summary: IdentityEdge DenseMesh edge that copies the source hidden state into the scratch edge output unchanged — the baseline pass-through.

nodes.name: IdentityEdge
nodes.summary: Zero-state DenseEdge implementation that copies its input hidden state verbatim into the scratch output.

nodes.name: edge_lora.rs
nodes.summary: LoraEdge DenseMesh edge that applies a frozen low-rank LoRA update (B·A) on top of the identity pass-through, supporting per-edge gates and rank-capped scratch reuse (paper §4.2.2 frozen-vertex setting).
nodes.languageNotes: Trained LoRA edges live in riir-ai (R122 EdgeLoRA); katgpt-rs loads them read-only and applies them at inference.

nodes.name: LoraEdge
nodes.summary: DenseEdge backed by a LoRA A/B matrix pair plus optional gate; applies low-rank update B·A·x scaled and added to identity.

nodes.name: lora_row
nodes.summary: Computes one output row of the LoRA update B·(A·input_row) into a caller-provided buffer with effective-scale folding.

nodes.name: effective_scale
nodes.summary: Computes the per-row effective LoRA scale, folding in the global gate and any input-dependent normalisation.

nodes.name: route_into
nodes.summary: DenseEdge route_into implementation: applies the LoRA update across all input rows into the MeshScratch edge output.

nodes.name: edge_projection.rs
nodes.summary: ProjectionEdge DenseMesh edge applying a fixed (non-trainable) random projection matrix as the modelless fallback when no trained LoRA edge is available.

nodes.name: ProjectionEdge
nodes.summary: DenseEdge backed by a fixed random projection matrix, providing a non-trivial baseline transformation without trained weights.

nodes.name: project_row
nodes.summary: Computes one output row of the fixed projection y = W · input_row into a caller-provided buffer.

nodes.name: route_into
nodes.summary: DenseEdge route_into implementation: applies the projection across all input rows into the MeshScratch edge output.

nodes.name: handoff.rs
nodes.summary: HiddenHandoff carrier structure that ferries a hidden state, draft position, and confidence between drafter and verifier across the speculative decode boundary.

nodes.name: HiddenHandoff
nodes.summary: Carrier holding a DenseHidden plus draft position and confidence score, with new/clear helpers for reuse across decode steps.

nodes.name: topology.rs
nodes.summary: LayerwiseTopology graph orchestrator for DenseMesh: drives layer-wise forward passes (sequential, parallel rayon, batched scratch-pooled) over DenseNode vertices and DenseEdge matrices per LMNet §3.1.3.
nodes.languageNotes: Switches between three forward paths (sequential, rayon parallel, scratch-pooled) based on a VERTEX_BATCH_THRESHOLD to balance spawn overhead against allocation cost.

nodes.name: LayerwiseTopology
nodes.summary: Owns the topology widths, the shared DenseNode, and the per-layer edge matrix; exposes forward() plus convenience constructors chain_with_edge().

nodes.name: TopologyError
nodes.summary: Error enum for topology construction and forward failures (shape mismatch, edge-matrix mismatch, hidden-dim mismatch).

nodes.name: forward
nodes.summary: Top-level forward pass: walks layers in order, dispatching each layer to sequential or parallel forward based on width.

nodes.name: forward_layer_sequential
nodes.summary: Sequential per-successor forward of one layer: applies each DenseEdge in turn against the shared DenseNode output.

nodes.name: forward_layer_parallel
nodes.summary: Parallel rayon forward of one layer: spawns one task per successor vertex to apply edges concurrently.

nodes.name: forward_layer_parallel_pooled
nodes.summary: Batched scratch-pooled parallel forward (Path B): reuses per-worker scratches and output slots to avoid per-successor allocation at high widths.

nodes.name: traits.rs
nodes.summary: DenseNode and DenseEdge trait definitions — the seam contract for vertex forwards and edge transformations in the DenseMesh latent node network.

nodes.name: DenseNode
nodes.summary: Trait for a stripped transformer forward pass (no embed/de-embed): forward_dense plus hidden_dim accessor.

nodes.name: DenseEdge
nodes.summary: Trait for a DenseMesh edge: route_into (transform hidden state into scratch), cost_hint, and name for diagnostics.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Core DenseMesh data types: DenseHidden latent channel, Topology shape descriptors (chain/diamond/wide), MeshConfig, MeshScratch, ComputeTarget, and latent↔raw scalar bridge helpers.
nodes.languageNotes: DenseHidden is stored as Box<[f32]> for stable layout across passes; latent↔raw bridge helpers enforce the AGENTS.md domain split.

nodes.name: DenseHidden
nodes.summary: Dense latent hidden-state vector exchanged between DenseMesh nodes, with row slicing, clear, and AddAssign helpers for in-place updates.

nodes.name: Topology
nodes.summary: Topology shape descriptor with chain/diamond/wide presets, depth, per-layer width, role, and edge-count accessors.

nodes.name: MeshConfig
nodes.summary: Mesh-wide configuration: hidden dim, default topology, GPU width threshold, and a pick_compute selector.

nodes.name: MeshScratch
nodes.summary: Reusable scratch buffers for edge outputs and rank-capped LoRA temporaries, allocated once and cleared per forward to keep the hot path zero-alloc.

nodes.name: latent_to_raw_scalar
nodes.summary: Projects a latent DenseHidden slice to a single raw scalar along a direction — the bridge used at latent↔raw seams.

nodes.name: raw_to_latent_projection
nodes.summary: Reverse bridge: writes a raw scalar into a latent output buffer along a direction vector.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel for swir: re-exports SwiRController, soft_embedding, mix_thinking_signal, SwiRStrategyAdapter, configuration types, entropy kernels, convex-hull check, and the benchmark harness (Plan 275).

nodes.name: bench.rs
nodes.summary: SwiR GOAT-gate benchmark harness: ProblemSource/DecodeBackend traits, BenchResult/ComparisonResult metrics, Pareto sweep, and a synthetic reference implementation validating the harness on deterministic data (Plan 275 Phase 3).
nodes.languageNotes: Engine-side traits split model/dataset halves from the host; riir-ai Plan 313 implements them against Gemma 2 2B IT + MATH500 for empirical G1/G2 gates.

nodes.name: BenchConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for a benchmark run: problem count, mode (Explicit/Latent/Both), max steps, and convergence thresholds.

nodes.name: BenchResult
nodes.summary: Aggregated benchmark outcome: accuracy, average steps, latency, switch count, plus a formatted summary string.

nodes.name: ComparisonResult
nodes.summary: Differential between an Explicit-mode baseline and a Latent-mode run, with the GOAT-gate verdict (pass/fail per G1 accuracy and G2 efficiency).

nodes.name: ProblemSource
nodes.summary: Trait abstracting a benchmark problem dataset: length, prompt retrieval, and answer-correctness check.

nodes.name: DecodeBackend
nodes.summary: Trait abstracting the model half of the benchmark: embedding access and one decode step producing a probability vector.

nodes.name: SyntheticProblemSource
nodes.summary: Deterministic synthetic problem set used to validate the benchmark harness wiring without a real model.

nodes.name: SyntheticDecodeBackend
nodes.summary: Deterministic synthetic decode backend with a fixed embedding matrix and rule-based decode step for harness validation.

nodes.name: run_benchmark
nodes.summary: Runs a single benchmark configuration against a problem source and decode backend, returning a BenchResult.

nodes.name: run_pareto_sweep
nodes.summary: Sweeps the max-switch-count parameter across values, collecting ParetoPoint samples of accuracy vs efficiency.

nodes.name: verdict
nodes.summary: Classifies a comparison as GOAT-gate pass/fail based on the G1 (accuracy delta) and G2 (efficiency ratio) thresholds.

nodes.name: controller.rs
nodes.summary: SwiRController — 2-mode Explicit↔Latent state machine driven by the sign of entropy − reference_entropy, with asymmetric dwell windows, switch-count convergence, and kurtosis-escape injection.
nodes.languageNotes: Reference entropy is reset on every switch, so the decision is relative ('more or less confident than the last switch point') rather than absolute — drift-robust by design.

nodes.name: SwiRController
nodes.summary: Owns the current ThinkMode, dwell counters, reference entropy, switch count, and a fixed-size inject queue; step() advances the state machine one step.

nodes.name: step
nodes.summary: One controller step: compares current entropy to reference, applies dwell windows and convergence checks, and emits the next StepAction (token, soft embedding, or force-answer).

nodes.name: switch_to
nodes.summary: Performs a mode switch: updates ThinkMode, resets reference entropy to the current value, increments switch count, resets dwell.

nodes.name: observe_kurtosis
nodes.summary: Feeds an observed kurtosis value to the controller; if it exceeds the escape threshold, the next step forces a mode switch.

nodes.name: stats
nodes.summary: Returns a snapshot of SwiRStats (mode, switch count, dwell, kurtosis escapes) for diagnostics.

nodes.name: convex_hull_check.rs
nodes.summary: Convex-hull invariant check for the soft embedding: verifies ẽ_t[d] ∈ [min_v e(v)[d], max_v e(v)[d]] per dimension — a mathematical correctness check used in tests and the GOAT-gate harness, not the hot path.

nodes.name: in_vocab_convex_hull
nodes.summary: Checks that every dimension of the soft embedding lies within the per-dimension min/max box of the vocabulary embeddings.

nodes.name: entropy.rs
nodes.summary: Shannon entropy kernels: chunked SIMD-friendly probability reduction (shannon_entropy) and a max-shift-stable logits→entropy variant (entropy_from_logits) for SwiR mode decisions.

nodes.name: shannon_entropy
nodes.summary: Computes H = -Σ p_i ln(p_i) over a normalised probability slice with a 1e-20 fastmax floor to avoid log(0).

nodes.name: entropy_from_logits
nodes.summary: One-pass logits → Shannon entropy using a max-shift stabiliser (subtracts the row max before exp) to avoid overflow.

nodes.name: signal_mix.rs
nodes.summary: mix_thinking_signal kernel: linear-schedule interpolation between the would-be soft embedding and a control-token embedding at switch instants (paper Eq. 4) to keep the residual stream continuous across mode boundaries.

nodes.name: SignalMixKind
nodes.summary: Enum identifying whether a signal-mix blend is Explicit→Latent or Latent→Explicit (selects which anchor token is used).

nodes.name: mix_thinking_signal
nodes.summary: In-place blend: out ← ratio · out + (1 − ratio) · control_token_embed, with ratio increasing toward the soft embedding as the run progresses.

nodes.name: soft_embedding.rs
nodes.summary: soft_embedding kernel: probability-weighted vocabulary mixture ẽ_t = Σ_v p_t[v]·e(v) emitted in Latent mode, accumulating into a caller-provided scratch buffer with zero allocation.
nodes.languageNotes: Accumulates into out rather than overwriting so the caller can fold in a residual or signal-mix component in the same buffer without a second pass.

nodes.name: soft_embedding
nodes.summary: Computes ẽ_t = Σ_v p_t[v] · e(v) by chunked SIMD-friendly accumulation into a caller-zeroed output buffer.

nodes.name: strategy_adapter.rs
nodes.summary: SwiRStrategyAdapter: bridges the modelless SwiRController to the ThinkingStrategy integration point, owning the controller plus reusable softmax/probability scratch buffers and running per-step mode transitions.

nodes.name: SwiRStrategyAdapter
nodes.summary: Owns a SwiRController plus reusable probability and soft-embedding scratch buffers; implements ThinkingStrategy via on_step.

nodes.name: on_step
nodes.summary: Per-step ThinkingStrategy implementation: derives entropy from logits, drives the SwiRController, and produces a StepDirective (EmitToken / EmitSoftEmbedding / ForceAnswerPrefix).

nodes.name: softmax_into_scratch
nodes.summary: Max-shift-stable softmax into the adapter's reusable probability scratch buffer, used before entropy and soft-embedding computation.

nodes.name: resolve_control_token
nodes.summary: Maps a symbolic ControlToken to its concrete id from the host's ControlTokenIds, defaulting to a safe token when unset.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: SwiR configuration and shared types: ThinkMode enum, ControlToken, StepAction, SwiRConfig with paper-default dwell windows and switch caps, and SwiRStats counters.

nodes.name: ThinkMode
nodes.summary: Enum of reasoning modes: Explicit (decode a concrete token) or Latent (emit a probability-weighted soft embedding).

nodes.name: SwiRConfig
nodes.summary: Controller configuration: Explicit↔Latent dwell windows, max switch count, entropy smoothing, and convergence thresholds with paper-default values.

nodes.name: StepAction
nodes.summary: Output of one controller step: action variant (emit token, emit soft embedding, force answer) plus accompanying payload.

nodes.name: ControlToken
nodes.summary: Symbolic identifier for a control token (think-open, think-close, answer-prefix) resolved against host token ids at runtime.

nodes.name: SwiRStats
nodes.summary: Snapshot of controller runtime counters: current mode, switch count, dwell steps, kurtosis-escape fires.

wraps any ScreeningPruner; zero-cost abstraction over the inner pruner.

nodes.summary: Exploration strategy enum selecting between UCB1, epsilon-greedy, and Thompson Sampling for arm selection in Multi-Armed Bandit.
