nodes.summary: SON-LT trained multi-adapter LoRA FFT player running a Transformer forward pass over 57-token battle state to predict action type.

nodes.name: FftPlayer
nodes.summary: Trait defining the FFT player interface: select_action per unit per turn, name, and reset hooks.

nodes.name: HLFFTPlayer
nodes.summary: Hierarchical Learning FFT player: bandit Q-learning over 9 action types with cross-round adaptation and epsilon-greedy exploration.

nodes.name: RubricFFTPlayer
nodes.summary: FFT player using ROPD rubric-vector reward (RubricBanditPruner + RubricGatedAbsorbCompress) for multi-axis action evaluation.

nodes.name: SdarFFTPlayer
nodes.summary: FFT player using SDAR sigmoid-gated scalar reward for action selection and absorb-compress promotion.

nodes.name: FftSr2amPlayer
nodes.summary: FFT player extending GZero with ConfiguratorBandit for learned per-tick planning regulation using Shannon entropy context.

nodes.name: StatusEffect
nodes.summary: Enum of 9 FFT status effects (Poison, Regen, Protect, Shell, Haste, Slow, Silence, Blind, Sleep) with tick behavior and dispel rules.

nodes.name: ActiveEffect
nodes.summary: Active instance of a StatusEffect applied to a unit: tracks duration, potency, and applies tick effects each round.

nodes.name: TftFFTPlayer
nodes.summary: Generous Tit-for-Tat FFT player: role-based Nice/Retaliatory modes with configurable forgiveness and epsilon-greedy exploration.

nodes.name: Unit
nodes.summary: FFT unit: team, class, stats, position, HP/MP, alive flag. Primary actor in the ATB battle loop.

nodes.name: ActionType
nodes.summary: Enum of 9 FFT action types (Attack, Defend, Move, Potion, BlackMagic, WhiteMagic, CurePoison, Esuna, Dispel) with MP cost and magic classification.

nodes.name: GameEvent
nodes.summary: Enum of FFT game events (damage, heal, status apply/remove, move, etc.) recorded for replay and rendering.

nodes.name: BomberTemplate
nodes.summary: Enum of 8 Bomberman strategy archetypes (FleeBlast, ChaseNearest, BombWall, CampCorner, etc.) for G-Zero self-play.

nodes.name: BomberTemplateProposer
nodes.summary: UCB1-weighted template proposer with Hint-delta feedback: selects bomber strategy templates and tracks per-template performance statistics.

nodes.name: DeltaGatedAbsorbCompress
nodes.summary: Absorb-compress layer gated by Hint-delta: promotes arms only when delta reveals blind spots (high information deficit).

nodes.name: encode_battle_state
nodes.summary: Encodes BattleState into 57 tokens (tick + 8 units x 7 fields) in range 0..10 for SON-LT replay and LoRA inference.

nodes.name: delta_bandit.rs
nodes.summary: Wraps BanditPruner with a delta-floor and exponential decay (lambda_length) so arm rewards reflect token-level Hint-delta magnitude rather than raw outcomes, exposing blind-spot detection across arms.
nodes.languageNotes: Defines DeltaBanditPruner as a generic newtype over <P: BanditPruner> with fluent builder methods (with_delta_floor, with_lambda_length) and intrinsic relevance(depth,token_idx,parent_tokens).

nodes.name: fft_templates.rs
nodes.summary: FFT-battle specialization of G-Zero: defines an FFTTemplate taxonomy and an FFTTemplateProposer (UCB1 bandit) that learns which tactical templates produce the highest game-delta, including a 100+ line heuristic hint_score_override.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel for the G-Zero self-play distillation subsystem (Plan 064): re-exports HintDelta, DeltaGatedAbsorbCompress, DeltaBanditPruner, BomberTemplateProposer, FFTTemplateProposer, TemplateProposer, and GeneratedPair.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust mod.rs barrel pattern with feature-gated submodules (g_zero and fft feature flags conditionally include fft_templates).

nodes.name: template_proposer.rs
nodes.summary: Generic G-Zero template proposer: maintains a QueryTemplate catalog (writing/explanation/advice/analysis/coding/reasoning) with a UCB1 bandit and a reasoning cap, generating prompt/hint pairs targeted at observed blind-spot arms.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the HintDelta intrinsic reward signal (log-prob shift between query and hint distributions) and LogProbResult container, the modelless replacement for external LLM judges in G-Zero self-play.

nodes.name: mcts.rs
nodes.summary: Provides a BanditRolloutPolicy that drives MCTS rollouts with a UCB1/Thompson-sampling BanditPruner, mapping each GameState action to a bandit arm and selecting via epsilon-greedy exploration during simulation.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel for the abstract GameState trait and MCTS infrastructure: re-exports BanditRolloutPolicy and (downstream) the GameState trait used by the Go integration.

nodes.name: analytics.rs
nodes.summary: Go replay analytics: computes GoGameAnalytics from a replay (captures, score, branching, MLWR move-quality win-rate), detects garbage moves and unstable rounds, and converts raw samples into GoReplay objects for distillation.

nodes.name: autogo_client.rs
nodes.summary: Synchronous REST client for the external AutoGo play.py server (list_agents, new_game, get_game, make_move, pass_move), exposing AutoGoGameState and AutoGoError used by the tournament harness.

nodes.name: autoresearch.rs
nodes.summary: AutoResearch loop (Plan 065 Phase 5): runs multi-armed bandit search over Go player hyperparameters (center weight, greedy weight, capture weight), prunes weak arms, and prints structured trial summaries from internal self-play games.

nodes.name: event_log_player.rs
nodes.summary: Go-specific event log wrapper (feature-gated) that records stone placements, passes, resignations and eval events, with fork_at/diff/replay primitives that mirror the generic EventLog API for game-tree divergence analysis.

nodes.name: g_zero_player.rs
nodes.summary: G-Zero Go integration (Plan 065 Phase 4): implements GoTemplateProposer, GoDeltaGatedAbsorbCompress, and run_gzero_selfplay — a 276-line driver that plays template-informed moves, computes Hint-delta, and compresses promoted templates after each episode.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel for the Go integration (Plan 065): re-exports GoState, GoHeuristic, GoReplay, AutoGoClient, six GoPlayer implementations, tournament runner, and feature-gated event_log_player and sdpg_player submodules.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses #[cfg(feature = ...)] to conditionally compile event_log_player and sdpg_player; re-exports types across 11 submodules.

nodes.name: DeltaBanditPruner
nodes.summary: Generic newtype over BanditPruner that floors arm rewards by delta_floor and decays them with exponential lambda_length, exposing delta-aware observe_delta and blind_spot_arms methods.

nodes.name: observe_delta
nodes.summary: Feeds a Hint-delta into the inner BanditPruner after applying delta_floor and lambda_length decay, mapping intrinsic reward to arm updates.

nodes.name: blind_spot_arms
nodes.summary: Returns the top-k arms with the lowest mean delta, identifying where the model's hint distribution diverges least from the unassisted query.

nodes.name: FFTTemplate
nodes.summary: Enum-like taxonomy of FFT battle tactics (focus_fire, tank_shield, mage_burst, etc.) with all(), name(), and count() accessors used by the template bandit.

nodes.name: FFTTemplateProposer
nodes.summary: UCB1 bandit over FFT templates that selects tactical templates by mean game-delta, exposing select/observe_delta/best_template and a template_distribution snapshot.

nodes.name: hint_score_override
nodes.summary: 107-line heuristic that, given a template and battle state, returns an override score for each candidate unit action by pattern-matching tactical templates (focus fire on low-HP enemies, shielding threatened allies, etc.).

nodes.name: compute_game_delta
nodes.summary: Computes the reward signal for FFT template bandit updates by aggregating query vs hint score deltas across the simulated battle.

nodes.name: QueryTemplate
nodes.summary: Struct describing a prompt template (category, subtype, body) with defaults() returning the canonical 6-category catalog (writing/explanation/advice/analysis/coding/reasoning).

nodes.name: TemplateProposer
nodes.summary: Bandit-weighted prompt generator that proposes targeted templates for blind-spot arms, generates prompt/hint pairs via per-category generators, and enforces a reasoning budget cap.

nodes.name: defaults
nodes.summary: Constructs the default 6-category QueryTemplate catalog with multiple subtypes per category (e.g. coding has bug-fix, refactor, doc-write).

nodes.name: generate_from_template
nodes.summary: Dispatches to per-category generators to produce a (query, hint) GeneratedPair from a selected template id and category-specific subtype.

nodes.name: HintDelta
nodes.summary: Intrinsic reward struct capturing the log-prob shift between query-only and hint-assisted token distributions, with compute(), is_informative(), and token_count() accessors.

nodes.name: compute
nodes.summary: Computes HintDelta by comparing token log-probabilities between the unassisted query distribution and the hint-augmented distribution, returning the per-token and aggregate delta.

nodes.name: BanditRolloutPolicy
nodes.summary: MCTS rollout policy that wraps a BanditPruner, mapping each GameState action to a bandit arm and selecting moves via epsilon-greedy UCB1 during simulation.

nodes.name: select
nodes.summary: Selects the next action during an MCTS rollout by indexing legal actions into bandit arms and applying UCB1 with epsilon-greedy exploration.

nodes.name: GoGameAnalytics
nodes.summary: Aggregate analytics for a finished Go game: captures, final score, branching factor, move count, winner, and MLWR-derived quality metrics.

nodes.name: compute_analytics
nodes.summary: 114-line reducer that walks a GoReplay move trace to compute captures per move, running score, branching factor, and assembles a GoGameAnalytics summary.

nodes.name: compute_mlwr
nodes.summary: Computes the Move-Level Win Rate (MLWR) for a slice of moves by replaying the game from each move's perspective and recording whether the eventual winner was the move's player.

nodes.name: samples_to_replay
nodes.summary: Converts a sequence of RawGoSample records into a GoReplay by reconstructing the board state at each move, used for dataset curation before distillation.

nodes.name: AutoGoClient
nodes.summary: Synchronous HTTP client wrapping ureq with the AutoGo play.py REST surface: list_agents, new_game, get_game, make_move, pass_move.

nodes.name: AutoGoGameState
nodes.summary: Deserialized game state returned by AutoGo: board grid, current turn, move history, winner, and komi, used to convert to internal GoState.

nodes.name: make_move
nodes.summary: POSTs a stone placement (row, col) to the AutoGo server and returns the updated game state, propagating network errors as AutoGoError.

nodes.name: GoResearchConfig
nodes.summary: Per-arm hyperparameter bundle (center/greedy/capture/defend weights) for the AutoResearch bandit, with new/random/label/default constructors.

nodes.name: ResearchArm
nodes.summary: Tracks wins/games and derived UCB1 score for a single research configuration arm, with record(wins, games) and mean_reward() accessors.

nodes.name: AutoResearchResult
nodes.summary: Final output of run_autoresearch: surviving arms with their stats, pruned arms, best config, and a print_summary() formatter.

nodes.name: weighted_greedy_score
nodes.summary: Scores a candidate Go move by combining center, capture, defend, and greedy positional terms under a ResearchPlayer's weight vector.

nodes.name: run_autoresearch
nodes.summary: 125-line driver that runs the AutoResearch loop: initialize arms, play internal self-play games per arm, update UCB1, prune weak arms, and return the surviving configs.

nodes.name: GoEventLog
nodes.summary: Go-specific event log wrapper exposing record_place_stone/pass/resign/eval events, fork_at, diff, replay, and iteration primitives mirroring the generic EventLog API.

nodes.name: GoForkDiff
nodes.summary: Diff result between two GoEventLog forks, reporting shared_prefix_len, divergence_count, fork_point, and the list of differing events.

nodes.name: GoTemplateProposer
nodes.summary: Template bandit for Go moves: selects a Go move-template (corner/side/center/attack/defend/capture) via UCB1, proposes matching legal moves, and observes the resulting Hint-delta.

nodes.name: GoDeltaGatedAbsorbCompress
nodes.summary: Delta-gated absorb-compress cycle for Go templates: accumulates per-template deltas, triggers should_compress at threshold, and promotes high-delta templates via compress().

nodes.name: GoGZeroSelfPlayConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for G-Zero Go self-play: board_size, num_games, komi, absorb threshold, compress cadence, and player initialization parameters.

nodes.name: compute_move_score
nodes.summary: Scores a candidate Go move by combining template match, captures, defend/capture detection, center bonus, and star-point heuristics into a single scalar.

nodes.name: run_gzero_selfplay
nodes.summary: 276-line self-play driver: plays N Go games using a GoTemplateProposer + GoDeltaGatedAbsorbCompress loop, computes Hint-delta per move, and returns aggregate GoGZeroSelfPlayResults.

nodes.name: players.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the GoPlayer trait and six implementations (Random, Greedy, Validator, HL bandit, GZero template-bandit, MCTS) plus the GoMoveCategory taxonomy and freeze/thaw serialization for HL and GZero players.

nodes.name: replay.rs
nodes.summary: GoReplay recording/playback with three serialization formats (serde JSON, postcard bytes, and human-readable Debug): records each MoveRecord, computes avg/peak branching factor, and reconstructs a game via the replay() closure.

nodes.name: replay_writer.rs
nodes.summary: Writes Go game samples (state tensors + actions) to JSONL or compact binary format, with blake3 hashing, quality thresholding, and a GameSampleCollector that buffers moves until finalize_and_write emits only winning samples.

nodes.name: sdpg_player.rs
nodes.summary: Student-Distill Policy Gradient (SDPG) Go player: blends a teacher Q-value distribution with a student HL bandit via a sigmoid-gated beta schedule, supporting anchor/temperature/mode configuration for offline distillation.

nodes.name: state.rs
nodes.summary: Full Go board logic: GoState implements group/liberty tracking (BFS), suicide/ko legality, territory scoring with komi, the GameState trait (advance/reward/terminal), and a GoHeuristic providing liberty_advantage, influence, and positional_value evaluations.

nodes.name: tournament.rs
nodes.summary: Head-to-head tournament harness (Plan 065 Phase 3): runs N games between a local GoPlayerType and an AutoGo agent via the REST client, computes win_rate/avg_moves, and supports batch tournaments with summary tables.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Core Go enums and freeze/thaw structs: GoAction (Place/Pass/Resign), GoCell (Empty/Black/White), GoFrozenBandit and GoFrozenTemplates serialization containers used by HL/GZero player checkpointing.

nodes.name: utils.rs
nodes.summary: Board-level Go helpers: board_neighbors (orthogonal adjacency), extend_board_neighbors (in-place variant), and flood_group (BFS connected-component + liberty counting) used by group capture and suicide checks.

nodes.name: boltzmann.rs
nodes.summary: Boltzmann (softmax) sampling primitives for OPUS (Plan 129): boltzmann_sample for single draws, boltzmann_sample_batch for without-replacement top-k via Gumbel-top-k trick, and boltzmann_probabilities for normalized distributions.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Gumbel noise for without-replacement batch sampling and numerically-stable softmax via max-subtraction.

nodes.name: count_sketch.rs
nodes.summary: CountSketch projection (Plan 129): reduces an input_dim vector to sketch_dim via seeded hash functions, providing unbiased inner-product estimation in O(sketch_dim) and exact reference implementations for validation.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel for OPUS-inspired Boltzmann + redundancy selection (Plan 129): re-exports boltzmann_sample(_batch), CountSketch, OpusConfig, OpusBanditPruner, and OpusRedundantEnv.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Defines OpusBanditPruner (wraps BanditPruner with redundancy penalty + Boltzmann selection), OpusConfig (paper defaults tau=0.9, m=8192, rho=0.5), and OpusRedundantEnv (test environment with correlated arm groups).
nodes.languageNotes: Generic over P: BanditPruner; uses feature_dim hashing and CountSketch projection to estimate redundancy in sublinear time.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel for ROPD Rubric distillation: re-exports RubricCriterion, RubricTemplate, RubricVector, RubricScorer/PatternScorer, RubricGatedAbsorbCompress, and RubricBanditPruner — multi-criteria modelless reward without LLM judges.
nodes.languageNotes: ROPD ablation guidance: M>=2 references required to avoid single-trajectory over-anchoring (Table 6 reports -17.94 pts at M=1).

nodes.name: GoPlayer
nodes.summary: Trait defining a Go AI player: select_move(state, legal_moves, rng), name(), as_any_mut() for downcasting, and optional reset() for stateful players.

nodes.name: GoHLPlayer
nodes.summary: Heuristic-Learning Go player: maintains a BanditPruner over GoMoveCategory arms, updates Q-values from outcome, and supports freeze/thaw for checkpointing learned weights.

nodes.name: GoGZeroPlayer
nodes.summary: G-Zero Go player wrapping a TemplateStats bandit over GoTemplate: selects a template, proposes matching moves, observes outcome, and supports freeze/thaw serialization.

nodes.name: GoMctsPlayer
nodes.summary: MCTS-based Go player with configurable simulation budget and rollout depth, using BanditRolloutPolicy inside its search.

nodes.name: categorize_move
nodes.summary: Classifies a candidate Go move into a GoMoveCategory by checking capture/defend/atari/connect/shape patterns, used to index into the HL player's bandit.

nodes.name: greedy_score
nodes.summary: Computes a greedy positional score for a Go move by combining liberty gain, capture potential, connect bonus, and edge/corner heuristics.

nodes.name: GoReplay
nodes.summary: Game recorder that stores MoveRecord entries plus final winner/score, with avg_branching_factor / peak_branching_factor analytics and JSON/bytes serialization.

nodes.name: replay
nodes.summary: Deterministic replay driver: takes an initial GoState and a closure, then replays each MoveRecord in sequence, invoking the closure with state/action at each step.

nodes.name: GoReplayWriter
nodes.summary: File-backed writer that appends JsonlGoSample records (or compact binary equivalents) to disk with buffered I/O, flushing on drop.

nodes.name: GameSampleCollector
nodes.summary: In-memory buffer of Go move samples that, on finalize_and_write, emits only samples from the winning player above a configurable quality threshold.

nodes.name: JsonlGoSample
nodes.summary: Single training sample serializable to JSONL or binary: flattened board tensor tokens, action index, move number, quality score, and blake3 board hash for dedup.

nodes.name: from_state
nodes.summary: Constructs a JsonlGoSample from a GoState + action by flattening the board into tokens, computing the action's flat index, and hashing the board via blake3.

nodes.name: GoSdpgPlayer
nodes.summary: Student-Distill Policy Gradient Go player: blends a teacher Q-value distribution with a student HL bandit via a sigmoid-gated beta schedule for offline distillation.

nodes.name: update_outcome
nodes.summary: Updates both the SDPG bandit and the inner HL bandit after a game outcome, advancing the beta schedule and recording the experience for policy gradient.

nodes.name: select_move
nodes.summary: Selects a Go move by mixing teacher Q-values and student HL Q-values via the current beta, then sampling with optional temperature for exploration.

nodes.name: GoState
nodes.summary: Full Go board state: stone grid, neighbor adjacency, captures, komi, current player; implements group/liberty tracking, suicide/ko legality checks, territory scoring, and the GameState trait.

nodes.name: GoHeuristic
nodes.summary: Static heuristic bundle providing liberty_advantage, capture_delta, influence map, opening_phase detection, territorial_preference, and positional_value evaluations for GoState.

nodes.name: play_move
nodes.summary: 55-line stone placement routine: validates legality, places the stone, removes captured enemy groups, then removes self-captured groups (suicide check), and toggles the player to move.

nodes.name: score
nodes.summary: Scores the board via area-counting (stones + surrounded territory) with komi adjustment, returning the per-player score and the winner.

nodes.name: influence
nodes.summary: 64-line influence-map computation that propagates stone strength across the board via iterative dilation, used by GoHeuristic for territorial evaluation.

nodes.name: GoPlayerType
nodes.summary: Enum of player types eligible for tournaments (Random/Greedy/HL/GZero/MCTS/etc.) with create_player() factory and label() for display.

nodes.name: GoTournamentConfig
nodes.summary: Tournament configuration: number of games, board size, our color, their AutoGo agent name, and player-type selection with a default() preset.

nodes.name: GoTournamentResult
nodes.summary: Tournament outcome summary: win_rate, total_games, avg_moves, plus a print_summary() formatter for human-readable reports.

nodes.name: run_tournament
nodes.summary: 139-line tournament driver: instantiates our player and AutoGoProxyPlayer, plays N games alternating colors via the AutoGo REST client, and aggregates results into GoTournamentResult.

nodes.name: GoCell
nodes.summary: Three-valued cell enum (Empty/Black/White) with opponent(), is_stone(), from_i8(), player_id(), and from_player_id() conversions used throughout the Go engine.

nodes.name: GoFrozenBandit
nodes.summary: Serialization container for a frozen Go HL bandit: q_values, visits, epsilon, and config, with new_empty() and validate() for checkpoint round-tripping.

nodes.name: flood_group
nodes.summary: BFS that returns the connected stone group at start and its liberty count, used by group capture and suicide detection in GoState.

nodes.name: boltzmann_sample
nodes.summary: Draws a single arm index from a softmax(utilities/temperature) distribution using Gumbel noise for numerically-stable sampling without explicit normalization.

nodes.name: boltzmann_sample_batch
nodes.summary: Draws k arms without replacement via the Gumbel-top-k trick (sample-then-sort), preserving the true without-replacement softmax distribution.

nodes.name: boltzmann_probabilities
nodes.summary: Returns the normalized softmax probability vector for utilities under the given temperature, used for diagnostics and reference validation.

nodes.name: CountSketch
nodes.summary: Seeded CountSketch projection reducing input_dim vectors to sketch_dim via hashed sign-flips, with sketch(), inner_product_estimate(), and reference exact_inner_product() for validation.

nodes.name: sketch
nodes.summary: Projects an input_dim vector into sketch_dim by hashing each index to a bucket with a sign flip, producing an unbiased estimator of the original.

nodes.name: OpusConfig
nodes.summary: OPUS paper defaults (temperature tau=0.9, sketch_dim m=8192, redundancy_weight rho=0.5) with new/small/large presets and Default implementation.

nodes.name: OpusBanditPruner
nodes.summary: Wraps BanditPruner with CountSketch feature projection, Boltzmann selection, and redundancy penalty, exposing record_selection/select_arms and per-arm utility computation.

nodes.name: OpusRedundantEnv
nodes.summary: Test environment with correlated arm groups used to validate that OpusBanditPruner's redundancy penalty correctly diversifies selections away from near-duplicate arms.

nodes.name: select_arms
nodes.summary: Selects k arms from a candidate set by computing per-arm utility (q-value minus redundancy penalty) and drawing via Boltzmann sampling.

nodes.name: record_selection
nodes.summary: Records a selected arm by projecting its feature vector via CountSketch, updating the redundancy hash table, and forwarding the reward to the inner BanditPruner.

nodes.name: rubric_absorb.rs
nodes.summary: Rubric-vector-gated absorb-compress layer that promotes heuristics to hard constraints only when targeted criterion gaps appear, replacing scalar delta gating with fine-grained per-criterion targeting.
nodes.languageNotes: Wraps AbsorbCompressLayer with per-arm rubric history; requires multi-reference (m>=2) per ROPD ablation.

nodes.name: rubric_bandit.rs
nodes.summary: Bandit pruner variant that uses rubric-weighted gap scores as the reward signal instead of scalar delta, providing more correctness-aligned credit assignment than log-prob deltas.
nodes.languageNotes: Optional per-criterion bandits and reward normalization; tracks reference rubrics per arm.

nodes.name: scorer.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the RubricScorer trait and a regex-free PatternScorer implementation that scores responses against rubric templates using deterministic pattern checks (no LLM).
nodes.languageNotes: Includes default_rules() with ~15 built-in criterion checks; supports multi-reference scoring to prevent single-trajectory over-anchoring.

nodes.name: template.rs
nodes.summary: Domain-specific rubric templates (Bomber, FFT tactics, generic) encoding fixed criteria and weights mapped to the ROPD ropd.rubric.v1 schema.
nodes.languageNotes: RubricCriterion enum with weight semantics 5=decisive, 4=strong, 2=supporting, 1=routine.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: RubricVector type representing per-criterion pass/fail scores with weighted aggregation and multi-reference gap tracking — the structured replacement for scalar HintDelta.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements ROPD's s_i = sum(w_k * v_k) / sum(w_k) formula generalized to continuous scores in [0,1].

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel for the SDAR gated distillation subsystem, re-exporting SdarBanditPruner, SdarGatedAbsorbCompress, and supporting config types.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust module file using pub mod + pub use re-exports.

nodes.name: sdar_absorb.rs
nodes.summary: Sigmoid-gated absorb-compress layer adapting SDAR's asymmetric trust principle: promote arms only on positive teacher-student gaps, attenuate on negative gaps, no gradients.
nodes.languageNotes: Tracks per-arm promotion stats (benefit ratio, gate probability) and supports deterministic and stochastic gate modes.

nodes.name: sdar_bandit.rs
nodes.summary: Bandit pruner wrapping BanditPruner with SDAR-style sigmoid-gated reward updates, optional gate statistics tracking, and adaptive beta scheduling.
nodes.languageNotes: GateStats track running mean gate, original reward, and gated reward to compute pass-through ratio.

nodes.name: sdar_gate.rs
nodes.summary: Core SDAR sigmoid gate functions and SdarLearnedBeta online adapter that modulates signal intensity by teacher-student gap (sigma(beta * delta)) with optional gradient-free beta learning.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure functions sdar_gate, sdar_benefit_gate, sdar_gated_reward, sdar_should_promote; SdarLearnedBeta uses a 1D minimizer for online calibration.

nodes.name: RubricGatedConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for rubric-gated absorb with builder methods for benefit ratio, min references (defaults to 2 per ROPD ablation), and min weight thresholds.

nodes.name: RubricGatedAbsorbCompress
nodes.summary: Rubric-vector-gated absorb-compress layer wrapping AbsorbCompressLayer with per-arm rubric history and gap-driven promotion gating.

nodes.name: RubricBanditConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for the rubric-reward bandit with optional per-criterion bandits, reward floor, and normalization toggle.

nodes.name: RubricBanditPruner
nodes.summary: Bandit pruner using rubric-weighted gap scores as reward, tracking per-arm rubric history and reference rubrics for multi-reference scoring.

nodes.name: PatternScorer
nodes.summary: Regex-free RubricScorer implementation using configurable pattern rules with ~15 default criterion checks (no LLM, always available).

nodes.name: RubricCriterion
nodes.summary: Enum of rubric criteria (TaskFulfillment, OutputStructure, ConstraintSatisfaction, Completeness, Correctness) with name() and all() accessors.

nodes.name: RubricTemplate
nodes.summary: Collection of weighted rubric criteria with factory constructors for Bomber, FFT tactics, and generic domains.

nodes.name: RubricVector
nodes.summary: Per-criterion score vector with weighted aggregation, multi-reference gap tracking, and quadratic-weighted reward computation.

nodes.name: SdarAbsorbConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for SDAR-gated absorb with beta, benefit-ratio floor, RNG seed, promotion-stat tracking, and preset profiles (soft, aggressive, non_deterministic).

nodes.name: PromotionStats
nodes.summary: Aggregated statistics over absorb promotions: count, gate probability mean, benefit ratio mean, and promotion rate.

nodes.name: SdarGatedAbsorbCompress
nodes.summary: SDAR sigmoid-gated absorb-compress layer promoting arms only on positive teacher-student gaps, with optional RNG for stochastic gating.

nodes.name: SdarBanditConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for SDAR-gated bandit with beta and optional gate-stat tracking; presets soft and aggressive.

nodes.name: GateStats
nodes.summary: Running statistics of the SDAR gate: mean gate value, original vs gated reward sums, pass-through ratio.

nodes.name: SdarBanditPruner
nodes.summary: Bandit pruner applying SDAR sigmoid gating to reward updates, with optional learned beta adaptation.

nodes.name: SdarLearnedBeta
nodes.summary: Online beta adapter for the SDAR gate using a 1D minimizer to calibrate gate intensity from observed gated signals.

nodes.name: observe_rubric
nodes.summary: Records a rubric observation for an arm against multiple references, updating per-arm gap history and computing the absorb reward signal.

nodes.name: should_compress_gated
nodes.summary: Gate predicate deciding whether absorb-compress should fire for an arm based on configured rubric thresholds and accumulated gap history.

nodes.name: blind_spot_arms
nodes.summary: Returns the top-k arms with persistent rubric gaps (blind spots) ranked by gap magnitude.

nodes.name: observe_rubric
nodes.summary: Updates the rubric bandit with a single (student, reference) rubric pair, computing the per-arm reward and updating inner bandit stats.

nodes.name: observe_rubric_multi
nodes.summary: Multi-reference rubric observation that aggregates reward across M references to prevent single-trajectory over-anchoring.

nodes.name: compute_reward
nodes.summary: Computes the scalar bandit reward from a student rubric vector against a reference, applying optional normalization and reward floor.

nodes.name: default_rules
nodes.summary: Builds the default set of ~15 pattern-based criterion rules used by PatternScorer for bomber, FFT, and generic templates.

nodes.name: score_with_references_id
nodes.summary: Scores a response against a template using M references, returning a RubricVector with the template-id annotation for traceability.

nodes.name: score
nodes.summary: Trait method scoring a response against a template, returning a RubricVector with per-criterion pass/fail scores.

nodes.name: score_with_references

nodes.name: gap_vs_references
nodes.summary: Computes the per-criterion gap vector between this RubricVector and the best-matching reference (min per-criterion distance).

nodes.name: gap_criteria

nodes.name: quadratic_weighted_reward

nodes.name: weighted_score
nodes.summary: Aggregates per-criterion scores into a scalar via the ROPD weighted-mean formula sum(w_k*v_k)/sum(w_k).

nodes.name: observe

nodes.name: should_compress_gated

nodes.name: candidate_arms

nodes.name: update
nodes.summary: Updates the SDAR bandit: applies the sigmoid gate to the incoming reward, then forwards the gated reward to the inner bandit.

nodes.name: adapt_beta
nodes.summary: Adapts the SDAR gate beta based on the running mean gated reward to keep the gate in a useful operating range.

nodes.name: sdar_gate
nodes.summary: Core SDAR sigmoid gate function sigma(beta * x) used to modulate signal intensity by teacher-student gap.

nodes.name: advantage.rs
nodes.summary: SDPG advantage functions implementing three modes (raw delta, sigmoid, centered log-ratio) for transforming teacher-student Q-value differences into per-arm advantage signals.

nodes.name: anchor.rs
nodes.summary: Unnormalized KL anchor (UFKL/URKL) regularizing bandit Q-values against a frozen reference to prevent mode collapse during long self-play.

Re-exports advantage/anchor/schedule sub-modules and defines the SdpgBanditPruner

generic wrapper.

nodes.name: schedule.rs

nodes.name: cost_model.rs

nodes.name: game_bridge.rs

nodes.name: AdvantageMode

nodes.name: KlAnchor

nodes.name: SdpgBanditPruner

Generic SDPG pruner wrapping BanditPruner

with oracle teacher Q-values, KL anchor, beta schedule, and advantage-mode-driven updates.

nodes.name: DecisionPointEnv

nodes.name: GlobalProcedureEnv

nodes.name: BomberNode
nodes.summary: Enum of 11 Bomberman game-phase nodes (Start, Moving, PlacingBomb, Waiting, Explosion, ChainReaction, CheckAlive, PowerUp, Evading, GameOver, Draw).

nodes.name: BomberProcedure
nodes.summary: Bomberman game as a directed ProcedureGraph with builder for nodes and the full conditioned adjacency table.

nodes.name: ProcedureCostModel
nodes.summary: Cost model predicting training hours, VRAM, LoRA feasibility, complexity tier, and break-even inference count from graph size.

nodes.name: ComplexityTier
nodes.summary: Five-level complexity classification (Trivial, Simple, Moderate, Complex, HighlyComplex) derived from node and path counts.

nodes.name: ProcedureGameState
nodes.summary: Bridge trait mapping ProcedureGraph nodes to concrete GameState descriptions and back, with terminal round-trip validation.

nodes.name: GoNode
nodes.summary: Enum of 11 Go game-phase nodes (Start, Opening, Midgame, Endgame, KoFight, CaptureRace, Scoring, Resigned, BlackWins, WhiteWins, Draw).

nodes.name: GoProcedure
nodes.summary: Go game as a directed ProcedureGraph parameterized by board size (9x9 or 19x19) with full phase-transition adjacency.

nodes.name: centered_log_ratio
nodes.summary: Computes the SDPG Proposition 3.1 centered log-ratio advantage from teacher and student Q-vectors via softmax distributions.

nodes.name: softmax_scaled
nodes.summary: Temperature-scaled softmax helper used by the centered log-ratio advantage computation.

nodes.name: sigmoid_advantage
nodes.summary: Default SDPG advantage mode applying a per-arm sigmoid to the teacher-student Q difference.

nodes.name: anchor_loss
nodes.summary: Computes the unnormalized KL anchor loss between current Q-values and a frozen reference, for either forward (UFKL) or reverse (URKL) variants.

nodes.name: update
nodes.summary: SDPG bandit update: computes advantage from teacher/student Q, applies positive-advantage gating, anchors via KL, and forwards to inner bandit.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs an SdpgBanditPruner capturing teacher Q-values, reference Q snapshot, schedule, anchor, temperature, and advantage mode.

nodes.name: beta
nodes.summary: Computes the current beta coefficient from the step counter, applying linear warmup then linear decay.

nodes.name: graph_to_global_session
nodes.summary: Converts a procedure graph into a single global BanditSession treating every graph edge as one bandit arm.

nodes.name: extract_decision_points
nodes.summary: Walks a trajectory through the graph and collects per-step DecisionPoints capturing valid arms and the chosen edge at each node.

nodes.name: graph_trajectories_to_sessions_seeded
nodes.summary: Seedable batch converter turning multiple trajectories into per-decision-point BanditSessions with reproducible RNG.

nodes.name: TrajectoryBanditSummary::from_decision_points
nodes.summary: Aggregates a list of decision points into a TrajectoryBanditSummary with branching-factor histogram.

nodes.name: build_adjacency
nodes.summary: Encodes the full Bomberman phase-transition adjacency table as per-node edge lists with optional condition strings.

nodes.name: BomberNode::from_id
nodes.summary: Maps a numeric node id back to its BomberNode variant.

nodes.name: ProcedureCostModel::from_graph
nodes.summary: Constructs a cost model by enumerating paths in the graph up to a max depth and aggregating node/path/avg-length statistics.

nodes.name: estimated_quality_fraction
nodes.summary: Predicts the expected quality fraction (0-1) of frontier-model quality achievable by procedure compilation for this graph.

nodes.name: validate_trajectory
nodes.summary: Validates that a graph trajectory corresponds to a legal sequence of runtime game states via node-state round-trip checks.

nodes.name: validate_all_terminals
nodes.summary: Validates that every terminal node in the graph maps to a concrete terminal game state and back.

nodes.name: build_adjacency
nodes.summary: Encodes the full Go phase-transition adjacency table per board size as per-node edge lists with optional condition strings.

nodes.name: GoProcedure::new
nodes.summary: Constructs a GoProcedure for a given board size, building nodes and the size-specific adjacency table.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Subterranean Procedure Compilation module barrel re-exporting ProcedureGraph and all game procedures, samplers, cost model, and bridges.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements ProcedureGraph trait object with start/terminal/edges_from methods; behind the subterranean feature gate.

nodes.name: path_enumerator.rs
nodes.summary: Exhaustive acyclic path enumeration through procedure graphs using DFS with visited tracking, plus weighted sampling over enumerated paths.
nodes.languageNotes: Paper targets: travel=86 paths, zoom=60, insurance=2381; supports enumerate/count/sample/weighted_sample operations.

nodes.name: path_sampler.rs
nodes.summary: Generates structured training samples by decomposing procedure-graph trajectories into individual decision points with valid-action context and chosen action labels.
nodes.languageNotes: SampleFilter enum (All/FirstN/MinBranching/OnlyConditional) controls which decision points become training samples.

nodes.name: training_mode.rs
nodes.summary: Training mode configuration (LoRA, FullFineTune, QLoRA) for procedure compilation, with quality/vram/time tradeoff estimates per mode.
nodes.languageNotes: Paper finding: LoRA fails on procedural internalization; FullFineTune recommended. Config type only — actual training in riir-ai.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Core procedure-graph types: ProcedureNode (id, label, terminal/start flags), ProcedureEdge (from, to, optional condition), and Trajectory (path with conditions met).
nodes.languageNotes: Serde-serializable types forming the declarative substrate for all subterranean game procedures.

nodes.name: tes_loop.rs
nodes.summary: SimpleTES evaluation-driven scaling loop implementing RPUCG (Rooted Propagation UCB on Graph) selection, organizing test-time compute as (C, L, K, Phi) budget dimensions.
nodes.languageNotes: TesConfig holds global_width C, refinement_depth L, local_sample_size K; SimpleTesLoop.run is the main 115-line episode driver.

nodes.name: trace_informed_feedback_bandit.rs
nodes.summary: Wraps FeedbackBandit with an active-state-trace filter that biases harness-vs-weight lever selection using compression_ratio as a leading staleness signal before stall detection fires.
nodes.languageNotes: Policy: trace_signal = compression_ratio_mean * (1 + max(constraint_trend, 0)); switches to WeightUpdate preemptively.

nodes.name: vpd_em.rs
nodes.summary: VPD EM-style modelless distillation cycle alternating E-step (BCO unpaired preference teacher refinement) and M-step (KL-gated absorb-compress student distillation) with a dynamic student-anchored prior.
nodes.languageNotes: BcoOptimizer implements L = -E_y+[log sigma(r-d)] - E_y-[log sigma(-(r-d))] with shift momentum; VpdEmCycle drives the alternating loop.

nodes.name: ProcedureGraph
nodes.summary: Trait defining a directed procedure graph: start node, terminal nodes, edges-from, node/edge counts, and node labels; the declarative substrate for subterranean compilation.

nodes.name: PathEnumerator
nodes.summary: Exhaustive DFS-based enumerator of acyclic paths through a procedure graph, with weighted sampling and path counting.

nodes.name: PathSampler
nodes.summary: Generator of structured training samples from procedure-graph trajectories, decomposing paths into per-turn decision points with valid-action context.

nodes.name: SampleFilter
nodes.summary: Enum controlling which decision points become training samples: All, FirstN, MinBranching, or OnlyConditional.

nodes.name: SubterraneanTrainingMode
nodes.summary: Training mode enum (Lora, FullFineTune, Qlora) with VRAM multiplier, estimated quality, training-time multiplier, and path-count suitability per mode.

nodes.name: TrainingBudget
nodes.summary: Estimated training resource budget (mode, hours, VRAM GB, suitability flag, quality fraction) for a procedure compilation.

nodes.name: ProcedureNode
nodes.summary: A node in a procedure graph: id, label, and terminal/start flags, with start/terminal/intermediate constructors.

nodes.name: ProcedureEdge
nodes.summary: A directed edge in a procedure graph with optional condition string, produced by new() and conditional() constructors.

nodes.name: Trajectory
nodes.summary: A path through a procedure graph with the sequence of nodes and conditions met along the way.

nodes.name: TesConfig
nodes.summary: SimpleTES evaluation budget configuration: global_width C, refinement_depth L, local_sample_size K, and bandit strategy.

nodes.name: TesLoop
nodes.summary: Trait defining the SimpleTES RPUCG evaluation loop interface with inspiration selection, value propagation, and RPUCG scoring hooks.

nodes.name: SimpleTesLoop
nodes.summary: Concrete RPUCG evaluation loop implementation driving inspiration sampling, step evaluation, and best-solution tracking.

nodes.name: TraceInformedFeedbackBandit
nodes.summary: FeedbackBandit wrapper that biases harness-vs-weight lever selection using the active-state trace before stall detection fires.

nodes.name: BcoOptimizer
nodes.summary: Binary Classifier Optimization solver computing the BCO loss and updating the reward shift delta with momentum from unpaired preference samples.

nodes.name: VpdConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for the VPD EM cycle: E-step frequency, BCO temperature, KL penalty weight, and dynamic-prior toggle.

nodes.name: VpdEmCycle
nodes.summary: Alternating E/M distillation state machine: E-step refines teacher via BCO, M-step distills to student via SDAR-gated absorb-compress, anchored on current student Q.

nodes.name: dfs_enumerate
nodes.summary: Recursive DFS that enumerates all unique acyclic paths from a node to any terminal, tracking visited nodes.

nodes.name: weighted_sample
nodes.summary: Samples n paths from an enumerated set using weights derived from path length or custom scoring.

nodes.name: dfs_count
nodes.summary: Counts the number of unique acyclic paths from a node to any terminal without materializing them.

nodes.name: enumerate
nodes.summary: Top-level entry enumerating all acyclic paths from the graph's start node to any terminal node.

nodes.name: extract_samples
nodes.summary: Decomposes a trajectory into individual training Samples, each capturing the node, chosen action, and valid next actions at a turn.

nodes.name: count_samples_for_trajectory
nodes.summary: Counts the training samples that would be extracted from a trajectory under a given SampleFilter without materializing them.

nodes.name: estimated_quality
nodes.summary: Predicts the expected quality fraction for a training mode given the procedure path count (LoRA saturates early, FullFineTune scales).

nodes.name: TrainingBudget::estimate
nodes.summary: Estimates the training budget (hours, VRAM, suitability, quality) for a mode given model size and path count.

nodes.name: SimpleTesLoop::run
nodes.summary: Main SimpleTES episode driver: samples inspirations, runs K step evaluations per inspiration, propagates values, and tracks the best solution.

nodes.name: SimpleTesLoop::run_step
nodes.summary: Evaluates a single (inspiration, arm) step within the TES loop, returning the reward and updating history.

nodes.name: TesConfig::default
nodes.summary: Default TES budget configuration (C, L, K) and bandit strategy preset.

nodes.name: select
nodes.summary: Selects the harness-vs-weight lever using the trace signal (compression_ratio * constraint_trend) before falling back to stall detection.

nodes.name: BcoOptimizer::update_shift
nodes.summary: Updates the BCO reward shift delta from a batch of unpaired preference samples using momentum on the minimizer step.

nodes.name: e_step
nodes.summary: VPD E-step: refines teacher Q-values by running BCO on the accumulated feedback-signal samples with a dynamic student-anchored prior.

nodes.name: m_step
nodes.summary: VPD M-step: distills the refined teacher into the student via SDAR-gated absorb-compress with KL regularization.

nodes.name: BcoOptimizer::compute_loss
nodes.summary: Computes the BCO binary-classifier loss L = -E_y+[log sigma(r-d)] - E_y-[log sigma(-(r-d))] over unpaired preference samples.

nodes.name: VpdEmCycle::new
nodes.summary: Constructs a VpdEmCycle with config, action count, BCO optimizer, and empty E-step buffer.

nodes.name: collect_sample
nodes.summary: Adds an (action, outcome, feedback_signal) sample to the E-step buffer for the next BCO refinement.

nodes.name: softmax
nodes.summary: Numerically-stable softmax helper used by VPD probability computations.

nodes.name: kl_divergence
nodes.summary: Computes KL(log_p || log_q) from log-probabilities for VPD's KL regularization term.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for katgpt-quant, the KV-cache quantization codec library. Conditionally re-exports five codec submodules (turboquant, planar_quant, iso_quant, octopus, hybrid_oct_pq) behind cargo features.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses #[cfg(feature = "...")] pub mod gates so downstream crates only compile the codecs they pull in.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for the Hybrid OCT-PQ codec, combining PlanarQuant's O(d) 2D Givens rotation with OCTOPUS's octahedral triplet encoding to approach OCTOPUS MSE quality at PlanarQuant rotation speed (256 FMAs for d=128).

nodes.name: kv_cache.rs
nodes.summary: Compressed KV cache implementing the hybrid OCTOPUS-encoding + PlanarQuant-rotation pipeline: normalize, 2D Givens rotate, decompose into triplets, octahedral-encode, bit-pack. 754 lines of encode/decode logic plus the HybridOctPqKVCache struct.

nodes.name: HybridOctPqKVCache
nodes.summary: Compressed KV cache struct combining PlanarQuant 2D Givens rotation with OCTOPUS octahedral triplet encoding. Exposes the standard cache API: with_config, store_key/value, dequantize_key/value[_into], reset, bytes_per_token, compression_ratio.

nodes.name: store_key
nodes.summary: Encode and store one key vector: normalize, apply PQ 2D rotation, decompose into triplets, OCTOPUS-encode each triplet, bit-pack indices into the layer's byte buffer.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Core types for the hybrid codec: HybridOctPqConfig (compression hyperparameters) and HybridOctPqLayer (per-layer PQ rotation parameters + paired OCTOPUS codebooks).

nodes.name: HybridOctPqConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration struct controlling the hybrid codec: seed, layer count, kv_dim, max_seq_len, key/val bit budgets, and joint-rounding toggle. Uses OCTOPUS's non-uniform (b+1, b-1) bit split.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for IsoQuant: 4D quaternion rotation KV cache compression. Re-exports IsoQuantKVCache, the quaternion helpers, and IsoQuant config/layer/mode types.

nodes.name: kv_cache.rs
nodes.summary: IsoQuant compressed KV cache: normalize, 4D quaternion rotate (full sandwich or fast left-only), scalar quantize via TurboQuant codebooks, bit-pack. Achieves O(d) rotation cost (512-1024 FMAs for d=128) vs TurboQuant's O(d^2) 16,384 FMAs.

nodes.name: IsoQuantKVCache
nodes.summary: Compressed KV cache backed by 4D quaternion rotation. Stores per-layer quaternion state plus shared TurboQuant key/value codebooks, bit-packed indices, per-position norms, and zero-alloc scratch buffers.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Construct an IsoQuantKVCache from explicit bit widths: generates per-layer quaternions (full or fast mode), computes key/value codebooks via TurboQuant's Lloyd-Max routine, and pre-allocates bit-packed index storage.

nodes.name: unpack_indices_into
nodes.summary: Bit-unpack n indices of `bits` width from a packed byte buffer into a pre-allocated output slice, used on the decode hot path to reconstruct quantized coordinates without per-call allocation.

nodes.name: rotation.rs
nodes.summary: Quaternion 4D rotation primitives for IsoQuant. Implements Hamilton product (16 FMAs), full sandwich q_L*v*conj(q_R) (32 FMAs/group) and fast left-only q_L*v (16 FMAs/group), plus deterministic unit-quaternion generation.
nodes.languageNotes: Treats 4D vectors directly as quaternions for the Hamilton product, avoiding any matrix construction.

nodes.name: apply_rotation
nodes.summary: Apply the full IsoQuant vector rotation across all ceil(dim/4) groups: for full mode uses sandwich q_L*v*conj(q_R), for fast mode uses left-only q_L*v.

nodes.name: apply_inverse_rotation
nodes.summary: Inverse of apply_rotation: conj(q_L)*v*q_R (full) or conj(q_L)*v (fast). Used on the KV cache decode path to recover the pre-rotation coordinate frame.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Core IsoQuant types: IsoQuantMode (Full vs Fast rotation), IsoQuantLayer (per-layer left/right quaternion pairs for keys and values), and IsoQuantConfig.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for OCTOPUS (octahedral triplet KV cache compression). Barrel that re-exports the codebook, octahedral map, triplet, types, encode, forward, and kv_cache submodules and their primary public symbols.

nodes.name: codebook.rs
nodes.summary: Lloyd-Max scalar quantizers for OCTOPUS triplet components: a Beta-derived norm codebook (b-1 bits) and a triangular oct-direction codebook (b+1 bits), built via iterative centroid/boundary refinement toward minimum MSE.

nodes.name: ScalarCodebook
nodes.summary: Lloyd-Max scalar quantizer holding centroids (2^bits entries), decision boundaries (2^bits - 1), achieved MSE, and bit width. Provides quantize/dequantize methods used by both the norm and oct-direction codebooks.

nodes.name: build_norm_codebook
nodes.summary: Compute the Lloyd-Max codebook for triplet norm rho distributed as Beta(3/2, (d-3)/2), used by the OCTOPUS norm path with b-1 bits.

nodes.name: build_oct_codebook
nodes.summary: Compute the Lloyd-Max codebook for octahedral direction coordinates (xi, eta) on [-1,1], which have a triangular marginal induced by the equal-area octahedral map; used with b+1 bits.

nodes.name: encode.rs
nodes.summary: OCTOPUS triplet encoder with optional joint 3x3 rounding. Encodes a rotated KV vector into bit-packed triplet indices (xi, eta, rho) and decodes back; joint rounding searches 9 direction candidates for 6-14% MSE reduction at encode time only.

nodes.name: encode_triplet_joint
nodes.summary: Encode one triplet via the octahedral map with joint 3x3 rounding: enumerate 9 direction candidates, pick the one maximizing alignment s = t.n(xi,eta), then quantize the norm nearest to s. Encoder-only MSE optimization with no decoder/bitstream change.

nodes.name: pack_triplet_indices_into
nodes.summary: Bit-pack a slice of TripletIndices (2*dir_bits + nrm_bits bits each) into a pre-allocated byte buffer with arbitrary bit offset, used by the KV cache store path.

nodes.name: forward.rs
nodes.summary: Forward-pass helpers for the OCTOPUS attention path: dequantize keys/values into flat attention-layout buffers, score attention against the compressed cache, and compute quality metrics (cosine similarity, MaxSim, per-coordinate MSE).

nodes.name: attention_octopus
nodes.summary: Score attention for one query against flat (dequantized) OCTOPUS key/value buffers over positions [0..=pos], writing weighted sums into attn_out and reusing a scores scratch buffer.

nodes.name: kv_cache.rs
nodes.summary: OCTOPUS compressed KV cache: stores each (layer, position) as one f32 norm plus a bit-packed byte buffer of triplet indices. Encode pipeline: normalize, random rotate, triplet-decompose, octahedral-encode, bit-pack; decode reverses it.

nodes.name: OctopusKVCache
nodes.summary: Compressed KV cache struct storing per-layer OctopusLayer state, per-position key/value norms, bit-packed triplet-index byte buffers, and zero-alloc scratch buffers for the encode/decode hot path.

nodes.name: store_key
nodes.summary: Encode and store one key vector: normalize, apply the layer's random rotation, decompose into triplets, encode via the octahedral triplet encoder, and bit-pack indices into the layer's byte buffer.

nodes.name: octahedral.rs
nodes.summary: Octahedral map (Cigolle et al. JCGT 2014): bijective equal-area parameterization between S^2 and [-1,1]^2 used by OCTOPUS to encode triplet directions. Branch-free piecewise-linear encode/decode.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a branch-free sign_positive helper (bool as u8 as f32) to keep bijectivity at coordinate-zero equator boundaries.

nodes.name: oct_encode
nodes.summary: Project a unit vector on S^2 onto octahedral coordinates (xi, eta) in [-1,1]^2 by unfolding the bottom four faces of the octahedron onto the square's exterior.

nodes.name: oct_decode
nodes.summary: Inverse of oct_encode: reconstruct a unit vector on S^2 from octahedral coordinates (xi, eta), handling the bottom-four-face unfolding via the |xi|+|eta| > 1 test.

nodes.name: triplet.rs
nodes.summary: Triplet decomposition for OCTOPUS: splits a rotated d-dimensional vector into ceil(d/3) triplets, each storing an L2 norm rho and a unit direction on S^2. Provides decompose/recompose (allocating and _into variants) plus helpers.

nodes.name: Triplet
nodes.summary: A single triplet: an L2 norm rho plus a unit direction vector (x,y,z) on S^2. repr(C) for FFI-compatible layout; provides zero, from_slice, to_vec constructors.

nodes.name: decompose_into
nodes.summary: Decompose a rotated input slice into a pre-allocated Triplet output slice (ceil(d/3) entries, zero-padding the final partial triplet), avoiding per-call allocation on the encode hot path.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Core OCTOPUS types: OctopusConfig (compression hyperparameters with the (b+1, b-1) bit split), OctopusCodebook (paired norm + oct-direction ScalarCodebooks), OctopusLayer (per-layer rotation + dual codebooks), and TripletIndices.

nodes.name: OctopusConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration struct for OCTOPUS compression: seed, layer count, kv_dim, max_seq_len, key/val nominal bit budgets, plus toggles for QJL 1-bit residual and joint 3x3 rounding. Carries the static (b+1, b-1) bit-split helpers.

nodes.name: OctopusCodebook
nodes.summary: Paired ScalarCodebook for one side (key or value) of OCTOPUS: a norm codebook (b-1 bits, Beta marginal) and an oct-direction codebook (b+1 bits, triangular marginal). Build() dispatches to the appropriate Lloyd-Max routine.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for PlanarQuant: 2D Givens rotation KV cache compression (O(d) block-diagonal rotations, 256 FMAs for d=128). Barrel re-exporting PlanarQuantKVCache, the Givens rotation helpers, and config/layer types.

nodes.name: kv_cache.rs
nodes.summary: PlanarQuant compressed KV cache: normalize, block-diagonal 2D Givens rotation per adjacent pair, scalar quantize via TurboQuant codebook, bit-pack. Replaces TurboQuant's O(d^2) random rotation with O(d).

nodes.name: PlanarQuantKVCache
nodes.summary: Compressed KV cache struct holding per-layer PlanarQuantLayer state (Givens rotations + codebook centroids/boundaries), bit-packed key/value index buffers, per-position norms, and scratch buffers.

nodes.name: rotation.rs
nodes.summary: 2D Givens rotation primitives for PlanarQuant. Each adjacent pair of elements is rotated by an independent angle theta; forward and inverse are 4 FMAs per pair, totaling 256 FMAs for d=128.

nodes.name: apply_rotation
nodes.summary: Apply the block-diagonal 2D Givens rotation across all ceil(dim/2) pairs of the input vector, writing the rotated output. Used on the PlanarQuant encode path.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Core PlanarQuant types: PlanarQuantLayer (per-layer key/value Givens rotations plus Lloyd-Max centroids and boundaries) and PlanarQuantConfig.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for TurboQuant (arXiv:2504.19874): near-optimal vector quantization via random rotation + Lloyd-Max codebook + bit-packing. Barrel re-exporting the KV cache, codebook, rotation, and types submodules.

nodes.name: codebook.rs
nodes.summary: Lloyd-Max optimal scalar quantizer for TurboQuant. Iterates centroid/boundary refinement on the Beta(d/2, (d-1)/2) marginal of randomly rotated coordinates until convergence, yielding minimum-MSE centroids and boundaries.

nodes.name: compute_codebook
nodes.summary: Compute the Lloyd-Max optimal codebook for a single coordinate of a randomly rotated dim-dimensional unit vector: 2^bits centroids and 2^bits - 1 boundaries on [-1,1] under the Beta(d/2, (d-1)/2) marginal.

nodes.name: forward.rs
nodes.summary: Forward-pass helpers for the TurboQuant attention path: dequantize keys/values into flat attention-layout buffers, score attention against the compressed cache, and compute cosine-similarity and MaxSim quality metrics.

nodes.name: attention_turboquant
nodes.summary: Score attention for one query against flat (dequantized) TurboQuant key/value buffers over positions [0..=pos], writing weighted sums into attn_out and reusing a scores scratch buffer.

nodes.name: kv_cache.rs
nodes.summary: TurboQuant compressed KV cache: normalize, apply random orthogonal rotation (precomputed transpose for SIMD row-major inverse), Lloyd-Max scalar quantize, bit-pack. Supports 2/3/4-bit per coordinate with asymmetric key/value bit widths.

nodes.name: TurboQuantKVCache
nodes.summary: Compressed KV cache struct holding per-layer TurboQuantLayer state (rotation + transpose + QJL matrix), bit-packed key/value index buffers, per-position norms, and zero-alloc scratch buffers for the encode/decode hot path.

nodes.name: store_key
nodes.summary: Encode and store one key vector: normalize, apply the layer's random rotation, scalar-quantize via the key codebook, and bit-pack indices into the layer's byte buffer.

nodes.name: rotation.rs
nodes.summary: Random orthogonal rotation matrices for TurboQuant, generated via modified Gram-Schmidt QR decomposition for determinism. Also provides QJL Gaussian projection matrices for 1-bit residual estimation.
nodes.languageNotes: Stores the rotation as row-major f32 with a precomputed transpose so the inverse path can use SIMD row-major mat-vec multiplies.

nodes.name: generate_rotation_matrix
nodes.summary: Generate a deterministic dim x dim random orthogonal matrix via QR decomposition using modified Gram-Schmidt on a Gaussian-drawn input, with column-major working buffers to avoid per-column allocations.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Core TurboQuant types: TurboQuantCodebook (Lloyd-Max centroids/boundaries with padding-optimized field order), TurboQuantLayer (rotation, precomputed transpose, QJL matrix), and TurboQuantKVCacheConfig.
nodes.languageNotes: Field order Vec -> usize -> f32 -> u8 deliberately eliminates inter-field padding in the codebook struct.

nodes.name: TurboQuantCodebook
nodes.summary: Lloyd-Max scalar quantizer for TurboQuant: 2^bits centroids, 2^bits - 1 decision boundaries, the dim it was computed for, achieved per-coordinate MSE, and the bit width.

nodes.name: cht.rs
nodes.summary: Dynamic Convex Hull Trick line container providing O(log h) max-envelope queries, used as the backing store for the 2D hard-attention KV cache.
nodes.languageNotes: Line container maintaining sorted slopes with intersection-point metadata for upper-envelope max queries.

nodes.name: Line
nodes.summary: Represents a line y = m*x + b with intersection point p and metadata; an entry in the CHT line container.

nodes.name: CHT
nodes.summary: Convex Hull Trick container exposing add_line, argmax, and line_intersect over a sorted line set for max-envelope queries in O(log h).

nodes.name: add_line
nodes.summary: Inserts a new line into the container while maintaining sorted order by slope and recomputing intersection points; the core maintenance routine.

nodes.name: argmax
nodes.summary: Returns the maximum value of the upper envelope at query point x via ternary search over intersection points.

nodes.name: compile.rs
nodes.summary: End-to-end compiler driver that lowers C/Rust source to WASM, decodes the result, and emits a token prefix for the transformer-VM; bridges clang/rustc subprocesses with the WASM lowering pipeline.
nodes.languageNotes: Invokes clang and rustc via temp files; uses the WASM decoder and lower passes to produce a runnable token prefix.

nodes.name: CompileError
nodes.summary: Error enum for the compile pipeline covering missing/failed clang or rustc, decode errors, unsupported opcodes, and IO failures.

nodes.name: CompiledProgram
nodes.summary: Result of a successful compile: the decoded program, the formatted token prefix, the input base address, and the input section bytes.

nodes.name: compile_function
nodes.summary: Lowers a single decoded WASM function body into the transformer-VM dispatch-table program; the per-function backend of the compile pipeline.

nodes.name: build_program
nodes.summary: Walks a decoded WASM module and assembles the full dispatch-table program by calling compile_function on each function body.

nodes.name: find_clang
nodes.summary: Searches PATH and well-known locations for a clang binary suitable for compiling C source to WASM.

nodes.name: find_rustc
nodes.summary: Searches PATH and rustup toolchains for a rustc capable of emitting WASM.

nodes.name: compile_c_to_wasm
nodes.summary: Writes the C source to a temp file, invokes clang with WASM target flags, and returns the compiled WASM bytes.

nodes.name: compile_rust_to_wasm
nodes.summary: Wraps the user's Rust body in a template, writes it to a temp crate, and invokes rustc to emit WASM bytes.

nodes.name: compile_program
nodes.summary: Top-level entry: compile C source + input string to a CompiledProgram, invoking clang, decode, and prefix-formatting stages.

nodes.name: cumsum.rs
nodes.summary: Linked-list cumulative sum structure that records (value, position, sequence) tuples for incremental prefix-sum queries.

nodes.name: CumSum
nodes.summary: Linked-list accumulator exposing insert, query (sum up to a position), len, and clear; the fetch_sum primitive for the Percepta graph.

nodes.name: encoding.rs
nodes.summary: Parabolic key/query encoding helpers that project 2D attention (kx, ky) pairs into the convex-hull-friendly form used by HullHalf queries.

nodes.name: encode_key
nodes.summary: Encodes a 2D key (kx, ky) plus optional tie-break into the parabolic form expected by the CHT line container.

nodes.name: evaluator.rs
nodes.summary: Exact-arithmetic graph evaluator that steps a ProgramGraph token-by-token to verify transformer behavior without materializing weight tensors.
nodes.languageNotes: Used as the ground-truth reference to validate the analytically constructed transformer weights.

nodes.name: EvalError
nodes.summary: Error type for the evaluator; currently surfaces unknown-token failures during stepping.

nodes.name: AttentionEntry
nodes.summary: Cached attention KV record: the sequence id, the encoded (kx, ky) pair, and the stored values vector.

nodes.name: GraphEvaluator
nodes.summary: Steppable evaluator over a ProgramGraph that maintains position, CumSum accumulator, attention entries, and per-step scratch buffers.

nodes.name: step
nodes.summary: Advances the evaluator by one token, dispatching to attention/persist/reglu/ffn logic based on the token's role in the graph.

nodes.name: attention_insert_and_query
nodes.summary: Inserts the current step's KV entry and runs a hard-attention max query against the accumulated history.

nodes.name: compare_with_reference
nodes.summary: Runs the evaluator against a reference token sequence and reports divergence, used as a correctness gate.

nodes.name: gates.rs
nodes.summary: Primitive gate functions (reglu, stepglu, multiply, persist) plus the GateKind enum used to classify gated units in the Percepta graph DSL.

nodes.name: PersistSlot
nodes.summary: Named residual-stream slot bound to a persisted expression value, used to materialize intermediate state in the graph.

nodes.name: GateKind
nodes.summary: Enum of the four primitive gate kinds (Reglu, Stepglu, Multiply, Persist) with helpers for neuron/dim accounting.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel for the graph DSL; re-exports the core types (Expression, Dimension, GraphBuilder, ProgramGraph) from graph::types.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Core of the Percepta expression/dimension computation-graph DSL: sparse Expressions over named Dimensions, GraphBuilder for incremental construction, and ProgramGraph for captured programs ready for scheduling.
nodes.languageNotes: Sparse linear-combination Expressions (HashMap<DimId, f64>) with operator overloads; mirrors Percepta's transformer-vm graph/core.py.

nodes.name: Expression
nodes.summary: Sparse linear combination of dimensions (HashMap<DimId, f64>) with Add, Sub, Mul, Neg, Eq, and Display impls; the central DSL value type.

nodes.name: DimensionKind
nodes.summary: Enum classifying a Dimension as Input, ReGLU, Persist, LookUp, CumSum, or Generic, driving scheduler and weight-construction behavior.

nodes.name: Dimension
nodes.summary: Named, classified dimension with a u32 id; the unit of allocation in a GraphBuilder and the leaves of Expressions.

nodes.name: LookUp
nodes.summary: Attention-based retrieval descriptor: value/query/key 2D expressions, a tie-breaker, and the dim_ids it produces.

nodes.name: ProgramGraph
nodes.summary: Immutable captured graph holding all dims, lookups, input/output tokens, and the special one/position/inv_log_pos expressions; target of validation and scheduling.

nodes.name: ValidationError
nodes.summary: Error enum from ProgramGraph::validate covering missing dims/lookups, cycles, and input/output dimension mismatches.

nodes.name: GraphBuilder
nodes.summary: Mutable builder that allocates dimension and lookup ids, caches reglu/stepglu/multiply results, and constructs the encoded 2D keys/queries for attention fetches.

nodes.name: check_no_cycles
nodes.summary: Validates the ProgramGraph by walking expression dependencies and asserting the graph is acyclic; rejects programs that cannot be scheduled.

nodes.name: stepglu
nodes.summary: Builds a step(b >= 0) conditional gate as a graph operation, with caching for structural sharing of identical gate expressions.

nodes.name: multiply
nodes.summary: Builds an element-wise multiply gate between two expressions, with cache lookup for sharing.

nodes.name: encode_2d_key
nodes.summary: Encodes an attention key expression into the parabolic 2D form (kx, ky) plus tie-break consumed by HullHalf queries.

nodes.name: fetch_vec
nodes.summary: Constructs a vector-valued attention fetch that retrieves multiple values per query, the workhorse for attention layer construction.

nodes.name: name_expr_dims
nodes.summary: Auto-assigns human-readable names to the dimensions referenced by an expression for debugging and validation output.

nodes.name: hull.rs
nodes.summary: O(log N) 2D hard-attention KV cache built on a pair of Convex Hull Trick halves (upper + lower) with a brute-force fallback head for correctness verification.
nodes.languageNotes: HardAttentionHead wraps HullHalf upper/lower CHT containers; BruteAttentionHead provides O(N) reference queries.

nodes.name: AttentionResult
nodes.summary: Returned attention match: the matched value, its raw score, and the best kx coordinate for diagnostics.

nodes.name: HullHalf
nodes.summary: One side (upper or lower) of a convex hull attention cache, delegating storage to a CHT line container and providing sign-aware queries.

nodes.name: HardAttentionHead
nodes.summary: Full hard-attention head combining upper and lower HullHalf instances with global bounds; answers argmax attention queries in O(log N).

nodes.name: BruteAttentionHead
nodes.summary: Reference O(N) hard-attention head that scans all entries; used to verify HardAttentionHead correctness in tests.

nodes.name: query
nodes.summary: HullHalf query: ternary-search the upper envelope for the maximum attention score at (qx, qy, tb).

nodes.name: insert
nodes.summary: HardAttentionHead insertion: maintains both hull halves, global bounds, and left/right metadata as new KV pairs arrive.

nodes.name: walk_right
nodes.summary: Walks the hull to the right of a starting index, updating the best-score accumulator during a query.

nodes.name: legacy.rs
nodes.summary: Original reference implementation: KVCache2D with Graham Scan + ternary search, a Sudoku9x9 constraint solver, and a StreamingSolver that emits SolveEvents for visualization and parity checking.
nodes.languageNotes: Always compiled (no feature gate) — provides the historical baseline against which the hull-based path is compared.

nodes.name: Vec2
nodes.summary: 2D vector with dot and cross_z helpers used by the legacy hull-construction geometry.

nodes.name: KVCache2D
nodes.summary: Legacy 2D KV cache using Graham Scan hull construction and ternary-search fast attention; the predecessor of HardAttentionHead.

nodes.name: Sudoku9x9
nodes.summary: 9x9 Sudoku grid with validity checks, candidate elimination, and both naive and fast recursive solvers — used as a symbolic-validation showcase.

nodes.name: StreamingSolver
nodes.summary: Step-driven Sudoku solver that records Try/Accepted/Contradiction/Backtrack/Solved events for streaming visualization and CHT parity verification.

nodes.name: fast_attention
nodes.summary: Legacy O(log N) hard-attention query over the cached upper hull, the fast-path counterpart to linear_attention.

nodes.name: solve_fast_rec
nodes.summary: Recursive Sudoku solver using candidate propagation and backtracking, optimized with elimination-based pruning.

nodes.name: format_events
nodes.summary: Serializes the StreamingSolver's SolveEvent log into a human-readable trace for visualization tooling.

nodes.name: verify_cht_parity
nodes.summary: Cross-checks that the legacy Graham-Scan hull attention produces identical results to the new CHT-based path.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for katgpt-percepta: declares all feature-gated submodules and re-exports the public API (legacy always on; gates for percepta, percepta_gates, percepta_graph, percepta_wasm, percepta_compile).
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Cargo feature gates (percepta, percepta_gates, percepta_graph, percepta_wasm, percepta_compile) to control which submodules are compiled.

nodes.name: runner.rs
nodes.summary: High-level pipeline runner that orchestrates compile, build, run, evaluate, and specialize into a single API exposed via the Runner facade.

nodes.name: RunnerError
nodes.summary: Top-level error enum aggregating ScheduleError, EvalError, CompileError, WeightError, and runner-specific failures.

nodes.name: BuildResult
nodes.summary: Bundle of a successful build: weights, config, vocab, schedule, graph, and input/output token sets.

nodes.name: Runner
nodes.summary: Stateless facade exposing compile_*, build, run, evaluate, specialize, and the combined full_evaluate/full_pipeline helpers.

nodes.name: build
nodes.summary: Constructs a transformer for the universal program: builds the graph, schedules layers, and synthesizes weights.

nodes.name: build_from_graph
nodes.summary: Builds a transformer from an explicit ProgramGraph + token lists rather than the universal interpreter.

nodes.name: specialize
nodes.summary: First Futamura projection: specializes the universal interpreter for a specific program and reports the dimension/lookup reduction.

nodes.name: scheduler.rs
nodes.summary: MILP-style layer scheduler that assigns every graph dimension to one of four phases (Attention, Persist1, Ffn, Persist2) across N standard transformer layers, minimizing d_model via dependency analysis and interval coloring.
nodes.languageNotes: Combines a dependency-graph builder, a min-layers lower bound, an MILP feasibility search, and an interval-coloring register allocator.

nodes.name: OpKey
nodes.summary: Key identifying a producing op for a dimension: a LookUp, ReGLU, or Persist variant with its argument dimensions.

nodes.name: Phase
nodes.summary: Enum of the four standard transformer phases (Attention, Persist1, Ffn, Persist2) with a stable index.

nodes.name: StdLayer
nodes.summary: One standard transformer layer's four phase assignments, the unit of scheduled output.

nodes.name: DepGraph
nodes.summary: Precomputed dependency graph over graph dimensions: ops, inputs, deps_cache, children, consumers, and tight_to edges.

nodes.name: Schedule
nodes.summary: Result of a successful schedule: per-dim phase assignment, std layers, birth/death, alive-after sets, width, and slot_of map.

nodes.name: build_dep_graph
nodes.summary: Constructs the DepGraph for a ProgramGraph by walking lookups, gates, and persists and recording consumer/producer relationships.

nodes.name: milp_schedule
nodes.summary: Iterates layer counts from min_layers upward, attempting an MILP feasibility assignment of dims to phases until a valid schedule is found.

nodes.name: min_layers
nodes.summary: Computes the lower bound on required transformer layers from the longest dependency chain in the op set.

nodes.name: interval_coloring
nodes.summary: Interval-coloring register allocator that assigns concrete slots to dims based on their birth/death intervals, honoring fixed slots.

nodes.name: specialize.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the first Futamura projection: builds a universal interpreter model and specializes it for a concrete program, reporting the dimension/lookup/layer reduction achieved.

nodes.name: SpecializationError
nodes.summary: Error type covering schedule failures, empty programs, and universal-build failures during specialization.

nodes.name: SpecializationReduction
nodes.summary: Reports the ratio improvements (dims, lookups, layers, d_model, tokens) achieved by specializing the universal interpreter.

nodes.name: SpecializedModel
nodes.summary: Result of specialization: a concrete graph, schedule, weights, and the measured reduction versus the universal model.

nodes.name: UniversalModel
nodes.summary: The unspecialized universal interpreter model: graph + schedule + weights prior to program-specific reduction.

nodes.name: build_universal
nodes.summary: Constructs the universal interpreter model by feeding the WASM interpreter graph into the scheduler and weight builder.

nodes.name: specialize
nodes.summary: Specializes the universal model for a specific compiled program by baking its instructions into the FFN weights.

nodes.name: standard_cache.rs
nodes.summary: Reference O(N) softmax attention KV cache used for correctness verification against the O(log N) hull-based hard-attention path.

nodes.name: StandardCache
nodes.summary: Linear-scan attention cache exposing softmax query, temperature-scaled query, and hard-max query for cross-checking the hull cache.

nodes.name: query
nodes.summary: Standard softmax attention query over all cached entries, the O(N) reference implementation.

nodes.name: transformer.rs
nodes.summary: Vanilla autoregressive transformer with ReGLU FFN and analytical (non-learned) weights, providing forward_step, multi-head attention, and token generation over the CHT KV cache.

nodes.name: TransformerConfig
nodes.summary: Hyperparameters for the vanilla transformer: d_model, n_heads, n_layers, d_ffn, stop_token, max_gen.

nodes.name: TransformerVocab
nodes.summary: Token vocabulary with bidirectional id<->name mapping and a designated stop token.

nodes.name: ForwardScratch
nodes.summary: Reusable per-step scratch buffers (qkv, head_out, sublayer_out, ff, gated) to avoid allocation in the hot path.

nodes.name: VanillaTransformer
nodes.summary: The full transformer: weights + config + vocab, exposing generate, forward_step, apply_attention, apply_ffn, and tiebreak management.

nodes.name: generate
nodes.summary: Autoregressive token generation loop: steps forward through layers, applies attention with KV cache, and stops at the stop token.

nodes.name: forward_step
nodes.summary: Single forward step for one layer: applies attention then FFN with residual connections, advancing the KV cache.

nodes.name: apply_attention
nodes.summary: Multi-head attention sub-layer over the CHT KV cache, including per-head tiebreak handling.

nodes.name: apply_ffn
nodes.summary: ReGLU FFN sub-layer: ff_in gated by ReLU(ff_in_gated) then projected by ff_out, written back to the residual stream.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Shared lightweight types for the CHT hull KV cache: TieBreak mode enum, HullMeta accumulator for hull vertices, and a 2D Vec2 with geometry helpers.

nodes.name: TieBreak
nodes.summary: Enum for resolving attention ties: take the average of matched values or the latest one by sequence id.

nodes.name: HullMeta
nodes.summary: Per-vertex metadata accumulator: running value sum, last value, last sequence id, and count, resolved via a TieBreak policy.

nodes.name: Vec2
nodes.summary: 2D f64 vector with dot and cross_z, used by hull geometry calculations.

nodes.name: decoder.rs
nodes.summary: Pure-Rust WASM MVP binary decoder: parses the module header, type/import/function/export/global/code/data sections, and individual instructions into a structured WasmModule.

nodes.name: WasmInstr
nodes.summary: Decoded WASM instruction: opcode byte plus its parsed immediates.

nodes.name: WasmModule
nodes.summary: Fully decoded WASM module: types, imports, func_type_indices, exports, function bodies, data segments, and globals.

nodes.name: FuncBody
nodes.summary: Decoded function body: locals declaration, total local count, and instruction vector.

nodes.name: Import
nodes.summary: WASM import descriptor: module/name pair, kind, and index.

nodes.name: Export
nodes.summary: WASM export descriptor: name, kind, and index into the respective index space.

nodes.name: decode
nodes.summary: Top-level entry: validates magic/version and dispatches each section to its dedicated decoder.

nodes.name: decode_instruction
nodes.summary: Decodes a single WASM instruction at the cursor, parsing opcode-specific immediates (LEB128, memory operands, blocks).

nodes.name: read_signed_leb128
nodes.summary: Reads a signed LEB128 variable-length integer from a byte slice, advancing the cursor.

nodes.name: decode_import_section
nodes.summary: Parses the WASM import section, populating the module's import list and contributing to imported-function indexing.

nodes.name: arithmetic.rs
nodes.summary: Builds the byte-serial ALU sub-graph for the WASM interpreter: 8-bit addition with carry, subtraction with borrow, and signed/unsigned comparisons expressed as graph operations.

nodes.name: ByteArithmetic
nodes.summary: Holds the byte-serial add/carry/sub/borrow/memory-sign graph fragments built once and reused by the interpreter.

nodes.name: Comparisons
