nodes.summary: Comparison graph fragments: unsigned/signed less-than, greater-than, equality, and nonzero condition flags.

nodes.name: build
nodes.summary: Builds the comparison graph fragment that emits a_gt_b_u, a_lt_b_u, a_eq_b, and signed variants from two stack values.

nodes.name: dispatch.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the WASM opcode universe (35-op enum), ProgramInstruction representation, and the OpcodeDispatch graph that matches a fetched opcode pair against known opcodes via dot-product attention.
nodes.languageNotes: OpcodeDispatch uses op_dot (circle-point attention) to identify instructions in the universal interpreter.

nodes.name: Opcode
nodes.summary: Exhaustive enum of 35 supported WASM opcodes (arithmetic, control flow, memory, local/global, I/O) with metadata: wasm byte, stack delta, circle point.

nodes.name: ProgramInstruction
nodes.summary: One instruction in a baked program: opcode plus its raw byte payload (immediate or empty).

nodes.name: OpcodeDispatch
nodes.summary: Graph fragment holding the fetched-x/fetched-y expressions and cached op_dot/is_op results for opcode identification.

nodes.name: op_dot
nodes.summary: Computes the circle-point attention score between the fetched opcode pair and a target opcode, with caching.

nodes.name: unique_stack_pairs
nodes.summary: Enumerates the unique (stack-top, stack-second) opcode pairs needed to disambiguate via attention matching.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Builds the universal WASM interpreter as a computation graph: dispatches on fetched opcodes via attention, fetches operands, and emits per-opcode behavior — the heart of the Percepta transformer-VM.

nodes.name: DispatchCache
nodes.summary: Cached op_dot and is_op graph fragments built once by the interpreter and reused across all dispatch sites.

nodes.name: FetchResult
nodes.summary: Bundle of fetched opcode/states for one interpreter step: opcode x/y, stack delta, store-to-stack flag, is_write flag, immediate, and const byte.

nodes.name: PiecewiseLookup
nodes.summary: Piecewise linear lookup table (positive and negative branches) used for nonlinear mappings in the interpreter graph.

nodes.name: build_universal_fetch
nodes.summary: Builds the universal-mode instruction fetch graph: reads opcode bytes from memory and resolves stack-delta/store/write flags via attention.

nodes.name: build_specialized_fetch
nodes.summary: Builds the specialized-mode (Futamura) instruction fetch graph that bakes a concrete program's instructions into the FFN weights.

nodes.name: build
nodes.summary: Top-level interpreter graph builder: constructs fetch, dispatch, ALU, and per-opcode behavior, returning the input/output token lists. ~680 lines.

nodes.name: tokens.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the interpreter's input-dimension layout (InputDims) and emit-gate layout (EmitGates), plus the builders that translate them into the input/output token vectors consumed by the transformer.

nodes.name: InputDims
nodes.summary: Named layout of all input dimensions fed to the interpreter-transformer: byte number, carry, deltas, opcode x/y, is_write, and prefix slots.

nodes.name: EmitGates
nodes.summary: Named layout of all output emit gates: halt, branch-taken, call-commit, return-commit, out, byte, commit, and bt signals.

nodes.name: FetchedState
nodes.summary: Compact carrier of the fetched stack-delta and store-to-stack values produced by the fetch stage.

nodes.name: build_input_tokens
nodes.summary: Materializes InputDims into the concrete input-token list with prefix slots for opcode/delta/store/write/is-write fields.

nodes.name: build_output_tokens
nodes.summary: Materializes EmitGates into the concrete output-token list encoding the interpreter's per-step side effects.

nodes.name: lower.rs
nodes.summary: WASM lowering pipeline: rewrites hard-to-simulate instructions (MUL, DIV, REM, AND, OR, XOR, SHL, SHR, ROTL, ROTR, CLZ, CTZ, POPCNT, EXTEND) into sequences of basic ops (ADD, SUB, comparisons, branches, LOAD/STORE) that the transformer-VM can execute natively.
nodes.languageNotes: Two main entry points: lower_hard_ops rewrites per-function; lower_i64_ops lowers 64-bit operations. check_basic_only verifies the result.

nodes.name: BitOp
nodes.summary: Enum tagging which bitwise operation (And, Or, Xor) a lowering expansion should emit.

nodes.name: IntoImms
nodes.summary: Trait abstracting how different immediate kinds (i32 const, memory operand, block type) convert to instruction immediates.

nodes.name: lower_hard_ops
nodes.summary: Per-function lowering pass: scans instructions and expands each hard op using the matching expand_* routine, returning a fully-basic instruction stream.

nodes.name: lower_i64_ops
nodes.summary: Lowers 64-bit WASM operations into 32-bit sequences that the transformer-VM's 32-bit ALU can execute.

nodes.name: check_basic_only
nodes.summary: Post-pass verifier: returns the list of any remaining non-basic opcodes after lowering, used to assert the function is simulation-ready.

nodes.name: expand_ctz
nodes.summary: Expands i32.ctz (count-trailing-zeros) into a sequence of basic ops using a bit-twiddling decomposition.

nodes.name: expand_popcnt
nodes.summary: Expands i32.popcnt (population count) into a sequence of basic ops via a bit-by-bit accumulation loop.

nodes.name: emit_byte_bitop
nodes.summary: Emits a byte-wise bitwise-op sequence (And/Or/Xor with a constant mask) suitable for the byte-serial interpreter ALU.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel for the WASM toolchain: re-exports the decoder, lower passes, and interpreter computation-graph builders behind the percepta_wasm feature.

nodes.name: weights.rs
nodes.summary: Analytical (non-learned) weight construction: derives concrete transformer weight tensors (embedding, per-layer attention/FFN projections, unembedding, head tiebreak) from a ProgramGraph and its Schedule.
nodes.languageNotes: Reverse-engineers the closed-form weights that make a vanilla transformer implement the scheduled ALM graph — no training required.

nodes.name: TransformerWeights
nodes.summary: Top-level weight bundle: embedding, unembedding, per-layer weights, head tiebreak table, attn/ffn erase masks, and shape metadata.

nodes.name: LayerWeights
nodes.summary: Per-layer weight pair: attention weights and FFN weights for one transformer layer.

nodes.name: AttentionWeights
nodes.summary: Attention projection weights: input projection (QKV) and output projection matrices.

nodes.name: FfnWeights
nodes.summary: FFN projection weights: ff_in and ff_out matrices implementing the ReGLU gated projection.

nodes.name: HeadInfo
nodes.summary: Per-head descriptor: either a concrete Lookup head or a Passthrough head, driving how attention weights are constructed.

nodes.name: build_weights
nodes.summary: Top-level weight construction: walks the schedule and assembles the full TransformerWeights by delegating to per-layer builders.

nodes.name: build_attention_layer_weights
nodes.summary: Constructs the attention projection weights for one layer from the scheduled lookups, including per-head tiebreak.

nodes.name: build_ffn_layer_weights
nodes.summary: Constructs the ReGLU FFN projection weights for one layer from the scheduled ReGLU dims and erased slots.

nodes.name: count_layer_resources
nodes.summary: Pre-pass that counts the attention heads, FFN units, and slot demands for a layer to size the weight matrices before construction.

nodes.name: acceptance_forecast.rs
nodes.summary: Entropy-bounded acceptance-rate forecast (Bebop arXiv:2606.12370) that linearly bounds speculative-decode acceptance α by the target model's next-token entropy H(p), feeding an adaptive-γ signal into the decode loop.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements Propositions 1/2/4 bounds: α ≈ a − b·H(p). The adaptive-γ wiring (paper §7.6 unproven future work) is the GOAT-gated integration point.

nodes.name: AcceptanceForecast
nodes.summary: Entropy-bounded acceptance-rate forecaster with EMA-tracked Beta(α,β) parameters, exposing observe/forecast/reset and an adaptive γ selector.

nodes.name: fit_from_warmup
nodes.summary: Calibrates the linear α = a − b·H(p) bound from warmup (entropy, observed-acceptance) samples.

nodes.name: entropy_nats_zero_alloc
nodes.summary: Computes Shannon entropy in nats from a logits slice without heap allocation, used as the bound input.

nodes.name: alpha.rs
nodes.summary: LDT α-operator (Lattice Deduction Transformers, arXiv:2605.08605): progressive multi-solution supervision target ŷ = x ⊓ α({consistent y}), with a ConflictClauseDB for CDCL-style learning.
nodes.languageNotes: Lattice_deduction feature-gated. Combines a tightening α-target with conflict-clause learning (ConflictClause / ConflictClauseDB) over a Mutex<HashSet>.

nodes.name: AlphaTarget
nodes.summary: Progressive multi-solution supervision target tracking committed tokens and the tightening intersection of consistent solutions.

nodes.name: ConflictClauseDB
nodes.summary: CDCL-style clause database exposing learn/is_violated, backed by a Mutex<Vec<ConflictClause>>.

nodes.name: target
nodes.summary: Computes the α-tightened target by intersecting all remaining consistent solutions.

nodes.name: alpha_intersect
nodes.summary: Set-intersection primitive over candidate solutions consistent with the current commit set.

nodes.name: and_or_builder.rs
nodes.summary: AND-OR DDTree builder that converts flat marginals into an AND-OR tree using the ScreeningPruner relevance signal — low-relevance regions decompose into subgoals (AND), high-relevance leaves solve directly (OR root).
nodes.languageNotes: Plan 190 T2. Subgoals are blake3-keyed and memoized through ProofGoalCache so repeated structures across branches are solved once and reused.

nodes.name: AndOrBuilder
nodes.summary: AND-OR DDTree builder configured with a relevance threshold and max depth; produces an AndOrNode tree from marginals.

nodes.name: top_k_indices
nodes.summary: Returns the indices of the top-k values in a slice — the selection primitive used at OR nodes.

nodes.name: build
nodes.summary: Top-level entry: computes relevance profile, finds decomposition regions, and recursively builds AND-OR children.

nodes.name: solve_subgoal
nodes.summary: Recursively solves a memoized subgoal via ProofGoalCache, returning GoalResult for reuse across branches.

nodes.name: answer_extract.rs
nodes.summary: Answer-extraction strategies for parallel-probe speculative decoding (Plan 133 T2): pulls structured answers (boxed LaTeX, numeric, think-tokens, discrete actions) out of raw token sequences with zero external deps.
nodes.languageNotes: Stateless, std-only extractors composable via the AnswerExtractor trait. No regex crate — uses manual scanners.

nodes.name: RegexAnswerExtractor
nodes.summary: Manual string-scan answer extractor (no regex crate) pulling boxed LaTeX / 'Answer is:' substrings.

nodes.name: DiscreteActionExtractor
nodes.summary: Extracts discrete action IDs from token sequences for RL-style parallel-probe consensus.

nodes.name: extract_numeric
nodes.summary: Extracts the first parseable numeric value (int/float/fraction) from a token sequence, with unit-stripping heuristics.

nodes.name: extract_answer
nodes.summary: DiscreteActionExtractor entry — parses an action integer from the token tail.

nodes.name: belief_cache.rs
nodes.summary: Latent Transition Cache — LRU cache for (h_t, x_{t+1}) → ĥ_{t+1} MLP predictions, avoiding redundant BeliefDrafter forwards during DDTree branch exploration (Plan 217 Phase 4).
nodes.languageNotes: Uses papaya lock-free HashMap with blake3-hashed (h_t || next_emb) keys truncated to 16 bytes; tracks hits/misses atomically.

nodes.name: LatentTransitionCache
nodes.summary: Lock-free papaya-backed cache mapping blake3-hashed (h_t, next_emb) pairs to predicted ĥ_{t+1}, with hit/miss counters.

nodes.name: insert
nodes.summary: Inserts a cached transition, evicting on capacity overflow under the papaya lock-free map.

nodes.name: belief_drafter.rs
nodes.summary: NextLat belief-state speculative drafter (Plan 217 / arXiv:2511.05963): a 3-layer residual LatentDynamicsMLP predicts h_{t+1} from (h_t, emb(x_{t+1})) and BeliefDrafter wraps it with an output head for recursive variable-length drafting with entropy-gated stopping.
nodes.languageNotes: Architecture: h_{t+1} = h_t + FC3(GELU(FC2(GELU(FC1(LN(concat(h_t, next_emb))))))). Self-conditioning (Plan 222 T11) injects SC into the embedding channel. Feature-gated behind `belief_drafter` (default-OFF until GOAT proof).

nodes.name: LatentDynamicsMLP
nodes.summary: 3-layer residual MLP with input LayerNorm predicting the next hidden state from (h_t, next_emb); supports self-conditioning via forward_with_sc.

nodes.name: BeliefDrafter
nodes.summary: Recursive variable-length speculative drafter wrapping LatentDynamicsMLP + output head + token embeddings, with entropy-gated stopping.

nodes.name: draft_with_sc
nodes.summary: Recursive draft loop with additive self-conditioning injection into the embedding channel and entropy-gated stopping.

nodes.name: draft
nodes.summary: Recursive variable-length draft loop — repeatedly predicts h_{t+1}, logits, samples, and stops on entropy threshold.

nodes.name: load_from_bin
nodes.summary: Loads a LatentDynamicsMLP from a .bin file with a blake3 checksum trailer.

nodes.name: forward_into
nodes.summary: In-place MLP forward writing into a caller-provided MlpForwardScratch — avoids allocation on the hot path.

nodes.name: best_buddies.rs
nodes.summary: Best Buddies Drafting (Plan 199): filters draft marginals to tokens where draft and target models agree bidirectionally (mutual nearest neighbors), using Pearson correlation on logit distributions.
nodes.languageNotes: Feature flag `best_buddies`. Uses pearson_correlation on draft vs target logits per position to decide inclusion in the DDTree.

nodes.name: MarginalBestBuddyAligner
nodes.summary: Best-buddy aligner scoring draft↔target agreement via Pearson correlation with an EMA smoothing factor.

nodes.name: filter_marginals
nodes.summary: Filters a marginal batch to only positions where draft and target are mutual nearest neighbors; returns the filtered view used downstream by the DDTree.

nodes.name: blueprint.rs
nodes.summary: Blueprint pre-pass (LEAP arXiv:2606.03303): generates a cheap greedy argmax plan from marginals to hint the expensive DDTree search about which tokens are promising.
nodes.languageNotes: O(depth × vocab) greedy argmax — no tree search. The blueprint's compatibility bonus is applied in the DDTree heap.

nodes.name: BlueprintPass
nodes.summary: Blueprint pre-pass: stateless generator of a greedy argmax plan from marginals.

nodes.name: generate
nodes.summary: Greedy argmax at each depth — returns Vec<usize> where result[d] = argmax of marginals[d].

nodes.name: branch_confidence.rs
nodes.summary: Deep Manifold union-bound branch confidence (Research 205, Plan 231 / paper Eq. 32-35): errors on stacked piecewise manifolds propagate additively (Boole's inequality), so branch confidence should combine scores additively, not multiplicatively.
nodes.languageNotes: Trait + three strategies (Multiplicative, UnionBound, Hybrid). Hybrid blends multiplicative and additive by α per the paper.

nodes.name: HybridScorer
nodes.summary: Hybrid scorer blending MultiplicativeScorer and UnionBoundScorer by an α weight, per Deep Manifold §2.4.2.

nodes.name: MultiplicativeScorer
nodes.summary: Multiplicative branch-confidence scorer — errors compound exponentially (baseline).

nodes.name: UnionBoundScorer
nodes.summary: Additive (Boole's inequality) scorer — errors propagate additively, matching the manifold proof.

nodes.name: budget.rs
nodes.summary: Adaptive decode budget — derives a per-prompt DDTree budget from PFlash complexity signals (compression ratio or first-marginal Shannon entropy).
nodes.languageNotes: Two modes (Plan 167 Compression / Plan 175 Entropy) compile budget ∈ [base/2, base*2] from one entropy reading — the ANE RangeDim analogy.

nodes.name: adaptive_tree_budget
nodes.summary: Computes a per-prompt tree budget by scaling the base budget by a complexity signal (compression ratio or entropy) within a clamped range.

nodes.name: budget_compat.rs
nodes.summary: Budget adaptation integration helpers (Plan 167 Phase 2): glue between adaptive_tree_budget() and the speculative decode dispatch — produces effective budget and scaled draft lookahead from the compression ratio.
nodes.languageNotes: Two thin pure functions forming the dispatch-layer API; callers compute effective budget and lookahead then pass them into build_dd_tree / TreeBuilder.

nodes.name: effective_tree_budget
nodes.summary: Computes the effective tree budget from base budget, compression ratio, and a scaling mode.

nodes.name: scaled_draft_lookahead
nodes.summary: Scales draft_lookahead proportionally to effective/base budget so the drafter depth tracks the adapted budget.

nodes.name: caddtree_budget.rs
nodes.summary: CaDDTree (Plan 219) — cost-aware adaptive DDTree budget selection that replaces fixed Config::tree_budget with a per-round adaptive budget maximizing token throughput, using acceptance surrogate + latency estimator.
nodes.languageNotes: Based on CaDDTree (arXiv:2606.01813) unimodality + greedy optimal search and BASTION (arXiv:2605.29727) surrogate/estimator. Pipeline: marginals → acceptance surrogate → throughput(B) → greedy → B*.

nodes.name: BudgetSelector
nodes.summary: Cost-aware budget selector combining an AcceptanceSurrogate and a LatencyEstimator; greedily picks B* maximizing throughput.

nodes.name: AcceptanceSurrogate
nodes.summary: Predicts expected accepted length as a function of budget B (top-1 and per-budget paths), used by BudgetSelector.

nodes.name: build_dd_tree_adaptive_mux_residual
nodes.summary: Adaptive DDTree builder variant that muxes budget selection through ResidualTracker convergence feedback.

nodes.name: select_budget
nodes.summary: Greedy unimodal search over candidate budgets B to maximize throughput(B) = expected_accepted_length(B) / latency(B).

nodes.name: correlation_budget.rs
nodes.summary: Correlation Budget Allocation (Plan 200) — replaces heuristic PositionWeightedBudget γ with EMA-tracked draft↔target agreement rates per speculative depth; high agreement → more budget, low → less.
nodes.languageNotes: Feature flag `corr_budget`. Tracks per-depth acceptance rates via EMA and redistributes max_budget proportionally to agreement.

nodes.name: CorrelationBudgetAllocator
nodes.summary: Per-depth EMA-tracked agreement allocator that redistributes a max_budget across speculative depths proportional to empirical acceptance.

nodes.name: allocate
nodes.summary: Distributes max_budget across tracked depths proportional to their EMA agreement rates, with a floor to keep dead depths alive.

nodes.name: dd_tree.rs
nodes.summary: Core DDTree (Deliberation Decision Tree) engine — the heart of speculative decoding in katgpt-rs. Builds pruned/screened/balanced/SDE/belief/domino/manifold/lodestar/dendritic AND-OR trees from marginals under a ConstraintPruner / ScreeningPruner.
nodes.languageNotes: 4213 lines. TreeBuilder carries 12 build_* variants; the module also exposes ~30 free functions (build_dd_tree_*) composing pruners, SDE noise, lodestar horizon, dendritic gates, residual tracking, cross-scale width selection, and best-of-k rollouts. Heavily feature-gated (lodestar, domino_correction, elf_sde, and_or_dtree, belief_drafter, speculative_generator, kurtosis_gate, best_buddies).

nodes.name: TreeBuilder
nodes.summary: Builder carrying DDTree configuration (budget, width mode, depth budgets, pruner) across 12 build_* variants — build, build_screened, build_balanced, build_screened_progressive, build_screened_recfm, etc.

nodes.name: ResidualTracker
nodes.summary: Tracks residual convergence across build iterations (record_step, mean_residual, is_converged) to gate progressive DDTree expansion.

nodes.name: LodestarConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for the Lodestar-guided DDTree variant (build_dd_tree_lodestar) using a CompletionHorizon.

nodes.name: build_screened_recfm
nodes.summary: Screened DDTree build using reconstruction-error-guided (RECFM) branch expansion under a ScreeningPruner and budget config.

nodes.name: build
nodes.summary: Primary TreeBuilder.build — constructs a DDTree from marginals under a ConstraintPruner, extracting the best path and inference result.

nodes.name: build_dd_tree_lodestar
nodes.summary: Lodestar-guided DDTree build using a CompletionHorizon to steer branch selection toward likely-completing tokens.

nodes.name: decomp_reviewer.rs
nodes.summary: Decomposition quality reviewer — prevents AND-OR search collapse on dead-end branches by using ProofGoalCache hit rate as a progress signal: high cache miss → productive, high cache hit → prune.
nodes.languageNotes: LEAP-inspired statistical reviewer (not a model). Default min_novelty = 0.3 (30% of goals must be novel).

nodes.name: DecompositionReviewer
nodes.summary: Atomic-counter-backed reviewer tracking cache hit/miss per branch to decide whether decomposition is productive enough to continue.

nodes.name: dendritic_gate.rs
nodes.summary: Re-export shim for DendriticGate / dendritic_sigmoid from katgpt_core::dendritic_gate (Plan 260); the canonical NMDA-inspired implementation lives in katgpt-core so both the main crate and MuxBfs can share it.
nodes.languageNotes: Thin `pub use` shim — sole non-test surface is two re-exports. Tests exercise the re-exported compute_gate/should_exit_early behavior.

nodes.name: dflash.rs
nodes.summary: DFlash zero-alloc speculative marginal-distribution drafter — shared algorithmic cores (predict / AR / conditioned) parameterized over crate-specific forward fn and state, so improvements propagate to both katgpt-rs and riir-engine.
nodes.languageNotes: Issue 013 Phase B: collapses the dflash fork between katgpt-rs and riir-engine by extracting the three `_with` cores here; thin wrappers stay in each crate.

nodes.name: DflashCtx
nodes.summary: ForwardContext-like parameter bundle passed to the dflash _with cores — holds logits slice, buffers, and KV cache access.

nodes.name: dflash_predict_ar_with
nodes.summary: Auto-regressive dflash draft core — samples max_steps tokens by repeatedly invoking the crate-provided forward_fn with KV-cache position tracking.

nodes.name: dflash_predict_with
nodes.summary: Single-shot dflash draft core — produces a marginal distribution for one step under a forward_fn, with cache reset/invalidate hooks.

nodes.name: ilc.rs
nodes.summary: ILC (Iterative Latent Clustering) distillation — synonym-aware DDTree pruning (arXiv:2605.27734). Offline k-means on cousin context vectors yields a SynonymMap consumed online by SynonymAwarePruner to skip branches in already-explored clusters.
nodes.languageNotes: Phase 6 of Proposal 003. Hierarchical clustering per cousin depth; SynonymMap provides O(1) cluster lookup; build_dd_tree_screened_synonyms is the screened DDTree variant.

nodes.name: SynonymMap
nodes.summary: O(1) cluster-lookup table built from offline k-means centers — maps a state vector to its ClusterId with no allocation on the hot path.

nodes.name: IlcClusterer
nodes.summary: Offline k-means clusterer producing per-depth centers from episode data; outputs feed SynonymMap::from_centers.

nodes.name: build_dd_tree_screened_synonyms
nodes.summary: Screened DDTree variant that prunes branches whose states fall into already-explored synonym clusters, preserving diversity.

nodes.name: kmeans
nodes.summary: Lloyd's k-means loop over a flat state matrix with a fixed iteration budget, returning (centers, labels).

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel for the `distill` submodule — declares `ilc` (always-on) and `trd` (feature `trd_refined_draft`) and documents the Proposal 003 split history (peira → katgpt-spectral, ilc → here, trd → here).
nodes.languageNotes: 17-line barrel: `pub mod ilc;` plus `#[cfg(feature = "trd_refined_draft")] pub mod trd;`. No exports of its own.

nodes.name: trd.rs
nodes.summary: Trajectory-Refined Draft (TRDraft, arXiv:2606.08432, Plan 249) — modelless TRD for speculative decoding: detects prefix failure, re-drafts from the failure point with ConstraintPruner + ELF SDE noise, ranks raw vs refined via BT Rank, and bandit-learns when refinement helps.
nodes.languageNotes: Feature gate `trd_refined_draft` (default-OFF). Originally in root because prefold_prefix depended on crate::fold; the Phase 12 T4.5 move of fold/ into this crate dissolved the cycle.

nodes.name: TrajectoryRefinedDraft
nodes.summary: Top-level TRD orchestrator carrying config, bandit arm stats, and the raw vs refined branch scoring state.

nodes.name: refine_branch
nodes.summary: Re-drafts a branch from a detected failure point under ConstraintPruner + ELF SDE noise, returning a RefinementResult with chosen arm.

nodes.name: prefold_prefix
nodes.summary: Folds the prefix up to a failure point using crate::fold to seed re-drafting with a compressed context.

nodes.name: detect_prefix_failure
nodes.summary: Scans a raw branch for prefix failure by entropy spike / LeviathanVerifier rejection, returning the failure token index and reason.

nodes.name: domino.rs
nodes.summary: Domino Causal Correction (Plan 197, Research 177) — modelless decoupled pattern: O(1) hash-lookup prefix-conditioned logit residuals (PrefixCorrectionTable), a domino_score expansion priority, and a DominoPruner trait.
nodes.languageNotes: Three modelless mechanisms — no training, no LoRA. PrefixCorrectionTable hashes a token window to a logit residual via blake3; domino_score weights DDTree expansion by prefix strength.

nodes.name: PrefixCorrectionTable
nodes.summary: Hash-lookup table mapping a blake3-hashed token prefix to a vocab-sized logit residual for O(1) causal correction.

nodes.name: PrefixCorrectionTableBuilder
nodes.summary: Builder accumulating (prefix → residual) entries and producing an immutable PrefixCorrectionTable via build().

nodes.name: compute_prefix_strength
nodes.summary: Computes a prefix-strength score used to weight domino-corrected branches in DDTree expansion.

nodes.name: domino_lora.rs
nodes.summary: Domino LoRA causal correction adapter (Plan 231) — inference-only adapter reading domino_lora.bin (DMAD format) and applying a LoRA-style ΔL correction to draft logits with a GRU for causal state tracking across positions.
nodes.languageNotes: DMAD binary: 32-byte header (magic, version, dims) + f32 weights + blake3(32). Uses simd_add_inplace for the LoRA correction and matmul for the GRU step.

nodes.name: DominoLoraCorrection
nodes.summary: Inference-only LoRA correction adapter: holds the GRU state, A/B matrices, and embedding projection; applies ΔL via correct().

nodes.name: load
nodes.summary: Loads a DominoLoraCorrection from a .bin file, parsing the DMAD header, reading f32 weight blocks, and verifying the trailing blake3 checksum.

nodes.name: correct
nodes.summary: Applies the LoRA ΔL correction to a logits slice using the GRU-tracked causal state for the current position.

nodes.name: echo_env.rs
nodes.summary: ECHO Environment Predictor (Plan 247, arXiv:2605.24517) — three modelless primitives: EnvPredictorPruner scores candidate actions by predicted-outcome expectedness, PredictionVerifier produces a bandit reward from prediction accuracy, and PredictionConsistencyGate adjusts budget by inter-branch entropy.
nodes.languageNotes: All sigmoid (never softmax) per project rules. EnvPredictorPruner is a ScreeningPruner using sigmoid(dot-product); the gate contracts/expands budget by inter-branch entropy.

nodes.name: PredictionVerifier
nodes.summary: Post-hoc verifier comparing predicted features vs actual outcomes, producing an EMA-tracked bandit reward signal and correct_rate.

nodes.name: PredictionConsistencyGate
nodes.summary: Entropy-based confidence gate adjusting budget allocation: low inter-branch entropy → contract, high → expand for exploration.

nodes.name: compute_branch_entropy
nodes.summary: Computes the inter-branch entropy used by PredictionConsistencyGate to decide budget contraction/expansion.

nodes.name: flow_pruner.rs
nodes.summary: FlowPruner — GFlowNet-inspired stop-probability regularization that composes with any ScreeningPruner and adds a multiplicative flow bonus (λ · exp(logsumexp(−log P_stop))) to boost exploration where the model thinks the solution continues.
nodes.languageNotes: Wrapper pruner — wraps an inner ScreeningPruner and contributes a flow_bonus. Stop-probability sources: direct set, from marginals, or from entropy spike.

nodes.name: FlowPruner
nodes.summary: GFlowNet-inspired ScreeningPruner wrapper carrying an inner pruner, a λ flow weight, and per-position stop probabilities.

nodes.name: set_stop_probs_from_entropy
nodes.summary: Derives per-position stop probabilities from an entropy spike signal, used by the flow bonus computation.

nodes.name: attention_importance.rs
nodes.summary: Attention importance scorer (Plan 195 T2) — ranks reasoning steps by mean attention weight from later tokens, so steps essential to the reasoning chain are kept during folding.
nodes.languageNotes: Root-resident by design (Issue 033 §C Option C); feeds ScreeningPruner via chain_folder with step-importance scores from ForwardContext attention.

nodes.name: AttentionImportance
nodes.summary: Stateless step-importance scorer producing per-step mean-attention scores over a StepBoundary slice.

nodes.name: score_steps
nodes.summary: Computes per-step importance as the mean of attention scores within each step boundary; higher mean → more essential step.

nodes.name: chain_folder.rs
nodes.summary: Implements ChainFolder — the main inference-time CoT folding logic that ranks reasoning steps by attention importance and uses binary search to find the minimal step set preserving verification.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements katgpt_core::traits::ScreeningPruner so it plugs directly into the DDTree screening pipeline; compact_trace uses StillKV compression.

nodes.name: ChainFolder
nodes.summary: Main chain folding struct implementing ScreeningPruner; holds fold budget, attention importance scorer, accumulated decisions, and boundaries.

nodes.name: ChainFolder_binary_search_fold
nodes.summary: Binary searches for the minimal set of reasoning steps that still pass speculative verification, starting from fold_budget and shrinking.

nodes.name: ChainFolder_step_index_for_depth
nodes.summary: Maps a tree depth to the corresponding reasoning step index in the folded chain.

nodes.name: ChainFolder_compact_trace
nodes.summary: Invokes StillKV to compact the KV cache of surviving tokens after folding, providing synthesis-based reduction on top of selection-based folding.

nodes.name: ChainFolder_kept_token_count
nodes.summary: Counts the surviving tokens after folding given the per-step decisions and step boundaries.

nodes.name: ChainFolder_relevance
nodes.summary: ScreeningPruner trait impl — returns 1.0 for essential/anchor steps and 0.0 for foldable ones based on attention importance ranking.

nodes.name: verify_fold
nodes.summary: SpeculativeVerifier check on a candidate fold — confirms the folded prefix still produces a valid continuation.

nodes.name: build_decisions
nodes.summary: Constructs per-step FoldDecision values (Keep/Fold/Anchor) from the ranked boundaries and a target fold count.

nodes.name: estimate_tokens_saved
nodes.summary: Estimates the total token reduction achieved by a fold decision plan against the original chain length.

nodes.name: fold_bandit.rs
nodes.summary: Self-tuning fold budget selector using a 5-armed Thompson-sampling bandit (Beta posteriors) to balance exploration of fold aggressiveness against the best-known token-reduction budget.
nodes.languageNotes: Reward = acceptance_rate × token_reduction_ratio; 5 budget arms [0.3,0.5,0.7,0.9,1.0] with EMA decay.

nodes.name: FoldBandit
nodes.summary: 5-armed Thompson-sampling bandit over fold budgets [0.3,0.5,0.7,0.9,1.0] with EMA decay of Beta posteriors and optional precision gating.

nodes.name: FoldBandit_select_budget
nodes.summary: Thompson-samples a fold budget arm by drawing from each Beta posterior and picking the highest sample.

nodes.name: FoldBandit_record_reward
nodes.summary: Updates the Beta posterior of the chosen arm using reward = acceptance_rate × token_reduction_ratio.

nodes.name: FoldBandit_best_arm
nodes.summary: Returns the arm index with the highest expected budget under the current posteriors (exploitation-only selection).

nodes.name: budget_to_arm
nodes.summary: Maps a continuous fold-budget value to the nearest discrete arm index.

nodes.name: sample_beta
nodes.summary: Samples from a Beta(α,β) distribution using two Gamma variates via the inverse-CDF transform with the provided RNG.

nodes.name: fold_cache.rs
nodes.summary: Planning layer for KV-cache rollback after folding — tracks essential step indices and computes the truncate position and replay plan consumed by the transformer forward pass.

nodes.name: FoldCache
nodes.summary: KV-cache rollback planner — tracks essential step indices, total step count, and the computed truncate position for the transformer forward pass.

nodes.name: FoldCache_replay_essential
nodes.summary: Computes the replay plan: which essential steps must be re-run after truncating the KV cache to the fold point.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel for the ThoughtFold submodule — re-exports ChainFolder, FoldBandit, FoldCache, StepBoundary tracker, and ThinkingController integration helpers.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust module barrel re-exporting public types and functions from submodules.

nodes.name: step_boundary.rs
nodes.summary: Detects reasoning step boundaries in CoT text by scanning for structural markers (\\n\\n, think-tag transitions) and emitting ordered StepBoundary tagged as anchors or foldable.

nodes.name: detect_step_boundaries
nodes.summary: Scans CoT text for \\n\\n and think-tag transitions, emitting a position-sorted Vec<StepBoundary> with tag transitions marked as anchors.

nodes.name: thinking_ext.rs
nodes.summary: Bridge helpers that convert FoldResult / FoldStats into ThinkingFoldFeedback and reduction-ratio metrics for the ThinkingController feedback loop.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Core ThoughtFold data types — StepBoundary, FoldDecision, FoldResult, FoldContext, FoldStats, ThinkingFoldFeedback — consumed across all chain-folding submodules and the ScreeningPruner composition.

nodes.name: FoldResult_no_fold
nodes.summary: Constructs a FoldResult representing the identity (no-fold) outcome — keeps all steps, zero tokens saved.

nodes.name: FoldStats_record
nodes.summary: Accumulates a FoldResult into running FoldStats (totals, pass rate, query count).

nodes.name: kurtosis_gate.rs
nodes.summary: Zero-cost speculative-decoding gate that computes excess kurtosis of draft marginals in a single O(n) pass — high kurtosis (concentrated) means accept speculation, low kurtosis (flat) means fall back to autoregressive decoding.
nodes.languageNotes: Scale-invariant excess kurtosis κ = n·m₄/m₂² − 3 computed from unnormalized exp(l − max) values; numerical guards for n<4 and m₂<1e-10.

nodes.name: KurtosisGate
nodes.summary: Stateful gate holding an acceptance threshold and reusable scratch buffer; decides whether to speculate based on excess kurtosis of draft logits or probabilities.

nodes.name: excess_kurtosis
nodes.summary: Computes population excess kurtosis κ = n·m₄/m₂² − 3 in a single O(n) pass with no allocations; returns 0 for degenerate inputs.

nodes.name: excess_kurtosis_from_sum
nodes.summary: Variant of excess_kurtosis that reuses a pre-computed sum to avoid a second full pass for the mean — valid because kurtosis is scale-invariant.

nodes.name: KurtosisGate_should_speculate
nodes.summary: Computes excess kurtosis of softmax(logits) and returns true if it exceeds the configured threshold (concentrated → speculate).

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for katgpt-speculative — the shared speculative decoding + DDTree substrate extracted from katgpt-rs and riir-engine. Re-exports ~50 modules covering DDTree, dflash, NFCoT, fold, ppot, pruners, and verifiers.
nodes.languageNotes: Many modules are feature-gated (chain_fold, best_buddies, domino_correction, nf_flow_score, ppot, peira_distill, etc.) to mirror their historical root feature gates.

nodes.name: nf_flow.rs
nodes.summary: Modelless normalizing-flow density scoring over DDTree candidate trajectories — builds a diagonal affine flow from marginals and uses entropy-based log-determinant as an additive confidence bonus on top of base log-probability.
nodes.languageNotes: Flow score = base_logprob + Σ log(sigmoid(entropy_i)); high-entropy positions contribute ~0, low-entropy positions penalize. Branch-free inner loops for SIMD auto-vectorization.

nodes.name: NfFlowScore
nodes.summary: Stateful scorer wrapping the NF flow-density computation with a reusable scratch buffer; mirrors the free functions as methods for object-oriented use.

nodes.name: categorical_entropy
nodes.summary: Computes Shannon entropy H = −Σ p·ln(p) of a categorical distribution with branch-free inner loop and EPSILON guard against log(0).

nodes.name: flow_components
nodes.summary: Decomposes the flow score into (base_logprob, log_det) components — Σ log(marginal[selected]) and Σ log(sigmoid(entropy_i)).

nodes.name: score_with_qgf
nodes.summary: Adds an additive Q-gradient log-probability bonus to the base flow score — equivalent to scoring the QGF-tilted marginal with vanilla flow_score.

nodes.name: score_with_qgf_at
nodes.summary: Variant of score_with_qgf that applies the gradient bonus at a specific projection position rather than uniformly.

nodes.name: score_with_qgf_at_inner
nodes.summary: Hot-path inner loop shared by score_with_qgf_at — applies the gradient bonus at one position and computes the resulting flow score in place.

nodes.name: score_with_qgf_batch
nodes.summary: Batch variant of score_with_qgf — scores a Vec of candidate trajectories under the same gradient signal.

nodes.name: select_best_qgf
nodes.summary: Scores a batch of candidate trajectories with QGF augmentation and returns the index of the highest-scoring one.

nodes.name: select_best
nodes.summary: Vanilla best-trajectory selector — scores each candidate with flow_score and returns the index of the maximum.

nodes.name: nf_flow_budget.rs
nodes.summary: Allocates speculative depth budget proportional to NF flow scores using sigmoid weighting (not softmax, per project rules), with min-budget clamping and rescaling to preserve total budget.
nodes.languageNotes: Strict project rule: sigmoid weighting instead of softmax. Algorithm: w_i = σ(score_i − mean); budget_i = round(total·w_i/Σw) clamped to min_budget.

nodes.name: FlowBudgetAllocator
nodes.summary: Stateful allocator holding a min_budget floor and scratch buffer; wraps the free-function budget allocation API as methods.

nodes.name: normalize_budget
nodes.summary: Normalizes raw sigmoid-derived weights to sum exactly to total_budget while clamping each entry to a minimum — large rescaling loop that adjusts surplus/deficit.

nodes.name: allocate_budget_with_min
nodes.summary: Computes per-branch speculative depth budget = round(total·w_i/Σw) with each clamped to min_budget, returning a Vec<usize>.

nodes.name: FlowBudgetAllocator_allocate
nodes.summary: Method-form wrapper around allocate_budget_with_min using the FlowBudgetAllocator's stored min_budget.

nodes.name: nf_flow_fold.rs
nodes.summary: Confidence-gated bridge between NF FlowScore and ThoughtFold — accepts a chain fold only if flow_score(folded) ≥ α·flow_score(original), preventing ThoughtFold from discarding information-dense reasoning steps.

nodes.name: evaluate_fold
nodes.summary: Scores original vs folded chains with flow_score and returns FoldDecision::Accept if folded_score ≥ α·original_score, else Reject.

nodes.name: evaluate_fold_batch
nodes.summary: Batch variant of evaluate_fold — evaluates multiple folded candidates against one original chain, returning the best accepted one.

nodes.name: nf_flow_gate.rs
nodes.summary: Adaptive acceptance gate maintaining a sigmoid-bounded EMA of historical flow scores; accepts trajectories whose score exceeds the EMA threshold plus a configurable margin.
nodes.languageNotes: EMA adapts the acceptance bar over time; sigmoid bounding prevents NaN/Inf propagation from extreme flow scores.

nodes.name: NfFlowGate
nodes.summary: Adaptive acceptance gate holding EMA, sample count, smoothing α, margin, and optional fixed-threshold override; accepts trajectories whose score exceeds the EMA threshold.

nodes.name: NfFlowGate_accept
nodes.summary: Updates the EMA with a new score and returns true if the score exceeds (ema + margin) — the main accept/reject decision.

nodes.name: NfFlowGate_accept_batch
nodes.summary: Updates the EMA once with the mean of a batch of scores and returns the per-score accept decisions.

nodes.name: nf_flow_generator.rs
nodes.summary: Decorator wrapping any SpeculativeGenerator<TokenCondition,TokenOutput> to provide generate_scored() which re-ranks candidates by descending NF flow score while delegating vanilla generate()/generate_batch() to the inner generator.
nodes.languageNotes: Preserves trait compatibility — base generate()/generate_batch() delegate unchanged; flow scoring is opt-in via generate_scored().

nodes.name: FlowScoredGenerator
nodes.summary: Decorator wrapping an inner SpeculativeGenerator with an NfFlowScore; provides generate_scored() for re-ranked candidates while delegating vanilla generate() to the inner generator.

nodes.name: FlowScoredGenerator_generate_scored
nodes.summary: Generates multiple token candidates via the inner generator, scores each with NF flow density, and returns them sorted by descending flow score.

nodes.name: nf_flow_mux.rs
nodes.summary: Scores MUX vocabulary-superposition trajectories using NF flow density — discrete positions contribute standard log-prob, MUX-compressed positions contribute entropy of the superposition distribution.

nodes.name: score_mux_trajectory
nodes.summary: Scores a hybrid discrete+MUX trajectory — discrete positions contribute standard log-prob, MUX-superposition positions contribute superposition entropy.

nodes.name: aggregate_mux_score
nodes.summary: Aggregates a Vec<MuxFlowScore> into a single scalar trajectory score by summing densities with appropriate weighting.

nodes.name: nf_flow_qgf.rs
nodes.summary: Fusion of Q-gradient-guided drafting (QGF) with NF flow scoring — the drafter steers generation via the Q-critic gradient while the scorer ranks candidates by flow density augmented with the same Q-gradient signal.
nodes.languageNotes: Score synergy: QGF tilts the marginal before sampling; NFCoT then ranks the tilted candidates. Q-gradient applied as additive log-prob bonus at the projection position.

nodes.name: NfQgfDrafter
nodes.summary: Fusion struct pairing a Q-gradient-guided drafter with an NfFlowScore oracle; steers generation with QGF then ranks candidates by flow density.

nodes.name: NfQgfDrafter_generate_guided_scored
nodes.summary: Generates QGF-steered candidates and returns them sorted by NF flow density augmented with the Q-gradient signal — the core fusion hot path.

nodes.name: NfQgfDrafter_generate_guided_best
nodes.summary: Convenience wrapper around generate_guided_scored that returns only the highest-scoring candidate.

nodes.name: parallel_probe.rs
nodes.summary: Parallel-Probe 2D controller for training-free parallel reasoning — monitors N branches via periodic answer extraction, applies consensus-based early stopping and deviation-based branch pruning to cut sequential tokens ~30%.
nodes.languageNotes: Paper arXiv:2602.03845 defaults (probe_interval=500, stability_patience, prune_patience, warmup_steps). Consensus vote is O(N) per probe step — cheap global signal.

nodes.name: ParallelProbeConfig
nodes.summary: Copy-able config struct with paper-default probe_interval, stability_patience, prune_patience, warmup_steps, min_active_branches, and prune_vote_ratio.

nodes.name: ParallelProbeController
nodes.summary: Core controller holding per-branch state, config, consensus streak, and last consensus answer; runs probe/majority_vote/should_stop/should_prune per probe step.

nodes.name: ParallelProbeVerifier
nodes.summary: SpeculativeVerifier wrapper that drives ParallelProbeController during verification — extracts per-branch answers at probe intervals and returns ProbeDecision.

nodes.name: ParallelProbeConfig_validate
nodes.summary: Validates ParallelProbeConfig field bounds — probe_interval > 0, patience values ≥ 1, min_active_branches ≥ 1 — returning a Result with descriptive errors.

nodes.name: ProbingMatrix_push_step
nodes.summary: Records one probe step's per-branch answers into the ProbingMatrix ring buffer, evicting the oldest step when full.

nodes.name: ParallelProbeController_probe
nodes.summary: Single-probe pipeline: extract answers, compute majority vote, update consensus streak and per-branch disagree streaks, return ProbeDecision.

nodes.name: ParallelProbeController_majority_vote
nodes.summary: Computes the majority-vote answer across active branches at the latest probe step — O(N) string equality matching.

nodes.name: ParallelProbeController_should_stop
nodes.summary: Returns ProbeDecision::Stop or StopAndPrune once the consensus streak reaches stability_patience — skips during warmup.

nodes.name: ParallelProbeController_should_prune
nodes.summary: Identifies branches to prune: those disagreeing with the majority for prune_patience consecutive steps (after warmup, never below min_active_branches).

nodes.name: ParallelProbeVerifier_probe_branches
nodes.summary: SpeculativeVerifier trait method — extracts answers from each active branch's accumulated text and feeds them through the controller's probe pipeline.

nodes.name: ParallelProbeVerifier_speculate
nodes.summary: SpeculativeVerifier trait method — delegates draft-token speculation to the inner verifier while the probe controller observes outcomes.

nodes.name: ParallelProbeVerifier_new
nodes.summary: Constructor for ParallelProbeVerifier wrapping an inner verifier with n branches, a config, and an answer extractor closure.

nodes.name: pathway_tracker.rs
nodes.summary: Tracks sorted branch-selection patterns across consecutive inference steps in a fixed-capacity ring buffer and computes pathway stability as a sigmoid of the consecutive-match ratio — near 1.0 means converged fixed point.

nodes.name: PathwayTracker
nodes.summary: Ring-buffer tracker of sorted branch-selection patterns across consecutive inference steps; computes stability as a sigmoid of consecutive-match ratio.

nodes.name: PathwayTracker_update
nodes.summary: Records the sorted branch indices for the current step into the ring buffer, advancing the cursor and incrementing the step count.

nodes.name: PathwayTracker_stability
nodes.summary: Computes pathway stability as sigmoid(consecutive-match ratio) over the ring buffer — near 1.0 means converged fixed point, near 0.0 means unstable.

nodes.name: peira_pruner.rs
nodes.summary: Wraps any ScreeningPruner and modulates its relevance by PEIRA spectral alignment^α — high alignment passes the inner signal through, low alignment (early training) attenuates it to prevent untrusted noise contaminating the DDTree.
nodes.languageNotes: Formula: relevance_peira = inner_relevance × alignment^α. Hot-path cost ~2ns (one mul + one powf). Default α=0.5 (sqrt-like soft gating).

nodes.name: PeiraPruner
nodes.summary: Generic wrapper around any ScreeningPruner modulating relevance by PEIRA alignment^α — passes through when alignment is high, attenuates when low.

nodes.name: PeiraPruner_modulation_factor
nodes.summary: Returns alignment^α — the multiplicative relevance modulation applied to the inner pruner's score.

nodes.name: PeiraPruner_relevance
nodes.summary: ScreeningPruner trait impl — returns inner_relevance × alignment^α for the requested depth/token.

nodes.name: entropy.rs
nodes.summary: Computes per-position Shannon entropy over DFlash marginals and identifies high-entropy positions for CPU resampling, with adaptive variants that consult SessionKnowledge to skip known-bad regions.
nodes.languageNotes: Zero-allocation _into variants write into caller-provided buffers; entropy values optionally returned alongside positions to avoid recompute.

nodes.name: token_entropy
nodes.summary: Computes Shannon entropy H = −Σ p·ln(p) of a single token's probability distribution with EPSILON guard against log(0).

nodes.name: identify_high_entropy_positions_into
nodes.summary: Zero-alloc variant — writes positions whose entropy exceeds threshold into a caller-provided buffer instead of allocating a new Vec.

nodes.name: identify_high_entropy_positions_with_entropy_into
nodes.summary: Extended zero-alloc variant — writes both high-entropy positions and their entropy values into parallel caller-provided buffers.

nodes.name: identify_positions_by_rule_into
nodes.summary: Identifies high-entropy positions restricted to a TokenRule support set, writing into a caller-provided buffer — restricts resampling to digit/operator/etc tokens.

nodes.name: identify_positions_adaptive_into
nodes.summary: Adaptive variant — consults SessionKnowledge to skip known-bad positions and bias exploration toward historically successful ones.

nodes.name: identify_positions_adaptive_with_entropy_into
nodes.summary: Combined adaptive zero-alloc variant — writes both positions and entropy values, with SessionKnowledge-guided filtering.

nodes.name: knowledge.rs
nodes.summary: TRT-style rejection memory: records structured 'don't' insights from failed PPoT resampling attempts in a 64-entry ring buffer and biases future resampling away from known-bad tokens/positions — proves 'don'ts beat dos' at token level.
nodes.languageNotes: Ring buffer 64 × ~48 bytes = ~3KB per session; tracks per-rule success/fail counts and per-position stats for affinity queries.

nodes.name: SessionKnowledge
nodes.summary: TRT-style rejection memory — 64-entry ring buffer of RejectionInsight records with per-rule success/fail counts and per-position stats for adaptive rescue.

nodes.name: SessionKnowledge_new
nodes.summary: Constructor — allocates a SessionKnowledge with the given max_insights capacity and zeroes the per-rule/per-position counters.

nodes.name: SessionKnowledge_record
nodes.summary: Records a RejectionInsight into the ring buffer, incrementing per-rule fail counts and per-position rejection stats; evicts oldest when full.

nodes.name: SessionKnowledge_position_affinity
nodes.summary: Returns the rejection/acceptance affinity vector for a given position — used to bias resampling away from historically bad tokens.

nodes.name: SessionKnowledge_should_skip_position_with_threshold
nodes.summary: Decides whether to skip a position for resampling based on its rejection count exceeding a configurable threshold.

nodes.name: SessionKnowledge_preferred_rules
nodes.summary: Returns TokenRules ranked by historical success rate at a given position — guides which support set to try first.

nodes.name: SessionKnowledge_adaptive_threshold
nodes.summary: Computes an entropy threshold biased by recent rescue outcomes — lowers after failures, raises after successes (per PpotConfig knobs).

nodes.name: SessionKnowledge_insights
nodes.summary: Reads out the recorded RejectionInsight slice for inspection or serialization.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel for the PPoT (Probabilistic Programs of Thought) submodule — re-exports entropy identifiers, adaptive variants, SessionKnowledge, ranking selectors, and config types.

nodes.name: rank.rs
nodes.summary: Self-consistency ranking over multiple valid PPoT variants — selects the variant with highest agreement score against the others (correct solutions converge, incorrect ones disperse), with weighted and subset-filtered variants.
nodes.languageNotes: O(m²×L) for m variants of length L; chunked 4-at-a-time count_agreements for auto-vectorization; serial loop beats rayon for m≤16.

nodes.name: count_agreements
nodes.summary: Chunked 4-at-a-time token comparison between two variants — auto-vectorizable agreement count used by rank_by_consistency.

nodes.name: count_resampled_agreements
nodes.summary: Variant of count_agreements that skips positions also shared with a base path — counts agreements only at resampled positions.

nodes.name: compute_weighted_agreement_score
nodes.summary: Computes a position-weighted agreement score between variant i and the rest of the m variants — weights positions by their resampling relevance.

nodes.name: rank_by_consistency
nodes.summary: Ranks m valid variants by self-consistency agreement score — correct solutions converge, incorrect ones disperse.

nodes.name: rank_by_consistency_weighted
nodes.summary: Weighted variant of rank_by_consistency — uses compute_weighted_agreement_score to emphasize resampled positions.

nodes.name: select_best_variant
nodes.summary: Selects the single best variant by self-consistency agreement, validating each candidate against the ScreeningPruner.

nodes.name: select_best_variant_weighted
nodes.summary: Weighted variant of select_best_variant — uses position-weighted agreement scoring and pruner validation.

nodes.name: rank_by_consistency_subset
nodes.summary: Optimized rank_by_consistency operating on a subset of variant indices — used when only some variants need ranking.

nodes.name: rank_by_consistency_weighted_subset
nodes.summary: Optimized weighted ranker over a subset of variant indices.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: PPoT configuration and rule types — TokenRule enum (Digit/Compare/Arithmetic/Augment/All) defining constrained support sets for resampling, plus PpotConfig holding entropy thresholds, adaptive flags, and QMC settings.
nodes.languageNotes: TokenRule uses #[repr(u8)] for compact storage; support() builds heuristic vocab subsets for character-level tokenizers (BPE overrides via custom_support).

nodes.name: TokenRule
nodes.summary: Repr(u8) enum of constrained support sets for PPoT resampling — Digit, Compare, Arithmetic, Augment, All — with heuristic vocab subsets for character-level tokenizers.

nodes.name: PpotConfig
nodes.summary: Master PPoT configuration struct — entropy thresholds, num_samples, rule, adaptive knobs, max_insights, max_review_loops, QMC sub-config, and optional cached support.

nodes.name: TokenRule_support
nodes.summary: Builds the vocabulary support slice for a TokenRule at the given vocab_size — heuristic digit/operator/etc token-ID ranges for character-level tokenizers.

nodes.name: PpotConfig_default
nodes.summary: Default PpotConfig with conservative thresholds, adaptive enabled, char-level rule, and a sensible max_insights budget.

nodes.name: precision_aware_draft.rs
nodes.summary: Quantization-boundary-aware draft penalty scorer — penalizes draft tokens whose logits are close to quantization grid boundaries to improve acceptance rate, using precomputed invariants to remove per-logit divisions from the hot path.
nodes.languageNotes: BoundaryInvariants struct computed once per batch removes 1 division + 2 multiplications per logit; f32-only field order avoids padding.

nodes.name: BoundaryPenalty
nodes.summary: Copy-able penalty scorer — penalizes draft tokens whose logits are close to quantization grid boundaries to improve draft acceptance rate.

nodes.name: BoundaryPenalty_invariants
nodes.summary: Precomputes BoundaryInvariants (inv_scale, half_scale, near_threshold) once per batch to remove 1 division + 2 multiplications per logit from the hot path.

nodes.name: BoundaryPenalty_proximity_with
nodes.summary: Hot-path boundary-proximity computation using precomputed BoundaryInvariants — how close a logit is to the nearest quantization grid boundary.

nodes.name: BoundaryPenalty_compute_boundary_score
nodes.summary: Computes a per-token boundary score from a slice of logits using the precomputed invariants — aggregates proximity across the token's logit distribution.

nodes.name: BoundaryPenalty_apply_penalty
nodes.summary: Applies the boundary penalty in place to a mutable slice of draft scores using per-token logits and the configured penalty_weight.

nodes.name: precision_aware_generator.rs
nodes.summary: Generic wrapper that decorates any SpeculativeGenerator with a quantization BoundaryPenalty, exposing the penalty struct for caller-level score adjustment (Plan 227 Phase 4). The generate() path is currently pass-through; penalty is applied where raw logits are available.
nodes.languageNotes: Generic struct PrecisionAwareGenerator<G> with a blanket impl over G: SpeculativeGenerator, preserving the inner generator's Condition/Output/Error associated types.

nodes.name: prefill.rs
nodes.summary: PFlash-inspired speculative prefill: estimates per-token importance from the draft model's attention scores, then compresses the prompt to top keep_ratio spans before the target prefill. Hosts the PrefillScorer trait, substrate scorers, pure compression helpers, and the speculative_prefill* orchestrators.
nodes.languageNotes: Trait-based scorer abstraction (PrefillScorer) with trivial Random/Uniform substrate impls, mirroring the ConstraintPruner swap-point pattern.

nodes.name: prefix_scheduler.rs
nodes.summary: Hardware-aware multi-request verification budget allocator (DSpark §3.2.2). Builds an SPS (steps-per-second) curve from a hardware profile and globally distributes the verification budget across concurrent spec-decode requests to maximize throughput instead of wasting target compute on low-survival suffix tokens.
nodes.languageNotes: SpsCurve is built lazily via from_profile/constant with cumprod precomputation; HardwareAwarePrefixScheduler exposes schedule / schedule_from_token_probs / schedule_with_scratch variants.

nodes.name: residency_audit.rs
nodes.summary: Test-only residency audit for DDTree pruning paths (Plan 175). Analogous to ANE MLComputePlan, it verifies that pruning actually lands retained nodes on fast verification paths rather than silently falling back to slow paths while still producing valid trees. Zero runtime overhead; run in CI.

nodes.name: calibration.rs
nodes.summary: Offline per-head calibration for RTPurbo (arXiv 2605.16928). Runs one needle-based forward pass, computes a retrieval score per head from attention matrices, and partitions heads into a ~15% retrieval set and the local remainder. Result serializes to disk for reuse at inference time.
nodes.languageNotes: Three calibration entry points: calibrate_from_scores (naive O(n^2)), calibrate_from_causal_scores (causal-masked), and calibrate_from_adaptive_causal (feature-gated adaptive wrapper).

nodes.name: forward.rs
nodes.summary: Head-wise sparse decode/prefill integration for RTPurbo. Combines head calibration, low-dim projection, and dynamic top-p selection: local heads attend to a sink + local window while retrieval heads project pre-RoPE Q/K, select top-p positions, then run full-dim SDPA only on those indices. RtTurboCache caches selected_indices across decode steps.
nodes.languageNotes: Two entry points forward_rt_turbo_decode / forward_rt_turbo_prefill; RtTurboCache owns the per-head selected_indices scratch that updates each step.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: RTPurbo module barrel: declares the calibration, forward, projection, and top_p submodules (sat_retrieval gated behind cache_prune) and re-exports the public surface. Feature-gated by rt_turbo, requires dash_attn base; must pass 6/6 GOAT proofs before default-on promotion.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust module barrel using pub use re-exports with conditional compilation (#[cfg(feature=...)]) for opt-in components.

nodes.name: projection.rs
nodes.summary: Low-dimensional (16-dim) pre-RoPE projection for retrieval-head scoring (RTPurbo). Projects pre-RoPE query/key vectors into a low-dim space where high-frequency RoPE components become noise, capturing only the low-frequency signal retrieval heads actually use. Achieves >90% recall at 97% sparsity.
nodes.languageNotes: RetrievalProjection holds per-head W_Q/W_K slices; supports zeros/identity/xavier initializers and binary to_bytes/from_bytes serialization.

nodes.name: sat_retrieval.rs
nodes.summary: SAT (Summed-Area-Table) accelerated retrieval-head identification. Uses the cache_prune module's SummedAreaTable to compute per-head retrieval scores in O(1) per head after O(n^2) preprocessing, replacing the naive O(n^2) scan in calibration. Feature-gated behind both rt_turbo and cache_prune.

nodes.name: tests.rs
nodes.summary: Inline test suite for the RTPurbo submodule. Exercises calibration scoring, projection round-trips, top-p selection, and the integrated decode/prefill forward paths across 28 test functions.

nodes.name: top_p.rs
nodes.summary: Dynamic top-p (nucleus) token selection for RTPurbo sparse decode. Picks the smallest set of KV positions whose cumulative softmax mass exceeds top_p, adapting the selected-token count to the actual distribution shape. Provides both single-shot select_top_p and blockwise select_top_p_blockwise variants.

nodes.name: selectivity_router.rs
nodes.summary: Self-learning selectivity router for adaptive Chain-of-Thought (Plan 204, Research 180). Routes per-position between direct and CoT modes based on excess-kurtosis EMA tracking: high kurtosis (monosemantic, confident) -> direct; low kurtosis (polysemantic, uncertain) -> CoT. Routing improves automatically during serving with zero training.
nodes.languageNotes: SelectivityRouter exposes observe/should_think/kurtosis_at with serialize/deserialize for persistence; ComputeRoute enum distinguishes direct vs CoT paths.

nodes.name: spec_generator.rs
nodes.summary:
Token-domain SpeculativeGenerator implementation (Plan 193). Provides MarginalTokenGenerator (top-K marginal sampler implementing SpeculativeGenerator) and TokenConstraintPruner

, an adapter from ConstraintPruner to GenerativeConstraintPruner.

nodes.name: adaptive.rs
nodes.summary: Per-player adaptive threshold layer for the reconciliation engine. Wraps SpecReconciler with a two-armed (strict/lenient) bandit that learns, per player, the threshold minimizing false positives while still catching anomalies. Uses ThinkingBanditFrozen-style freeze/thaw for cross-session persistence.

nodes.name: manifold.rs
nodes.summary: Modelless plausibility-manifold generation: K forward-simulated trajectories from a known last-good state, each a sequence of TrajectoryPoint advanced by a physics-like step with Gaussian noise injection. Goal directions come from LEO Q-values or uniform random sampling. Defines the ManifoldGenerator trait and DefaultManifoldGenerator impl.

nodes.name: manifold_scorer.rs
nodes.summary: Soft scorer for the reconciliation engine (Plan 177, Task T4). Computes cosine similarity between an incoming client trajectory and the pre-generated plausibility manifold to produce a plausibility score used as the soft signal in the verdict pipeline.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Speculative Reconciliation Engine module barrel (feature-gated). Declares the adaptive, manifold, manifold_scorer, reconciler, reconciliation_pruner, and types submodules and re-exports the public surface. Pipeline: hard bounds -> manifold generation -> soft scoring -> verdict; fully modelless.

nodes.name: reconciler.rs
nodes.summary: SpecReconciler: the main entry point orchestrating the reconciliation pipeline (hard bounds -> manifold generation -> soft scoring -> verdict) for verifying offline game-state trajectories against a LEO-generated plausibility manifold.

nodes.name: reconciliation_pruner.rs
nodes.summary: Hard-bound ConstraintPruner for the reconciliation engine (Plan 177, Task T2). Enforces domain-specific validity checks (velocity bound, position bound, kill-rate Chebyshev bound) as hard constraints: a violation means the trajectory is physically impossible and is pruned immediately before any soft scoring.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Core types for the Speculative Reconciliation Engine: TrajectoryPoint (#[repr(C)], zero-heap, with position/velocity/direction accessors), ReconciliationVerdict (Accept/Quarantine/Uncertain), and ReconciliationConfig. All types are real-time-game-state-verification safe.
nodes.languageNotes: TrajectoryPoint uses #[repr(C)] for FFI/real-time safety with derived accessors (pos_x/vel_x/direction/speed/distance_to/delta_from).

nodes.name: thinking_controller.rs
nodes.summary: Adaptive Chain-of-Thought controller (Plan 194). Decides per-query whether to think (latent reasoning via RiM buffer slots) or answer directly. Learns from episode feedback via a bandit, auto-routes between CPU (PPoT resample) and GPU (full RiM decode) based on load, and persists learned weights via freeze/thaw dumps. Thinking is optional; when enabled it must improve outcomes.
nodes.languageNotes: ThinkingController composes ThinkingBandit (two-armed strict/direct), GpuLoadSignal, and ThinkingConfig; select_mode_with_rv takes a uniform RV for testability.

nodes.name: trust_region.rs
nodes.summary: Trust-Region Adaptive Speculation (TRAS, Plan 182 / Research 162). Extends speculative decoding with an adaptive verification window (high trust -> batch accept; low trust -> verify every token), TRB-style blend sampling on rejection (mu_beta = piS^(1-beta) * piT^beta), and trust-driven CPU/GPU routing hints.
nodes.languageNotes: TrustTracker/TrustRegionState maintain a running P_accept signal from the LeviathanVerifier; find_blend_beta solves the TRB mixing weight each step.

nodes.name: verifier_trait.rs
nodes.summary: SpeculativeVerifier trait: strategy-pattern swap point for verifying drafted tokens against a target distribution. Hosted in katgpt-speculative (not katgpt-core) because its signature references TransformerWeights, which sits above katgpt-core. Concrete impls (SimulatedVerifier, LeviathanVerifier) live in the root crate due to a forward-cycle dep.
nodes.languageNotes: pub trait SpeculativeVerifier: Send + Sync with a single speculate() method taking draft weights/config/token/pos/rng; the trait itself has zero forward deps so it lives below the forward-cycle.

nodes.name: vocab_coreset.rs
nodes.summary: DDTree Vocab Coreset (Research 161, Plan 181). Aggregates K+1 draft marginals into a vocab coreset that restricts DDTree expansion, reducing the branching factor from |V| to |coreset|. Also exposes should_use_delta_sparse to decide when a delta-sparse representation beats dense.

nodes.name: weaver.rs
nodes.summary: Weaver inference-only logit corrector (Issue 131). Mirrors riir-train-engine's Weaver adapter as a read-only inference module: loads trained weights from a safetensors checkpoint, runs the 7-step forward pass (conditioning -> causal MHA -> SwiGLU -> top-K gather -> residual add -> renormalize), and applies the residual correction to DFlash draft logits over the top-K candidate set.
nodes.languageNotes: WeaverCorrector::from_safetensors_bytes / from_checkpoint load read-only WeaverWeights; weaver_forward is the standalone 7-step function used by the corrector.

nodes.name: PrecisionAwareGenerator
nodes.summary: Generic wrapper struct PrecisionAwareGenerator<G> that decorates any SpeculativeGenerator with a BoundaryPenalty, carrying inner generator, penalty scorer, and an enabled flag.

nodes.name: PrefillScorer
nodes.summary: Trait abstracting per-token importance scoring for speculative prefill. Concrete substrate impls (RandomScorer, UniformScorer) provide baselines; production impls use attention-based scoring.

nodes.name: SpsCurve
nodes.summary: Steps-per-second curve built from a hardware profile or a constant, with cumprod precomputation used by the scheduler to map a global budget across requests.

nodes.name: HardwareAwarePrefixScheduler
nodes.summary: Multi-request verification budget allocator that uses an SpsCurve to globally distribute block lengths across concurrent spec-decode requests. Exposes schedule, schedule_from_token_probs, and schedule_with_scratch variants plus realized_theta introspection.

nodes.name: ResidencyReport
nodes.summary: Audit result struct capturing whether constraint/screening pruners and the baseline actually land retained nodes on fast verification paths. Carries the per-path residency counts consumed by audit_constraint_pruner / audit_screening_pruner / audit_baseline and is_degrading.

nodes.name: HeadClassification
nodes.summary: Per-head role assignment produced by calibration: which heads are retrieval heads and which are local, plus the retrieval score per head. Consumed by the forward path to route attention computation.

nodes.name: HeadCalibration
nodes.summary: Aggregate calibration state holding the HeadClassification plus per-head retrieval scores. Provides 13 accessor/utility methods (role_of, score_of, is_retrieval, n_retrieval, n_local, n_heads, all_local) and binary serialization (to_bytes/from_bytes/save/load/validate).

nodes.name: compute_retrieval_score
nodes.summary: Single-head retrieval score from an attention matrix: R_h = mean(attn from post-needle positions to pre-needle positions). Naive O(n^2) baseline; the sat_retrieval module provides an O(1)-per-head SAT variant.

nodes.name: calibrate_from_scores
nodes.summary: Entry point that takes per-head retrieval scores and partitions heads into the top ~15% retrieval set and the local remainder, producing a HeadCalibration.

nodes.name: RtTurboCache
nodes.summary: Per-step decode cache that persists the selected_indices chosen by top-p selection across decode steps, with new/decode/prefill/update_selected_indices methods. Avoids recomputing the sparse attention target set each step.

nodes.name: forward_rt_turbo_decode
nodes.summary: Decode-step entry point combining calibration, projection, and top-p selection: local heads attend to sink+window, retrieval heads project pre-RoPE Q/K, select top-p positions, then run full-dim SDPA on those indices.

nodes.name: RetrievalProjection

nodes.name: MarginalTokenGenerator

nodes.name: TokenConstraintPruner

nodes.name: DefaultManifoldGenerator

nodes.name: ManifoldScorer
nodes.summary: Soft scorer exposing new/set_manifold/score_against_manifold/score_trajectory. Computes cosine similarity between an incoming trajectory and the plausibility manifold to produce the soft signal for the verdict.

nodes.name: SpecReconciler

nodes.name: TrajectoryPoint

nodes.name: ReconciliationConfig

Composes a ThinkingBandit, GpuLoadSignal, and ThinkingConfig; exposes select_mode/record_reward/route_thinking/adaptive_budget/set_gpu_load/set_trust_signal plus freeze/save_bandit/load_bandit for persistence. select_mode_with_rv accepts a uniform RV for deterministic tests.

nodes.summary: Core routing forward: applies critical-entropy interval gate, RV threshold check, TVP tier decision, and lodestar budget before dispatching to GPU/CPU/ANE; updates all signal trackers.

nodes.name: dispatch_gpu_or_cpu
nodes.summary: Backend dispatch helper: tries GPU first, falls back to CPU if unavailable, updates last_backend and total_inferences.

nodes.name: stats
nodes.summary: Builds and returns a RouterStats snapshot of all current router signals.

nodes.name: forward_batch
nodes.summary: Batched forward: routes a slice of tokens through the chosen backend in one call and records all inferences.

nodes.name: generate_routed
nodes.summary: Token generation loop that routes every step through the router and accumulates the output token slice.

nodes.name: generate_validated
nodes.summary: Validated generation loop: drives a generator + pruner with a stopping condition, routing each step through the router.

nodes.name: observe_critical_entropy
nodes.summary: Updates the critical-entropy tracker with a new observation and recomputes the last_critical_entropy signal used by the G3 gate.

nodes.name: signal_recompile_for_tier
nodes.summary: Returns whether a tier upgrade should trigger a model recompile based on the current backend and target tier.

nodes.name: router_tests.rs
nodes.summary: Unit and integration tests for InferenceRouter, extracted from the inline `mod tests`. Covers CPU-only start, promotion/demotion under load, batched forward equivalence, breakeven bandit preference, critical-entropy deferral, and the G1-G5 TVP+RV ablation suite.

nodes.name: test_router_promotes_under_load
nodes.summary: Verifies the router promotes from CPU-only to a higher tier once inferred QPS crosses the trigger threshold.

nodes.name: test_router_falls_back_to_cpu_without_gpu
nodes.summary: Verifies the router transparently falls back to CPU when no GPU backend is available, even under load.

nodes.name: test_lodestar_route_hook_observe_and_query
nodes.summary: Tests the lodestar route hook: observe distance/budget then query lodestar_suggests_cpu.

nodes.name: test_breakeven_bandit_prefers_amortized
nodes.summary: Verifies the breakeven bandit prefers the amortized-cost arm once enough inferences have accumulated.

nodes.name: tvp_tier_decision_branches
nodes.summary: Exhaustive TVP tier-decision branch test covering all (RV, TVP) signal combinations and asserting the composed decision.

nodes.name: g4_tvp_plus_rv_strictly_dominates_either_alone
nodes.summary: G4 ablation: TVP+RV composed signal must dominate either signal alone across a simulated cascade of tier decisions.

nodes.name: router_tvp.rs
nodes.summary: Thicket Variance Probe (TVP) router-facing impl block on InferenceRouter (Plan 267). Pure mechanical extraction from inference_router.rs; gated on `thicket_variance_probe` and compiles to nothing when the feature is off (G3 zero-impact).
nodes.languageNotes: tier_to_kp maps the router's ComputeTier to the pruners-crate KpComputeTier; module is `#[cfg(feature = ...)]` so disabling the feature removes the whole impl block.

nodes.name: update_tvp
nodes.summary: Updates the TVP (Thicket Variance Probe) signal tracker from a new observation.

nodes.name: observe_tvp_decision
nodes.summary: Records the post-hoc TVP tier decision for offline analysis of TVP-vs-RV composition quality.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Root crate barrel: declares all root-resident modules (benchmark, dllm, inference_router, plot, pruners, sleep, speculative, transformer, types) and re-exports module-scoped leaf-crate surfaces under cfg feature gates.
nodes.languageNotes: Issue 125 removed 136 back-compat root re-export shims; remaining `pub mod X { pub use katgpt_Y::X::*; }` blocks provide the flat-import surface root modules need.

nodes.name: plot.rs
nodes.summary: Benchmark visualization with plotters SVG backend: horizontal bar charts of throughput/us-per-step, timeseries regression checking against CSV history, feature-grouped bar charts, and a feature radar plot.

nodes.name: TsRow
nodes.summary: Timeseries CSV row record: run_date, commit, features, category, method, feature_dim, throughput, us_per_step, avg_accept_len.

nodes.name: plot_results
nodes.summary: Plots a slice of BenchResults as a horizontal bar chart SVG with throughput and us/step annotations using the plotters SVG backend.

nodes.name: parse_timeseries_csv
nodes.summary: Parses a benchmark timeseries CSV file into a Vec<TsRow> for regression analysis.

nodes.name: plot_timeseries
nodes.summary: Plots a benchmark timeseries from a CSV path with regression lines, produces an SVG per category in the bench dir.

nodes.name: plot_feature_grouped
nodes.summary: Plots benchmark results grouped and colored by feature dimension as a grouped bar chart SVG.

nodes.name: plot_feature_radar
nodes.summary: Plots a radar chart SVG showing per-feature-dimension normalized benchmark scores.

nodes.name: arena.rs
nodes.summary: 13x13 Bomberman arena grid (Bevy ECS Resource): seed-driven generation with fixed pillars, randomized destructible walls, 3x3 spawn corners, walkability queries, respawn clearing, and from_cells/fixed templates for deterministic tests.
nodes.languageNotes: ArenaGrid derives bevy_ecs::prelude::Resource so it can be injected as a world resource; from_cells/fixed enable reproducible RL episode setups.

nodes.name: ArenaGrid
nodes.summary: 13x13 Bomberman arena grid as a Bevy ECS Resource. Owns cells[y][x], width, and height; provides generation, walkability, spawn, and respawn helpers.
nodes.languageNotes: Derives bevy_ecs::prelude::Resource so it can be injected as a world resource.

nodes.name: generate
nodes.summary: Seed-driven arena generator: border walls, fixed interior pillars at even (x,y), randomized destructible walls, and 3x3 clear spawn corners.

nodes.name: from_cells
nodes.summary: Constructs an ArenaGrid from an explicit cells template with full validation (dimensions, border walls, pillar pattern).

nodes.name: fixed
nodes.summary: Constructs an ArenaGrid from a string template (one row per line) for deterministic test/RL episode setups.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Root module of the Bomberman HL Arena — a 4-player bevy_ecs tournament testbed where each AI uses progressively heavier HL technology (bandit, absorb-compress, WASM, LoRA). Defines core ECS component types (Cell, Player, Bomb, PowerUp, GridPos, GameEvent), the BomberAction enum, and feature-gated re-exports of every player variant.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Cargo feature gates to conditionally compile each player variant (g_zero, sdpg_bandit, sdar_gate, rmsd_distill, ropd_rubric, sr2am_configurator, vpd_em_distill, bomber-wasm, event_log, skill_lifecycle, bomber-agent).

nodes.name: arena_runner.rs
nodes.summary: Library entry point for running N-game Bomberman tournaments between 4 players via bevy_ecs World, producing a MatchupResult suitable for leaderboard aggregation.

nodes.name: blend_context.rs
nodes.summary: Shared board-state feature extraction (compute_phi, sigmoid) producing the d=7 context vector consumed by all HLPlayer blend estimators. Extracted in Plan 436 to de-duplicate context computation across linear/binned/kernel estimators.

nodes.name: blend_estimators.rs
nodes.summary: Modelless nonlinear blend estimators (BinnedBlendEstimator + KernelBlendEstimator) that learn the context-to-Q mapping the linear contextual bandit could not — both are non-parametric online averagers with no offline training or backprop.
nodes.languageNotes: KernelBlendEstimator uses a Nadaraya-Watson weighted average over a ring buffer; BinnedBlendEstimator discretizes blast_proximity into 5 bins for O(1) lookup.

nodes.name: bomber_state.rs
nodes.summary: Lightweight Clone-able BomberState snapshot (~2KB) implementing the GameState trait — a deterministic forward model that sidesteps bevy_ecs::World (which is not Clone). Drives bomber_state-driven search, heuristic evaluate(), and BanditBomberHeuristic for bandit trials.

nodes.name: contextual_bandit.rs
nodes.summary: Linear per-arm contextual bandit (Q(a,s) = theta_a^T * phi(s)) for HLPlayer — an online LMS adaptive filter, not a trained network. No backprop, no softmax; exploration is epsilon-greedy and scoring uses sigmoid per project rule.
nodes.languageNotes: Update rule is error * phi outer product — equivalent to NLMS adaptive filter, deliberately not gradient descent on network weights.

nodes.name: event_log_player.rs
nodes.summary: Bomber-specific wrapper around the generic EventLog fork-diff infrastructure — records move/bomb/eval events as a type-safe event-sourced game trace with fork_at() and diff() for branching replays (Plan 124).

nodes.name: g_zero_player.rs
nodes.summary: G-Zero self-play bomber player using UCB1 template selection driven by Hint-delta intrinsic reward, with DeltaBanditPruner, DeltaGatedAbsorbCompress and cross-round action-level Q memory.

nodes.name: gate_player.rs
