nodes.summary: Bomber player backed by InferenceRouter — encodes heuristic game-state features as tokens, routes each forward pass through the TriggerGate QPS/latency tier system, and maps logits back to action scores. Proves the gate routing pipeline works inside the arena loop.

nodes.name: players.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the BomberPlayer trait and the canonical player ladder: RandomPlayer, GreedyPlayer, ValidatorPlayer, LoraPlayer, LoraWasmPlayer, NNPlayer, and the flagship HLPlayer (LoRA + WASM + Bandit + AbsorbCompress). Also hosts shared action-scoring helpers (score_action, is_safe_action, has_escape_route) reused by every variant player.

nodes.name: replay.rs
nodes.summary: Replay training-data pipeline — serializes per-tick game state (board, bombs, powerups, chosen action, danger level) to JSONL via ReplayWriter for downstream distillation and analysis.

nodes.name: replay_backward.rs
nodes.summary: GFlowNet-inspired backward policy extractor — walks winning replays backward through the action validator to learn which alternative actions were also safe, producing P_B(s'|s) data for backward policy training.

nodes.name: rmsd_player.rs
nodes.summary: RMSD-filtered bomber player — extends SdarPlayer with a two-step relevance mask (pre-filter actions by |Q_teacher - Q_student|, then apply SDAR sigmoid gating only to the top-S most informative actions) plus plateau-detecting TeacherContinuation.

nodes.name: BinnedBlendEstimator
nodes.summary: Non-parametric blend estimator that discretizes blast_proximity into 5 bins, each holding per-arm empirical Q averages for O(1) lookup. Captures the nonlinear step function the linear contextual bandit could not represent.

nodes.name: KernelBlendEstimator
nodes.summary: Nadaraya-Watson weighted average over a ring buffer of observed (context, arm, reward) triples — soft interpolation between contexts. Supports export_state/import_state for freeze/thaw.

nodes.name: BomberState
nodes.summary: Cloneable ~2KB snapshot of the full bomber game state (players, bombs, powerups, grid, tick) implementing the GameState trait. Drives the deterministic forward model used by heuristic search and bandit rollouts.

nodes.name: BanditBomberHeuristic
nodes.summary: StateHeuristic implementation that delegates evaluation to a shared BanditStats reference so bandit trial rollouts can observe heuristic signals during bomber_state-driven search.

nodes.name: ContextualBandit
nodes.summary: Linear per-arm contextual bandit (7 arms, d=7 context) using online LMS updates — a deterministic adaptive-filter primitive, not a trained network. Exposes predict, update, visits, q_report for HLPlayer integration.

nodes.name: BomberEventLog
nodes.summary: Bomber-typed wrapper around the generic EventLog — records move/bomb/eval/game-start/game-end events with fork_at() for branching replays and diff() against other logs to compute divergence points.

nodes.name: GZeroPlayer
nodes.summary: G-Zero self-play bomber player — UCB1 template proposer feeding DeltaBanditPruner and DeltaGatedAbsorbCompress, with freeze/thaw and per-round compress_cycle for cross-round Q memory.

nodes.name: GatePlayer
nodes.summary: Bomber player that routes every action-decision forward pass through the InferenceRouter / TriggerGate tier system, exercising QPS checks, tier promotion/demotion, and CPU fallback inside the arena loop.

nodes.name: BomberPlayer
nodes.summary: Trait every arena AI implements — select_action(), update_outcome(), compress_cycle(), freeze/thaw, plus shared action-history state. Defines the contract the tournament runner uses to drive any player variant.

nodes.name: RandomPlayer
nodes.summary: P1 baseline — picks a uniform-random valid action each tick. No model, no learning. Reference floor for arena tournaments.

nodes.name: GreedyPlayer
nodes.summary: P2 heuristic player — selects the action with the highest score_action() value each tick. No learning, pure greedy resource collection.

nodes.name: ValidatorPlayer
nodes.summary: P3 player wrapping Greedy with hard safety rules via is_safe_action() — vetoes moves that would land the player in a blast zone.

nodes.name: HLPlayer
nodes.summary: Flagship P5 player combining LoRA proposals, WASM safety validation, n-armed bandit arm selection, and AbsorbCompress cross-round memory. Demonstrates the full HL stack adapting online during arena play.

nodes.name: LoraPlayer
nodes.summary: P2b player that scores candidate actions via a LoRA-applied Transformer forward pass — proves a trained LoRA policy beats random in the arena.

nodes.name: LoraWasmPlayer
nodes.summary: P4 player combining LoRA proposal with WASM safety filtering — proves the synergy of learned policy + sandboxed validator beats either alone.

nodes.name: NNPlayer
nodes.summary: P3b player that runs native (non-LoRA) Transformer scoring with optional WASM safety check — baseline for the WASM validator contribution.

nodes.name: ReplaySample
nodes.summary: Serializable per-tick training record — board cells, player position, bombs, powerups, chosen action, danger level, and quality score. Feeds SDPG teacher-Q loading and distillation pipelines.

nodes.name: RmsdPlayer
nodes.summary: Player wrapping the RMSD relevance filter around SdarPlayer's sigmoid-gated bandit — pre-filters actions by teacher-student Q gap before applying SDAR gating.

nodes.name: run_bomber_game
nodes.summary: Runs a single full Bomberman game between 4 players via bevy_ecs World, ticking the deterministic game loop and returning a BomberRoundResult with placement and per-player stats.

nodes.name: run_bomber_matchup
nodes.summary: Runs a configured number of Bomber games and aggregates results into a MatchupResult suitable for leaderboard comparison.

nodes.name: compute_phi
nodes.summary: Extracts the 7-dimensional board-state context vector (blast-zone flag, proximities, wall density, bias) shared by every HLPlayer blend estimator.

nodes.name: process_explosions
nodes.summary: Advances the explosion phase of the deterministic forward model — chain reactions, wall destruction, player deaths, and power-up reveals for expired bombs.

nodes.name: score_action
nodes.summary: Core heuristic scoring function used by GreedyPlayer and as the baseline inside HLPlayer — aggregates escape, trap, intercept, bomb-placement and powerup signals into a scalar per-action score.

nodes.name: walk_backward
nodes.summary: Walks a single winning replay backward through is_safe_action(), recording per-tick chosen action plus the set of alternative safe actions for backward policy extraction.

nodes.name: rubric_player.rs
nodes.summary: ROPD Rubric-based bomber player — same architecture as GZeroPlayer but replaces scalar delta with a RubricVector multi-criteria reward feeding RubricBanditPruner and RubricGatedAbsorbCompress. Tests whether rubric vectors help in single-axis (survival) domains.

nodes.name: sdar_player.rs
nodes.summary: SDAR-gated bomber player — sigmoid-gated scalar reward replaces RubricVector. Same template-proposer skeleton as GZero/Rubric but with SdarBanditPruner and SdarGatedAbsorbCompress as the dense reward path.

nodes.name: sdpg_helpers.rs
nodes.summary: Bomber-specific SDPG helpers — load_teacher_q_from_replay() reads the bomber ReplaySample JSONL format and aggregates per-template teacher Q-values; SdpgBanditPrunerReplayExt exposes from_replay() on the SDPG bandit.

nodes.name: sdpg_player.rs
nodes.summary: SDPG Bandit bomber player — oracle-informed self-distilled policy gradient using SdpgBanditPruner's centered log-ratio advantage for dense per-arm credit assignment, with optional teacher-Q loading from replay.

nodes.name: skill_lifecycle_player.rs
nodes.summary: Wraps HLPlayer with the MUSE skill lifecycle pipeline — PrunerMemory records experiences, BomberTestGate validates at configurable intervals, SkillCatalog promotes validated skills, and a feedback loop adds confidence bonuses/penalties to action scoring.

nodes.name: sonlt_player.rs
nodes.summary: SON-LT (Sparse OPD-Native LoRA Training) arena player — loads a 6-adapter trained LoRA file and runs a full Transformer forward pass over the 169-cell board encoding to predict the next Bomberman action. Proves trained LoRA policy can drive the arena loop.

nodes.name: sr2am_player.rs
nodes.summary: SR^AM bomber player — extends GZeroPlayer with a ConfiguratorBandit that decides per-tick whether to do full template search (PlanNew), reuse last template (PlanExtend), or skip template entirely (PlanSkip), using Shannon entropy as the uncertainty context.

nodes.name: systems.rs
nodes.summary: bevy_ecs 0.15 World-based game systems — init_world/spawn_players/run_tick drive the deterministic tick loop (bomb fuses, explosions, player actions, power-up collection) without using an ECS schedule.

nodes.name: tft_player.rs
nodes.summary: Tit-for-Tat bomber player — Axelrod-style game-theory composite combining Nice (Greedy scorer), Retaliatory (HL attack when provoked), and Forgiving (auto-reset) via a 2-state FSM.

nodes.name: validator_agent.rs
nodes.summary: Coding-agent validator loop — TemplateProposer generates rule-AST ValidatorCandidate candidates, RulePlayer evaluates them in the arena, and AgentLoop runs the generate/evaluate/mutate cycle with convergence detection (Issue 052).

nodes.name: vpd_player.rs
nodes.summary: VPD EM-style bomber player — extends SdarPlayer with an explicit EM cycle: M-step every round does KL-gated distillation of teacher into student, E-step every F=5 rounds runs BCO unpaired-preference refinement of the teacher.

nodes.name: wasm_pruner.rs
nodes.summary: Sandboxed WASM bomber validator backed by wasmi with a papaya instance pool — batch_validate() serializes the grid once per tick and validates all player-by-action pairs in one FFI call (~14x faster per tick than v1). Fuel-limited, no WASI access.

nodes.name: RubricPlayer
nodes.summary: Player replacing scalar delta with a multi-criteria RubricVector reward — tests whether rubric scoring helps in single-axis (survival) domains.

nodes.name: SdarPlayer
nodes.summary: Player using SdarBanditPruner (sigmoid-gated scalar reward) and SdarGatedAbsorbCompress — the dense-reward counterpart to RubricPlayer's vector reward.

nodes.name: SdpgPlayer
nodes.summary: Player using SdpgBanditPruner's centered log-ratio advantage for dense per-arm credit assignment, with optional teacher-Q initialization from replay.

nodes.name: SkillLifecyclePlayer
nodes.summary: Wraps HLPlayer with the MUSE skill lifecycle — PrunerMemory recording, BomberTestGate validation, SkillCatalog promotion, and a feedback loop that adjusts action scoring based on per-arm skill status.

nodes.name: SonltPlayer
nodes.summary: Loads a SON-LT trained 6-adapter LoRA file and runs a Transformer forward pass over the 169-cell board encoding to predict the next action — proves a fully trained policy can drive the arena loop.

nodes.name: Sr2amPlayer
nodes.summary: Extends GZeroPlayer with a ConfiguratorBandit that regulates per-tick planning effort (PlanNew / PlanExtend / PlanSkip) using Shannon entropy as the uncertainty context.

nodes.name: TftPlayer
nodes.summary: Axelrod Tit-for-Tat composite — Nice (Greedy) by default, Retaliatory (HL attack) when provoked by a nearby hostile bomb, Forgiving (auto-reset) after a configurable duration.

nodes.name: AgentLoop
nodes.summary: Generate/evaluate/mutate outer loop — TemplateProposer produces candidates, RulePlayer evaluates them in the arena, results feed back into the proposer until convergence or max_generations.

nodes.name: VpdPlayer
nodes.summary: Extends SdarPlayer with an explicit EM cycle — M-step does KL-gated teacher-to-student distillation each round, E-step runs BCO unpaired-preference teacher refinement every F=5 rounds.

nodes.name: BomberWasmPruner
nodes.summary: Sandboxed wasmi-backed validator with a papaya instance pool — batch_validate() and batch_relevance() serialize state once per tick and validate all player-action pairs in a single FFI call.

nodes.name: run_tick
nodes.summary: Deterministic per-tick ECS advancement — processes bomb fuses, explosions, player actions, and powerup collection in fixed order on &mut World (no ECS schedule).

nodes.name: init_world
nodes.summary: Constructs the initial bevy_ecs World for a bomber game — spawns the arena grid, destructible walls, power-ups, and the 4 player entities at standard spawn positions.

nodes.name: load_teacher_q_from_replay
nodes.summary: Reads a bomber ReplaySample JSONL file and aggregates per-template quality scores into a teacher_q vector for seeding SdpgBanditPruner.

nodes.name: wasm_state.rs
nodes.summary: Zero-copy serializer that encodes Bomberman game state (grid, player position, bombs) into a flat token buffer for WASM/NN-player inference input. Backed by a reusable ZeroCopyStateBuffer to avoid per-tick allocation.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses manual byte-buffer packing instead of serde for deterministic WASM ABI compatibility; falls back to Default trait for empty buffer initialization.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Back-compat shim for the pruners module: blanket re-exports katgpt_pruners and conditionally re-exports the bomber submodule (which stays root-resident due to main-crate dependencies).
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy use of feature-gated `pub use` (`#[cfg(feature = "bomber")]`, `#[cfg(all(feature = "game_state", feature = "bomber"))]`) to keep optional game-state types out of the default build.

nodes.name: consolidation.rs
nodes.summary: Implements offline sleep-time memory consolidation: when the KV cache fills, runs N recurrent GDN2 passes to bake context into fast weights, then evicts. Preserves single-pass wake-time latency for real-time constraints.
nodes.languageNotes: Separates wake-time single-pass inference from eviction-time multi-pass consolidation, mirroring the LT2/AutoDreamer architectural pattern.

nodes.name: eviction.rs
nodes.summary: KV cache eviction strategies (hard-evict and sliding-window) applied after sleep consolidation completes. The evict() dispatcher selects strategy at runtime.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel for sleep consolidation (Plan 154), re-exporting consolidation, eviction, and types submodules. Documents the wake-time vs sleep-time pass split.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Defines SleepConfig (sleep-pass count + window size) and the EvictionStrategy enum (HardEvict / SlidingWindow{retain}) that parameterize the sleep consolidation pipeline.
nodes.languageNotes: EvictionStrategy::SlidingWindow carries an inline `retain: usize` field, demonstrating Rust's tagged-enum payload pattern for strategy configuration.

nodes.name: sp_kv_forward_mod.rs
nodes.summary: Sparse/paged KV-cache forward kernels: attention_head_core/gated SDPA loops, gate-bias construction from head utilities, and the large forward_sp_kv / forward_sp_kv_quant drivers that orchestrate sparse-pruned attention with optional quantization.
nodes.languageNotes: Defines the BiasProvider trait with NoBias / GateBias implementations — a classic Rust strategy pattern for swappable attention bias sources.

nodes.name: d2f.rs
nodes.summary: Thin re-export shim preserving the historical `crate::speculative::d2f::*` path after the D2F (Discrete Diffusion Forcing) production code moved to the katgpt-forward crate; retains 2 train-coupled tests.

nodes.name: d2f_verifier.rs
nodes.summary: Re-export shim for the D2fDrafterVerifier after it moved to katgpt-forward. Single-line glob re-export preserving the historical import path.

nodes.name: dd_tree.rs
nodes.summary: Re-export shim for the Decision-Diffusion Tree (DDTree) speculative-decoding module; re-exports katgpt-forward::dd_tree plus two feature-gated schedule wrappers (gdsd_distill, thinking_prune).

nodes.name: diffusion_sampler.rs
nodes.summary: Hosts train_logistic_on_patterns, a research harness that trains a logistic sampler head over dllm-generated pattern data and evaluates it as a DiffusionSampler — the one root-resident piece bridging training and the diffusion-sampler inference API.

nodes.name: flashar_anchor.rs
nodes.summary: Re-export shim for FlashAR strided anchor-then-fill D2F decoding (moved to katgpt-forward); re-exports AnchorConfig / AnchorFillResult / anchor_then_fill and retains 2 train-coupled tests.

nodes.name: ZeroCopyStateBuffer
nodes.summary: Reusable byte buffer wrapper exposing serialize/serialize_grid/as_bytes/default for zero-allocation game-state encoding.

nodes.name: serialize_game_state
nodes.summary: Encodes grid + player position/id + bomb list into a freshly allocated token buffer for NN-player input.

nodes.name: serialize_into_buffer
nodes.summary: Writes the full game state into a caller-provided buffer, avoiding allocation on the hot per-tick path.

nodes.name: serialize_grid_only
nodes.summary: Encodes only the grid and active bombs into a buffer, omitting player state, for partial-context inference.

nodes.name: consolidation_pass
nodes.summary: Runs one recurrent GDN2 consolidation pass over the filled KV cache region, baking context into fast weights with optional k-normalization.

nodes.name: sleep
nodes.summary: Top-level sleep entrypoint: runs N consolidation passes then triggers eviction per the SleepConfig.

nodes.name: evict
nodes.summary: Dispatches KV-cache eviction to the configured strategy (HardEvict or SlidingWindow).

nodes.name: sliding_window_evict
nodes.summary: Retains the most recent `retain` tokens and evicts older entries, shifting survivors to low positions for positional continuity.

nodes.name: EvictionStrategy
nodes.summary: Tagged enum selecting HardEvict (clear everything) or SlidingWindow{retain} (keep recent tokens) after sleep consolidation.

nodes.name: SleepConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration struct holding sleep_passes count, window_size, and eviction strategy, with should_sleep position check.

nodes.name: SpKvForwardContext
nodes.summary: Holds scratch buffers (gate_bias, predictor, head utilities, flat keys/values) needed by the sparse-pruned KV forward kernels.

nodes.name: BiasProvider
nodes.summary: Strategy trait supplying per-head attention bias and a may_prune hint; implemented by NoBias and GateBias.

nodes.name: attention_head_core
nodes.summary: Core SDPA loop for one attention head: computes Q-K scores, softmax, and value weighted sum into attn_out, with optional bias injection.

nodes.name: attention_head_gated
nodes.summary: Gated variant of attention_head_core that applies a per-source gate_bias before softmax, enabling sigmoid-gated latent steering.

nodes.name: build_gate_biases
nodes.summary: Constructs per-source gate bias values from head utilities, retained mask, position window, and threshold for a given gating mode.

nodes.name: forward_sp_kv
nodes.summary: Top-level sparse-pruned KV forward driver: runs per-layer attention with BiasProvider gating, LoRA adapters, and domain-latent steering for one decoding step.

nodes.name: forward_sp_kv_quant
nodes.summary: Quantized-cache variant of forward_sp_kv: dequantizes K/V on the fly from a QuantizedKVCache-backed predictor buffer to halve memory bandwidth.

nodes.name: train_logistic_on_patterns
nodes.summary: Research harness: trains a mini dllm model on pattern data, fits a logistic sampler head, and evaluates sampler accuracy as a DiffusionSampler.

nodes.name: flashar_consensus.rs
nodes.summary: Re-export shim for FlashAR Consensus tri-mode verifier with ternary thermal paths; re-exports ConsensusConfig, FlashARConsensusVerifier, compute_ternary_consensus and routing helpers from katgpt-forward.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Top-level barrel for the speculative-decoding subsystem: aggregates katgpt-speculative, katgpt-forward, and katgpt-pruners re-exports, declares root-resident modules (dd_tree, prefill, step_paged, step_gdn_tree, types), and wires feature-gated drafter/verifier paths.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy `#[cfg(feature = ...)]` gating (belief_drafter, domino_correction, echo_env_predictor, gdn_tree_verify, plasma_path, etc.) reflects the many experimental speculative-decoding variants.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: PPoT (Probabilistic Programs of Thought) module barrel: documents the CPU-only rescue path for rejected DDTree branches and re-exports entropy/knowledge/rank/types helpers from katgpt-speculative while keeping resample root-resident.
nodes.languageNotes: Architecture comment documents a two-layer design: Plan 026 baseline rescue vs Plan 027 adaptive rescue with rejection memory and self-consistency ranking.

nodes.name: resample.rs
nodes.summary: Implements PPoT resampling primitives and rescue strategies: support-bounded sampling, different-value sampling, QMC variants, multi-strategy sampling, and adaptive/reviewed rescue with rejection memory. CPU-only fallback when DDTree verification rejects all branches.
nodes.languageNotes: Provides both standard RNG sampling and Quasi-Monte Carlo (Sobol-style `u`) variants of every primitive — pairs naturally with the knowledge/rank helpers re-exported via ppot/mod.rs.

nodes.name: prefill.rs
nodes.summary: Root-resident complement to katgpt-forward::prefill: re-exports the prefill scorers (Attention/BlockAttention/Random/Uniform) and retains block_select_entmax (alpha-entmax adaptive block selection) because its katgpt-attn dependency would create a cycle if moved.

nodes.name: set_diffusion.rs
nodes.summary: Re-export shim for the Set Diffusion inference decoder (Research 376 Phase 4); re-exports katgpt-forward::set_diffusion and retains TRAIN-only tests that depend on root-local dllm training code.

nodes.name: step_gdn_tree.rs
nodes.summary: Implements speculative_step_gdn_tree — a speculative-decoding step for pure-GDN2 models that drafts a tree, verifies against the target model, and commits the accepted path sequentially (Plan 424 T4.3).

nodes.name: step_paged.rs
nodes.summary: Deprecated paged speculative-decoding step: speculative_step_rollback_paged drafts with the draft model, verifies against the target, and performs snapshot/rollback against a paged KV cache when branches diverge.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Speculative-decoding root types: re-exports substrate types (TreeNode, DraftResult, configs, pruner traits) from katgpt-core and defines root-only composition types DDTreeBranchCache (paged branch fork/rollback) and SelfSpecConfig.

nodes.name: tf_loop.rs
nodes.summary: Training-free loop wrapper: re-exports the moved substrate from katgpt-transformer::tf_loop and retains should_apply_pruner_at_iteration (kept root-side to avoid a katgpt-pruners -> katgpt-transformer -> katgpt-pruners dependency cycle).
nodes.languageNotes: Illustrates the cycle-avoidance pattern: a thin retained fn prevents a reverse dependency between two crates that already have a one-way edge.

nodes.name: transformer.rs
nodes.summary: Central root-side transformer module: re-exports substrate types (TransformerWeights, KVCache, MultiLayerKVCache, PagedKVCache, RavenKVCache, PrefillContext) from katgpt-transformer and hosts the many forward-pass variants (batched, looped, prefill, paged, raven, quantized, turboquant) plus generation helpers and depth-routing utilities.
nodes.languageNotes: Single 5.6k-LOC file concentrates every inference-path variant — RiM reasoning slots, LT2 wake-time looping, RAVEN retrieval-augmented cache, training-free ODE loops, and collapse-detecting generation — behind feature gates.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Root types module: re-exports shared types (Config, Rng, math utils, LoRA, DomainLatent) from katgpt-core and defines root-only items — the CompactableKVCache extension trait, AsymmetricKVConfig, and top_p_coreset selection helper.

nodes.name: ppot_resample
nodes.summary: Baseline PPoT rescue: resamples tokens at high-entropy positions in a base path using provided marginals and an RNG.

nodes.name: ppot_resample_with_support
nodes.summary: Resamples at specified positions restricted to a caller-provided support set, narrowing the variant space.

nodes.name: ppot_resample_different_value
nodes.summary: Resamples guaranteeing a different token than the original at each targeted position — forces exploration away from the rejected draft.

nodes.name: ppot_resample_multi_strategy
nodes.summary: Generates `count` variant paths using a configurable mix of resampling strategies with a preferred-token bias.

nodes.name: ppot_rescue
nodes.summary: Plan 026 baseline rescue: when DDTree verification rejects all branches, attempts resampled paths and screens them via the ScreeningPruner until one is valid.

nodes.name: ppot_rescue_adaptive
nodes.summary: Plan 027 adaptive rescue: uses rejection memory and self-consistency ranking (TRT-inspired) to cycle strategies and rank candidate paths by mutual agreement.

nodes.name: ppot_rescue_reviewed
nodes.summary: Reviewed rescue variant that records per-resample metrics (entropy, rank, acceptance) into a shared metrics struct for offline analysis.

nodes.name: block_select_entmax
nodes.summary: Adaptive prompt-block selection using alpha-entmax sparsification (Plan 106 T20); picks which prompt blocks to retain based on entmax-softmax support.

nodes.name: speculative_step_gdn_tree
nodes.summary: Speculative-decoding step for pure-GDN2 models: drafts a GDN tree from the drafter, verifies each candidate against the target forward, and returns the accepted token path.

nodes.name: commit_accepted_path_sequential
nodes.summary: Sequentially replays the accepted token path through the target forward to update its KV cache consistently after verification.

nodes.name: speculative_step_rollback_paged
nodes.summary: Deprecated paged speculative step: drafts from the draft model, verifies against the target, and performs snapshot/rollback on a paged KV cache when branches diverge.

nodes.name: DDTreeBranchCache
nodes.summary: Paged KV cache wrapper that supports branch fork/forward/rollback/discard for speculative-decoding tree exploration.

nodes.name: SelfSpecConfig
nodes.summary: Composition config bundling draft_width, D2fDecodeConfig, and DiffusionSampler for self-speculative decoding.

nodes.name: should_apply_pruner_at_iteration
nodes.summary: Thin wrapper over PrunerSchedule::should_screen_full deciding whether to apply full screening at a given training-free loop iteration.

nodes.name: forward_batched
nodes.summary: Batched forward pass over a token slice with position offset, used for parallel prefill or batch decoding.

nodes.name: forward_looped
nodes.summary: LT2 wake-time multi-pass forward with elastic loop override, residual/SDPA gating, GDN2 fast weights, sleep config, recursion gate, and halter-based early exit.

nodes.name: forward_training_free_loop
nodes.summary: Training-free (no-backprop) iterative refinement loop that re-uses cached activations across K sub-steps per ODE-style anchor blending.

nodes.name: forward_single_layer
nodes.summary: Computes one transformer layer (QKV projection, SDPA, FFN, residual) for a single token at a given position.

nodes.name: depth_route
nodes.summary: Depth-routing mixer: combines multi-source residuals via a query/norm-weighted softmax over sources, writing logits and scaled buffers.

nodes.name: forward_prefill
nodes.summary: Prefill forward pass that consumes a PrefillContext (compressed prompt blocks) and populates the KV cache with LoRA and domain-latent adaptation.

nodes.name: generate_with_prefill
nodes.summary: End-to-end generation: runs prefill on prompt tokens then decodes up to max_gen_tokens, applying optional LoRA pair and domain latent.

nodes.name: generate_with_collapse_detection
nodes.summary: Generation loop with a collapse detector that halts early when outputs degenerate (e.g. repetition, NaN), wired to a thinking-end token signal.

nodes.name: forward_paged
nodes.summary: Paged-KV-cache forward for one token at a given sequence index, used by speculative branching with snapshot/rollback.

nodes.name: generate_into
nodes.summary: Generates n_tokens into a caller-provided cache, reusing cache state across calls for streaming generation.

nodes.name: raven_compute_router_into
nodes.summary: Computes the RAVEN retrieval router weights (top-k softmax over raw logits) into a caller-provided buffer.

nodes.name: raven_update
nodes.summary: Updates the RAVEN retrieval-augmented KV slots with a new key/value pair using a forget-rate blend.

nodes.name: raven_readout_into
nodes.summary: Reads out the RAVEN retrieval slots via query-key softmax over stored slots, writing the weighted value sum into a provided buffer.

nodes.name: forward_raven
nodes.summary: Full forward step with RAVEN retrieval-augmented attention: updates and reads from retrieval slots in addition to standard KV cache.

nodes.name: forward_quantized
nodes.summary: Forward step using a quantized KV cache: dequantizes K/V on access to halve memory bandwidth at the cost of dequant arithmetic.

nodes.name: CompactableKVCache
nodes.summary: Extension trait adding optional compact_into(budget, strategy) to QuantizedKVCache; default impl returns Err so every cache is soundly default-impl-able.

nodes.name: AsymmetricKVConfig
nodes.summary: Config for asymmetric K/V bit-width quantization with symmetric convenience constructor and compression-ratio reporting.

nodes.name: top_p_coreset
nodes.summary: Selects a coreset of indices whose cumulative probability mass reaches top-p, using caller-provided scratch buffers (zero-allocation).

nodes.name: top_p_coreset_allocating
nodes.summary: Convenience wrapper around top_p_coreset that allocates its own scratch buffers for one-off callers.

nodes.name: beta_fitter.rs
nodes.summary: Fits the per-token additive attention bias β via nonnegative least squares (projected gradient descent with Cholesky-based gradient estimation), recovering optimal biases that minimize attention mass error during KV cache compaction.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses power iteration to estimate the spectral norm for projected-gradient step sizing, and an 8-wide SIMD dot product (dot_8wide) for the inner gradient products.

nodes.name: fit_beta_nnls
nodes.summary: Solves the constrained NNLS problem for β via projected gradient descent, iterating between gradient computation (with Cholesky factorization), weight clamping to [w_lower, w_upper], and spectral-norm-scaled step updates.

nodes.name: finalize
nodes.summary: Converts the optimized weight vector w into β = ln(w), computes residual norms, and assembles the BetaFitResult with relative error for downstream reporting.

nodes.name: cholesky_decompose
nodes.summary: Performs a Cholesky factorization of a symmetric positive-definite submatrix of A^T A used to precondition the NNLS gradient step.

nodes.name: estimate_spectral_norm_squared
nodes.summary: Estimates the squared spectral norm of the NNLS Hessian via power iteration, providing the Lipschitz constant used to scale gradient-descent steps.

nodes.name: chunked.rs
nodes.summary: Splits long KV caches into overlapping chunks, runs the per-chunk AM compactor, concatenates the results, and uses a RoPE position-free bridge to keep key positions consistent across chunk boundaries.
nodes.languageNotes: Bridges f32 key tensors through a half-precision (f16) PositionFreeCompactor in katgpt_kv::still_kv to neutralize RoPE phase shifts at chunk boundaries.

nodes.name: compact_kv_based
nodes.summary: Chunks a flat KV cache by stride/overlap, invokes the per-chunk compactor with a locally adjusted config, and concatenates compact keys, values, and β into a single ChunkedCompactOutput.

nodes.name: compact_text_based
nodes.summary: Compacts caller-supplied text chunks (TextChunk with pre-split keys/values/queries), un-rotating and re-rotating RoPE phases around the per-chunk compactor call to preserve positional consistency.

nodes.name: apply_rope_phase_shift
nodes.summary: Convenience helper that rewrites RoPE positions on a key tensor in-place by composing un-rotation at start_pos with re-rotation at new_pos.

nodes.name: chunk_starts
nodes.summary: Computes the list of chunk start offsets given total length, chunk size, and stride, clamping the final chunk to the array bound.

nodes.name: infer_d
nodes.summary: Infers the head dimension d from the first non-empty chunk's key length, returning a DimensionMismatch error when chunks disagree or are all empty.

nodes.name: ChunkedCompactor
nodes.summary: Stateful compaction driver holding chunk_size and overlap, exposing compact_kv_based and compact_text_based entry points.

nodes.name: compact.rs
nodes.summary: Top-level Attention-Matching compaction pipeline: validates config, selects compact keys (HighestAttn or OMP), fits β via NNLS, fits Cv via Cholesky least-squares, dispatches score-matrix backends through SolverRouter, and builds a reconstruction report.
nodes.languageNotes: The compact() entry point is a thin wrapper that constructs a default SolverRouter and forwards to compact_with_router(); dispatch_score_matrix picks CPU-scalar / Rayon / GPU based on the router verdict.

nodes.name: compact
nodes.summary: Convenience entry point that runs the AM pipeline with a default SolverRouter and GPU flag disabled, returning the populated CompactOutput.

nodes.name: compact_with_router
nodes.summary: Full AM pipeline: validates inputs and config, runs the chosen key selector, computes per-token β via NNLS, fits Cv via least-squares, and emits a RouterTrace capturing which score-matrix backend was used.

nodes.name: dispatch_score_matrix
nodes.summary: Backend dispatcher: selects compute_score_matrix (scalar), compute_score_matrix_rayon, or the GPU stub based on the SolverBackend verdict, falling back to Rayon on GPU failure.

nodes.name: build_reconstruction_report
nodes.summary: Computes the per-query relative attention-output error and attention-mass error between the selected compact block and the full KV cache, packaging them into a ReconstructionReport.

nodes.name: CompactError
nodes.summary: Error enum returned by the AM pipeline, covering invalid configuration (InvalidConfig) and shape mismatches between K/V/Q (DimensionMismatch).

nodes.name: compact_fixed_beta.rs
nodes.summary: Fast-path AM compaction that skips NNLS and uses a caller-supplied constant β (typically BETA_MID), trading reconstruction fidelity for substantially lower latency on small/short caches.

nodes.name: compact_with_fixed_beta
nodes.summary: Runs the AM pipeline with a fixed β scalar: validates inputs, selects compact keys, computes attention with the constant bias, fits Cv via least-squares, and builds a reconstruction report.

nodes.name: curve.rs
nodes.summary: Defines HeadSensitivityCurve — a per-head piecewise-linear sensitivity function ΔQ(r) that supports interpolation, marginal-gain queries, and monotonicity validation used by the budget solver.

nodes.name: interpolate
nodes.summary: Linearly interpolates (or flat-extrapolates) the sensitivity curve at an arbitrary ratio in [0, 1], returning ΔQ at that budget fraction.

nodes.name: marginal_gain
nodes.summary: Returns the marginal quality gain of stepping from r_from by step — the derivative signal consumed by the greedy-swap solver.

nodes.name: HeadSensitivityCurve
nodes.summary: Immutable per-head sensitivity descriptor: sorted ratio knots, matching ΔQ values, and the head identifier; enforces sorted, equal-length, non-empty inputs in its constructor.

nodes.name: measure.rs
nodes.summary: Placeholder sensitivity-measurement routine that synthesizes HeadSensitivityCurve entries via a deterministic closed-form delta function; the real measurement implementation lives in the riir-ai repo.
nodes.languageNotes: Synthetic delta uses a power-law (1-r)^1.5 decay scaled per head parity, so even heads are more sensitive than odd — useful for solver testing.

nodes.name: measure_sensitivity_stub
nodes.summary: Builds one HeadSensitivityCurve per head by evaluating synthetic_delta over STUB_RATIOS, returning a Vec ready for the HeadBudgetSolver.

nodes.name: synthetic_delta
nodes.summary: Deterministic synthetic ΔQ(head_id, r) used by the measurement stub, returning a power-law decay clamped to [0, 0.8] with zero delta at r=1.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel for the head_budget submodule, re-exporting HeadSensitivityCurve, HeadBudgetSolver, HeadBudgetSchedule, and the sensitivity measurement stub.

nodes.name: schedule.rs
nodes.summary: Tamper-evident HeadBudgetSchedule carrier: serializes per-head budget shares to postcard, hashes (model_id, shares) with BLAKE3, and verifies integrity on deserialization.
nodes.languageNotes: f32 shares are hashed in little-endian byte form for cross-platform determinism; version field is intentionally excluded from the hash so schedule bumps don't invalidate prior hashes.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a HeadBudgetSchedule from model_id and shares, computing the BLAKE3 integrity hash at creation time.

nodes.name: verify
nodes.summary: Recomputes the BLAKE3 hash over (model_id, shares) and returns whether it matches the stored hash, detecting any post-construction tampering.

nodes.name: compute_hash
nodes.summary: BLAKE3-hashes the model_id bytes concatenated with the little-endian bytes of each f32 share, producing the deterministic integrity tag.

nodes.name: HeadBudgetSchedule
nodes.summary: Carries per-head budget shares alongside a model identifier, version, and BLAKE3 hash; serializes to/from postcard bytes for distribution.

nodes.name: solver.rs
nodes.summary: Greedy-swap HeadBudgetSolver: given per-head sensitivity curves and a target global ratio, redistributes discrete budget shares to minimize total quality loss using marginal-gain comparisons.

nodes.name: solve
nodes.summary: Greedy swap iteration that, at each step, finds the head with the largest marginal gain from receiving a share and the head with the smallest marginal loss from giving one, then transfers a step_size share when the net gain is positive; terminates at local optimality.

nodes.name: total_quality_loss
nodes.summary: Sums the interpolated ΔQ across all heads at their current ratios, yielding the total quality loss for a candidate allocation.

nodes.name: is_locally_optimal
nodes.summary: Returns true when no single step-size swap between any pair of heads can improve total quality — the convergence test for the greedy solver.

nodes.name: HeadBudgetSolver
nodes.summary: Holds per-head sensitivity curves, layer/head counts, and the step size for the greedy-swap budget allocator.

nodes.name: highest_attn.rs
nodes.summary: Fast key selector that ranks original K tokens by aggregated attention score (mean/RMS/max across reference queries) and returns the top-t as the compact key set Ck.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses select_nth_unstable_by for O(n) top-t selection followed by a small sort of just the selected prefix — avoids a full sort of all candidate indices.

nodes.name: select_highest_attn_keys
nodes.summary: Computes per-key aggregated attention score (Mean, RMS, or Max over Qref), then returns the top-t key indices as a KeySelection with uniform weights of 1.0.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel for key_selection: defines the KeySelection output struct and KeySelectorKind discriminator, and re-exports select_highest_attn_keys / select_omp_keys.

nodes.name: KeySelectorKind
nodes.summary: Compact u8-repr discriminator (HighestAttn, Omp, OmpFast) with From conversions from KeySelector and ScoreMethod for runtime dispatch.

nodes.name: omp.rs
nodes.summary: Orthogonal Matching Pursuit key selector: greedily adds the key whose residual mass feature most correlates with the unmet target attention mass, refitting β via NNLS at configurable intervals.
nodes.languageNotes: Supports two modes — classic OMP (one key per iter) and OmpFast (k keys per iter) — chosen via the AmConfig.selector field.

nodes.name: select_omp_keys
nodes.summary: Runs OMP over the mass-feature matrix to grow the compact key set until t keys are chosen or the target mass τ is reached; periodically refits β via fit_beta_nnls over the selected subset.

nodes.name: mass_coverage
nodes.summary: Computes the fraction of |residual| mass captured by |m| over their overlap, used as the OMP stopping/convergence metric.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for katgpt-attn-match: documents the Attention-Matching compaction algorithm (MIT ICML 2026), gates every submodule behind the attn_match feature, and re-exports the full public API surface.
nodes.languageNotes: All modules are gated behind #[cfg(feature = "attn_match")]; rerank requires the separate maxsim feature. Constants like DEFAULT_W_LOWER/UPPER encode paper Appendix C.2 bounds.

nodes.name: online.rs
nodes.summary: Streaming KV-cache compactor that triggers an AM compaction once the physical token budget is exceeded, preserving a configurable recent window untouched while compacting the older prefix.

nodes.name: maybe_compact
nodes.summary: Checks the current position against the trigger threshold and, when exceeded, splits the cache into an older prefix (compacted via compact()) and a preserved recent window; returns None while still under budget.

nodes.name: OnlineCompactor
nodes.summary: Stateless driver holding phys_budget (compaction trigger threshold) and recent_window (number of tail tokens preserved verbatim), exposing maybe_compact as the primary entry point.

nodes.name: OnlineCompactResult
nodes.summary: Output of an online compaction: compacted prefix, preserved recent keys/values, the recent_start_pos offset, and total_logical_len; exposes total_bytes and bytes_saved metrics.

nodes.name: rerank.rs
nodes.summary: Retrieval reranking utilities (Plan 080, Research 45): reranks documents against a query via Cosine mean-similarity or MaxSim late-interaction scoring, plus NDCG@k evaluation and SIMD-accelerated cosine helpers.
nodes.languageNotes: Cosine hot loops delegate to simd_dot_f32 / simd_add_inplace / simd_scale_inplace from katgpt-simd; SymmetricBoundaryPair is gated behind the bt_rank feature for Plan 085 Deep Manifold Part 2.

nodes.name: rerank
nodes.summary: Scores each document against the query using the chosen RerankMethod (Cosine mean or MaxSim late-interaction), then returns documents sorted by descending score as RerankedDoc entries.

nodes.name: ndcg_at_into
nodes.summary: Computes Normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain at cutoff k into a caller-supplied ideal-rels buffer, avoiding allocation when called repeatedly across queries.

nodes.name: cosine_score_into
nodes.summary: Computes cosine similarity between every (query, document) pair into a caller-supplied matrix using SIMD dot products for the per-row norms and inner products.

nodes.name: cosine_rerank_score_doc_only
nodes.summary: Inner-loop cosine helper for rerank: given a precomputed query mean and norm, computes the document mean and cosine in-place into a reusable scratch buffer.

nodes.name: SymmetricBoundaryPair
nodes.summary: Plan 085 attraction/repulsion boundary descriptor with symmetry metric and adaptive β derived from the attraction-repulsion imbalance.

nodes.name: router.rs
nodes.summary: Backend router that picks among CPU-scalar / SIMD / Rayon / GPU / ANE compute backends based on token-count thresholds with optional hysteresis to avoid flapping on small length changes.

nodes.name: pick_backend
nodes.summary: Selects the compute backend for a token count t, applying hysteresis when the change from last_t is within the configured percentage band; otherwise follows the target_backend verdict.

nodes.name: target_backend
nodes.summary: Pure threshold-based backend selection (no hysteresis): returns the SolverBackend appropriate for the given t and gpu_available flag.

nodes.name: SolverRouter
nodes.summary: Stateful router holding config, last_backend, and last_t; exposes pick_backend, target_backend, and reset for the AM pipeline's dispatch decisions.

nodes.name: SolverRouterConfig
nodes.summary: Threshold configuration: cpu_max_t, simd_max_t, gpu_min_t, ane_max_t, and hysteresis_pct; provides sensible defaults mirroring the paper's measured crossover points.

nodes.name: SolverBackend
nodes.summary: Enum of available compute backends: CpuScalar, CpuSimd, CpuRayon, Gpu, Ane — each carrying an as_str() label for tracing.

nodes.name: score_matrix.rs
nodes.summary: Scalar reference implementation of the AM score-matrix primitives: compute_score_matrix (Q·K^T/√d), row-wise max, softmax attention, fused softmax+output, and pure attention-output reduction.
nodes.languageNotes: Inner dot products use the 8-wide unrolled dot_8wide from score_matrix_simd even in the 'scalar' path, giving a portable baseline that still vectorizes on most targets.

nodes.name: compute_score_matrix
nodes.summary: Reference scalar Q·K^T/√d score matrix computation writing into a caller-allocated flat buffer of length n*t_len.

nodes.name: row_max
nodes.summary: Computes the per-query row-wise maximum of a score matrix, used as the softmax stability shift.

nodes.name: compute_softmax_attention
nodes.summary: Numerically-stable row-wise softmax over the score matrix, writing attention probabilities (and optional mass sums) into caller-supplied buffers.

nodes.name: compute_softmax_attention_and_output
nodes.summary: Fused softmax+output kernel: computes softmax(Q·Ck^T/√d + β) and immediately multiplies by values Cv, producing both attention weights and the final compacted output.

nodes.name: compute_attention_output
nodes.summary: Pure attention-output reduction: multiplies precomputed attention weights by values to produce y = attn · V.

nodes.name: score_matrix_gpu.rs
nodes.summary: GPU dispatch stub for the score matrix: returns GpuDispatchError::ShaderNotAvailable unconditionally, with a fallback path that retries on the Rayon backend.
nodes.languageNotes: The actual GPU shader is gated behind the root-only gpu_inference feature; this leaf crate always falls through to compute_score_matrix_rayon.

nodes.name: try_compute_score_matrix_gpu
nodes.summary: Stub GPU entry point that always returns Err(ShaderNotAvailable) without touching the output buffer; the GPU dispatch will land here once the gpu_inference feature is enabled at the root crate.

nodes.name: compute_score_matrix_gpu_or_rayon
nodes.summary: Tries the GPU stub and transparently falls back to compute_score_matrix_rayon on any error, giving callers a single GPU-or-CPU entry point.

nodes.name: GpuDispatchError
nodes.summary: Error enum for GPU dispatch failures: NoDevice, ShaderNotAvailable, DispatchFailed.

nodes.name: score_matrix_rayon.rs
nodes.summary: Multi-threaded Rayon backend for the score matrix and RMS attention, parallelizing across query-row blocks whose size is auto-tuned from the row byte footprint.
nodes.languageNotes: compute_block_rows picks rows_per_block so each block fits in roughly L1/L2 — exposing parallelism without blowing the cache.

nodes.name: compute_score_matrix_rayon
nodes.summary: Parallel Q·K^T/√d score-matrix computation: chunks query rows into cache-sized blocks and processes them across the Rayon thread pool with the unrolled dot_8wide inner kernel.

nodes.name: compute_rms_attention_rayon
nodes.summary: Parallel per-key RMS attention score computation used by the HighestAttn selector — folds per-query squared scores in f64 then reduces to a single per-key RMS value.

nodes.name: score_matrix_simd.rs
nodes.summary: Portable SIMD-style score-matrix kernel using an 8-wide unrolled accumulator (dot_8wide), with an optional numerical-stability clamp on the exp input to avoid overflow.
nodes.languageNotes: dot_8wide manually unrolls the dot product to eight f32 lanes per iteration so the auto-vectorizer reliably produces wide SIMD even at -O1.

nodes.name: compute_score_matrix_simd
nodes.summary: SIMD-accelerated score-matrix computation using dot_8wide, with optional row-wise stabilization that clamps scores before the softmax exp step.

nodes.name: dot_8wide
nodes.summary: Eight-wide unrolled f32 dot product — the hot inner kernel reused by the scalar, SIMD, and Rayon backends plus the NNLS/Cholesky fitters.

nodes.name: tests.rs
nodes.summary: Integration test module running the GOAT (Gate of Acceptance Tests) matrix: synthetic β recovery, CV value reconstruction, OMP mass coverage, highest-attention RMS coverage, full-pipeline determinism, and an end-to-end selector sweep.

nodes.name: goat_g1_beta_recovery_synthetic
nodes.summary: GOAT gate G1: verifies fit_beta_nnls recovers the ground-truth β and weights from a synthetic attention matrix within a tight tolerance.

nodes.name: goat_g2_cv_reconstruction_synthetic
nodes.summary: GOAT gate G2: verifies fit_cv_least_squares reconstructs compact values Cv from synthetic (X, Y) data with bounded relative error.

nodes.name: goat_g3_omp_mass_coverage
nodes.summary: GOAT gate G3: verifies select_omp_keys achieves target mass coverage τ on a synthetic KV block, asserting the residual mass decays below threshold.

nodes.name: goat_g4_highest_attn_rms_coverage
nodes.summary: GOAT gate G4: verifies select_highest_attn_keys captures most of the per-key RMS attention mass within the selected top-t subset.

nodes.name: goat_determinism_full_pipeline
nodes.summary: GOAT determinism gate: runs the full compact() pipeline twice on identical inputs and asserts byte-equal β and compact_values, locking down the no-gradient determinism property.

nodes.name: e2e_compact_block_data_all_selectors
nodes.summary: End-to-end test exercising compact() with the default config across all three selectors (HighestAttn, OMP, OmpFast) on a synthetic block, asserting each produces a reconstruction report.

nodes.name: test_compact_attention_with_beta
nodes.summary: Unit test for compute_compact_attention: verifies that adding a positive β bias shifts softmax mass onto the selected keys as expected.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Core type definitions for the AM crate: ScoreMethod / KeySelector / SolverChoice enums, the central AmConfig with convenience constructors and validation, and the output AmResult + ReconstructionReport carriers.

nodes.name: highest_attn
nodes.summary: Convenience constructor returning an AmConfig tuned for the HighestAttnKeys selector with paper-default NNLS bounds and Cholesky solver.

nodes.name: omp
nodes.summary: Convenience constructor returning an AmConfig tuned for classic OMP (one key per iteration) with the paper-default refit interval and NNLS settings.

nodes.name: validate
nodes.summary: Validates AmConfig fields against the original token count, returning ConfigError strings for non-positive compact_size, no-op configs, invalid OMP iteration counts, and inverted weight bounds.

nodes.name: AmConfig
nodes.summary: Central configuration struct: compact_size, selector, score_method, OMP iteration parameters, NNLS weight bounds, CV solver choice, and reporting toggles; provides highest_attn / omp / omp_fast constructors and a validate method.

nodes.name: AmResult
nodes.summary: Output carrier for compact(): selected_indices, compact_keys, β, compact_values, original/compact lengths, head_dim, and optional ReconstructionReport; exposes compression_ratio and bytes_saved metrics.

nodes.name: value_fitter.rs
nodes.summary: Fits the compact values Cv via ordinary least squares on the normal equations, with both unblocked and cache-blocked Cholesky factorization paths and optional ridge-jitter fallback for rank-deficient Hessians.
nodes.languageNotes: The blocked Cholesky path activates when t ≥ a tunable block size, mirroring LAPACK's potf2/potrf split; ridge jitter is added on demand when compute_relative_error detects a singular factor.

nodes.name: fit_cv_least_squares
nodes.summary: Solves the cross-variance least-squares problem for Cv via the normal equations, attempting Cholesky first and retrying with ridge jitter on failure; reports relative error and solver status.

nodes.name: solve_cholesky_multi_rhs
nodes.summary: Back-substitutes a precomputed Cholesky factor L against multiple right-hand sides (the d-dim Cv columns) in one pass.

nodes.name: compute_relative_error
nodes.summary: Computes the relative L2 reconstruction error between Cv · X and Y using the 8-wide dot kernel for the residual norm.

nodes.name: cholesky_decompose
nodes.summary: Top-level Cholesky entry point that dispatches to the unblocked path for small t and the blocked path for larger matrices.

nodes.name: cholesky_decompose_unblocked
nodes.summary: Classic unblocked Cholesky–Banachiewicz factorization of a t×t SPD matrix in row-major layout, using dot_8wide for the inner dot products.

nodes.name: cholesky_decompose_blocked
nodes.summary: Cache-blocked Cholesky factorization that tiles the matrix into bs×bs panels, delegating diagonal-block factorization to the unblocked kernel and using dot_8wide for off-diagonal updates.

nodes.name: compute_compact_attention
nodes.summary: Computes the compacted attention output softmax(Q·Ck^T/√d + β) · Cv for verification and reconstruction reporting, using the 8-wide dot kernel and numerically-stable softmax.

nodes.name: forward.rs
nodes.summary: SpectralQuant forward-pass helpers: dequantizes compressed KV vectors into flat attention-layout buffers and computes quantized attention / max-sim scores. Provides both scalar and Rayon-parallel paths.
nodes.languageNotes: Hot path: scalar + rayon-parallel variants gated behind the `spectral_quant` + `maxsim` features.

nodes.name: gauge_invariant.rs
nodes.summary: Modelless LoRA factor-pair primitives (arXiv:2606.12921 / LoRA-Muon): gauge rebalance, invariant compose, and invariant lerp that remove the (A,B)~(AR,BR^-T) gauge ambiguity. Uses power iteration against PSD Gram for sigma-max estimation.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure linear algebra on borrowed factor slices; reuses `spectral_retract` for the shared power-iterate + L2 retract step.

nodes.name: hla_eigenbasis.rs
nodes.summary: Windowed per-NPC eigenbasis recovery (Issue 001): maintains an incremental Gram matrix over a ring buffer of HLA activation ticks and recovers top-k eigenvectors via Jacobi sweeps. Optional provenance hashing for cache identity.
nodes.languageNotes: O(T·D²) rank-1 Gram updates plus an explicit Jacobi eigensolver on the D×D Gram — no external LAPACK dependency.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for katgpt-spectral — the spectral quantization substrate spun out of katgpt-rs (Issue 015). Declares all public modules and re-exports the API consumed by katgpt-kv, funcattn_compose, chiaroscuro, and the root aggregator.
nodes.languageNotes: Module declarations only — zero functions, the crate exists to publish a stable module surface.

nodes.name: manifold_power_iter_router.rs
nodes.summary: Modelless Manifold Power Iteration MoE router (arXiv:2606.12397): one power-iteration step against per-expert Grams followed by L2 retraction to a constant norm. Includes sigmoid top-k gating and snapshot-swap reconditioning with blake3 cache identity.
nodes.languageNotes: Consumes `spectral_retract::power_iter_retract`; snapshot hook uses blake3 hashes to invalidate the cached expert Gram.

nodes.name: nonuniform_quant.rs
nodes.summary: End-to-end non-uniform quantizer combining two-regime (semantic + tail) allocation with per-dimension water-fill codebooks. Fits, compresses, and decompresses head vectors with reported MSE and compression ratio.
nodes.languageNotes: Composes `spectral::BitAllocator` + `spectral::LloydMaxQuantizer` per semantic dimension.

nodes.name: attention_spectralquant
nodes.summary: Computes single-query quantized attention against flat dequantized K/V buffers, writing the attention output and reusing a scores scratch buffer.

nodes.name: maxsim_score_spectralquant
nodes.summary: Scalar max-sim scoring of a batch of queries against a SpectralQuant cache slot range.

nodes.name: par_dequantize_spectral_keys_flat
nodes.summary: Rayon-parallel dequantization of SpectralQuant keys into a freshly allocated flat buffer, with an early-exit threshold.

nodes.name: par_dequantize_spectral_values_flat
nodes.summary: Rayon-parallel dequantization of SpectralQuant values into a freshly allocated flat buffer, with an early-exit threshold.

nodes.name: par_maxsim_score_spectralquant
nodes.summary: Rayon-parallel max-sim scoring across a query batch against the SpectralQuant cache.

nodes.name: maxsim_score_spectralquant_fallback
nodes.summary: Scalar fallback for max-sim scoring when the parallel path is unavailable or disabled at runtime.

nodes.name: power_iterate_sigma_max
nodes.summary: Estimates σ_max(A) via n_steps of power iteration against an explicit matvec into a reusable scratch pair.

nodes.name: gauge_rebalance
nodes.summary: LoRA-Muon Algorithm 2: rescales (A,B) so the factor pair has a controlled singular-value profile, removing the gauge artifact.

nodes.name: gauge_invariant_compose
nodes.summary: Composes a sequence of gauge-rebalanced LoRA factor pairs into a single (A_out, B_out) pair in a gauge-invariant way.

nodes.name: gauge_invariant_lerp
nodes.summary: Linearly interpolates two gauge-rebalanced LoRA factor pairs with an alpha blend weight.

nodes.name: EigenbasisTracker
nodes.summary: Incremental tracker that maintains a D×D Gram over a ring buffer of HLA ticks; supports rank-1 updates and top-k eigenbasis recovery.

nodes.name: push_tick
nodes.summary: Pushes one HLA activation tick into the tracker's ring buffer and applies the corresponding rank-1 update to the Gram matrix.

nodes.name: recover
nodes.summary: EigenbasisTracker method: runs k Jacobi sweeps over the accumulated Gram and writes the top-k eigenvectors / eigenvalues out.

nodes.name: recover_eigenbasis_from_window
nodes.summary: One-shot recovery of top-k eigenvectors from an explicit T×D window with a borrowed scratch buffer.

nodes.name: recover_eigenbasis_from_window_fast
nodes.summary: Fast-path eigenbasis recovery: skips provenance bookkeeping when only eigenvectors / eigenvalues are needed.

nodes.name: recover_eigenbasis_inner
nodes.summary: Core Jacobi eigensolver loop over the D×D Gram with optional provenance capture (window_id, hash, ticks).

nodes.name: DefaultMpiRouterSnapshotHook
nodes.summary: Default snapshot-swap hook: blake3-hashes the expert Grams to detect cache invalidation and reconditions router rows on swap.

nodes.name: compute_expert_gram_into
nodes.summary: Computes the per-expert Gram M[i] = W_g[i] · W_g[i]^T into a borrowed buffer.

nodes.name: manifold_power_iter_router
nodes.summary: Runs one power-iteration step per expert router row against its Gram, then L2-retracts to the constant norm C = C'/√N.

nodes.name: manifold_power_iter_router_inplace
nodes.summary: In-place variant of the MPI router that writes the reconditioned row directly into the router weight slice.

nodes.name: compute_diagnostics_with_scratch
nodes.summary: Reports lambda_alignment and max violation diagnostics for the reconditioned router rows against their Grams.

nodes.name: gate_sigmoid_topk_into
nodes.summary: Sigmoid-gated top-k expert selection with a partial-sort index buffer; writes scores in-place.

nodes.name: recondition_at_swap
nodes.summary: Snapshot-swap callback: rebuilds the cached Gram (if the snapshot changed) and re-runs MPI across all experts.

nodes.name: NonUniformQuantizer
nodes.summary: End-to-end two-regime quantizer with optional water-fill per-dim codebooks; fits, compresses, decompresses, reports MSE.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: NonUniformQuantizer constructor: captures eigenvalues, allocation parameters, and water-fill bounds for later fit().

nodes.name: fit
nodes.summary: Calibrates the semantic and tail Lloyd-Max codebooks against rotated calibration data; water-fills bits across semantic dims.

nodes.name: compress
nodes.summary: Encodes a head vector into semantic + tail indices and packs them with the per-dim bit widths.

nodes.name: decompress
nodes.summary: Reconstructs a head vector from its packed semantic + tail indices and the calibrated codebooks.

nodes.name: off_principal.rs
nodes.summary: Off-Principal task-vector retrieval (Plan 264 / arXiv 2606.13657): projects task deltas onto the complement of W_src's principal subspace and scores them there, where the signal concentrates. Provides bounded-temperature scoring.
nodes.languageNotes: Stores a thin U_k factor of the source weights; projection is a single matmul + subtraction.

nodes.name: outlier_guard.rs
nodes.summary: Per-layer Kolmogorov-Smirnov D-statistic scanner (Plan 224) that runs once at model load to detect outlier-injection attacks on quantized weight matrices. Cross-checks flags with a Stiff/Soft eigenvalue confidence test.
nodes.languageNotes: O(n log n) per weight matrix; consumes `spectral::ks_d_statistic`.

nodes.name: peira.rs
nodes.summary: PEIRA modelless distillation (SC-PEIRA Algorithm 1): a PeiraDistiller that accumulates covariance between student and teacher activations step-by-step, plus the spectral alignment-score metric and power-iteration SVD used by GOAT proofs.
nodes.languageNotes: Wraps PeiraConfig / PeiraCovariance from katgpt-core; alignment score is the Frobenius-normalized sigma_max of the cross-covariance.

nodes.name: procrustes.rs
nodes.summary: Closed-form orthogonal Procrustes solver (Issue 001): finds the best orthogonal alignment R between two paired anchor sets A, B via polar decomposition. Includes centering, determinant correction, residual reporting, and an underdetermined-guard.
nodes.languageNotes: Polar iteration is the workhorse (Higham's scaled Newton iteration); the canonical SVD path is replaced to avoid LAPACK.

nodes.name: river_valley.rs
nodes.summary: River-Valley diagnostic metrics (Plan 152): subspace ratios, entropy-based effective rank (erank), and update-trajectory cosine similarity. Pure scalar arithmetic, always-on, used to characterize optimization health.
nodes.languageNotes: Vendors a Jacobi eigenvalue solver so erank has zero external dependencies.

nodes.name: spectral.rs
nodes.summary: Core SpectralQuant algorithms (Plan 078): participation ratio, variance thresholds, Jacobi eigendecomposition, offline eigenbasis calibration (single + dual-Gram), water-fill bit allocation, and a Lloyd-Max scalar quantizer with K-S diagnostic.
nodes.languageNotes: Hand-rolled Jacobi eigensolver (no ndarray/nalgebrablas) keeps the crate dependency-lean for cross-frame use.

nodes.name: OffPrincipalIndex
nodes.summary: Stores the top-k principal basis U_k of W_src and projects task deltas onto its complement for retrieval scoring.

nodes.name: off_principal_project
nodes.summary: Projects a delta q onto the complement of U_k via q - U_k U_k^T q, writing the off-principal residual in-place.

nodes.name: from_u_k
nodes.summary: OffPrincipalIndex constructor that takes a precomputed thin U_k factor directly.

nodes.name: score_bounded_with_temp
nodes.summary: Computes a temperature-scaled retrieval score between off-principal query and adapter embeddings.

nodes.name: OutlierGuardConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for the OutlierGuard scanner: KS threshold, on-detection action, and Stiff/Soft cross-check toggle.

nodes.name: OutlierGuardReport
nodes.summary: Aggregates per-layer LayerReports with totals and the maximum observed KS D-statistic.

nodes.name: OutlierGuard
nodes.summary: Top-level scanner: scans weight matrices at load time and decides whether to warn, reject, or stay silent.

nodes.name: StiffSoftCrossCheck
nodes.summary: Cross-checks a KS flag against an eigenvalue anomaly signal and emits a confidence level (Clean / Medium / High).

nodes.name: scan_layer
nodes.summary: Scans one weight matrix of one layer: computes KS D-statistic, optionally cross-checks, and appends a LayerReport.

nodes.name: scan_transformer_weights
nodes.summary: Drives the OutlierGuard across all layers / weight tensors of a transformer at model load.

nodes.name: check
nodes.summary: StiffSoftCrossCheck::check: combines the KS flag with an eigenvalue anomaly flag into a confidence verdict.

nodes.name: log_message
nodes.summary: Formats a human-readable detection log line with layer, weight name, and confidence level.

nodes.name: PeiraDistiller
nodes.summary: Step-by-step PEIRA distiller: accumulates student/teacher cross-covariance and exposes alignment + loss histories.

nodes.name: step
nodes.summary: PeiraDistiller::step: rank-1 update of the cross-covariance from a (student, teacher) activation pair.

nodes.name: peira_alignment_score_into
nodes.summary: Computes the PEIRA spectral alignment score (sigma_max of the normalized cross-covariance) into a reusable scratch.

nodes.name: peira_planning_quality
nodes.summary: Compares student vs teacher planning scores to summarize distillation quality.

nodes.name: power_iteration_into
nodes.summary: Generic k-step power iteration against a square matrix into a reusable scratch pair.

nodes.name: synthetic_cca_sample
nodes.summary: Generates a synthetic canonical-correlation sample (used by GOAT proof fixtures).

nodes.name: ProcrustesConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration knobs for the Procrustes solver: centering, special-orthogonal constraint, residual/determinant reporting, minimum anchors.

nodes.name: ProcrustesScratch
nodes.summary: Reusable scratch buffers (means, M = A^T B, predicted row) for repeated Procrustes solves of growing size.

nodes.name: orthogonal_procrustes
nodes.summary: Solves the orthogonal Procrustes problem for paired anchor sets A, B via polar decomposition with optional centering, determinant flip, and residual reporting.

nodes.name: polar_iteration
nodes.summary: Higham scaled-Newton polar decomposition iteration that drives X towards the nearest orthogonal factor.

nodes.name: determinant_d
nodes.summary: Hand-rolled d×d determinant via cofactor expansion (used to detect reflection vs rotation).

nodes.name: subspace_ratios
nodes.summary: Computes per-direction ratios of gradient energy projected onto the dominant eigenbasis.

nodes.name: effective_rank_into
nodes.summary: Entropy-based effective rank (erank) of a matrix via Gram + Jacobi eigenvalues, writing into borrowed buffers.

nodes.name: effective_rank
nodes.summary: Convenience wrapper for effective_rank_into that allocates the buffers internally.

nodes.name: erank_from_gram_into
nodes.summary: erank from a precomputed Gram + its eigenvalues, using the standard entropy formula.

nodes.name: jacobi_eigenvalues_into
nodes.summary: Vendored Jacobi eigenvalue-only solver for symmetric matrices into a borrowed output slice.

nodes.name: update_cosine_similarity
nodes.summary: Tracks the cosine similarity between consecutive optimization updates for trajectory smoothness.

nodes.name: CalibrationResult
nodes.summary: Output of eigenbasis calibration: eigenvectors, eigenvalues, d_eff, spectral gap, variance thresholds.

nodes.name: LloydMaxQuantizer
nodes.summary: Optimal non-uniform scalar quantizer: fits centroids by Lloyd-Max iteration against Gaussian or empirical data.

nodes.name: participation_ratio
nodes.summary: Computes d_eff = (Σλ)² / Σ(λ²): 1 for rank-1, n for uniform spectrum.

nodes.name: cumulative_variance_thresholds
nodes.summary: Returns the index counts for 95% and 99% cumulative spectral-variance thresholds.

nodes.name: jacobi_eigendecompose
nodes.summary: Pure-Rust cyclic Jacobi eigensolver for a symmetric matrix, returning eigenvalues and eigenvectors.

nodes.name: calibrate_eigenbasis
nodes.summary: Calibrates the eigenbasis from a stack of head_dim samples via covariance + Jacobi eigendecomposition.

nodes.name: calibrate_eigenbasis_dual_gram
nodes.summary: Dual-Gram calibration variant that combines key and value covariances into a shared eigenbasis.

nodes.name: waterfill_bits
nodes.summary: Allocates a total bit budget across dimensions proportional to eigenvalue (water-filling) within min/max bounds.

nodes.name: fit
nodes.summary: LloydMaxQuantizer::fit: iterates centroid assignments against empirical data until convergence.

nodes.name: fit_for_sigma
nodes.summary: Closed-form Lloyd-Max fit assuming a Gaussian input distribution with the given sigma.

nodes.name: ks_d_statistic
nodes.summary: Two-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov D-statistic between empirical weights and a reference, used by OutlierGuard.

nodes.name: normal_cdf
nodes.summary: Standard-normal CDF approximation used by the KS reference distribution.

nodes.name: spectral_budget.rs
nodes.summary: Layer-adaptive spectral budget router (Plan 253): uses per-layer spectral power-laws (Magakyan 2026) to predict Newton-Schulz iteration depth and rank-p retention. Provides LOD presets and per-arm (gaming / chain / diagnostic) overrides.
nodes.languageNotes: Power law σ_q(M) = c_q · M^(-α_layer) drives both NS depth and retention fraction.

nodes.name: spectral_concentration.rs
nodes.summary: Spectral concentration adaptive rank (Plan 264 Phase 3): computes the top-k fraction of spectral energy from singular values and maps it to an adaptive LoRA rank. Concentrated spectra get small ranks, diffuse spectra get larger ones.

nodes.name: spectral_kv_cache.rs
nodes.summary: SpectralQuant KV cache: per-layer store that normalizes, rotates, quantizes, and variable-bit packs K/V tensors at write time, and unpacks + inverse-rotates at read time. Supports calibration-driven construction, scratch-buffer variants, and Rayon-parallel batch dequantization.
nodes.languageNotes: Cache layout: semantic dims get per-dim variable-bit codebooks, tail dims share a uniform low-bit codebook.

nodes.name: spectral_retract.rs
nodes.summary: Shared spectral retraction primitives: explicit-PSD-operator matvec, a single power-iteration step, and an L2 norm retraction loop. DRY primitive consumed by gauge_invariant and manifold_power_iter_router.
nodes.languageNotes: Takes the PSD operator as a closure so callers can plug either a Gram view or an explicit matrix.

nodes.name: spectral_rewire.rs
nodes.summary: Spectral Rewiring weight-delta purification (Plan 423 / arXiv:2607.03065): projects ΔW onto W₀'s SVD spectral subspace, separating on-manifold (delta_star) from residual energy. Includes indexed fast-path, diagnostics, and on-manifold fraction reporting.
nodes.languageNotes: project_core is the hot inner loop (144 lines of in-place SVD subspace projection with residual carry).

nodes.name: spectral_rotation.rs
nodes.summary: Rotation transforms for SpectralQuant: a learned-eigenvector SpectralRotation and a feature-gated RandomRotation (TurboQuant baseline). Vendors a deterministic random rotation generator so the crate has no rotation dependency.
nodes.languageNotes: RandomRotation is gated behind the `turboquant` feature; SpectralRotation is always-on.

nodes.name: SpectralBudgetConfig
nodes.summary: Per-model spectral budget configuration: derives per-layer NS depth and retention fractions from model dims.

nodes.name: SpectralLod
nodes.summary: Level-of-detail presets (Lod0..Lod3) mapping NS iteration depth and retention fraction for tiered inference budgets.

nodes.name: SpectralBudgetArm
nodes.summary: Named compute arm (gaming / chain / diagnostic) resolving NS iterations and retention from a base preset.

nodes.name: spectral_exponent
nodes.summary: Predicts the per-layer spectral power-law exponent α from depth fraction and layer type.

nodes.name: from_model_dims
nodes.summary: SpectralBudgetConfig::from_model_dims: derives a per-layer budget plan from layer count, model size, and layer types.

nodes.name: rank_p_retain
nodes.summary: Applies rank-p truncation by zeroing tail singular directions per layer at the configured retention fraction.

nodes.name: spectral_concentration
nodes.summary: Computes the top-k concentration of spectral energy from a descending-sorted singular value slice.

nodes.name: adaptive_rank
nodes.summary: Maps a spectral-concentration value to an adaptive LoRA rank within [min_rank, max_rank].

nodes.name: SpectralQuantKVCache
nodes.summary: Per-layer SpectralQuant KV cache: stores packed variable-bit indices + norms, exposes store/dequantize/parallel paths.

nodes.name: from_calibration
nodes.summary: SpectralQuantKVCache::from_calibration: builds per-layer codebooks and rotations from offline calibration + sample data.

nodes.name: store_vector
nodes.summary: Normalizes, rotates, quantizes, and variable-bit packs a K or V vector into the cache at (layer, pos).

nodes.name: dequantize_key_into
nodes.summary: Reconstructs a key vector at (layer, pos) into a borrowed output slice.

nodes.name: dequantize_key_into_with_scratch
nodes.summary: Scratch-buffer variant of key dequantization that avoids per-call allocation in hot paths.

nodes.name: reset
nodes.summary: Resets all layer positions back to empty while keeping the calibrated codebooks intact.

nodes.name: par_dequantize_keys_flat_into
nodes.summary: Rayon-parallel batch dequantization of keys at a position range into a flat row-major buffer.

nodes.name: par_dequantize_values_flat_into
nodes.summary: Rayon-parallel batch dequantization of values at a position range into a flat row-major buffer.

nodes.name: generate_random_rotation
nodes.summary: Deterministic seeded random rotation matrix generator (vendored from TurboQuant for the cache fallback path).

nodes.name: pack_variable_bits
nodes.summary: Bit-packs an index slice where each entry has a different bit width into a contiguous byte buffer.

nodes.name: unpack_variable_bits
nodes.summary: Inverse of pack_variable_bits: extracts variable-width indices from a packed byte buffer.

nodes.name: PowerRetractScratch
nodes.summary: Reusable scratch (matvec output + norm) for power-iteration-then-retract calls.

nodes.name: power_iter_step
nodes.summary: One power-iteration step against a closure-based matvec; normalizes and returns the new Rayleigh quotient estimate.

nodes.name: matvec_psd_into
nodes.summary: Computes v ↦ PsdOp · v into a borrowed buffer using a scratch accumulator.

nodes.name: power_iter_retract
nodes.summary: Runs n power-iter steps then L2-retracts the vector to a target norm; the shared primitive used by gauge_invariant and the MPI router.

nodes.name: SpectralRewireScratch
nodes.summary: Preallocated SVD work buffers (U, Σ, V, A^T Δ, residual) reused across spectral-rewire calls.

nodes.name: SpectralRewireIndex
nodes.summary: Precomputed thin SVD (U_r, Σ_r, V_r) of W₀ enabling fast spectral-rewire application to many deltas.

nodes.name: spectral_rewire_into
nodes.summary: Projects ΔW onto W₀'s SVD subspace into borrowed output buffers, separating delta_star from the residual.

nodes.name: project_core
nodes.summary: In-place inner loop of spectral rewire: orthogonal projection of ΔW onto span(U_r) and span(V_r) with residual carry.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: SpectralRewireIndex::new: computes and caches the thin SVD of W₀ for repeated rewrites.

nodes.name: spectral_rewire_with_index_into
nodes.summary: Fast path: applies a precomputed SpectralRewireIndex to a delta, skipping the per-call SVD.

nodes.name: rewiring_matrix_diagnostics_with_threshold
nodes.summary: Reports diagonal vs off-diagonal energy and a sparsity estimate of the rewiring matrix at a relative threshold.

nodes.name: SpectralRotation
nodes.summary: Learned-eigenvector rotation: stores V and V^T for fast in-place rotate / unrotate of head vectors.

nodes.name: RandomRotation
nodes.summary: Per-(layer, head) deterministic random rotations used as the TurboQuant baseline; feature-gated behind `turboquant`.

nodes.name: generate_rotation_matrix
nodes.summary: Vendors a seeded deterministic rotation matrix generator (Gram-Schmidt on Gaussian columns) for the TurboQuant baseline.

nodes.name: get_matrix
nodes.summary: RandomRotation::get_matrix: returns the borrowed rotation for a (layer, head) pair.

nodes.name: baseline.rs
nodes.summary: Monte Carlo null test for the Stiff/Soft anomaly gate: builds a null distribution of structural-agreement scores against random noise to calibrate false-positive rates.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Stiff/Soft Subspace Anomaly Gate module root (Plan 138): declares the baseline, stability, and subspace submodules and re-exports their public API. Feature-gated behind `stiff_anomaly`.

nodes.name: stability.rs
nodes.summary: Eigenvalue stability tracking across temporal windows (Plan 138): EigenvalueTracker freezes baseline mean/std, computes Jaccard stability and z-scores, and StiffAnomalyGate emits Normal / StiffCollision / ElasticAbsorption verdicts with FPR validation.
nodes.languageNotes: Jaccard implementation uses sorted top-k eigenvalueintersection counting with reusable scratch buffers.

nodes.name: subspace.rs
nodes.summary: Stiff/soft subspace decomposition (Plan 138): partitions eigenvalues / eigenvectors into a stiff top-k set by trace-mass threshold and a soft complement, and computes the soft alignment ratio α against a delta.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Shared data-model types for SpectralQuant: LloydMaxCodebook, SpectralQuantCalibration, WaterfillAllocation, SpectralQuantLayer, and SpectralQuantKVCacheConfig. Field order is layout-optimized to eliminate inter-field padding.
nodes.languageNotes: Field order: Vec (24B/8-aligned) → usize → Option<f32> → f32 eliminates inter-field padding.

nodes.name: monte_carlo_null_test
nodes.summary: Runs N Monte Carlo iterations of the stiff-subspace pipeline against random noise to establish a null distribution and FPR calibration.

nodes.name: EigenvalueTracker
nodes.summary: Tracks eigenvalue mean/std over temporal windows and computes Jaccard stability and z-scores against the baseline.

nodes.name: StiffAnomalyGate
nodes.summary: Anomaly gate combining z-score and alpha thresholds into Normal / StiffCollision / ElasticAbsorption verdicts, with FPR validation.

nodes.name: freeze_baseline
nodes.summary: EigenvalueTracker::freeze_baseline: computes mean/std over collected window spectra for later z-scoring.

nodes.name: eigenvalue_jaccard_with_buffers
nodes.summary: Sorted top-k Jaccard stability between two eigenvalue spectra using reusable scratch buffers.

nodes.name: evaluate_with_buffers
nodes.summary: StiffAnomalyGate::evaluate_with_buffers: produces a GateResult with reusable scratch, combining z-score + alpha signals.

nodes.name: validate_fpr
nodes.summary: Validates the gate's empirical false-positive rate against stable windows.

nodes.name: StiffSoftDecomposition
nodes.summary: Reusable decomposition buffer that splits eigenvalues / eigenvectors into stiff top-k and soft complement slices.

nodes.name: stiff_subspace_k
nodes.summary: Returns the smallest k whose top-k eigenvalue trace mass reaches the requested threshold.

nodes.name: decompose_into
nodes.summary: Splits eigenvalues / eigenvectors into stiff and soft slices via trace-mass threshold into a borrowed buffer.

nodes.name: soft_alignment_ratio
nodes.summary: Computes α: how much of a delta aligns with the soft complement vs the stiff principal subspace.

nodes.name: SpectralQuantCalibration
nodes.summary: Per-(layer, head, kv_type) calibration result: eigenvectors, eigenvalues, sample count, variance thresholds, spectral gap, d_eff.

nodes.name: WaterfillAllocation
nodes.summary: Per-dimension water-fill allocation output: bits_per_dim, total semantic bits, min/max bounds.

nodes.name: SpectralQuantLayer
nodes.summary: Per-layer calibrated SpectralQuant state: calibration, QJL signs, semantic + tail codebooks, packed bit layout.

nodes.name: SpectralQuantKVCacheConfig
nodes.summary: Top-level configuration for the SpectralQuant KV cache: seeds, layer count, kv dims, Lloyd iteration cap, calibration sample count.

nodes.name: collapse.rs
