nodes.summary: Implements CHIAR-Former's CollapseDiscovery harness (Fusion C) that detects when per-token routing utility U collapses toward zero and triggers OpPromotion to prune dead operators. Pure inference-time with no learned filters.
nodes.languageNotes: Welford-style streaming variance tracker drives a sigmoid-gated promotion decision over a sliding window of entropy observations.

nodes.name: entropy.rs
nodes.summary: Core spectral-entropy primitive: computes per-token normalized Shannon entropy H(x) in [0,1] via a Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) of the embedding, plus a numerically-stable sigmoid helper. Fusion 0 feeding every other CHIAR module.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses an in-place DCT-II with a preallocated scratch buffer and FFTW-style planner; entropy is normalized by log2 of the non-zero coefficient count.

nodes.name: kv.rs
nodes.summary: CHIAR KV-cache fusion (Fusion A): classifies each incoming key by spectral entropy into one of three storage strategies (DCT-truncated, quantized, full) using streaming tau thresholds, and reports utilization entropy of the resulting mix.
nodes.languageNotes: Enum-as-index pattern (as_index/from_index) keeps the dispatcher branchless; compression_ratio reports expected bits/key for budget accounting.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Chiaroscuro Attention module root: declares and re-exports the six CHIAR primitives (entropy, kv, op_trait, regime, tau, collapse) and defines ChiarRouterHook, the observation-only bridge exposing CHIAR stats to the InferenceRouter.
nodes.languageNotes: Module is feature-gated behind `chiaroscuro`; the hook is zero-cost when the feature is disabled.

nodes.name: op_trait.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the ChiaroscuroOp trait and ChiaroscuroRouter (Fusion B) that routes each token to either DctMixOp (cheap DCT-mix attention) or FullAttnOp based on spectral entropy, tracking per-op utilization so collapse discovery can prune dead ops.
nodes.languageNotes: DctMixOp::forward_token precomputes a DCT truncation of the query and applies it via a scratch matmul; FullAttnOp is a thin pass-through.

nodes.name: regime.rs
nodes.summary: CHIAR regime gate (Fusion D): uses a Welford streaming variance tracker to decide whether the current prompt is 'long and naturalistic' enough to benefit from CHIAR, exposing a probabilistic should_apply_chiar flag.
nodes.languageNotes: apply_probability returns a Bernoulli gate so callers can blend CHIAR vs baseline attention smoothly rather than hard-switching.

nodes.name: tau.rs
nodes.summary: StreamingTauCalibrator: maintains a rolling window of observed spectral entropies and exposes streaming quantile-derived tau_lo / tau_hi thresholds that the KV dispatcher and op router use to make per-token decisions.
nodes.languageNotes: Quantiles are recomputed lazily from a sorted-window snapshot on each query; tau_lo/tau_hi are also mutable so external schedules can override them.

nodes.name: adaptive_k.rs
nodes.summary: Adaptive-K routing primitive for DashAttention: chooses a context-dependent number of attended blocks per query via a learned affine map, then forwards through a cache/indexer pair that respects the per-query k.
nodes.languageNotes: compute_adaptive_k applies a sigmoid-gated linear projection to the dot-product score distribution; result is clamped to [k_min, k_max].

nodes.name: block_topk.rs
nodes.summary: Largest DashAttention primitive: implements block-level top-k selection with scalar-heap, NEON, and AVX2 SIMD variants, plus a per-group top-k router. Central to DashAttention's sparse block retrieval.
nodes.languageNotes: Three argtopk implementations are feature-gated (target_arch); insert_sorted maintains a min-heap of (score,idx) pairs so the k-th best is O(1).

nodes.name: channel_aware.rs
nodes.summary: Channel-aware DashAttention router: discovers a subset of head dimensions that are most informative for routing, stores a compressed routing_key per block, and provides NEON/AVX2 SIMD dot-product kernels for the indexer.
nodes.languageNotes: RoutingChannelDiscovery::calibrate runs a sweep over candidate channel masks to pick the mask that preserves top-k accuracy with the fewest channels.

nodes.name: chunk_summary.rs
nodes.summary: Chunk-summary primitive for DashAttention: maintains a cache of mean-pooled key summaries (with optional entropy weights) per chunk and per head, plus the query-time scoring used by the entmax router.
nodes.languageNotes: ChunkSummaryQuery::new_random seeds per-head random queries when no learned summary exists; summarize_chunk_into_with_entropy blends attention weights with a precomputed entropy bias.

nodes.name: CollapseDiscoveryHarness
nodes.summary: Streaming harness that observes per-token routing utility (entropy of op-utilization distribution) over a sliding window and emits an OpPromotion when utilization collapses toward zero.

nodes.name: check_collapse
nodes.summary: Computes current op-utilization entropy and, if below the configured threshold, returns an OpPromotion describing the demoted ops; otherwise returns a no-promotion snapshot.

nodes.name: spectral_entropy_dct_into
nodes.summary: In-place DCT-II spectral entropy: writes the per-token normalized entropy H(x) in [0,1] into a caller-provided scratch buffer using a preallocated planner; the primary hot path feeding every other CHIAR module.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a radix-2 in-place DCT-II; entropy is -sum(p log2 p) over the magnitude spectrum normalized by log2 of the support count.

nodes.name: ChiaroscuroKvDispatcher
nodes.summary: Stateful dispatcher that classifies each incoming key into one of three KV storage strategies (DCT-truncated, quantized, full) using streaming tau thresholds and tracks per-strategy utilization for telemetry.

nodes.name: ChiaroscuroKvStrategy
nodes.summary: Enum of the three KV-cache storage strategies with as_index/from_index helpers for branchless dispatch and a compression_ratio report.

nodes.name: utilization_entropy
nodes.summary: Computes the Shannon entropy of the observed strategy distribution in [0,1]; 1.0 means a uniform mix, 0.0 means collapse to a single strategy.

nodes.name: compression_ratio
nodes.summary: Reports the expected bits-per-key compression ratio for a given strategy at the configured DCT coefficient count, used for cache budget accounting.

nodes.name: ChiarRouterHook
nodes.summary: Observation-only bridge that wraps ChiaroscuroKvDispatcher, ChiarRegimeGate, and StreamingTauCalibrator so the InferenceRouter can surface CHIAR stats without owning the full pipeline; zero-cost when the feature is off.

nodes.name: stats
nodes.summary: Returns a ChiarRouterStats snapshot (utilization entropy, regime decision, token count) for RouterStats reporting.

nodes.name: ChiaroscuroOp
nodes.summary: Trait abstracting a per-token attention operation with an entropy operating window, a relative-cost hint, and a forward_token method; implemented by DctMixOp and FullAttnOp.

nodes.name: ChiaroscuroRouter
nodes.summary: Routes each token to one of N registered ChiaroscuroOp implementations based on its spectral entropy, tracks per-op utilization, and exposes survivors/zero-utilization views for collapse discovery.

nodes.name: DctMixOp
nodes.summary: ChiaroscuroOp implementation that applies a DCT-truncated (low-frequency-only) attention pass for low-entropy tokens; the cheap fast path.

nodes.name: FullAttnOp
nodes.summary: ChiaroscuroOp implementation that delegates to the full attention pass for high-entropy tokens; the accurate fallback.

nodes.name: route_from_h
nodes.summary: Selects an op index for a precomputed spectral entropy value by scanning op operating windows; returns the index whose [entropy_lo, entropy_hi] contains h_x.

nodes.name: utilization_entropy
nodes.summary: Shannon entropy of the per-op utilization distribution; fed into CollapseDiscoveryHarness to detect dead ops.

nodes.name: forward_token
nodes.summary: DctMixOp's per-token forward: projects the query via a precomputed DCT-truncation matrix and accumulates the result into the output buffer; the cheap attention fast path.

nodes.name: WelfordVariance
nodes.summary: Online single-pass variance tracker using Welford's algorithm; the numerical backbone of the regime gate's naturalistic-variance test.

nodes.name: ChiarRegimeGate
nodes.summary: Decides whether CHIAR should be applied for the current prompt by combining a minimum-prompt-token gate with a Welford variance test on observed spectral entropies.

nodes.name: should_apply_chiar
nodes.summary: Returns true when prompt token count exceeds the minimum and observed entropy variance exceeds the naturalistic threshold; the hard on/off decision.

nodes.name: apply_probability
nodes.summary: Returns a [0,1] probability of applying CHIAR based on how far above threshold the variance is; enables smooth blending rather than hard switching.

nodes.name: StreamingTauCalibrator
nodes.summary: Maintains a rolling window of observed spectral entropy values and exposes streaming quantile-derived tau_lo and tau_hi thresholds; the calibration source for KV dispatcher and op router decisions.

nodes.name: tau_lo
nodes.summary: Returns the low quantile (default 10th percentile) of the observed entropy window, recomputing the sorted snapshot lazily; used as the lower KV-strategy cutoff.

nodes.name: tau_hi
nodes.summary: Returns the high quantile (default 90th percentile) of the observed entropy window; tokens above tau_hi use the full-attention path.

nodes.name: quantile
nodes.summary: Linear-interpolated quantile over the sorted observation window; the inner primitive used by tau_lo/tau_hi.

nodes.name: AdaptiveKConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration struct for the adaptive-k router: k_min, k_max bounds plus learned affine parameters (w, b) for the sigmoid gating function.

nodes.name: compute_adaptive_k
nodes.summary: Computes a per-query k in [k_min, k_max] from the dot-product score distribution by applying a learned affine map and sigmoid; the central decision primitive of the adaptive-k router.
nodes.languageNotes: Score distribution is first reduced to a scalar feature (mean of top quartile) before the affine+sigmoid map.

nodes.name: BlockTopKRouter
nodes.summary: DashAttention router that performs top-k block selection using SIMD-accelerated argtopk over block-centroid dot products; the default sparse-retrieval path.

nodes.name: PerGroupTopKRouter
nodes.summary: Variant of BlockTopKRouter that partitions blocks into groups and selects top-k within each group, guaranteeing coverage across the full sequence.

nodes.name: argtopk_simd
nodes.summary: NEON-accelerated argtopk over an f32 score slice: maintains a min-heap of the top-k (score,idx) pairs using SIMD insert_sorted_simd_neon.
nodes.languageNotes: Feature-gated on target_arch = "aarch64"; falls back to scalar heap otherwise.

nodes.name: argtopk_simd_avx2
nodes.summary: AVX2-accelerated argtopk over an f32 score slice: vectorized min-heap maintenance via insert_sorted_simd_avx2.
nodes.languageNotes: Feature-gated on target_arch = "x86_64" + target_feature = "avx2".

nodes.name: argtopk_scalar_heap
nodes.summary: Scalar fallback argtopk using a binary-heap-backed min-heap of (score,idx) pairs; correct on every platform.

nodes.name: insert_sorted
nodes.summary: Scalar helper that inserts a (val,idx) pair into a sorted min-heap of size k, evicting the smallest when full.

nodes.name: forward_indexer
nodes.summary: Scores the query against cached block centroids and runs argtopk to produce the top-k block indices for value gather.

nodes.name: RoutingChannelDiscovery
nodes.summary: Calibration utility that sweeps candidate head-dim channel masks and measures top-k accuracy retention to pick the most informative routing channels.

nodes.name: ChannelAwareRouter
nodes.summary: DashAttention router that operates on a compressed routing-key (subset of head dims) with SIMD dot-product kernels for the indexer.

nodes.name: calibrate
nodes.summary: Greedy channel-selection sweep: starts with all channels and iteratively drops the channel whose removal least degrades top-k overlap with the full-dot-product baseline.

nodes.name: simd_dot_neon
nodes.summary: NEON-vectorized f32 dot product over aligned slices; the hot kernel of ChannelAwareRouter's indexer.

nodes.name: simd_dot_avx2
nodes.summary: AVX2-vectorized f32 dot product over aligned slices; x86 counterpart of simd_dot_neon.

nodes.name: ChunkSummaryCache
nodes.summary: Pre-allocated SOA buffer holding mean-pooled key summaries (and optional entropies) per chunk per kv-head, populated during prefill and consumed by the routing layer during decode.

nodes.name: summarize_chunk_into_with_entropy
nodes.summary: Computes a query-weighted summary of a chunk's keys into a caller-provided buffer, also emitting a per-chunk entropy bias used by the entropy-aware routing layer.

nodes.name: summarize_chunk_into
nodes.summary: Computes a softmax-weighted mean of a chunk's keys against a query into a caller-provided buffer; the no-entropy variant.

nodes.name: allocate
nodes.summary: Allocates the SOA summary buffers for n_chunks chunks; preserves prior data when growing.

nodes.name: entmax.rs
nodes.summary: alpha-entmax (alpha=1.5) sparse softmax for DashAttention: in-place transformation of score vectors into sparse probability distributions, with support-count reporting and a GQA-aggregate variant that sums probabilities across head groups.
nodes.languageNotes: entmax_1p5_into runs Peters & Vazquez' bisection algorithm with a pre-sorted scores buffer; support is the count of non-zero entries post-threshold.

nodes.name: entmax_router.rs
nodes.summary: EntmaxRouter: a thin DashAttention router that scores block summaries against the query using entmax-sparsified probabilities, providing the cache + indexer interface consumed by the DashAttention forward path.
nodes.languageNotes: Keeps an EntmaxCache of head_dim-aligned block centroids; forward_indexer runs argtopk over entmax-sparsified scores.

nodes.name: forward.rs
nodes.summary: DashAttention composition layer: forward_dash_attn_prefill and forward_dash_attn_decode orchestrate the full attention pass (Q/K/V projection, chunk summary scoring, entmax routing, value gather) for prefill and decode phases respectively.
nodes.languageNotes: Both functions take a ForwardContext and shared weights/caches; decode reuses summary_cache populated during prefill to avoid recomputation.

nodes.name: kv_outer_prefill.rs
nodes.summary: KvOuterPrefill: a sparse prefill path that builds a KvOuterIndex of per-query hot blocks from a router's decisions, then performs sparse attention only over the selected blocks. Used as the outer loop of DashAttention prefill.
nodes.languageNotes: prefill_sparse fuses score computation, max-finding, and scaled accumulation into a single pass per query; logaddexp handles numerically-stable log-space accumulation.

nodes.name: meta_router.rs
nodes.summary: MetaRouter: a multi-armed-bandit policy selector that picks among several DynPolicy routing strategies per call, updates per-arm Q-values from observed latency rewards, and decays exploration epsilon over time.
nodes.languageNotes: Integrates with katgpt_pruners::bandit and katgpt_core::traits::ScreeningPruner; compute_reward normalizes actual_latency_ns against a baseline.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: DashAttention module root: declares and re-exports the 14 dash_attn submodules (clean core + composition layer + Phase-12 VortexFlow cluster) and re-exports the public API (entmax, routing, chunk_summary, forward).
nodes.languageNotes: Feature-gated behind `dash_attn`; the VortexFlow cluster was moved here from the root crate in Phase 12 (2026-07-04) once cross-crate deps resolved.

nodes.name: msa_distill.rs
nodes.summary: Multi-Stage-Attention distillation routers for DashAttention: MaxPoolBlockScorer and MaxStdDevBlockScorer compress each block's keys into a single representative vector (max-pool or lambda-weighted std-dev) for cheap top-k retrieval.
nodes.languageNotes: MsaBlockCache precomputes compressed representations; max_qk_score uses a tight f32 dot loop without SIMD as a calibration baseline.

nodes.name: routing.rs
nodes.summary: DashAttention block-scoring and routing-bias layer: scores chunk summaries against queries using entmax (optionally entropy-weighted), computes per-kv-head routing bias, and exposes a wall-aware variant honoring per-chunk retention thresholds.
nodes.languageNotes: score_blocks_entmax_with_entropy_into is the hot loop: fuses dot-product, entropy-bias add, and entmax sparsification; RoutingScratch holds reusable sorted/probs buffers.

nodes.name: sat_analysis.rs
nodes.summary: SAT (summed-area-table) analysis utility: profiles per-head sparsity of an attention matrix by reading a SummedAreaTable from katgpt_kv::cache_prune and reporting non-zero mass and effective support per head.
nodes.languageNotes: Used by MetaRouter to derive reward signals; HeadSparsityInfo carries mean sparsity, max sparsity, and head index of each extremum.

nodes.name: value_energy.rs
nodes.summary: ValueEnergyRouter: a DashAttention router that scores blocks by a combined key-centroid dot product and value-norm 'energy' term, favoring blocks that carry both high relevance and high information content.
nodes.languageNotes: forward_cache precomputes per-block centroid and L2-norm; forward_indexer blends scaled scores then runs argtopk.

nodes.name: vortex_flow.rs
nodes.summary: VortexFlow cluster root: defines the VortexFlow trait, VortexFlowConfig, VortexRouter (cache + indexer), and RoutingDecision/VortexScratch helpers. Provides a unified sparse-attention surface that composes the other dash_attn routers.
nodes.languageNotes: build_vortex_router is a factory that picks a concrete router impl from VortexFlowConfig; VortexRouterCache::from_config pre-sizes caches for the configured block budget.

nodes.name: entmax_1p5_into
nodes.summary: In-place 1.5-entmax transformation: runs Peters & Vazquez' bisection over the threshold tau so that the resulting distribution has at most k non-zero entries summing to 1.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a pre-sorted-scores buffer and a probs scratch; bisection converges in ~12 iterations for f32 tolerance.

nodes.name: entmax_gqa_aggregate_into
nodes.summary: Aggregates per-query-head entmax probabilities across each kv-head group, summing and counting members to produce group-level distributions for GQA routing.

nodes.name: EntmaxRouter
nodes.summary: DashAttention router that scores block centroids against the query via entmax-sparsified probabilities and selects the top-k blocks; the canonical DashAttention sparse path.

nodes.name: EntmaxCache
nodes.summary: Cache of head_dim-aligned block centroids populated during the cache phase and consumed by the indexer phase.

nodes.name: forward_dash_attn_prefill
nodes.summary: DashAttention prefill forward: projects tokens into Q/K/V, populates chunk summary cache, computes per-chunk routing bias, and performs sparse attention over the selected blocks. The composition root for prefill.

nodes.name: forward_dash_attn_decode
nodes.summary: DashAttention decode forward: reuses the summary_cache populated during prefill to score chunks for a single query token and gathers values over the top-k blocks. The composition root for decode.

nodes.name: KvOuterPrefill
nodes.summary: Outer-loop sparse prefill driver: takes a routing policy + block budget and produces a SparsePrefillResult by gathering per-query hot blocks from a KvOuterIndex.

nodes.name: prefill_sparse
nodes.summary: Main sparse prefill loop: for each query, computes block scores, selects hot blocks via the router, and accumulates scaled values with numerically-stable logaddexp.

nodes.name: KvOuterIndex
nodes.summary: Inverted index mapping each block to the set of queries for which it was selected as hot; built from per-query routing decisions.

nodes.name: MetaRouter
nodes.summary: Multi-armed-bandit policy selector: maintains per-arm Q-values and visit counts, selects a DynPolicy per call via epsilon-greedy, and updates rewards from observed latency.
nodes.languageNotes: Integrates katgpt_pruners::bandit + katgpt_core::traits::ScreeningPruner; decays epsilon to shift from exploration to exploitation.

nodes.name: DynPolicy
nodes.summary: Trait object wrapping a routing policy with its associated cache; the per-arm unit consumed by MetaRouter.

nodes.name: compute_reward
nodes.summary: Normalizes actual_latency_ns against a baseline to produce a [0,1] reward; bounded so a single outlier cannot dominate the bandit.

nodes.name: MsaBlockCache
nodes.summary: Cache of distilled (compressed) per-block representations used by the MSA scorer routers; stores either max-pool or lambda-weighted std-dev summaries.

nodes.name: MaxPoolBlockScorer
nodes.summary: DashAttention router that compresses each block to its max-pooled key and scores queries against those compressed representations.

nodes.name: MaxStdDevBlockScorer
nodes.summary: DashAttention router that compresses each block to a lambda-weighted std-dev summary, emphasizing high-variance (informative) blocks.

nodes.name: score_blocks_entmax_with_entropy_into
nodes.summary: Hot loop of the DashAttention routing layer: fuses per-chunk dot-product scoring, entropy-bias addition, and entmax sparsification into a single pass over chunk summaries.

nodes.name: score_blocks_wall_aware_into
nodes.summary: Wall-aware routing variant: skips chunks whose retention falls below a caller-supplied threshold, enabling prompt-wall-aware sparse attention.

nodes.name: compute_routing_bias
nodes.summary: Computes the per-kv-head routing bias tensor from a batch of queries and chunk summaries; consumed by the multi-query forward path.

nodes.name: RoutingScratch
nodes.summary: Reusable scratch buffers (sorted scores, probs, dot products) for the routing layer; avoids per-call allocation in the hot path.

nodes.name: head_sparsity_profile
nodes.summary: Profiles per-head sparsity of an attention matrix using a SummedAreaTable from katgpt_kv::cache_prune; reports non-zero mass and effective support per head, feeding the MetaRouter reward.

nodes.name: ValueEnergyRouter
nodes.summary: DashAttention router that scores blocks by a blend of query-key relevance and value-norm 'energy', favoring blocks that are both relevant and information-dense.

nodes.name: ValueEnergyCache
nodes.summary: Cache of per-block key centroids and L2 value norms populated during the cache phase; consumed by the energy-aware indexer.

nodes.name: VortexFlow
nodes.summary: Trait unifying the VortexFlow sparse-attention surface: declares the cache, indexer, and cache_new methods that every concrete Vortex router must implement.

nodes.name: VortexRouter
nodes.summary: Concrete Vortex router that composes an inner routing policy with a VortexRouterCache; the primary user-facing sparse-attention entry in the cluster.

nodes.name: VortexRouterCache
nodes.summary: Per-router cache storing block centroids, value norms, and routing metadata; sized from VortexFlowConfig via from_config.

nodes.name: RoutingDecision
nodes.summary: Append-only buffer of (block_idx, weight) decisions produced by the indexer; consumed by the value-gather phase.

nodes.name: VortexScratch
nodes.summary: Reusable scratch space (scores, indices, heaps) for the Vortex router; avoids per-call allocation in the hot path.

nodes.name: build_vortex_router
nodes.summary: Factory that selects and constructs a concrete Vortex router from a VortexFlowConfig; the single entry point for obtaining a VortexFlow instance.

nodes.name: diagonal_gate.rs
nodes.summary: Shared DiagonalGate abstraction used by both GDN2 and Wall attention, exposing per-channel diagonal gate vectors with apply/apply_inverse transforms and an exp-rescale variant for projection-derived gates.
nodes.languageNotes: Trait-based polymorphism with three implementors (DiagonalGate, Gdn2DiagonalGate, WallDiagonalGate) sharing a common gate interface.

nodes.name: ega_attn.rs
nodes.summary: Energy-Gated Attention (EGA): computes per-token spectral salience energy scores and gates attention weights through a learned projection with z-normalization and sigmoid bounding.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses katgpt-core SIMD primitives for the energy-score hot path; allocates only via _into variants.

nodes.name: chiar_blend.rs
nodes.summary: FUNCATTN x Chiaroscuro composition that blends functional-attention output with a fallback path per-token, weighted by DCT spectral entropy routed through ChiaroscuroOp.

nodes.name: freeze_thaw.rs
nodes.summary: Freeze/thaw layer for FuncAttn weights: BLAKE3-committed weight snapshots with content-addressed verification and an atomic snapshot store supporting modelless runtime hot-swap.
nodes.languageNotes: BLAKE3 content commitment + RwLock-based atomic swap; the weights blob stays latent (never synced), only the hash + version would be emitted as an audit event.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Feature-gated barrel module exposing the three opt-in FuncAttn composition children (spectral_pre_rotate, chiar_blend, freeze_thaw) under their respective feature flags.

nodes.name: spectral_pre_rotate.rs
nodes.summary: SpectralQuant eigenbasis pre-rotation for FuncAttn: calibrates a basis from activation samples, pre-rotates weights into the eigenbasis, and derives an effective rank from a variance threshold.

nodes.name: forward.rs
nodes.summary: Composition-layer forward pass for Gated DeltaNet-2 attention: runs token embedding, per-layer QKV projection, GDN2 recurrent state update/readout, and MLP residual, threading a multi-layer GDN2 cache.
nodes.languageNotes: 157-line forward_gdn2 is the decode hot path; uses unchecked indexing and katgpt-core SIMD matmul/rmsnorm.

nodes.name: kernel.rs
nodes.summary: GDN2 O(1)-per-token recurrent kernel: state update (S <- Diag(alpha)·S + k⊗(w⊙v - Sᵀ(b⊙k))) and state readout (o = Sᵀq), plus a fused recurrent_step combining both for inference.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy use of unsafe unchecked indexing and katgpt-core SIMD outer-product accumulation for the dk×dv state matrix.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module for GDN2 attention: re-exports the kernel, types, forward, and (feature-gated) tree_forward + tree_verify_bridge submodules.

nodes.name: tree_forward.rs
nodes.summary: Tree-structured GDN2 forward pass: processes all speculative-decoding tree nodes in one pass without rollback, calling the verify bridge per layer to score and accept a leaf.
nodes.languageNotes: 185-line forward_tree_gdn2 mirrors forward_gdn2 but vectorized over the tree topology using per-layer verify_gdn2_tree_layer.

nodes.name: tree_verify_bridge.rs
nodes.summary: Bridge between the GDN2 recurrent cache and the tree verifier: computes scalar alpha/beta schedules, verifies a candidate tree layer against the cache, and commits the accepted leaf back into the recurrent state.

nodes.name: compute_gate_from_projection
nodes.summary: Computes a Wall-style diagonal gate from a projection: exp-rescales the projected vector, clamps the log-sigmoid result, and writes the gate into the output slice.

nodes.name: apply_exp_rescale
nodes.summary: Applies an exp-rescale transform to a target tensor given gate values: scales by exp(g) for positive gates and exp(-g) otherwise, clamped to the smaller dimension.

nodes.name: z_normalize
nodes.summary: Zero-mean unit-variance normalizes a score slice in place using SIMD sum and sum-of-squares primitives.

nodes.name: compute_energy_gate_into
nodes.summary: Computes the energy-gated salience vector from a raw energy slice: copies, z-normalizes, then applies alpha/tau-bounded sigmoid exponentiation in place.

nodes.name: energy_scores_into
nodes.summary: Computes per-token energy scores as the SIMD dot product of the projected query against each token window.

nodes.name: gate_attention_into
nodes.summary: Applies the energy gate to attention weights for a full sequence: z-normalizes energies, computes the gate, and scales the attention rows in place.

nodes.name: compute_token_entropies_into
nodes.summary: Computes per-token DCT spectral entropy using the Chiaroscuro entropy primitive and writes the entropies into the output slice.

nodes.name: blend_by_entropy_into
nodes.summary: Blends FuncAttn output with a fallback output per element, weighted by a sigmoid of the token entropy scaled by tau/beta configuration.

nodes.name: from_weights
nodes.summary: Constructs a FuncAttnWeightsSnapshot from raw basis/Q/K/V weight slices, computing and storing its BLAKE3 commitment.

nodes.name: from_parts
nodes.summary: Constructs a FuncAttnWeightsSnapshot from pre-computed parts plus an externally supplied BLAKE3 hash, for restoring a previously committed snapshot.

nodes.name: hash_into
nodes.summary: Feeds all snapshot fields (dimensions, scalars, weight slices) into a BLAKE3 hasher to derive the content commitment.

nodes.name: commit
nodes.summary: Computes and stores the snapshot's BLAKE3 commitment by finalizing a fresh hasher over the hashed fields.

nodes.name: swap
nodes.summary: Atomically swaps the snapshot store's current snapshot for a new one, returning the previous snapshot or a CommitmentMismatch error.

nodes.name: calibrate_and_pre_rotate_basis
nodes.summary: Calibrates an eigenbasis from activation samples and pre-rotates the basis weights into the calibrated frame in one pass.

nodes.name: pre_rotate_from_calibration
nodes.summary: Pre-rotates basis weights in place given an existing SpectralQuant calibration result.

nodes.name: effective_basis_rank
nodes.summary: Determines the effective basis rank from a calibration's eigenvalues and a variance threshold, supporting 0.95/0.99 presets and a cumulative-variance fallback.

nodes.name: forward_gdn2
nodes.summary: Full GDN2 forward pass over a token: embeddings, per-layer RMSNorm + QKV projection, GDN2 state update and readout, attention output projection, MLP residual, and final norm/logits.

nodes.name: generate_gdn2_into
nodes.summary: Autoregressive generation loop driving forward_gdn2 for n_tokens steps, sampling each next token into a caller-supplied buffer.

nodes.name: gdn2_recurrent_step
nodes.summary: Fused GDN2 recurrent step: updates the state matrix S in place (alpha-decay plus outer-product write) and reads out the next-token output in one call.

nodes.name: gdn2_state_update
nodes.summary: GDN2 state update only: writes a new (key, value) pair into S with alpha-decay and the configured erase/write gates, without producing an output.

nodes.name: gdn2_state_readout
nodes.summary: GDN2 state readout only: computes o = Sᵀq for the supplied query against the recurrent state.

nodes.name: forward_tree_gdn2
nodes.summary: Tree-structured GDN2 forward pass: embeds all tree nodes, projects QKV per layer, verifies each candidate tree layer, writes the accepted leaf into the cache, and returns the verified logits.

nodes.name: gdn2_scalar_alpha
nodes.summary: Reduces a per-channel alpha vector to a single scalar via the geometric mean of its positive entries; returns None for non-uniform alpha.

nodes.name: verify_gdn2_tree_layer
nodes.summary: Scores every candidate tree node at one layer against the GDN2 recurrent state using the scalar alpha/beta schedule and returns per-node logits for the verifier.

nodes.name: commit_gdn2_tree_layer
nodes.summary: Commits the accepted leaf of the speculative tree back into the GDN2 cache by writing its keys/values through the configured gates.

nodes.name: DiagonalGate
nodes.summary: Trait defining the diagonal-gate interface: dimension, gate computation, apply/apply_inverse transforms, and reset.

nodes.name: Gdn2DiagonalGate
nodes.summary: DiagonalGate implementor for GDN2 attention, parameterized by a single per-dim alpha vector.

nodes.name: WallDiagonalGate
nodes.summary: DiagonalGate implementor for Wall attention, derived from a projected prefix with an optional gate_max clamp and exp-rescale apply semantics.

nodes.name: EgaGate
nodes.summary: Energy-Gated Attention gate module holding the energy projection weights, alpha, and tau; exposes energy score computation and attention gating.

nodes.name: FuncAttnChiaroscuroOp
nodes.summary: ChiaroscuroOp implementor that routes low-DCT-entropy tokens through FuncAttn, configured by a FuncAttnChiarBlendConfig with tau/beta blend parameters.

nodes.name: FuncAttnWeightsSnapshot
nodes.summary: Immutable FuncAttn weight snapshot carrying basis/Q/K/V slices plus metadata (alpha, temperature, version) and a BLAKE3 content commitment.

nodes.name: FuncAttnSnapshotStore
nodes.summary: Thread-safe atomic snapshot store holding the current FuncAttn snapshot behind a lock, with version tracking and commitment-verifying swap.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Type layer for GDN2: per-head recurrent state (Gdn2HeadState), per-layer head grouping with GQA-aware scratch buffers (Gdn2LayerState), and the multi-layer cache container with memory accounting.
nodes.languageNotes: GQA (grouped-query attention) aware KV head mapping; Gdn2GateConfig enum selects EraseOnly/Full/Kda gate variants.

nodes.name: hga_forward.rs
nodes.summary: Hierarchical Grouped Attention (HGA) three-stage forward: chunk scoring via entmax-1.5, top-k chunk selection, per-chunk group selection, then a fused scaled-dot-product attention over fetched groups.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses entmax_1p5 from dash_attn for sparse chunk-probability distribution; sdpa helper is a local scaled-dot-product kernel.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for katgpt-attn: feature-gated re-export of all attention-stack modules (gdn2, diagonal_gate, dash_attn, chiaroscuro, rat_bridge, ega_attn, static_cal, funcattn_compose, hga_forward).
nodes.languageNotes: Each module is behind its own Cargo feature; hga_forward requires both hga and dash_attn features.

nodes.name: bridge.rs
nodes.summary: RAT+ bridge state: maintains per-layer dilation, a sigmoid-bounded gate derived from query × gdn2_readout, and a projected readout vector updated each step.

nodes.name: dilated_kv.rs
nodes.summary: Dilated KV cache accessor for the RAT+ bridge: stride-based index computation and a dilated decode step that gathers dilated keys/values and fuses them through bridge attention.

nodes.name: dilation_router.rs
nodes.summary: Adaptive dilation router: selects attention dilation from queries-per-second and per-layer relative-variance scores, promoting wider dilation on peaked layers and at higher QPS.

nodes.name: fuse.rs
nodes.summary: Bridge attention fuse for RAT+: blends dilated KV-cache attention with the GDN2 recurrent state readout via a sigmoid gate, producing the fused rat_decode_step used by the bridge decoder.
nodes.languageNotes: 107-line bridge_attention_into is the fused hot path; uses unsafe set_len for zero-allocation weight assembly.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module for the RAT+ recurrence bridge: feature-gated re-export of bridge, dilated_kv, dilation_router, fuse, and vortex submodules.

nodes.name: vortex.rs
nodes.summary: Vortex block router for the RAT+ bridge: precomputes per-block centroids over dilated KV keys and scores candidate blocks by a gate-weighted similarity to the query.

nodes.name: static_cal.rs
nodes.summary: Static per-head attention-scale calibration table: stores per-layer/head sigmoid-bounded scales, supports calibration from activation statistics, and commits a BLAKE3 hash for tamper detection plus RV-variance-driven recalibration checks.
nodes.languageNotes: BLAKE3 commitment over the raw f32 scale bytes; run_calibration_pass and check_rv_recalibration are modelless inference helpers driven by a caller-supplied forward_fn.

nodes.name: forward_hga
nodes.summary: Hierarchical Grouped Attention forward: scores chunks via dot product, applies entmax-1.5 for sparse chunk selection, selects top groups per chunk, fetches them, and runs fused SDPA.

nodes.name: sdpa
nodes.summary: Local scaled-dot-product attention kernel over fetched HGA groups with causal masking and softmax normalization.

nodes.name: compute_gate
nodes.summary: Computes a sigmoid-bounded bridge gate as exp(-dot(query, gdn2_readout)), blending the recurrent readout with the incoming query.

nodes.name: dilated_decode_step
nodes.summary: Allocating dilated decode step: gathers dilated KV entries, applies the bridge gate, and returns the fused bridge attention output.

nodes.name: dilated_decode_step_into
nodes.summary: Zero-allocation dilated decode step that writes the fused bridge attention output into a caller-supplied buffer.

nodes.name: select_layer_dilation
nodes.summary: Selects a per-layer dilation, biasing toward wider dilation for peaked layers (high relative-variance score) at the current QPS.

nodes.name: select_dilation
nodes.summary: Free-function dilation selector that maps a QPS value through configured thresholds to a DilationConfig.

nodes.name: bridge_attention
nodes.summary: Allocating bridge attention: fuses dilated KV attention with the GDN2 readout through a sigmoid gate and returns the output plus alpha.

nodes.name: bridge_attention_into
nodes.summary: Zero-allocation fused bridge attention: scores dilated keys against the query, blends the GDN2 readout via a per-key sigmoid gate, and accumulates the weighted value sum into the output buffer.

nodes.name: rat_decode_step_into
nodes.summary: One-step RAT+ bridge decode: computes the bridge gate from the GDN2 readout, runs fused bridge attention over the dilated KV cache, and writes the result into the output buffer.

nodes.name: compute_centroids
nodes.summary: Computes per-block centroids by averaging dilated KV keys over fixed-size blocks, storing them for later block scoring.

nodes.name: score_blocks
nodes.summary: Scores each precomputed block centroid by a gate-weighted blend of raw similarity and a dampened fallback, returning ranked (block_index, score) pairs.

nodes.name: calibrate_from_stats
nodes.summary: Calibrates per-head sigmoid-bounded scales from collected HeadStats (mean/variance/max activation) and commits the updated table.

nodes.name: check_rv_recalibration
nodes.summary: Runs a forward pass over calibration prompts and, if the relative-variance exceeds a threshold, triggers a recalibration of the scale table.

nodes.name: Gdn2HeadState
nodes.summary: Per-KV-head GDN2 recurrent state: owns the dk×dv state matrix S and exposes new/reset.

nodes.name: Gdn2LayerState
nodes.summary: Per-layer GDN2 state grouping all KV heads with GQA-aware scratch buffers (out, temp, erase_b, decay_alpha, write_w_channel, delta) and a gate config.

nodes.name: MultiLayerGdn2Cache
nodes.summary: Top-level GDN2 cache holding one Gdn2LayerState per transformer layer, with reset and memory_bytes accounting helpers.

nodes.name: RatBridgeState
nodes.summary: Per-layer RAT+ bridge state: tracks the current dilation, the last gate alpha, and a projected readout vector.

nodes.name: DilationRouter
nodes.summary: Adaptive dilation router holding QPS thresholds and per-layer relative-variance scores to drive layer-aware dilation selection.

nodes.name: DilationBridgeRouter
nodes.summary: Vortex block router carrying the current dilation, precomputed block centroids, and the last computed bridge gate for similarity blending.

nodes.name: StaticCalTable
nodes.summary: Per-head attention-scale table indexed by (layer, head), with calibration from activation stats and a BLAKE3 commitment for tamper detection.

nodes.name: d2f.rs
nodes.summary: Core diffusion-to-fast (d2f) decode primitives for the dllm path: block-level diffusion decoding, multi-step scheduling (logit-normal, equi-probability), greedy/temperatured sampling, convergence checks, soft-decode variants, and pipeline assembly over a D2fContext.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses builder-style config structs (D2fDecodeConfig with quality/speed/multistep_quality presets) and pre-allocated scratch buffers passed through every decode entry point to keep the hot path zero-allocation.

nodes.name: d2f_context.rs
nodes.summary: Defines D2fContext, the pre-allocated scratch buffer holding KV cache, attention scores, and per-block activations for diffusion-LM decoding, plus a block-causal forward pass used to seed each denoising hop.

nodes.name: d2f_verifier.rs
nodes.summary: Speculative verifier (D2fDrafterVerifier) that pairs a draft d2f configuration against a target model and re-runs each draft step through the target to score acceptance under the tri-mode pipeline.

nodes.name: dd_tree.rs
nodes.summary: Discrete-diffusion tree builders for speculative path exploration: a screened schedule-aware builder and a GDSD (greedy discrete speculative diffusion) builder that walks per-step marginals under a screener constraint.
nodes.languageNotes: File is 2566 lines but exposes only two free functions; the bulk consists of the per-node marginal tables and internal traversal closures that the tree-sitter parser does not surface as standalone items.

nodes.name: denoise_loops.rs
nodes.summary: Iterative denoising loop family for diffusion-LM decoding: a vanilla loop, a scheduled variant, a residual-conditional-denoising (RCD) loop, and the 3SR warm-start variant, all parameterised by an optional NoRepeat constraint.

nodes.name: dense_mesh_node_transformer.rs
nodes.summary: TransformerNode: a dense-mesh draft node wrapping a single transformer forward step with a pooled KV-cache slot, enabling many parallel draft candidates to share the substrate while keeping per-node state.

nodes.name: dflash.rs
nodes.summary: dFlash drafter prediction variants: plain, autoregressive, parallel, conditioned, domino-corrected, router-conditioned, and the fusion variant that blends drafter marginals with a target-derived prior.
nodes.languageNotes: Each variant comes in a `*_with` form that takes a pre-allocated SpeculativeContext and a plain form that allocates internally, giving callers a zero-alloc fast path.

nodes.name: diffusion_sampler.rs
nodes.summary: Diffusion sampler ensemble (logistic, MLP, transformer) that decides whether each draft step should be accepted, with trajectory collection from real decode runs, AUC evaluation, and binary decision thresholds.

nodes.name: drafter_lora.rs
nodes.summary: Low-rank adapter (LoRA) weights for the drafter network plus its forward context, training loop (training-pair generation from replays, cross-entropy loss, SGD), and save/load to a compact column-major file format.

nodes.name: flashar_anchor.rs
nodes.summary: FlashAR anchor-then-fill drafter: predicts stride-spaced anchor tokens via the target model, then fills the gaps between anchors using block diffusion seeded by the anchor context.

nodes.name: flashar_consensus.rs
nodes.summary: FlashAR consensus verifier: runs dual-path (horizontal/vertical) drafting, fuses the two token streams via a ternary consensus gate, routes hot paths thermally, and re-verifies accepted tokens against the target.

nodes.name: forward.rs
nodes.summary: Core transformer forward pass for the inference substrate: attention head kernel, base and coda forward variants (the two main decode trajectories), standard and clustered LM heads with top-k index selection, and decode-stage dispatch.
nodes.languageNotes: forward_base and forward_coda together account for ~730 lines; both take the same scratch signature so the two decode trajectories can share every helper above them.

nodes.name: forward_positions.rs
nodes.summary: Bidirectional and block-causal positional forward passes used to seed diffusion-LM denoising: BidirectionalContext holds the full bidirectional KV, with a safe (allocation-free) attention entry point and a block-causal variant for chunked decode.

nodes.name: forward_set_causal.rs
nodes.summary: Set-causal forward pass that evaluates a token sequence under an arbitrary position ordering (not just left-to-right), enabling set-diffusion (MDLM-style) decoding where tokens are revealed in any causal order.

nodes.name: hla_forward.rs
nodes.summary: High-Level Attention (HLA) and Asymmetric-HLA (AHLA) forward passes plus their token-generation helpers, providing a hardware-friendly batched-attention alternative to the per-token forward in forward.rs.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for katgpt-forward: defines ForwardContext (the top-level pre-allocated scratch + delta-routing helper that sits ABOVE katgpt-transformer and katgpt-pruners to break their composition-layer cycle) and re-exports every composition submodule gated by cargo features.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy use of feature-gated `pub mod` (dllm, tri_mode, flashar_anchor, flashar_consensus, set_diffusion, rcd_residual, d2f_3sr_warm_start) lets downstream crates compile only the decode paths they need.

nodes.name: prefill.rs
nodes.summary: Prefill scorers (AttentionScorer and BlockAttentionScorer traits) that rate how well a draft model reproduces the target's prompt-time attention distribution, used to warm-start the speculative context.

nodes.name: set_diffusion.rs
nodes.summary: Set-diffusion (MDLM-style) decode driver: generates tokens in parallel over a causal-ordering rather than left-to-right, with config presets, scheduled decode, per-step sampling, and a pluggable set-causal forward callback.

nodes.name: speculative_context.rs
nodes.summary: SpeculativeContext: pre-allocated marginal and probability slices indexed per diffusion step, plus sampled-token storage, giving the speculative and dFlash drafters a zero-allocation scratch view.

nodes.name: step.rs
nodes.summary: Speculative-step primitives: plain, rollback (target-reverified), conditioned, router-aware, and configurator-driven variants, plus a helper to extract accepted token paths from a built dd-tree and a Shannon-entropy probe.

nodes.name: verifier.rs
nodes.summary: Speculative verifiers: SimulatedVerifier (a fast acceptance-rate proxy used in benchmarks) and LeviathanVerifier (the production target-reverified drafter with optional LoRA and forecast hooks).

nodes.name: decode_all
nodes.summary: Drives the full d2f pipeline end-to-end across every block in the D2fPipeline, threading weights, pruner, screener, and rng through each per-block decode and accumulating a D2fPipelineResult.

nodes.name: d2f_decode_block_with_prompt_with_sampler
nodes.summary: Decodes one diffusion block given a D2fContext, prompt tokens, and a pluggable DiffusionSampler, running the multi-step denoising schedule, sampling, and convergence check in a single zero-alloc entry point.

nodes.name: D2fDecodeConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for a d2f decode block (block size, schedule kind, step counts, thresholds) with quality / speed / multistep_quality presets and a block-size override.

nodes.name: D2fContext
nodes.summary: Pre-allocated scratch structure (22 fields) holding the KV cache, attention score buffers, and per-block activations for diffusion-LM decoding; reset and committed between blocks.

nodes.name: forward_block_causal_with
nodes.summary: Runs a block-causal forward pass that seeds each denoising hop by attending only within the active causal block, writing results into a caller-provided D2fContext.

nodes.name: D2fDrafterVerifier
nodes.summary: Holds paired target weights, target config, d2f config, and draft width so that draft steps can be re-verified against the target model under the tri-mode pipeline.

nodes.name: speculate
nodes.summary: Runs one full draft-then-verify cycle on the d2f pipeline, returning the accepted token span and the rejection point for rollback bookkeeping.

nodes.name: build_dd_tree_screened_with_schedule
nodes.summary: Builds a discrete-diffusion speculative tree under a screener constraint and an externally-supplied per-hop schedule, threading the chain seed and hop indices through the marginal walker.

nodes.name: build_dd_tree_gdsd
nodes.summary: Greedy Discrete Speculative Diffusion tree builder that expands the highest-marginal token at each node, producing a single high-confidence path for downstream verification.

nodes.name: denoise_loop_rcd
nodes.summary: Residual-Conditional Denoising loop: each step conditions on the residual between the current noisy state and the running clean estimate, iterating until confidence threshold or step budget is met.

nodes.name: denoise_loop_rcd_3sr
nodes.summary: Three-Step Refinement (3SR) warm-start variant of the RCD denoising loop that bootstraps the residual estimate from the drafter's first three decoded tokens before entering the main loop.

nodes.name: TransformerNode
nodes.summary: A dense-mesh draft candidate node bundling config, weights, token, position, and a pooled KV-cache slot so that many parallel draft candidates can share the transformer substrate while keeping per-node state.

nodes.name: dflash_predict_ar_with_fusion
nodes.summary: Autoregressive dFlash drafter that fuses the drafter's predicted marginals with a target-derived prior using a fusion config before sampling the next token into the speculative context.

nodes.name: dflash_predict_conditioned_with_routing
nodes.summary: Conditioned dFlash drafter that routes tokens through a learned router and pruner-relevance mask before producing the next-step prediction, enabling drafter specialisation across token clusters.

nodes.name: DiffusionSampler
nodes.summary: Enum dispatching over logistic / MLP / transformer sampler backends, with auto-selection from decode config, predict / predict_batch / train forwarding, AUC evaluation, and binary decide thresholds.

nodes.name: collect_trajectories
nodes.summary: Runs the d2f decode pipeline against target tokens to harvest (features, accept-label) trajectories used to train the diffusion sampler classifier.

nodes.name: DrafterLoraWeights
nodes.summary: Container for low-rank adapter matrices across drafter layers with flat-parameter get/set, total-count accounting, and zero/random initialisation gated by rank and alpha.

nodes.name: forward_drafter_with_lora
nodes.summary: Runs the full drafter transformer forward pass with LoRA adapters injected into every projection, writing into pre-allocated q/k/v/attn/hidden/logits buffers supplied by a DrafterForwardContext.

nodes.name: fill_with_anchors
nodes.summary: Given pre-placed anchor tokens, fills the inter-anchor gaps with block-diffusion decode seeded by each anchor's context, threading the pruner and screener through every gap.

nodes.name: anchor_then_fill
nodes.summary: Two-stage FlashAR driver: predicts anchors at a configurable stride via the target model, then delegates to fill_with_anchors to complete the token sequence.

nodes.name: FlashARConsensusVerifier
nodes.summary: Verifier pairing target and draft models with a ConsensusConfig and draft width, used to drive dual-path drafting, ternary consensus fusion, and thermal-path routing in speculate.

nodes.name: speculate
nodes.summary: Runs the full FlashAR consensus verify cycle: dual-path drafting, ternary consensus over horizontal/vertical token streams, thermal routing of hot paths, and target re-verification of accepted tokens.

nodes.name: forward_base
nodes.summary: The primary decode-trajectory forward pass: token + position embedding, wall-prefix state, every transformer layer with optional LoRA and domain-latent conditioning, and LM-head projection into the logits slice.

nodes.name: forward_coda
nodes.summary: Alternative decode-trajectory forward pass sharing the scratch signature of forward_base, used for the coda path (e.g. multi-token-prediction or final-layer specialisation).

nodes.name: clustered_lm_head
nodes.summary: Two-level LM head that first scores a small cluster classifier, picks the top-k clusters, then evaluates only their token rows, reducing the vocab-size matmul cost on large vocabularies.

nodes.name: BidirectionalContext
nodes.summary: Scratch structure (22 fields) holding the full bidirectional KV cache and per-position activations, used to seed diffusion-LM denoising from a non-causal prompt encoding.

nodes.name: forward_block_causal_positions
nodes.summary: Block-causal forward pass that processes tokens in chunked causal blocks of a configurable size, used to seed each diffusion hop without recomputing the full prompt.

nodes.name: forward_set_causal_positions
nodes.summary: Evaluates a token sequence under an arbitrary position ordering (the set-causal order), applying attention masks consistent with that ordering so any MDLM-style reveal schedule can be decoded.

nodes.name: forward_hla
nodes.summary: High-Level Attention forward pass: batches the per-token attention computation into a single hardware-friendly kernel, writing results into the ForwardContext scratch.

nodes.name: forward_ahla
nodes.summary: Asymmetric HLA forward pass variant that decouples query and key/value head counts (GQA-style) for inference on target models with unequal Q/KV dimensions.

nodes.name: ForwardContext
nodes.summary: The topmost pre-allocated scratch type in the inference DAG (~50 fields): composes transformer substrate buffers (x, q, k, v, attn_out, ...) with pruner handles and delta-routing helpers; constructed once per (Config, total_len) and reused across decode calls.
nodes.languageNotes: Fields are pub because the type crosses the crate boundary: forward-pass functions in the root crate need direct buffer access that pub(crate) visibility could not provide.

nodes.name: set_diffusion_decode
nodes.summary: Top-level set-diffusion decode driver: given a forward callback, config, and prompt, iteratively reveals tokens in a causal order, sampling each from the model's masked-token distribution until the sequence is fully denoised.

nodes.name: SpeculativeContext
nodes.summary: Pre-allocated marginal and probability slices indexed per diffusion step, with sampled-token storage, giving the speculative and dFlash drafters a zero-allocation view into a contiguous marginals buffer.

nodes.name: speculative_step_with_configurator
nodes.summary: Most general speculative-step entry point: threads a configurator and shared context through the draft-then-verify-then-rollback cycle, allowing external code to retune decode parameters between hops.

nodes.name: LeviathanVerifier
nodes.summary: Production target-reverified speculative drafter holding paired target/draft weights and configs, with optional LoRA injection and forecast hooks; speculate runs the full draft-verify-accept cycle.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for katgpt-kv, the KV-cache namespace that aggregates every compression, compaction, projection-sharing, and quantization backend behind historical feature flags (Issue 015 Phase 3 extraction).
nodes.languageNotes: Rust crate root using per-module `pub mod x;` declarations gated by individual `#[cfg(feature = ...)]` flags to preserve pre-extraction semantics.

nodes.name: async_qdq.rs
nodes.summary: Async double-buffered dequantization scheduler that hides quantized-KV dequant latency by prefetching the next chunk into a shadow buffer while the active buffer is being consumed (Plan 227 Phase 6).

nodes.name: kv_share.rs
nodes.summary: Q-K=V projection-sharing helpers that merge key/value weights and biases, and compute cache-layout savings, slots-per-layer, memory-per-token, and attention FLOPs factor for shared-projection architectures (Plan 185).

nodes.name: osc_kv.rs
nodes.summary: Oscillatory KV cache backend that discretizes key/value storage as damped second-order oscillators via IMEX integration, exposing continuous-time readout with per-layer tunable omega/beta (Plan 189).
nodes.languageNotes: IMEX (implicit-explicit) integration treats linear damping implicitly and nonlinear forcing explicitly for stable long-horizon KV evolution.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module exposing the cache_prune primitives — summed-area-table, rolling hash, and sensitivity detector sub-modules distilled from the CachePrune paper (Plan 140, Research 101).

nodes.name: rolling_hash.rs
nodes.summary: Polynomial rolling hash and segment pool for O(n) variable-length KV-cache segment matching using Mersenne-prime modular arithmetic, with prefix-hash indexing for fast reusable-segment lookup.
nodes.languageNotes: Mersenne-prime (2^k - 1) modulus enables addition/subtraction via bitwise OR/AND tricks in mersenne_mul / mersenne_add / mersenne_sub.

nodes.name: sat.rs
nodes.summary: Summed-Area Table (integral image) over attention matrices enabling O(1) rectangular region queries for intra/inter attention scoring and best-reusable-segment search.

nodes.name: sensitivity.rs
nodes.summary: SensitivityDetector trait with Strict and Open implementations, plus MaskedSegment for marking token ranges that must be recomputed vs reused during KV-cache sharing.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module exposing the compressed-sensing KV importance probe primitives — types, budget, gate, lasso, and probe runner distilled from arxiv 2606.13594 (Research 247).

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Core types for the CS-KV probe — Episode (KV cache + label success), AblationMask bitset, KvGroupRanking scored output with blake3 hashing, and DensityBudget interpolator configuration.

nodes.name: budget.rs
nodes.summary: Density-budget interpolator computing the integer top-K KV budget as a function of compression aggressiveness (ca) between sparse and dense endpoints, using a convex blend with rounding.

nodes.name: gate.rs
nodes.summary: GatedKvSlice applies a KvGroupRanking + DensityBudget to a KV cache, writing soft-gate bias terms (log(s + epsilon)) into attention scores following the SP-KV convention.

nodes.name: lasso.rs
nodes.summary: Coordinate-descent Lasso solver with soft-thresholding used to recover per-head importance scores from compressed-sensing ablation measurements.

nodes.name: probe.rs
nodes.summary: CsKvProbe runner orchestrating ablation-mask sampling, episode evaluation, and Lasso-based importance recovery to produce a KvGroupRanking for compressed-sensing KV-group importance probing.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module exposing the KVarN variance-normalized KV-cache quantization submodules — kv_cache, var_norm, hadamard, and eval (Research 159).

nodes.name: kv_cache.rs
nodes.summary: Central KVarN variance-normalized quantized KV cache implementation: stores key/value tiles with Hadamard pre-rotation, Sinkhorn variance normalization, and asymmetric RTN quantization; exposes the QuantizedKVCache trait plus per-tile quantize/unpack helpers.
nodes.languageNotes: Tile-centric design — every quantize/dequantize path operates on a `tile_size × group_size` block so variance normalization and Hadamard transforms can share scratch buffers.

nodes.name: var_norm.rs
nodes.summary: Iterative Sinkhorn-style dual-scaling variance normalization for KV-cache tiles, equalizing per-row and per-column standard deviations in log space to reduce heterogeneity-driven quantization error.
nodes.languageNotes: Log-space scaling avoids overflow/underflow when row/column std ratios span orders of magnitude; log_clamp_lo/hi bound the duals.

nodes.name: hadamard.rs
nodes.summary: In-place fast Hadamard transform applied to KV-cache tiles (row-wise, column-wise, or both) to concentrate variance and improve downstream uniform quantization quality.

nodes.name: eval.rs
nodes.summary: Pseudo-decode evaluation harness for KVarN quantization that simulates the full quantize→dequantize pipeline per tile and reports MSE, cosine similarity, and max magnitude error against the unquantized reference.

nodes.name: auto_route.rs
nodes.summary: QPS-driven heuristic auto-router for the segment-checkpoint subsystem, selecting SSC top-K, segment size, and checkpoint policy thresholds based on observed queries-per-second.

nodes.name: DoubleBuffer
nodes.summary: Generic active/shadow buffer pair supporting atomic swap and shadow-ready handoff for overlapping producer/consumer work on quantized KV tensors.

nodes.name: AsyncQdqScheduler
nodes.summary: Scheduler that owns separate DoubleBuffer instances for keys and values and drives chunked prefetch/advance/reset cycles so dequantization of the next chunk overlaps with consumption of the current one.

nodes.name: RollingHash
nodes.summary: Polynomial rolling hash over a Mersenne-prime modulus with precomputed powers, supporting prefix hashes, O(1) substring-hash queries, and incremental slide updates.

nodes.name: KvSegmentPool
nodes.summary: Indexed pool of cached KV segments keyed by length and prefix hash, supporting segment insertion and fast best-match lookup against a request token stream.

nodes.name: SummedAreaTable
nodes.summary: Enum dispatching between FlatSat (single matrix) and NestedSat (per-head matrix list) integral-image representations of attention scores.

nodes.name: SensitivityDetector
nodes.summary: Trait abstraction over token-sensitivity detection strategies (Strict vs Open) that decides which token ranges are eligible for KV-cache reuse vs recompute.

nodes.name: MaskedSegment
nodes.summary: Span over a token stream annotated with recompute indices, contextualization score, and a reusability flag, constructible from a boolean mask.

nodes.name: GatedKvSlice
nodes.summary: Unit struct exposing apply / apply_allocating entry points that write SP-KV-compatible soft-gate biases derived from a KvGroupRanking + DensityBudget into attention logits.

nodes.name: CsProbeConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for the CS-KV importance probe specifying mask count, ablation fraction, Lasso regularization strength and iteration count, plus head/group geometry.

nodes.name: CsKvProbe
nodes.summary: Entry-point struct for the compressed-sensing KV-group importance probe, exposing run() which produces a KvGroupRanking from a set of labeled episodes.

nodes.name: Episode
nodes.summary: Pairs a captured KV cache snapshot with its label-success observation, serving as one row of the compressed-sensing measurement matrix.

nodes.name: KvGroupRanking
nodes.summary: Per-group importance ranking with from_scores construction, argmax selection, and blake3 content hashing for caching/deduplication of probe results.

nodes.name: DensityBudget
nodes.summary: Interpolator that maps a per-channel sparsity fraction ca in [0,1] into an integer top-K budget blended between K_sparse and K_dense endpoints across the total dimension.

nodes.name: PseudoDecodeResult
nodes.summary: Per-tile quality metrics (MSE, cumulative MSE, cosine similarity, max magnitude error) reported by the KVarN pseudo-decode evaluation harness.

nodes.name: KVarNConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for the KVarN cache — layer count, KV dimension, max sequence length, bit width, tile size, plus toggles for variance normalization, Hadamard pre-rotation, static calibration, and an optional per-head precision budget.

nodes.name: KVarNKVCache
nodes.summary: Quantized KV cache that stores keys and values as bit-packed quantized tiles with Hadamard, variance-normalization, and RTN scale metadata, exposing the QuantizedKVCache trait (store / dequantize / reset / pos) and tile-level quantize helpers.

nodes.name: VarNormConfig
nodes.summary: Knobs for the Sinkhorn variance-normalization loop: iteration count, log-space clamp bounds, and tile size.

nodes.name: OscKVConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for the Oscillatory KV cache — layer count, KV dimension, max sequence length, integration timestep dt, and default damping beta.

nodes.name: OscKVCache
nodes.summary: Oscillatory KV cache that integrates per-layer second-order state (y, z) via IMEX, exposing the QuantizedKVCache trait plus per-layer omega/beta tunables for steering frequency and damping.

nodes.name: SegmentAutoRoute
nodes.summary: Heuristic policy struct that maps observed queries-per-second to SSC top-K, segment size, and checkpoint-policy choices, trading retrieval overhead against accuracy as load changes.

nodes.name: add_segment
nodes.summary: Registers a token span into the KvSegmentPool by computing prefix hashes via the roller, materializing its CachedSegment, and updating the by-length and prefix-hash indexes.

nodes.name: find_matches
nodes.summary: Scans the request token stream for reusable cached segments by length-indexed prefix-hash probing with substring-hash verification, returning MatchResult hits.

nodes.name: region_sum
nodes.summary: O(1) rectangular sum query over a SummedAreaTable with clamped bounds and edge-case handling for empty or out-of-range regions.

nodes.name: best_reusable_segment
nodes.summary: Searches a span (with a minimum-length constraint) for the sub-segment that maximizes the contextualization score, using the SAT for O(1) intra/inter attention lookups.

nodes.name: from_mask
nodes.summary: Constructs a MaskedSegment from a boolean sensitivity mask, computing contiguous recompute indices, span boundaries, and the reusability flag while honoring a minimum-length cutoff.

nodes.name: k_for
nodes.summary: Maps a compression-aggressiveness scalar ca in [0,1] to an integer top-K budget by interpolating between K_sparse and K_dense across the configured total dimension.

nodes.name: apply
nodes.summary: In-place variant that writes SP-KV-compatible log(s + epsilon) soft-gate biases into the caller-supplied bias buffer, zeroing out groups below the DensityBudget threshold via the ranking's argmax ordering.

nodes.name: lasso
nodes.summary: Coordinate-descent L1-regularized least-squares solver returning sparse per-head importance coefficients from the compressed-sensing measurement matrix (phi) and label-success observations (y).

nodes.name: sample_masks
nodes.summary: Generates M random ablation masks over n_heads at the configured ablation_fraction using the supplied RNG, returning the mask set consumed by the probe runner.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Top-level probe driver: samples ablation masks, evaluates each episode with and without ablation, assembles the measurement matrix, runs the Lasso, and returns the resulting KvGroupRanking.

nodes.name: shared_kv_project
nodes.summary: Projects a single shared weight matrix onto both key and value pathways, returning the merged key/value tensors for shared-projection attention (Plan 185).

nodes.name: pseudo_decode_eval
nodes.summary: Simulates the KVarN quantize→dequantize pipeline tile-by-tile on unquantized keys/values and accumulates per-tile and cumulative MSE, cosine similarity, and max magnitude error into a PseudoDecodeResult.

nodes.name: hadamard_transform_inplace
nodes.summary: In-place recursive fast Walsh-Hadamard transform over a 1-D buffer of length power-of-two, used to concentrate variance before uniform quantization.

nodes.name: with_config
nodes.summary: Builds a KVarNKVCache from a KVarNConfig — allocates bit-packed key/value buffers, precomputes tile metadata, decides Hadamard/variance-norm skip flags, and runs optional static calibration of per-tile scales.

nodes.name: dequantize_key_into
nodes.summary: Reverses the full key-side pipeline (unpack → inverse variance-norm scales → inverse Hadamard) for one (layer, position) into the caller-supplied output buffer.

nodes.name: dequantize_value_into
nodes.summary: Reverses the value-side pipeline (unpack → inverse dual-scale variance-norm → inverse Hadamard) for one (layer, position); the longest dequantize path because value tiles are grouped per-token.

nodes.name: quantize_key_tile
nodes.summary: Forward key-side tile quantization: applies Hadamard, runs Sinkhorn variance normalization, performs asymmetric RTN quantization with per-channel and per-token scales, and writes packed bits into the buffer.

nodes.name: quantize_val_tile
nodes.summary: Forward value-side tile quantization mirroring quantize_key_tile with per-token × per-channel scale orientation; writes packed quantized values plus their rtn_scales and rtn_zp metadata into the cache.

nodes.name: variance_normalize_into
nodes.summary: In-place iterative Sinkhorn-style dual-scaling loop that updates row/column log-scales (and their running best) until the row/column standard-deviation imbalance drops below tolerance or iterations are exhausted.

nodes.name: with_config
nodes.summary: Constructs an OscKVCache from an OscKVConfig — allocates per-layer OscKVLayer state buffers (y, z, omega_sq, beta) sized to max_seq_len × kv_dim.

nodes.name: bench.rs
nodes.summary: Benchmark and verification suite for SegmentCheckpoint — measures insert throughput, gate computation cost, memory growth, NIAH retrieval quality, and SSC drafter overhead against full retrieval.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses criterion-style bench fns alongside synthetic retrieval probes; mix of throughput benches and correctness tests.

nodes.name: gating.rs
nodes.summary: GRM-style gating primitives for segment retrieval — computes sigmoid gates from query/summary dot products and selects top-k segments for context-dependent lookup.

nodes.name: memory_soup.rs
nodes.summary: Branch-state memory soup for segment checkpoints — computes a decision-tree-style branch state from token positions to route segment retrieval.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Root of the segment_checkpoint module (Plan 223b) — defines SegmentCheckpoint, bounded-memory SegmentStore with LFU eviction, and CheckpointPolicy gating; re-exports auto_route, bench, gating, ssc, and memory_soup submodules.

nodes.name: ssc.rs
nodes.summary: SSC (Sparse Segment Cache) speculative drafter — selects top-k segments by gate score and enhances draft token logits with retrieved segment context.

nodes.name: kv_cache.rs
nodes.summary: ShardKV asymmetric KV cache (Plan 147) — K path via undo-RoPE, PCA rotation, water-fill bit allocation, Lloyd-Max quant; V path via Hadamard rotation and K-means VQ; decode path streams 8-bit lossless.
nodes.languageNotes: Large impl block (~1300 lines) with SIMD norm, in-place Hadamard transform, Lloyd-Max quantize, and K-means VQ fit on the K/V paths.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for ShardKV asymmetric K/V compression (Plan 147, Research 109) — re-exports ShardKVCache, RopeFreqs, and ShardConfig types.

nodes.name: rope.rs
nodes.summary: Rotary position embedding (RoPE) frequency table for the ShardKV K path — supports apply, undo_rope (for pre-quantization position removal), and reapply_rope (for restoring positions post-quantization).

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: ShardKV configuration types — VqCodebook (K-means codebook), ShardConfig (compression params), ShardCalibration (measured per-layer stats), and ShardLayer (per-layer shard descriptor).

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for SP-KV self-pruned key-value attention (Plan 070, arXiv:2605.14037) — re-exports SpKvConfig, SpKvCache, GateBiasBuffer, SpKvPredictors, and the utility predictor functions.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Core SP-KV data structures — SpKvConfig (gating mode + thresholds), SpKvLayerCache/SpKvCache (per-head density tracking and gated writes), UtilityPredictorWeights, SpKvPredictors (freeze/thaw), and the SpKvQuantCache quantization layer metadata.

nodes.name: utility_predictor.rs
nodes.summary: UtilityPredictor inference kernels for SP-KV — 2-layer MLP (SiLU to sigmoid) producing per-head utility scores, plus soft/hard/tahg gate-bias builders and multi-head utility aggregation.

nodes.name: beta_bias.rs
nodes.summary: Beta additive attention bias for StillKV compaction — implements BetaStrategy enum with beta-A MassMatching (log(T/t) scalar) and beta-D VortexFlow (attention-concentration-weighted per-latent bias), derived from cross-attention distributions.

nodes.name: compact_cache.rs
nodes.summary: CompactKVCache container for StillKV — holds the post-compaction latent KV tensors with CompactionStrategy metadata and memory/compression-ratio reporting.

nodes.name: iterative.rs
nodes.summary: IterativeChunkCompactor for streaming StillKV compaction over long sequences — splits KV into chunks with lookahead, runs the per-chunk pipeline (un-rotate, concat, query bank, perceiver, beta bias, re-rotate), and emits compacted f16 KV.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for StillKV perceiver-based compaction (Plan 245) — re-exports BetaBias, CompactKVCache, IterativeChunkCompactor, StillPerceiver, PositionFreeCompactor, and QueryBank; provides a SIMD cosine_similarity helper and integration tests.

nodes.name: perceiver.rs
nodes.summary: StillPerceiver cross/self-attention compactor (mirrors STILL architecture) — cross-attends a 2d latent ([K_free; V]) against the full KV cache with internal RoPE, then runs a self-attention refinement pass; includes hand-fused SIMD softmax, RMSNorm, and chunk-4 dot products.
nodes.languageNotes: Hand-fused inner loops (dot_chunk4, accumulate_chunk4, softmax_rows) for SIMD-friendly attention; no external tensor dependency.

nodes.name: position_free.rs
nodes.summary: PositionFreeCompactor — un-rotates RoPE-encoded keys to a position-free basis (enabling position-invariant compaction), then re-rotates the compacted keys at new positions; computes position offsets for chunk realignment.

nodes.name: query_bank.rs
nodes.summary: QueryBank strategies for StillKV compaction — ClusterQueryBank (k-means centroids), AttentionQueryBank (importance sampling), SpectralQueryBank (PCA/SVD projection), BfcfQueryBank (region blend), and MuxQueryBank (multiplexed superposition), with a create_query_bank factory.

nodes.name: targeted_precision.rs
nodes.summary: Per-head precision budget allocator (Plan 227 Phase 2) — allocates more quantization bits to sensitive heads and fewer to robust heads, with uniform/compute-budget modes and a total-bit verifier.

nodes.name: SegmentStore
nodes.summary: Bounded-memory store of SegmentCheckpoint entries keyed by segment_id with LFU eviction, access counting, and summary/segment-id iteration.

nodes.name: CheckpointPolicy
nodes.summary: Policy enum controlling when segments are checkpointed or pre-summarized, derived from a tier label.

nodes.name: SscDrafter
nodes.summary: Sparse Segment Cache speculative drafter — maintains a rolling context window, selects top-k segments via gating, and enhances draft logits with retrieved KV context.

nodes.name: ShardKVCache
nodes.summary: Asymmetric K/V quantized cache implementing the QuantizedKVCache trait — drives the K path (PCA + Lloyd-Max) and V path (Hadamard + K-means VQ) with streaming 8-bit decode fallback.

nodes.name: RopeFreqs
nodes.summary: Precomputed RoPE frequency table with apply (forward rotation), undo_rope (position removal pre-quantization), and reapply_rope (position restoration post-quantization).

nodes.name: SpKvConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for SP-KV self-pruned attention — carries gate mode (soft/hard/tahg), write threshold tau, hidden dim resolution, and per-step gate-mode selection.

nodes.name: SpKvLayerCache
nodes.summary: Per-layer SP-KV cache tracking write density and dispatching gated vs unconditional KV writes based on the predicted utility threshold.

nodes.name: SpKvCache
nodes.summary: Multi-layer SP-KV cache aggregating per-layer SpKvLayerCache entries with average-density reporting.

nodes.name: GateBiasBuffer
nodes.summary: Buffer builder constructing SP-KV gate biases — exposes soft (log u), hard (0 or -infinity), and tahg (threshold-amplified hard gate) bias construction from utility predictor outputs.

nodes.name: BetaBias
nodes.summary: Additive attention bias container for StillKV — holds the chosen BetaStrategy (MassMatching or VortexFlow) and exposes mass-matching offset / vortex-flow computation / cross-attention-derived bias.

nodes.name: AttentionDistribution
nodes.summary: Attention distribution summary (entropy, concentration, peak) extracted from cross-attention weights, used to drive the beta-D VortexFlow per-latent bias.

nodes.name: CompactKVCache
nodes.summary: Post-compaction KV container holding compacted f16 K/V tensors plus CompactionMeta, with memory-byte and compression-ratio accessors.

nodes.name: IterativeChunkCompactor
nodes.summary: Streaming StillKV compactor — splits KV streams into chunks with a compact budget, runs the full perceiver pipeline per chunk, and supports checkpoint-augmented compaction.

nodes.name: StillPerceiver
nodes.summary: Perceiver compactor block with cross-attention (latent queries attending to full KV) and self-attention refinement, internal RoPE, hand-fused SIMD softmax/RMSNorm, and weight-returning forward variants.

nodes.name: StillPerceiverConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for StillPerceiver — cross/self head dims, kv_dim, latent count, and RoPE theta with defaults mirroring the STILL architecture.

nodes.name: PositionFreeCompactor
nodes.summary: RoPE un-rotate/re-rotate utility producing a position-free key basis for compaction and restoring positions on the compacted output.

nodes.name: QueryBank
nodes.summary: Trait (and factory hub) for StillKV query-bank strategies — declares the generate_queries contract implemented by Cluster, Attention, Spectral, BFCF, and Mux variants.

nodes.name: PrecisionBudget
nodes.summary: Per-head bit allocation container — holds head_bits, average budget, layer/head geometry, and sensitivity scores; computes sensitivity-weighted budgets and verifies total KV bit cost.

nodes.name: compute_gates
nodes.summary: Computes sigmoid gate scores from query/segment-summary dot products for GRM-style retrieval.

nodes.name: top_k_gates
nodes.summary: Selects the top-k segments by gate score and returns their indices and gate values.

nodes.name: compute_branch_state
nodes.summary: Computes a decision-tree branch state from token positions to route segment retrieval in the memory-soup variant.

nodes.name: compute_and_select_top_k
nodes.summary: Computes segment gates and selects the top-k in one pass for the SSC drafter.

nodes.name: enhance_draft
nodes.summary: Enhances draft token logits by mixing in retrieved top-k segment context.

nodes.name: from_calibration
nodes.summary: Constructs a ShardKVCache from measured per-layer ShardCalibration stats, building the K-path PCA rotations, water-fill bit allocations, and V-path VQ codebooks.

nodes.name: store_key
nodes.summary: Stores a key vector through the ShardKV K path — undo RoPE, PCA-rotate, water-fill allocate bits, and Lloyd-Max quantize into the packed cache.

nodes.name: hadamard_transform_inplace
nodes.summary: In-place Hadamard rotation used by the ShardKV V path and decode-streaming fallback to spread energy before quantization.

nodes.name: kmeans_fit
nodes.summary: Lloyd-Max K-means fitting over groups of 4 V elements to build the 256-entry VQ codebook for the ShardKV V path.

nodes.name: write_gated
nodes.summary: Conditionally writes a KV entry to the layer cache only if the predicted utility exceeds the configured threshold tau; updates density tracking.

nodes.name: predict_into
nodes.summary: Runs the 2-layer (SiLU to sigmoid) utility MLP over the hidden state into a caller-supplied output buffer for zero-alloc inference.

nodes.name: aggregate_utilities
nodes.summary: Reduces per-head utility predictions across layers/heads into a single UtilityAggregation summary for downstream gating.

nodes.name: compute_beta_vortex_flow
nodes.summary: Computes the beta-D VortexFlow per-latent bias weighted by attention concentration from the cross-attention distribution.

nodes.name: from_cross_attn
nodes.summary: Builds an AttentionDistribution (and derived BetaBias) from raw cross-attention weight rows.

nodes.name: compact_chunk
nodes.summary: Runs the full StillKV per-chunk compaction pipeline — un-rotate, concat to 2d, query-bank generate, perceiver forward, beta-bias, split, re-rotate, f16 convert.

nodes.name: cosine_similarity
nodes.summary: Computes cosine similarity between two flat f32 vectors via three SIMD dot-product reductions (NEON/AVX2+FMA) instead of a scalar fused loop.
