nodes.languageNotes: Deliberately split into 3 SIMD dot calls because LLVM cannot auto-vectorize a fused 3-output scalar loop.

nodes.name: cross_attention
nodes.summary: Cross-attention pass — latent queries attend to full KV with internal RoPE applied to queries/keys, producing the compacted latent KV.

nodes.name: self_attention
nodes.summary: Self-attention refinement pass over the compacted latent KV.

nodes.name: forward
nodes.summary: Top-level StillPerceiver forward — runs cross-attention then self-attention over the input KV.

nodes.name: un_rotate_keys
nodes.summary: Removes the RoPE rotation from keys at their original position, yielding a position-free basis that can be compacted without positional bias.

nodes.name: create_query_bank
nodes.summary: Factory dispatching to the selected QueryBank strategy variant (Cluster, Attention, Spectral, BFCF, Mux) from a strategy enum.

nodes.name: compute_budget
nodes.summary: Allocates per-head bits from sensitivity scores under an average-bit budget — sensitive heads get more bits, robust heads fewer.

nodes.name: cache.rs
nodes.summary: Per-goal shared FlowField cache with dirty-cell tracking and topology-version invalidation; orchestrates the Q-value to grid to FFT to gradient pipeline via get_or_compute.
nodes.languageNotes: Pre-allocates FftPlanner and scratch buffers once and reuses them across get_or_compute calls to keep the hot path allocation-free.

nodes.name: FlowFieldCache
nodes.summary: Main cache struct mapping goal_id to a CachedField, exposing get_or_compute as the entry point that recomputes a FlowField when dirty cells exceed threshold or the topology version bumps.

nodes.name: get_or_compute
nodes.summary: Pipeline entry point that returns a cached FlowField for a goal or recomputes it via LeoHead Q-value extraction, obstacle inflation, FFT smoothing, and gradient extraction when the dirty threshold is exceeded.

nodes.name: fft.rs
nodes.summary: FFT low-pass smoothing and obstacle inflation primitives for potential-field de-noising, using rustfft to support arbitrary (non-power-of-2) grid dimensions.
nodes.languageNotes: Exposes both an allocating fft_smooth entry and a zero-alloc fft_smooth_into variant that reuses caller-provided Complex buffers and FftPlanner.

nodes.name: fft_smooth
nodes.summary: Forward FFT then low-pass filter (cutoff as fraction of Nyquist) then inverse FFT, zeroing frequencies whose normalized radius exceeds cutoff to remove local minima from the potential field.

nodes.name: fft_smooth_into
nodes.summary: Pre-allocated variant of fft_smooth that reuses caller-provided Complex scratch buffers and FftPlanner across repeated calls with the same grid dimensions to avoid per-call allocation.

nodes.name: inflate_obstacles_with_snapshot
nodes.summary: Inflates blocked cells by a radius and returns a bitfield snapshot of the pre-inflation blocked state so callers can restore topology between FlowField recomputes.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for Fourier-smoothed potential fields; declares cache, fft, and steering submodules and defines the FlowField grid, LeoPotentialGrid, and FlowFieldConfig core types.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust module barrel that combines pub mod declarations, pub use re-exports, and concrete struct definitions in one file.

nodes.name: FlowField
nodes.summary: Row-major 2D grid of unit (dx, dy) flow vectors with one field per goal; provides checked and unchecked cell lookup plus blocked-cell marking.

nodes.name: LeoPotentialGrid
nodes.summary: Scalar potential field constructed from LEO Q-values that supports gradient extraction, blocked-cell tracking, and slice access for FFT smoothing input.

nodes.name: FlowFieldConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration struct carrying tunable FlowField cache parameters such as dirty-threshold cutoffs and FFT smoothing defaults.

nodes.name: steering.rs
nodes.summary: NPC steering integration with FlowField: bilinear sub-cell interpolation of flow vectors, blending with local avoidance forces, and flow-field eligibility checks.

nodes.name: flow_steering
nodes.summary: Bilinear interpolation of the FlowField at a sub-cell position, returning a unit-length direction vector or zero when the query is out of bounds.

nodes.name: blend_steering
nodes.summary: Blends the flow-field steering direction with a local avoidance force to produce the final per-NPC steering vector.

nodes.name: should_use_flow_field
nodes.summary: Eligibility check that decides whether an NPC should consult the shared FlowField or fall back to local steering based on goal and density criteria.

nodes.name: belief.rs
nodes.summary: BeliefInferenceFn trait: stochastic hidden-state sampler for imperfect-information games paired with an induced CWM kernel for ISMCTS, requiring only posterior-support coverage rather than exact posterior distribution.
nodes.languageNotes: Trait uses an associated type Sample so integrators can choose any hidden-state representation without the trait constraining it.

nodes.name: BeliefInferenceFn
nodes.summary: Trait abstracting a stochastic belief-state sampler; implementors draw n samples from the belief at the current observation horizon for ISMCTS root aggregation.

nodes.name: commitment.rs
nodes.summary: CwmCommitment artifact: BLAKE3-committed induction-event record carrying the canonical commitment hash, a caller-managed monotonic version, and the GameState tick at which induction occurred.
nodes.languageNotes: Derives serde::Serialize+Deserialize plus Hash/Eq so commitments can cross the sync boundary and be deduplicated in chain consensus.

nodes.name: CwmCommitment
nodes.summary: BLAKE3-committed induction-event struct produced when an InducedCwmKernel is induced; the blake3 field is the canonical commitment and version is a contents-ordinal counter excluded from the hash.

nodes.name: from_kernel
nodes.summary: Constructs a CwmCommitment by computing BLAKE3 over the kernel's canonical_bytes along with the supplied version and tick.

nodes.name: hot_swap.rs
nodes.summary: InducedCwmSlot atomic hot-swap slot for an induced CWM kernel; readers on the 20Hz hot path see a consistent (kernel, commitment) snapshot via Arc swap while writers atomically replace and bump version.
nodes.languageNotes: Mirrors the LoRAHotSwap and micro_belief snapshot pattern: an Arc<(kernel, commitment)> swapped atomically so hot-path readers never observe a torn snapshot.

nodes.name: InducedCwmSlot
nodes.summary: Atomic swap slot owning an Arc to the current (kernel, commitment) pair; induce() replaces it while current(), current_blake3(), and current_version() give readers a consistent snapshot.

nodes.name: induce
nodes.summary: Cold-tier writer that atomically swaps in a new kernel and its freshly-computed CwmCommitment, bumping the version counter for the slot.

nodes.name: ismcts.rs
nodes.summary: Information-Set MCTS over an induced CWM plus belief function: per-iteration determinized MCTS with root-level information-set aggregation, keying shared root statistics by action hash.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a root HashMap keyed by action hash because S::Action is only required to be Hash+Eq+Clone, not Ord — a deliberate relaxation to keep the kernel trait generic.

nodes.name: NodeStats
nodes.summary: Per-action statistics accumulator tracking visit count and total value with mean_value and UCB1 computation for selection.

nodes.name: InformationSet
nodes.summary: Root statistics table mapping action hash to NodeStats, providing record, mean_value_for, and visits_for accessors used during ISMCTS aggregation.

nodes.name: ismcts_search_with_inference
nodes.summary: ISMCTS entry point: runs budget iterations of determinized MCTS sampling one hidden state per iteration from the belief function, then aggregates root action statistics and returns the UCB1-best action.

nodes.name: ismcts_tests.rs
nodes.summary: Unit tests for ISMCTS Phase 2 (T2.4) using a Leduc-style 2-card imperfect-information fixture; verifies the G2 gate that ISMCTS picks non-fold at least 70 percent of the time when posterior P(strong) is 0.7.

nodes.name: LeducState
nodes.summary: Mock Leduc-holdem GameState fixture with a hidden opponent card; implements InducedCwmKernel canonical bytes and drives the ISMCTS G2 play-strength tests.

nodes.name: kernel.rs
nodes.summary: InducedCwmKernel marker trait over GameState for forward models that are verifiable (pass auto-generated transition tests), committable (BLAKE3 over canonical bytes), and hot-swappable.

nodes.name: InducedCwmKernel
nodes.summary: Marker trait adding canonical_bytes and commitment capability to a GameState impl, forming the verifiable and committable contract for an induced Code World Model.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: induced_cwm module barrel: re-exports the kernel, commitment, belief, hot-swap, ISMCTS, tournament, and transition-test primitives that constitute the open half of the Code World Model Super-GOAT (Plan 296, arxiv 2510.04542).
nodes.languageNotes: Rust module root that aggregates nine sibling files via mod + pub use, declaring no types of its own.

nodes.name: tests.rs
nodes.summary: Phase 1 unit tests for the induced CWM kernel primitive using a mock counter-game domain; exercises the G1 verifiability gate and G4 commitment integrity gate with deterministic BLAKE3 and canonical-bytes assertions.

nodes.name: MockCounterState
nodes.summary: Mock u32-counter GameState fixture where each kernel advances the counter by a per-kernel step_size; used to verify that InducedCwmKernel passes its own trajectory-derived transition tests.

nodes.name: tournament.rs
nodes.summary: Value Function Tournament arena-play selector over StateHeuristic candidates for the CWM G2 prime play-strength GOAT gate; round-robin matches rank candidates by win-rate versus baseline, tie-broken by head-to-head.

nodes.name: PlayerStats
nodes.summary: Per-candidate accumulator tracking games played, wins, losses, draws, and cumulative reward; exposes win_rate and avg_reward accessors plus a Display formatter for rankings.

nodes.name: ValueFnTournament
nodes.summary: Round-robin arena-play orchestrator that wraps each StateHeuristic candidate into an MCTS-based policy, plays head-to-head matches, and returns the win-rate-ranked TournamentWinner.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Tournament entry point that plays every candidate against every other and the baseline under a ply cap, then assembles the full ranking and returns the TournamentWinner.

nodes.name: unit_test.rs
nodes.summary: TransitionUnitTest primitive: auto-generated (pre-state, action, expected-post-state, optional legal-actions) regression tests produced from observed trajectories, implementing the G1 verifiability gate for induced kernels.

nodes.name: TransitionUnitTest
nodes.summary: Struct holding one (pre, action, expected_post, optional expected_legal_actions) tuple plus the kernel step_size used to derive a precise failure diff when a kernel fails to reproduce an observed transition.

nodes.name: verify_transition
nodes.summary: Runs a single TransitionUnitTest against a kernel and returns Ok(()) on exact reproduction or a TransitionTestFailure carrying the precise diff when the kernel diverges.

nodes.name: make_transition_tests_from_trajectory
nodes.summary: Walks an observed (state, action) trajectory and emits one TransitionUnitTest per step, forming the auto-generated regression suite a correctly-induced kernel must pass 100 percent of.

nodes.name: irrep_pruner.rs
nodes.summary: Spectral Irrep Pruner: speculative-decoding constraint pruner that runs a 1D FFT over the logit vector and uses spectral flatness to decide whether the distribution is converged (allow all tokens) or uncertain (restrict to top-k).
nodes.languageNotes: Implements the crate's ConstraintPruner trait; the FFT-based spectral_flatness computation uses a pre-allocated scratch buffer for a zero-alloc hot path.

nodes.name: spectral_flatness
nodes.summary: Computes the spectral flatness ratio (geometric mean over arithmetic mean) on the magnitude spectrum of a 1D FFT of the logit vector, returning a value in [0,1] where high indicates converged (peaked) logits.

nodes.name: IrrepPruner
nodes.summary: Main pruner struct implementing ConstraintPruner; caches the current spectral flatness on set_logits and admits all tokens when flatness exceeds threshold or restricts to a precomputed top-k index set otherwise.

nodes.name: IrrepPrunerConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration struct for IrrepPruner carrying the spectral-flatness threshold and a with_threshold builder; default and from_config constructors are exported for wiring into the speculative decoder.

nodes.name: mcts.rs
nodes.summary: Generic game-agnostic Monte Carlo Tree Search substrate extracted from the root crate (Plan 008); operates on the GameState, RolloutPolicy, and StateHeuristic traits and is reusable by any leaf crate via cargo add katgpt-core.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses ArrayVec<usize, MAX_UNEXPANDED> for per-node unexpanded-action storage to eliminate heap allocation on the MCTS hot path; MAX_UNEXPANDED=362 covers standard Go board sizes.

nodes.name: MCTSNode
nodes.summary: Tree node storing inline state, visit count, total value, parent link, and an ArrayVec of unexpanded actions plus child indices; provides new_root, new_child, and is_fully_expanded.

nodes.name: mcts_search
nodes.summary: Public MCTS entry point with a default RandomRolloutPolicy; runs the four-phase Select-Expand-Rollout-Backprop loop under an advance() budget and returns the most-visited child action.

nodes.name: mcts_search_informed
nodes.summary: MCTS variant accepting a custom RolloutPolicy and StateHeuristic for informed search; used by the tournament and ISMCTS pipelines to plug in candidate value functions.

nodes.name: active_state.rs
nodes.summary: ActiveStateTrace trait: minimal three-scalar bridge (compression_ratio_mean, constraint_trend, hla_arousal) between MUX-Latent compression producers in riir-games and TraceInformedFeedbackBandit consumers in katgpt-pruners; placed in katgpt-core to satisfy Rust's orphan rule.
nodes.languageNotes: Exists in katgpt-core purely so the orphan rule lets riir-games impl the trait for its local ActiveStateEvent and katgpt-pruners consume it via a local wrapper.

nodes.name: ActiveStateTrace
nodes.summary: Read-only trait over a windowed active-state trace exposing three f32 scalars; implementors choose the windowing strategy (last N events, last T ticks, exponential weighting).

nodes.name: EmptyTrace
nodes.summary: No-op ActiveStateTrace stub returning zero scalars; used as a default in tests and in contexts where no producer is wired.

nodes.name: indicator_cascade.rs
nodes.summary: Indicator Cascade two-stage verifier escalation: stage-1 IndicatorProbeBank OR-fuses probe fires online, stage-2 IndicatorVerifier adjudicates only flagged candidates; ships the trait plus AlwaysConfirm and AlwaysReject stubs, leaving the real LLM-judge impl to riir-ai.

nodes.name: IndicatorVerifier
nodes.summary: Stage-2 verifier trait object that adjudicates a flagged candidate given its firing label and per-indicator scores; returns true if confirmed misaligned, false if the flag is a false positive.

nodes.name: IndicatorCascade
nodes.summary: Composes a stage-1 IndicatorProbeBank with a stage-2 IndicatorVerifier; run() OR-fuses probe outputs and only invokes the verifier on candidates the bank flagged, achieving approximately 15x false-positive-rate reduction at modest true-positive-rate cost.

nodes.name: indicator_probe_bank.rs
nodes.summary: Defines a frozen, content-addressable IndicatorProbeBank of random projection directions and thresholds used by indicator-based speculative pruners, with blake3 hashing and a versioned binary wire format for serialization.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses PhantomMarkers for label genericity and a bespoke blake3-checksummed binary header for deterministic freeze/thaw across runs.

nodes.name: indicator_similarity.rs
nodes.summary: Builds a cosine similarity matrix over the directions in an IndicatorProbeBank and clusters near-parallel indicators to deduplicate the probe set.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module that re-exports all pruner implementations (indicator cascade/similarity/probe bank, ReMax, review metrics, active state) as the public pruners facade.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust `mod.rs` re-export pattern; the modern pub use crate::... aliases expose a stable API surface.

nodes.name: remax.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the ReMax (expected-maximum) family of analytic speculative-decoding metrics: expected max over M samples and per-action expected improvement of draft distributions.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure numerical functions; weights all logic on closed-form expectation formulas rather than simulation.

nodes.name: review_metrics.rs
nodes.summary: Accumulates metrics for speculative-decoding review passes: helpfulness/harmfulness counts, path-consistency (reward hacking vs faithful), entropy anomaly detection, emotion profile, and feature-read accounting.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy use of Display impls per summary struct and a Default-driven strategy enum for review configuration.

nodes.name: adaptive.rs
nodes.summary: Computes adaptive quasi-guidance-field weights from a drafter/oracle disagreement signal using a sigmoid-shaped confidence gate.

nodes.name: dispatch.rs
nodes.summary: Backend dispatch layer that routes QGF gradient computation across CPU SIMD, GPU batch, and Apple Neural Engine (ANE) delegates based on action-space and batch size.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses trait objects (QgfGpuDelegate / QgfAneDelegate) plus Option-backed null delegates to cleanly model absent hardware.

nodes.name: drafter.rs
nodes.summary: Quasi-guidance drafter that projects generator state into the oracle's action space, tilts logits via a Q-gradient from the oracle, and samples guided tokens at a configurable guidance period.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module re-exporting the quasi-guidance-field (QGF) submodules: adaptive weighting, backend dispatch, drafter, oracles, projector, and routing.

nodes.name: oracles.rs
nodes.summary: Concrete QGradientOracle implementations including a Bayesian Flow Network (BFN) proxy oracle that exposes returns and confidence without a learned critic.

nodes.name: projector.rs
nodes.summary: One-step and batch projection primitives that lift a SpeculativeGenerator's state into the projected action representation consumed by the QGF drafter and oracle.

nodes.name: route.rs
nodes.summary: Selects a QgfComputeRoute (CpuSimd, GpuBatch, or AneCritic) from action-space size and batch size to drive the QGF dispatch layer.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module re-exporting the speculative-decoding submodule family: QMC sampling, QMC halter, distribution sampling, and shared types.

nodes.name: qmc.rs
nodes.summary: Quasi-Monte Carlo engine for speculative noise queries: Sobol (with primitive-polynomial direction numbers), lattice, and stratified samplers, plus Gaussian inverse-CDF transforms and dyadic/block bootstrap estimators.
nodes.languageNotes: Hand-rolled GF(2) arithmetic (gcd/mulmod/powmod) is used to verify primitive polynomials for Sobol direction-number generation, avoiding external sobol tables.

nodes.name: qmc_halter.rs
nodes.summary: Statistically-grounded halter for QMC-driven speculative expansion: decides Continue/Halt/RefusedFloor per draft step using Wilson confidence intervals, union-bound ceilings, and observed hit counts.

nodes.name: sampling.rs
nodes.summary: Distribution sampling primitives for speculative decoding: standard categorical sampling, QMC-driven categorical sampling, k-sample QMC, and residual (stochastic / greedy hybrid) distribution sampling.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Shared type definitions for speculative decoding: decode-strategy enum, draft result and event logs, latency stability snapshots, SDE / marginal-fusion / KV-routing / flash-prefill / position-weighted-budget configs, conflict detectors, and tree-search trajectory credit assignment.
nodes.languageNotes: Most structs carry `default` constructors tuned for metal / long-context / short-context profiles; the TrajectoryCredit + TesNode pair implements lightweight tree-search credit propagation.

nodes.name: traits.rs
nodes.summary: Central trait and type definitions for the katgpt-core crate: ConstraintPruner hierarchy, GameState / RolloutPolicy abstractions, Leo/Uvfa heads, DualLeoMixer, AutocurriculumSampler, SpeculativeGenerator, QGradientOracle, and BestBuddyAligner used throughout the workspace.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses default-method-heavy traits (ConstraintPruner, QGradientOracle) so implementations only override what they need; ActingMode/AlphaSchedule enums parametrize the DualLeoMixer.

nodes.name: from_frozen_bytes
nodes.summary: Deserializes an IndicatorProbeBank from its blake3-checksummed binary wire format, validating magic, version, dimensions, and hash before reconstructing directions and thresholds.

nodes.name: IndicatorProbeBank
nodes.summary: Frozen bank of random projection directions and per-direction thresholds that scores state/label pairs for indicator-based speculative pruning; supports fused OR-fire activation and content-addressed freeze/thaw.

nodes.name: cluster
nodes.summary: Greedy clustering of indicator directions by intra-cluster cosine similarity, producing a deduplicated representative probe set from the similarity matrix.

nodes.name: from_bank
nodes.summary: Constructs an IndicatorSimilarityMatrix by computing all pairwise cosine similarities between the directions of a probe bank.

nodes.name: expected_improvement_per_action_inplace
nodes.summary: In-place variant of per-action expected-improvement computation that writes the ReMax improvement of draft distribution q over prior pi (for M samples) into a caller-supplied output buffer, avoiding allocations.

nodes.name: expected_improvement
nodes.summary: Closed-form expected improvement of sampling from q versus pi under the expected-max-over-M metric, used to rank speculative draft candidates.

nodes.name: ReviewMetrics
nodes.summary: Aggregator for speculative-decoding review-pass metrics: tracks helpful/harmful counts, path-consistency (reward hacking vs faithful), entropy anomalies, emotion profile, and detection-vs-prediction feature reads.

nodes.name: summary
nodes.summary: Computes a ReviewSummary snapshot (helpfulness, harmfulness, benefit ratio, path tallies) from the accumulated review metrics.

nodes.name: ReviewSummary
nodes.summary: Snapshot struct summarizing the value of a speculative review pass: helpfulness/harmfulness rates, benefit ratio, and outcome category tallies.

nodes.name: adaptive_guidance_weight
nodes.summary: Maps a drafter/oracle confidence signal to a quasi-guidance weight via a sigmoid gate parameterized by threshold and steepness.

nodes.name: dispatch_batch
nodes.summary: Routes a batched QGF gradient computation across CPU SIMD, GPU, or ANE backends based on the selected compute route, dispatching into per-backend inner implementations.

nodes.name: dispatch_single
nodes.summary: Single-sample variant of the QGF backend dispatch; selects GPU/ANE/CPU path based on availability and writes the gradient into the provided output buffer.

nodes.name: QGuidedDrafter
nodes.summary: Quasi-guidance drafter wrapping a SpeculativeGenerator and QGradientOracle: projects state, tilts logits by the oracle's Q-gradient at a configurable weight/period, and samples guided tokens.

nodes.name: tilt_logits_adaptive
nodes.summary: Adaptively tilts draft logits by the oracle Q-gradient using a sigmoid confidence gate parameterized by threshold and steepness, writing the tilted logits and gradient into caller-supplied buffers.

nodes.name: generate_project_tilt_sample
nodes.summary: Full guided-drafting pipeline in one call: project state, tilt logits via the oracle gradient, and sample into the provided sample buffer.

nodes.name: BfnProxyOracle
nodes.summary: QGradientOracle implementation backed by a Bayesian Flow Network proxy: exposes precomputed returns and a confidence signal without a learned critic, for QGF gradient queries.

nodes.name: project_one_step
nodes.summary: Projects a single generator state one step forward into the action representation used by the QGF drafter and oracle.

nodes.name: QgfComputeRoute
nodes.summary: Enum selecting the QGF compute backend: CpuSimd, GpuBatch, or AneCritic, chosen from action-space size and batch size by route_for.

nodes.name: SobolQmc
nodes.summary: Sobol low-discrepancy sequence generator for QMC sampling, supporting multi-dimensional draws, advance, and optional scrambling, with direction numbers derived from primitive polynomials.

nodes.name: find_primitive_poly
nodes.summary: Searches GF(2) polynomial space to find a primitive polynomial of the requested degree, used to derive Sobol direction numbers.

nodes.name: fill_noise_queries_gaussian_qmc
nodes.summary: Generates a batch of Gaussian noise queries via QMC by drawing low-discrepancy uniforms and pushing them through the inverse-normal CDF, for use in speculative sampling.

nodes.name: contiguous_block_bootstrap_pass_at_m
nodes.summary: Performs a contiguous-block bootstrap resampling pass at a given M to estimate acceptance variance for speculative QMC, returning a BootstrapEstimate.

nodes.name: QmcHalter
nodes.summary: Configurable halter that decides whether QMC-driven speculative expansion should continue, halt, or refuse the floor at each step, using target coverage and k_min/k_max bounds.

nodes.name: evaluate
nodes.summary: Evaluates whether to continue, halt, or refuse the floor for a draft step from observed hits, coverage probability, and current k, returning a QmcHaltDecision with reason.

nodes.name: sample_residual_distribution_into
nodes.summary: Stochastic-greedy hybrid sampler: writes a residual distribution combining the greedy top-1 of p with stochastic remainder from q into a caller-supplied buffer for speculative decoding.

nodes.name: sample_k_from_distribution_qmc
nodes.summary: Draws k samples from a categorical distribution using a QMC low-discrepancy uniform source instead of pseudo-random uniforms, improving coverage for speculative drafts.

nodes.name: StabilitySnapshot
nodes.summary: Snapshot of speculative-decoding latency stability, aggregating per-phase latencies into p50/p99/mean, coefficient of variation, and an overall stability score.

nodes.name: DecodeStrategy
nodes.summary: Enum of supported decode strategies (autoregressive, speculative, discrete diffusion soft/hard, self-speculation, set diffusion) with a recommend helper that picks a strategy from block size and token count.

nodes.name: FlashPrefillConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for flash prefill: block size, attention sink, sliding window, tail window, alpha blending, score reduction, and budget adaptation, with metal / long-context / short-context presets.

nodes.name: compute
nodes.summary: Computes p50/p99/mean latency, coefficient of variation, and the aggregate stability score from a slice of sorted per-phase latencies for a StabilitySnapshot.

nodes.name: allocate
nodes.summary: Distributes a total speculative budget across tree depths using a gamma position-weighting scheme, respecting the per-depth minimum and the configured max depth.

nodes.name: from_trajectory_scores
nodes.summary: Constructs a TrajectoryCredit from per-trajectory scores, recording best/worst trajectories and indices for downstream credit assignment.

nodes.name: ConstraintPruner
nodes.summary: Core trait for speculative constraint pruners: validates candidate tokens (single and batch), propagates constraints across decoding steps, and exposes optional manifold-score / constraint-vector / reject-confidence hooks.
nodes.languageNotes: Default method implementations make every method optional, enabling lightweight NoPruner / NullPruner stand-ins.

nodes.name: GameState
nodes.summary: Trait抽象ing an environment/game state for planning: enumerates available actions, advances state, reports terminal status and reward, and exposes action-space size and tick budget.

nodes.name: DualLeoMixer
nodes.summary: Mixer that combines Leo (learned-oracle) and Uvfa (unified value-function-approximator) heads via a configurable alpha schedule and acting mode (Lc / LeoOnly / UvfaOnly / Max / Min), with behavioral-cloning config.

nodes.name: AutocurriculumSampler
nodes.summary: Self-play autocurriculum goal sampler that tracks observed goals, optionally restricts sampling to previously-seen goals, and accumulates per-episode completion counts for curriculum progression.

nodes.name: QGradientOracle
nodes.summary: Trait for oracles that provide a Q-gradient signal at a (state, projected-action) pair for quasi-guidance drafter tilt, plus a confidence estimate; backed by a default NoGuidanceOracle null implementation.

nodes.name: best_buddies
nodes.summary: Computes mutual best-buddy pairs from Pearson correlation rows, used by BestBuddyAligner to measure agreement between draft and verification distributions.

nodes.name: backend.rs
nodes.summary: Compute-backend selection enum (Cpu/Simd/Gpu) plus a dispatch helper that picks a backend from cell count and GPU availability.
nodes.languageNotes: C-like enum with helper function rather than trait objects; zero-overhead backend dispatch.

nodes.name: DecBackend
nodes.summary: Enum listing the three compute backends (CPU scalar, SIMD, GPU) used to dispatch hot DEC kernels.

nodes.name: select_backend
nodes.summary: Heuristic dispatcher that returns the best DecBackend based on cell count and whether a GPU is available.

nodes.name: bom_heat_kernel.rs
nodes.summary: Multi-hypothesis (Bag-of-Modes) heat-kernel trajectory sampler: perturbs near-harmonic eigenmodes to emit k candidate trajectories for speculative decoding.
nodes.languageNotes: "_into" suffix is the project-wide convention for in-place, allocation-free variants that take preallocated output and scratch buffers.

nodes.name: near_harmonic_indices
nodes.summary: Selects eigenvalue indices that lie within a tolerance band of integer harmonics, identifying modes that contribute most to long-range heat diffusion.

nodes.name: heat_kernel_trajectory_bom
nodes.summary: Allocating wrapper that produces k perturbed heat-kernel trajectories from a base eigendecomposition for speculative decoding hypotheses.

nodes.name: heat_kernel_trajectory_bom_into
nodes.summary: In-place multi-hypothesis trajectory sampler that writes k perturbed trajectories into a preallocated output, reusing scratch buffers across calls.

nodes.name: cache.rs
nodes.summary: Memoization layer for Hodge decomposition and Betti numbers: topology-version-keyed caches plus a dirty-region tracker that invalidates entries when faces are removed.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust idiom: separate DirtyRegion struct composes cleanly into DecCache via field embedding; both implement Default.

nodes.name: DirtyRegion
nodes.summary: Tracks the set of faces and vertices changed since a topology version, enabling incremental cache invalidation.

nodes.name: DecCache
nodes.summary: Topology-versioned memoization store for Hodge components and Betti numbers, with embedded DirtyRegion for targeted invalidation.

nodes.name: hodge_decompose_cached
nodes.summary: Cache-aware wrapper around hodge_decompose: returns stored components when the topology version matches, otherwise recomputes and stores.

nodes.name: affected_vertices
nodes.summary: Walks a face's boundary edges/vertices to compute the vertex set touched by a removal, used to grow the dirty region.

nodes.name: flow.rs
nodes.summary: Helmholtz-Hodge decomposition of edge-flow fields into exact (gradient), coexact (curl), and harmonic components, packaged as a DecFlowField with topology-version-aware recomputation.
nodes.languageNotes: DecFlowField uses interior mutability pattern: compute/recompute_if_dirty check topology_version against the cell complex.

nodes.name: DecFlowField
nodes.summary: Owns the exact/coexact/harmonic/combined flow vectors for a decomposed edge field, plus the topology version they were computed at.

nodes.name: compute
nodes.summary: Full Helmholtz-Hodge decomposition: applies d₀ to the potential then splits the resulting edge field via hodge_decompose.

nodes.name: recompute_if_dirty
nodes.summary: Re-runs compute only when the cell complex's topology version has advanced since the last decomposition.

nodes.name: to_flow_vectors
nodes.summary: Serializes the decomposed exact/coexact/harmonic/combined flows into flat vectors for downstream consumption.

nodes.name: exact_flow
nodes.summary: Standalone accessor returning the exact (gradient) component of a potential field.

nodes.name: coexact_flow
nodes.summary: Standalone accessor returning the coexact (curl) component of an edge field.

nodes.name: harmonic_flow
nodes.summary: Standalone accessor returning the harmonic (kernel of Δ) component of an edge field.

nodes.name: solve_grid_width
nodes.summary: Recovers the grid width from the vertex count and a weighted-cell sum, used to sanity-check 2D grid complexes.

nodes.name: heat_kernel.rs
nodes.summary: Heat-kernel action expm(-tΔ)h on cochain fields: dense eigenbasis path for small rank and Krylov-subspace expmv path for large complexes, each with allocation-free _into variants.
nodes.languageNotes: Trajectory API branches on complex size: linear (dense V expm(-tΛ)Vᵀ) below a rank threshold, Krylov (Arnoldi expmv) above it.

nodes.name: DecEigendecomposition
nodes.summary: Stores eigenvalues and eigenvectors of the Hodge Laplacian for a given rank, with metadata (rank, n_cells).

nodes.name: compute
nodes.summary: Builds the eigendecomposition via Lanczos-style iteration up to k eigenpairs with a max-iter cap.

nodes.name: heat_kernel_trajectory_linear
nodes.summary: Allocating wrapper for V·expm(-tΛ)·Vᵀ·h via the dense eigenbasis.

nodes.name: heat_kernel_trajectory_linear_into
nodes.summary: In-place dense-eigenbasis heat-kernel action writing into a preallocated output buffer.

nodes.name: heat_kernel_trajectory_krylov
nodes.summary: Allocating wrapper for the Krylov-subspace approximation of expm(-tΔ)h on large complexes.

nodes.name: heat_kernel_trajectory_krylov_into
nodes.summary: In-place Krylov-subspace heat-kernel action via Arnoldi with scaling-and-squaring.

nodes.name: hodge.rs
nodes.summary: Core Hodge theory: Helmholtz-Hodge decomposition, Betti numbers via boundary-matrix rank, harmonic projectors, conjugate-gradient Poisson solver, and a deflated dense eigensolver for the Hodge Laplacian spectrum.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements both functional (free-fn) and method-based variants; the free fns are the public API while CgScratch reusable buffers avoid allocation in hot loops.

nodes.name: HodgeComponents
nodes.summary: Helmholtz-Hodge split of a cochain into exact (gradient), harmonic (kernel), and coexact (curl) components.

nodes.name: CgScratch
nodes.summary: Reusable workspace (b, r, p, ap vectors) for conjugate-gradient solves, sized via ensure(n).

nodes.name: cg_solve
nodes.summary: Allocating conjugate-gradient solve of the Poisson system for the coexact component.

nodes.name: cg_solve_scalar
nodes.summary: In-place scalar CG solve writing into x_out and reusing CgScratch; the workhorse used by hodge_decompose.

nodes.name: hodge_decompose
nodes.summary: Top-level Helmholtz-Hodge decomposition: solves for exact/coexact/harmonic components and returns them in HodgeComponents.

nodes.name: betti_numbers
nodes.summary: Computes the Betti numbers β_k by taking ranks of the boundary matrices via boundary_matrix_rank.

nodes.name: boundary_matrix_rank
nodes.summary: Numeric rank of the k-th boundary matrix via Gaussian elimination over a sparse representation.

nodes.name: harmonic_projector
nodes.summary: Projects a cochain onto the harmonic subspace (kernel of the Hodge Laplacian).

nodes.name: hodge_energy
nodes.summary: Computes the Hodge energy ½⟨ω, Δω⟩, a scalar smoothness functional.

nodes.name: hodge_residual
nodes.summary: Returns the L2 residual norm ‖Δω‖, a conservation-law violation indicator.

nodes.name: dec_relevance_score
nodes.summary: Reduces a feature vector to a scalar relevance score used for downstream motor gating.

nodes.name: hodge_eigendecomposition_full
nodes.summary: Dense eigendecomposition of the Hodge Laplacian with deflation against previously found eigenvectors.

nodes.name: hodge_spectrum
nodes.summary: Returns only the eigenvalues of the Hodge Laplacian (lightweight wrapper around the full eigendecomposition).

nodes.name: l2_norm
nodes.summary: L2 (Euclidean) norm of a slice.

nodes.name: normalize_inplace
nodes.summary: In-place L2 normalization of a slice to unit length.

nodes.name: deflate
nodes.summary: Gram-Schmidt deflation: removes components of v that lie in the given orthonormal basis.

nodes.name: htno.rs
nodes.summary: Hierarchical TN Operator (HTNO) multigrid V-cycle for cochain fields: full-weighting restriction, coarse solve, and prolongation, with a 2x2 grid coarsening pattern.
nodes.languageNotes: Name "HTNO" = Hierarchical Tensor-Network Operator; coarsen/prolongate on cochains rather than finite-element functions.

nodes.name: VCycleRestriction
nodes.summary: Maps fine vertices to coarse vertices via full-weighting restriction, exposing n_coarse_vertices and fine_vertex_of accessors.

nodes.name: VCycleScratch
nodes.summary: Reusable workspace (restricted + coarse-solved buffers) for one V-cycle iteration.

nodes.name: htno_v_cycle
nodes.summary: Allocating one V-cycle: restrict → coarse-solve → prolongate on a cochain field.

nodes.name: htno_v_cycle_into
nodes.summary: In-place V-cycle writing the refined field into a preallocated output, reusing VCycleScratch.

nodes.name: grid_coarsen_2x2
nodes.summary: Builds the 2x2 full-weighting restriction pattern for a (w,h) grid.

nodes.name: krylov.rs
nodes.summary: Krylov-subspace matrix-exponential action (expmv) via Arnoldi iteration with scaling-and-squaring, plus a small dense Padé-style expm and matrix helpers.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements Al-Mohy–Higham style expmv: chooses scaling factor from ||A|| and a Taylor truncation parameter.

nodes.name: krylov_expmv
nodes.summary: Allocating wrapper returning expm(tA)·h via Krylov-subspace approximation.

nodes.name: krylov_expmv_into
nodes.summary: In-place Arnoldi-based expmv writing into a preallocated output, with internal scaling-and-squaring.

nodes.name: expm_small
nodes.summary: Dense Padé-style matrix exponential for small matrices used in the Krylov projection step.

nodes.name: matmul
nodes.summary: Dense matrix-matrix multiply helper for square row-major f64 matrices.

nodes.name: inf_norm
nodes.summary: Infinity norm (max absolute row sum) of a dense matrix, used for scaling-and-squaring.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for katgpt-dec: declares all modules, re-exports the public DEC API surface, and feature-gates the motor_gated module (Plan 357).
nodes.languageNotes: Crate docs at top declare "Discrete Exterior Calculus substrate" and the dₖ₊₁∘dₖ=0 conservation guarantee. The motor_gated module lives behind the `motor_gated_field` feature.

nodes.name: motor_gated.rs
nodes.summary: Amari-style motor-gated neural-field evolution step that fuses Hodge-Laplacian diffusion with a per-channel ReLU-gated motor gain (Plan 357; opt-in via motor_gated_field feature).
nodes.languageNotes: Single Euler-style time-step unifies the linear Hodge Laplacian with a learned per-channel gain, preserving conservation when relu_slope=0.

nodes.name: relu_gate_into
nodes.summary: In-place ReLU activation with configurable negative slope, applied per channel to a cochain field.

nodes.name: evolve_motor_gated_field
nodes.summary: One motor-gated evolution time-step: applies the Hodge Laplacian, then ReLU-gates each channel by the motor vector, writing into preallocated scratch.

nodes.name: nonlinear_heat_kernel.rs
nodes.summary: Nonlinear heat-kernel trajectory via Gauss-Legendre quadrature of the Duhamel/source expansion, with optional ReLU gating applied per quadrature node.
nodes.languageNotes: Duhamel principle: u(t) = expm(-tL)u(0) + ∫₀ᵗ expm(-(t-s)L)·N(u(s))ds, approximated by n-point Gauss-Legendre quadrature.

nodes.name: NonlinearScratch
nodes.summary: Reusable per-quadrature-node workspace (h_s, r_s, n_s, m_s vectors) for the nonlinear trajectory integrator.

nodes.name: gauss_legendre_nodes_weights
nodes.summary: Computes n-point Gauss-Legendre nodes and weights on [0,1] via Newton iteration on the Jacobi-matrix eigenvalues.

nodes.name: resize_field
nodes.summary: Resizes a cochain field to a new rank/dim/length, reallocating only when capacity is exceeded.

nodes.name: expm_source_term_quadrature
nodes.summary: Weighted quadrature sum of the nonlinear source term evaluated at Gauss-Legendre nodes, with optional ReLU gating per node.

nodes.name: heat_kernel_trajectory_nonlinear
nodes.summary: Allocating wrapper for the nonlinear heat-kernel trajectory with n-quadrature-point source-term evaluation.

nodes.name: heat_kernel_trajectory_nonlinear_into
nodes.summary: In-place nonlinear trajectory integrator writing into a preallocated output and reusing NonlinearScratch.

nodes.name: operators.rs
nodes.summary: Discrete exterior calculus operators on cell complexes: exterior derivative dₖ (gradient/curl/divergence), codifferential δₖ, Hodge Laplacian Δₖ = δd + dδ, and graph Laplacian (general + grid + edge-list fast paths).
nodes.languageNotes: Each operator has an allocating version and an `_into` in-place version that takes caller-provided scratch buffers; the in-place variants are the ones used in hot loops.

nodes.name: exterior_derivative
nodes.summary: Allocating dₖ operator: rank-k → rank-(k+1) coboundary (gradient/curl/divergence depending on rank).

nodes.name: exterior_derivative_into
nodes.summary: In-place dₖ writing into a caller-provided output buffer, dispatching on rank.

nodes.name: codifferential
nodes.summary: Allocating δₖ operator: adjoint of dₖ, rank-k → rank-(k-1).

nodes.name: codifferential_into
nodes.summary: In-place δₖ writing into a caller-provided output buffer.

nodes.name: hodge_laplacian
nodes.summary: Allocating Δₖ = δₖ₊₁dₖ + dₖ₋₁δₖ (Hodge Laplacian) composition.

nodes.name: hodge_laplacian_into
nodes.summary: In-place Δₖ composition that reuses caller-provided scratch buffers for intermediate d and δ results.

nodes.name: graph_laplacian
nodes.summary: Allocating standard graph Laplacian L = D - A applied to a rank-0 potential.

nodes.name: graph_laplacian_into
nodes.summary: In-place graph Laplacian on a rank-0 potential writing into a caller-provided output.

nodes.name: graph_laplacian_edge_list_into
nodes.summary: Edge-list fast path for the graph Laplacian: iterates edges directly without building an adjacency matrix.

nodes.name: graph_laplacian_grid_into
nodes.summary: Specialized 2D-grid fast path for the graph Laplacian exploiting the regular 4-neighbour stencil.

nodes.name: point_sampler.rs
nodes.summary: Continuous-space sampling of cochain fields at arbitrary (x,y) points via bilinear (quad) and barycentric (triangular) interpolation, with pluggable local-coordinate encodings (raw, cartesian sincos, barycentric CDF).
nodes.languageNotes: Sample-on-point pattern bridges the discrete cochain (cell-indexed) representation with continuous (x,y) query points needed by the pointwise neural operator.

nodes.name: LocalCoordEncode
nodes.summary: Enum selecting how a local coordinate is encoded for the neural operator: Raw, CartesianSincos, or BarycentricSortCdf.

nodes.name: PointSamplerScratch
nodes.summary: Reusable workspace (state + local_coord) for the point sampler, resizable via resize().

nodes.name: locate_grid_point
nodes.summary: Finds the grid cell containing (px,py) and returns its integer floor coordinates.

nodes.name: sample_point_quad_into
nodes.summary: Top-level quad-mesh sampler dispatch: locates the cell, computes the local coordinate encoding, and interpolates the field.

nodes.name: sample_point_tri_into
nodes.summary: Top-level triangle-mesh sampler dispatch: locates the triangle, computes barycentric coords, and interpolates.

nodes.name: sample_cochain_at_point_quad_into
nodes.summary: Low-level bilinear interpolator writing the sampled feature vector into a preallocated output.

nodes.name: sample_cochain_at_point_tri_into
nodes.summary: Low-level barycentric interpolator over triangle vertex features, writing into a preallocated output.

nodes.name: local_coordinate_aug_cartesian
nodes.summary: Augments a local (u,v) coordinate with sincos features into a caller-provided output.

nodes.name: local_coordinate_aug_barycentric
nodes.summary: Augments sorted barycentric coordinates with a piecewise-linear CDF encoding.

nodes.name: triangular_cdf
nodes.summary: Piecewise-linear CDF of a triangular distribution parameterized by (left, mode, right), used for barycentric encoding.

nodes.name: sheaf_admm.rs
nodes.summary: Sheaf-ADMM consensus optimization on cell complexes: SheafMaps constructors (identity, selector, per-edge, top-k), local objectives (diagonal quadratic + L1), four step variants (standard, soft-thresholded, conjugate-gradient), and three sheaf-Laplacian matvec builders.
nodes.languageNotes: ADMM = Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers; the 'sheaf' prefix means constraints live on edge-vertex restriction maps of a cellular sheaf.

nodes.name: SheafMaps
nodes.summary: Cell-local restriction/projection maps between vertex stalks and edge stalks; constructors select identity, fixed-selector, per-edge, or top-k patterns.

nodes.name: LocalObjective
nodes.summary: Enum of per-edge local cost functions: diagonal quadratic or diagonal quadratic + L1.

nodes.name: AdmmScratch
nodes.summary: Reusable workspace (edge projections, sheaf-Laplacian output, warm-start rhs, and CG buffers) for ADMM iterations.

nodes.name: identity
nodes.summary: Builds SheafMaps where every edge restriction is the identity (no cross-vertex coupling).

nodes.name: selector
nodes.summary: Builds SheafMaps where every edge selects the same subset of vertex dimensions.

nodes.name: selector_per_edge
nodes.summary: Builds SheafMaps where each edge has its own per-edge selector index set.

nodes.name: selector_per_edge_topk
nodes.summary: Builds SheafMaps where each edge selects its top-k scoring vertex dimensions (sparse attention-style).

nodes.name: sheaf_admm_step
nodes.summary: Allocating one standard ADMM consensus step (x-update, z-consensus, dual ascent).

nodes.name: sheaf_admm_step_into
nodes.summary: In-place standard ADMM step reusing AdmmScratch buffers.

nodes.name: sheaf_admm_step_soft_into
nodes.summary: In-place soft-thresholded ADMM step for L1-augmented objectives.

nodes.name: sheaf_admm_step_cg_into
nodes.summary: In-place ADMM step whose x-update is solved by conjugate-gradient for improved convergence on stiff problems.

nodes.name: x_update
nodes.summary: Inner x-update: per-cell primal minimization of (objective + rho·||x - z + u||²).

nodes.name: soft_threshold
nodes.summary: Scalar soft-thresholding (proximal operator of |·|) used by the L1 variant.

nodes.name: sheaf_laplacian_identity_grid_into
nodes.summary: Specialized sheaf-Laplacian matvec for identity sheaf maps on a 2D grid, exploiting the regular stencil.

nodes.name: sheaf_laplacian_via_maps
nodes.summary: Allocating wrapper applying the sheaf Laplacian via generic SheafMaps.

nodes.name: sheaf_laplacian_matvec
nodes.summary: In-place sheaf-Laplacian matvec L_s·z via per-edge restriction/projection, reusing edge-projection scratch.

nodes.name: simd.rs
nodes.summary: SIMD-accelerated primitives: branchless fast sigmoid (rational approximation), in-place vectorized sigmoid over a slice, and a horizontal f32 dot product.
nodes.languageNotes: Fast sigmoid uses the rational 1/(1+|x|) branchless approximation; ideal for activation-hot inner loops where std::sigmoid is too costly.

nodes.name: fast_sigmoid
nodes.summary: Branchless rational sigmoid approximation (1/(1+|x|)) returning a scalar.

nodes.name: simd_sigmoid_inplace
nodes.summary: Vectorized in-place sigmoid over a mutable slice using portable SIMD intrinsics.

nodes.name: simd_dot_f32
nodes.summary: Horizontal f32 dot product over two slices using SIMD lanes with a scalar tail.

nodes.name: stokes_calculus.rs
nodes.summary: Stokes-calculus integrals on cell complexes: belief-mass divergence, region boundary flux (with optional Hodge decomposition, plus several specialized variants), and line/circulation integrals along paths and closed loops.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements the discrete analogues of the divergence theorem and Stokes/Kelvin-Stokes theorems on the cell complex.

nodes.name: belief_mass_divergence
nodes.summary: Discrete divergence of a belief-flow field on vertices, used for evidence-mass accounting in the inference engine.

nodes.name: boundary_flux_mass
nodes.summary: Allocating divergence-theorem boundary integral of a field over a region's boundary cells.

nodes.name: boundary_flux_mass_with_decomp
nodes.summary: Boundary-flux variant that takes a precomputed Hodge decomposition to separate exact/coexact/harmonic contributions.

nodes.name: boundary_flux_mass_only
nodes.summary: Boundary-flux fast path that skips the Hodge decomposition when only the total flux is needed.

nodes.name: boundary_flux_mass_only_scratched
nodes.summary: Boundary-flux fast path reusing caller-provided in-region scratch, avoiding allocation in repeated queries.

nodes.name: boundary_flux_mass_indexed
nodes.summary: CSR-indexed boundary-flux fast path optimized for issuing many region queries in sequence.

nodes.name: line_integral
nodes.summary: Line integral of an edge field along a path of edges, summing edge-value × edge-length contributions.

nodes.name: circulation_integral
nodes.summary: Circulation of an edge field around a closed loop (Kelvin-Stokes theorem).

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Core types for the DEC substrate: oriented CellComplex (vertices/edges/faces/volumes) with CSR coboundary index and topology versioning, and CochainField (typed feature vectors on cells of a given rank).
nodes.languageNotes: Boundary operators stored in CSR-like (offset, entries) form; topology_version bumped on every remove_face/remove_cell so caches can invalidate.

nodes.name: CoboundaryIndex
nodes.summary: CSR-style (offsets, entries) index of coboundary cells, supporting O(1) lookup of cells whose boundary contains a given cell.

nodes.name: CellComplex
nodes.summary: Top-level oriented cell complex: boundary operators per rank, coboundary index, grid dimensions, and a topology_version counter for cache invalidation.

nodes.name: CochainField
nodes.summary: Typed feature vector on cells of a given rank: owns data, rank, and per-cell feature dimension.

nodes.name: grid_2d
nodes.summary: Constructs a 2D grid cell complex of width w and height h with oriented edges and faces.

nodes.name: from_edges
nodes.summary: Constructs a cell complex from a vertex count and an edge list, deriving all higher-rank structure.

nodes.name: build_coboundary_index
nodes.summary: Derives the coboundary CSR index from the boundary operators for a given rank.

nodes.name: remove_face
nodes.summary: Topology mutation: removes a face and bumps topology_version, invalidating dependent caches.

nodes.name: remove_cell
nodes.summary: Topology mutation: removes a cell of the given rank via swap-remove and rebuilds affected boundary entries.

nodes.name: swap_remove_from_boundary
nodes.summary: O(1) swap-remove helper for a (row, col) entry in the boundary operator matrices.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for katgpt-claim, the Claim-Level Reliability pair. Feature-gates and re-exports the claim_rubric (L0-L3 evidence ladder validator) and clr (sigmoid-projection vote runtime) modules.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust crate root using #[cfg(feature = ...)] to gate two sibling sub-modules; the bridge between them lives in downstream consumers, not here.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel for the claim_rubric subsystem, re-exporting checklist, types, validator, and vocabulary submodules that implement the L0-L3 evidence grading ladder.

nodes.name: checklist.rs
nodes.summary: Static lookup tables mapping each EvidenceLevel (L1-L3) to its required EvidenceItemId set, plus the four checklist sections (S1-S4). Drives the rubric's 'what evidence does level X require' queries.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure-data module returning const slices; the heavy lifting is done by callers in validator.rs.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Core domain types for the evidence ladder: EvidenceLevel enum (L0-L3), EvidenceItemId (17 rubric items), Claim builder struct, Grade result, VocabularyViolation, and ChecklistSection. The shared vocabulary every other claim_rubric file operates on.
nodes.languageNotes: Mix of newtype enums (EvidenceItemId) and builder-pattern structs (Claim::new/with_evidence/grade).

nodes.name: validator.rs
nodes.summary: ClaimValidator that grades a Claim by intersecting its satisfied evidence against the level checklist and scanning its text for vocabulary violations. Produces honest_level, missing items, and promotion advice.
nodes.languageNotes: Zero-state validator (new() takes no args); all context comes from the Claim itself plus the const checklist tables.

nodes.name: vocabulary.rs
nodes.summary: Verb-tier policy mapping claim verbs ('induces', 'causally controls', etc.) to minimum evidence levels, and the scan() function that flags any verb used above its allowed level as a VocabularyViolation.
nodes.languageNotes: Three tiered const verb lists (L1_SAFE_VERBS, L2_VERBS, L3_VERBS) drive a linear scan; case-insensitive substring matching.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel for the clr (Claim-Level Reliability) runtime, re-exporting nine sibling modules: brevity, extractor, learning_potential, mgpo, scratch, traits, types, verifier, vote.

nodes.name: brevity.rs
nodes.summary: Brevity tiebreak for vote clustering: when multiple clusters tie on reliability, prefers the cluster whose representative trajectory has fewer tokens/steps.

nodes.name: extractor.rs
nodes.summary: FnClaimExtractor, a generic closure-based implementation of the ClaimExtractor trait that wraps user-supplied extractor functions for use in the vote pipeline.
nodes.languageNotes: Generic over M (metadata) and F (extractor closure) with PhantomData to satisfy the borrow checker.

nodes.name: learning_potential.rs
nodes.summary: Information-theoretic helpers: learning_potential() (mean negative log-prob over a sequence, a surprise signal) and should_write_memory() (gates freeze/thaw writes by reliability and curiosity thresholds).

nodes.name: mgpo.rs
nodes.summary: Mixed-Geometric Policy Optimization (MGPO) sampling weights and SIMD-accelerated budget allocation. The weight function exp(-gamma*|2p-1|) peaks at p=0.5 (maximum uncertainty) and decays toward confident extremes.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses katgpt_core::simd::simd_sum_f32 for the weight normalization in allocate_budget.

nodes.name: scratch.rs
nodes.summary: ClrScratch, reusable per-call buffers (verdicts, reliability, cluster_id) for the vote runtime. reset_for(k, m) resizes without reallocating to amortize cost across votes.

nodes.name: traits.rs
nodes.summary: Core CLR traits: ClaimExtractor (trajectory -> claims), ClaimVerifier (claim+direction -> sigmoid score), and DirectionVectorSource (named latent directions with blake3 versioning).

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Core CLR data structures: ClrConfig (9 vote knobs with defaults), Claim (embedding+payload), Trajectory, Cluster, and VoteResult. The shared vocabulary the vote pipeline operates on.
nodes.languageNotes: ClrConfig::default pins the canonical hyperparameters (k, m, tau_v, tau_reliable, tau_curiosity, alpha_freeze_thaw, gamma_mgpo, lambda_long2short, tiebreak_eps).

nodes.name: verifier.rs
nodes.summary: SigmoidProjectionVerifier implementing ClaimVerifier: projects a claim embedding onto a stored direction vector via SIMD dot product and returns sigmoid(dot). Also provides FlatDirections storage and a blake3 version helper.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses katgpt_core::simd::simd_dot_f32 for the projection; deliberately sigmoid (not softmax) so each claim is scored independently.

nodes.name: vote.rs
nodes.summary: Main CLR entrypoints: clr_vote and clr_vote_minimal. For each trajectory, extract claims, verify against directions, reliability-gate the mean verdict, group trajectories into outcome clusters, and pick a winner with brevity tiebreak.
nodes.languageNotes: Reuses ClrScratch to avoid per-call allocation; clr_vote_minimal is a leaner variant that elides the brevity tiebreak for hot paths.

nodes.name: requirements
nodes.summary: Returns the const slice of EvidenceItemId values required for a given EvidenceLevel (L1/L2/L3 levels are cumulative).

nodes.name: section_items
nodes.summary: Returns the const list of EvidenceItemId values belonging to a given ChecklistSection (S1-S4).

nodes.name: full_checklist
nodes.summary: Returns all four ChecklistSections in canonical order (S1-S4) for display or promotion-advice generation.

nodes.name: EvidenceLevel
nodes.summary: Enum encoding the four-step evidence ladder (L0=None, L1=Detection, L2=Functional, L3=Causal). Carries human-readable label() and description() accessors.

nodes.name: Claim
nodes.summary: Builder-pattern struct representing a single claim: text + feature_class + declared evidence level + satisfied evidence items. new/with_evidence/grade chain produces a Grade via ClaimValidator.

nodes.name: Grade
nodes.summary: Result of grading a Claim: honest_level (capped by evidence), missing items for declared level, vocabulary violations, and a downgrade flag.

nodes.name: VocabularyViolation
nodes.summary: Records a single vocabulary policy breach: the offending verb, where it was found (level), and the maximum level where that verb is permitted.

nodes.name: ClaimValidator
nodes.summary: Zero-state validator exposing grade(), passes(), promote_advice(), and evidence_level(). Grades a Claim by intersecting satisfied evidence with the level checklist and scanning text for vocabulary violations.

nodes.name: grade
nodes.summary: Grades a Claim: computes evidence_level from satisfied items, finds missing items for the declared level, scans for vocabulary violations, and downgrades honest_level when violations are present.

nodes.name: promote_advice
nodes.summary: Returns human-readable advice on how to promote a Claim to its declared level: for each missing EvidenceItemId, emits 'to upgrade to {target}, add evidence for: {desc}'.

nodes.name: evidence_level
nodes.summary: Given a satisfied evidence set, returns the highest EvidenceLevel whose requirements are fully met (L0 if none).

nodes.name: scan
nodes.summary: Scans claim text for any verb whose minimum allowed level exceeds the provided evidence_level, returning a VocabularyViolation per offender.

nodes.name: min_level_for_verb
nodes.summary: Looks up the minimum EvidenceLevel at which a verb may be used, by checking membership in L1_SAFE_VERBS, L2_VERBS, L3_VERBS in order.

nodes.name: brevity_tiebreak
nodes.summary: Given candidate cluster indices with equal reliability, returns the index of the cluster whose representative trajectory has the fewest tokens/steps. Falls back to first-encountered on full tie.

nodes.name: FnClaimExtractor
nodes.summary: Generic closure-based ClaimExtractor impl: wraps a user-supplied fn(&Trajectory) -> Vec<Claim>. The default adapter used by tests and minimal pipelines.

nodes.name: learning_potential
nodes.summary: Returns the mean negative log-prob over a sequence (sampled at log_prob_at), an information-theoretic surprise signal used to gate freeze/thaw memory writes.

nodes.name: allocate_budget
nodes.summary: Distributes an integer total_budget across weighted candidates proportionally using SIMD-accelerated summation, with floor rounding and saturating remainder distribution.

nodes.name: mgpo_sampling_weight
nodes.summary: MGPO sampling weight function exp(-gamma*|2p-1|), which peaks at p=0.5 (maximum uncertainty) and decays toward either confident extreme.

nodes.name: ClrScratch
nodes.summary: Reusable per-call buffers for the vote pipeline (verdicts, reliability, cluster_id). new() preallocates and reset_for(k,m) clears/resizes in place to amortize across votes.

nodes.name: ClaimExtractor
nodes.summary: Trait abstracting the extraction of Claim vectors from a Trajectory. Implemented by FnClaimExtractor and downstream domain-specific extractors.

nodes.name: ClaimVerifier
nodes.summary: Trait abstracting claim verification: given a claim and a direction index, returns a sigmoid score in [0,1]. Implemented by SigmoidProjectionVerifier.

nodes.name: DirectionVectorSource
nodes.summary: Trait for a named bank of latent direction vectors with direction(), a blake3 content hash, and a version tag for cache invalidation.

nodes.name: ClrConfig
nodes.summary: Nine-knob configuration for the CLR vote pipeline: cluster count k, claims-per-trajectory m, reliability/curiosity thresholds, freeze/thaw alpha, MGPO gamma, long-to-short lambda, and tiebreak epsilon.

nodes.name: VoteResult
nodes.summary: Output of clr_vote: the winning Cluster, all clusters, per-trajectory reliability scores, and per-trajectory verdicts.

nodes.name: SigmoidProjectionVerifier
nodes.summary: ClaimVerifier impl that scores a claim by sigmoid(dot(claim_embedding, direction_vector)). Holds a DirectionVectorSource and direction_dim; verify() indexes a direction and runs a SIMD dot followed by the sigmoid.

nodes.name: verify
nodes.summary: Computes sigmoid(simd_dot(claim.embedding, directions[direction_idx])) in [0,1]. Independent per-claim scoring (not softmax) so reliability aggregates freely.

nodes.name: clr_vote
nodes.summary: Main CLR entrypoint: extract+verify claims per trajectory, reliability-gate the mean verdict, group trajectories into outcome clusters, and pick a winner via brevity tiebreak. Writes through ClrScratch and returns a VoteResult.

nodes.name: clr_vote_minimal
nodes.summary: Leaner variant of clr_vote that skips the brevity tiebreak and cluster-build step, used on hot paths where the winner is the sole cluster of flawless trajectories.

nodes.name: assign_clusters
nodes.summary: Groups trajectory indices into clusters by outcome equality (using the caller-supplied outcome_eq predicate), assigning wrapping-add cluster IDs into the scratch buffer.

nodes.name: build_clusters
nodes.summary: Materializes Cluster records from the cluster_id assignment: per-cluster member lists, total reliability, and the representative (highest-reliability) member index.

nodes.name: integration_tests.rs
nodes.summary: Integration test suite for the AlienSampler primitive: verifies determinism, beta-blend extremes (β=0 coherence-only, β=1 availability-only), z-score edge cases, median-of-top-m invariants, and that ranked output is a permutation of input indices carrying no embedding.
nodes.languageNotes: Ships a tiny local LCG RNG (class Lcg) and a DotCoherence helper so tests stay fully deterministic with no external rand dependency.

nodes.name: median_top_m.rs
nodes.summary: Implements MedianTopMAvailability, the load-bearing availability scorer from arXiv:2603.01092: for each candidate it computes cosine similarity against a row-major community bank, partial-sorts the top-m via select_nth_unstable, and returns the median — the exact rule the paper's ablation shows is non-substitutable.
nodes.languageNotes: Stores the bank row-major with precomputed inverse norms; availability_embedded_with_scratch takes a caller-owned cosine scratch buffer so the per-candidate hot path allocates nothing.

nodes.name: MedianTopMAvailability
nodes.summary: Availability scorer that keeps a row-major community-embedding bank with cached inverse norms and computes per-candidate availability as the median of the top-m cosine similarities, with batched and scratch-taking entry points for zero-allocation hot paths.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a MedianTopMAvailability from a jagged community bank (Vec<Vec<f32>>), flattening it row-major, validating uniform dimension and finite values, and precomputing per-row norms; rejects m=0.

nodes.name: from_flat_bank
nodes.summary: Constructs directly from an already-flat row-major bank with an explicit dimension, used when the caller maintains the flat representation; mirrors new() but skips the flatten step and validates length/dim alignment instead.

nodes.name: push_bank_items
nodes.summary: Incrementally appends new community embeddings to the bank, establishing the dimension on the first push and maintaining cached norms/inv-norms and scratch capacity in sync; cheaper than rebuilding via new().

nodes.name: availability_embedded_with_scratch
nodes.summary: Zero-allocation hot path: computes one candidate's availability by writing cosine products into a caller-owned scratch buffer, partial-sorting the top-m, and returning the median; returns 0 for empty bank or zero-norm operands.

nodes.name: availability_batch
nodes.summary: Computes availability for a batch of candidates into a caller-supplied output slice, reusing one cosine scratch buffer across candidates to avoid per-candidate allocation.

nodes.name: median_of_top_m
nodes.summary: Core math primitive: returns the median of the top-m values of a slice using select_nth_unstable_by for O(n) partial selection, then a small sort over the top-m window; falls back to max (top-1) when m=1 and to the bank-size median when m exceeds the slice length.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root and documentation hub for the Alien Sampler primitive (distilled from arXiv:2603.01092): re-exports AlienSampler, MedianTopMAvailability, the Coherence/Availability traits, and config/error types, and documents the Fβ=(1−β)·zC+β·zU fusion rule, GOAT gates, and the zero-allocation contract.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust barrel module: pub mod declarations plus selective pub use re-exports of the public API surface.

nodes.name: sampler.rs
nodes.summary: Implements AlienSampler<V,C,A>, the generic coherence × availability frontier ranker: takes caller-owned scratch and output buffers, computes per-axis scores, z-scores each axis over the population (with zero-variance guards), fuses via Fβ=(1−β)·zC+β·zU, and stable-sorts by total_cmp with input-index tie-break.
nodes.languageNotes: Generic over the embedding type V and the two axis scorers; rank_into is the allocation-free entry point, rank and rank_precomputed are convenience wrappers.

nodes.name: AlienSampler
nodes.summary: Generic sampler struct holding owned CoherenceScorer, AvailabilityScorer, and AlienConfig instances; main entry points are rank (allocating), rank_into (zero-alloc), and rank_precomputed (skips per-axis scoring).

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs an AlienSampler from owned coherence scorer, availability scorer, and AlienConfig; rejects β outside [0,1] with AlienSamplerError::ScratchLengthMismatch-style validation.

nodes.name: rank
nodes.summary: Convenience entry point: allocates a Vec<ScoredCandidate> of the right capacity and delegates to rank_into; suitable for cold paths where the caller does not want to manage an output buffer.

nodes.name: rank_into
nodes.summary: Zero-allocation ranking: validates scratch lengths against candidate count, splits scratch buffers in half to compute coherence and availability scores per candidate in place, then calls fuse_and_sort into the caller-owned output buffer.

nodes.name: rank_precomputed
nodes.summary: Skips per-axis scoring entirely: takes pre-computed coherence and availability score slices (e.g. cached or externally produced) and only runs the fuse_and_sort stage — useful when scores are reused across calls.

nodes.name: fuse_and_sort
nodes.summary: Core fusion kernel: z-scores both axes via mean_std_population, computes Fβ=(1−β)·zC+β·zU per candidate using mul_add for numerical stability, builds ScoredCandidate records, and stable-sorts descending by total_cmp with input-index tie-break.

nodes.name: mean_std_population
nodes.summary: Computes population mean and standard deviation of an f32 slice in a single pass, returning (0.0, 0.0) for empty input so callers can branch into the zero-variance degenerate path.

nodes.name: traits.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the two caller-implemented axis traits CoherenceScorer<V> and AvailabilityScorer<V> that the AlienSampler is generic over, plus small SumCoherence / FirstAtomAvailability / ConstAvailability reference implementations used in tests and as usage examples.
nodes.languageNotes: Each trait is a single coherence/availability fn — the two-axis decomposition is encoded entirely in the trait pair.

nodes.name: CoherenceScorer
nodes.summary: Trait abstracting the coherence axis: given a candidate embedding V, returns an f32 coherence score (higher = more on-personality / higher-guide). Caller-implemented; the sampler z-scores the result across the pool.

nodes.name: AvailabilityScorer
nodes.summary: Trait abstracting the availability axis: given a candidate embedding V, returns an f32 representing how represented the candidate is in the community repertoire; the sampler negates it to derive alien-ness. MedianTopMAvailability is the canonical implementation.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Holds the AlienSampler shared types: AlienConfig (β and top_m with paper_default/coherence_only/availability_only presets), ScoredCandidate (score + index, Ord via total_cmp), and AlienSamplerError (the ScratchLengthMismatch variant).
nodes.languageNotes: ScoredCandidate implements Ord + PartialOrd via f32::total_cmp for deterministic, NaN-safe ordering required by the sampler's stable sort.

nodes.name: AlienConfig
nodes.summary: Sampler configuration carrying β (coherence/availability blend in [0,1]) and top_m (median window size); provides paper_default (β=0.7, m=10), coherence_only (β=0), and availability_only (β=1) presets.

nodes.name: ScoredCandidate
nodes.summary: Output record pairing a fused Fβ score with the originating candidate index; Ord/PartialOrd delegate to f32::total_cmp for deterministic, NaN-safe descending sort with stable index tie-break.

nodes.name: AlienSamplerError
nodes.summary: Error enum returned by AlienSampler rank methods, currently the ScratchLengthMismatch variant raised when caller scratch buffers do not match the candidate count.

nodes.name: paper_default
nodes.summary: Returns the AlienConfig preset validated by arXiv:2603.01092: β=0.7, top_m=10, the empirically-backed frontier blend.

nodes.name: coherence_only
nodes.summary: Returns the β=0 AlienConfig preset used for the coherence-only baseline (motif-collapse reference) and as the upper bound for the G2 quality-preservation GOAT gate.

nodes.name: availability_only
nodes.summary: Returns the β=1 AlienConfig preset corresponding to availability-only (random-alien) ranking; used as the degenerate extreme in beta-sweep tests.

nodes.name: feedback.rs
nodes.summary: Async feedback reporter: serializes inference results with postcard and ships them to a background sender thread (lazy-initialized via a OnceLock channel) so the hot path never blocks; gated by FeedbackConfig.url and a min_reward threshold.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses std::sync::OnceLock + mpsc channel + std::thread::spawn to decouple serialization/network from the inference hot path.

nodes.name: FeedbackConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for the feedback reporter: an optional ingest URL (None disables reporting) and a min_reward threshold below which results are skipped to avoid noise.

nodes.name: get_feedback_sender
nodes.summary: Lazy-initializes and returns the global feedback mpsc Sender, spawning the background consumer thread exactly once on first call via a static OnceLock.

nodes.name: send_feedback
nodes.summary: Public entry point: postcard-serializes the result and enqueues it onto the background channel, subject to FeedbackConfig gating (URL present and reward ≥ min_reward); never blocks the caller.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for katgpt-deprecated, the exiled-primitives crate: re-exports the alien_sampler, feedback, and unit_distance modules behind their respective feature gates so dead/failed GOAT mechanisms stay zero-impact by default.
nodes.languageNotes: Each module is gated by a Cargo feature (alien_sampler, feedback, unit_distance) — the crate ships empty unless features are explicitly opted in.

nodes.name: cm_field.rs
nodes.summary: Implements CmField, the algebraic CM-field construction (Q(i), Q(√5,i), Pro-2 tower) used to refute Erdős's 1946 unit-distance conjecture: composes a Minkowski lattice and a ClassGroupPigeonhole, exposes delta/unit-count verification, and ships split-prime enumeration + class-number bounds + δ-optimization helpers.
nodes.languageNotes: Combines the modelless MinkowskiLattice and ClassGroupPigeonhole components with a light model-based CM-field layer to produce provable ν(n) ≥ n^(1+δ) constructions.

nodes.name: CmField
nodes.summary: Top-level CM-field struct aggregating field params, the Minkowski lattice, the class-group pigeonhole analyzer, the generated unit elements, and a human-readable name; provides factory constructors (qi, q_sqrt5_i, pro2_tower_base, from_params) and a verify_all() audit returning a FieldVerification.

nodes.name: FieldVerification
nodes.summary: Audit record produced by CmField::verify_all: carries the field name, δ value, unit count vs lower bound, and pass/fail flags for split-prime validity, unit-on-circle, projection injectivity, and pigeonhole bound — rendered via its Display impl.

nodes.name: qi
nodes.summary: Factory constructing a CmField for Q(i) parameterized by a caller-chosen list of split primes: builds the Gaussian Minkowski lattice, instantiates the class-group pigeonhole, generates unit elements, and labels the field "Q(i)".

nodes.name: q_sqrt5_i
nodes.summary: Factory constructing a CmField for Q(√5, i) parameterized by split primes and a denominator: builds the Q(√5,i) Minkowski lattice, runs the pigeonhole, generates units, and labels the field "Q(√5, i)".

nodes.name: pro2_tower_base
nodes.summary: Factory constructing the base field of a Pro-2 tower (a 2-adic tower construction) by deriving the lattice from field params and running the pigeonhole unit generator; the seed for the higher-stage tower search.

nodes.name: from_params
nodes.summary: Generic factory building a CmField from arbitrary CmFieldParams and a list of per-prime exponents (defaulting missing exponents to 1): used by tower-search arms to materialize candidate field constructions for δ evaluation.

nodes.name: verify_all
nodes.summary: Runs the full GOAT audit on a CmField: split-prime validity, units-on-circle check, projection injectivity, δ positivity, and the pigeonhole bound, packaging the results into a FieldVerification record.

nodes.name: generate_point_set
nodes.summary: Materializes a planar point set from the CM-field lattice by enumerating polydisc points and projecting to the plane; the input to count_unit_distances for empirical ν(n) measurement.

nodes.name: enumerate_split_primes
nodes.summary: Number-theory helper: returns all primes p ≤ limit with p ≡ 1 (mod 4) (the split primes in Q(i)), via a Sieve of Eratosthenes; the input space for δ optimization.

nodes.name: select_split_primes
nodes.summary: Returns the first n split primes using a prime-number-theorem-derived upper bound for the sieve limit; convenience wrapper around enumerate_split_primes for callers that just want n primes.

nodes.name: class_number_bound
nodes.summary: Analytic number-theory helper: computes the Minkowski-style upper bound on the class number h_K from the root discriminant and field degree using the standard (π/4)^(d/2) · √|D| / (...) formula; feeds the pigeonhole lower bound on distinct unit elements.

nodes.name: compare_delta
nodes.summary: Ranks a collection of CM fields by their δ estimate (descending) — used to compare Q(i), Q(√5,i), and tower-base constructions when selecting the best field for a given target dimension.

nodes.name: minkowski.rs
nodes.summary: Implements MinkowskiLattice, the modelless high-dimensional lattice component of the unit-distance proof: stores basis/min-separation/co-volume/packing parameter and provides sup-norm computation, polydisc enumeration, projection-injectivity verification, and named factory constructors (gaussian, erdos_grid, q_sqrt5_i, from_field_params).
nodes.languageNotes: Operates on Complex C64 vectors; the recursive enumerate_polydisc backtracking search is the core point-enumeration primitive.

nodes.name: MinkowskiLattice
nodes.summary: Modelless lattice type over complex vectors: exposes packing-bound estimation, polydisc point enumeration, projection to the plane, coset-average unit-pair counting, and several named constructors for canonical lattices (Gaussian integers, Erdős grid, Q(√5,i), generic field params).

nodes.name: from_field_params
nodes.summary: Builds a MinkowskiLattice from a CM-field dimension, root discriminant, and denominator: constructs the scaled identity basis, derives the minimum separation from the discriminant, and computes the co-volume/packing parameter from the log of 4·root_disc·denominator.

nodes.name: is_projection_injective
nodes.summary: Verifies that the lattice-to-plane projection is injective on the unit set: collects non-zero coordinate entries and checks that no two have equal or opposite real/imaginary parts in the chosen projection coordinate.

nodes.name: points_in_polydisc
nodes.summary: Enumerates lattice points inside the polydisc of the given radius via recursive backtracking (delegates to enumerate_polydisc), seeding from the origin and capacity-bounded by the polydisc_count analytic estimate.

nodes.name: enumerate_polydisc
nodes.summary: Recursive DFS backtracking search that enumerates lattice points inside the polydisc by walking integer coefficient ranges per dimension and pruning on sup-norm squared; the workhorse behind points_in_polydisc.

nodes.name: q_sqrt5_i
nodes.summary: Factory constructing a MinkowskiLattice for Q(√5, i): derives the root discriminant from √5, builds the scaled identity basis, and computes the minimum separation and packing parameter from the discriminant and a denominator argument.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for the Unit Distance GOAT proof: documents the disproof of Erdős's 1946 conjecture (ν(n) ≥ n^(1+δ)) and re-exports the four component types (MinkowskiLattice, ClassGroupPigeonhole, CmField, TowerSearch) plus shared types and helpers, all behind the unit_distance feature gate.
nodes.languageNotes: Component-type table (T1 modelless, T2 modelless, T4 light model-based, T5 model-based) in the doc comment encodes the proof's layered architecture.

nodes.name: pigeonhole.rs
nodes.summary: Implements ClassGroupPigeonhole, the modelless norm-one element counter: from field params and prime pairs it derives the unit-set lower bound (product of exponents + 1), generates concrete unit elements via sum-of-two-squares and sqrt(-1) recovery, and exposes a δ estimate from the analytic class-number bound.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure-integer number-theory helpers (sum_of_two_squares, find_sqrt_minus_one, mod_pow) implement the Cornacchia-style split-prime decomposition without external crates.

nodes.name: ClassGroupPigeonhole
