nodes.summary: Modelless analyzer holding field params and prime pairs: computes total configurations (∏(eᵢ+1)), the unit-set lower bound, the pigeonhole analyze() summary, the δ estimate, and dispatches unit generation across the Q(i), Q(√5,i), and general field families.

nodes.name: generate_unit_elements
nodes.summary: Dispatches unit-element generation to the appropriate family-specific routine (Q(i), Q(√5,i), or general) based on the stored field params, returning a Vec of complex unit elements padded to at least the pigeonhole lower bound.

nodes.name: generate_qi_units
nodes.summary: Generates unit elements for the Q(i) family: seeds from {1, i, -1, -i} base units and, for each split prime, decomposes p as a sum of two squares and synthesizes the corresponding complex unit on the unit circle, deduplicating by absolute tolerance.

nodes.name: generate_q_sqrt5_i_units
nodes.summary: Generates unit elements for the Q(√5, i) family: combines uniform-circle seeds with per-split-prime sum-of-two-squares decomposition, capping at the pigeonhole lower bound and deduplicating rotated units.

nodes.name: sum_of_two_squares
nodes.summary: Cornacchia-style decomposition: for a prime p ≡ 1 (mod 4), returns (a, b) with a² + b² = p by first recovering a square root of -1 mod p (via find_sqrt_minus_one) and then running the Euclidean-style descent.

nodes.name: find_sqrt_minus_one
nodes.summary: Recovers a square root of −1 modulo a prime p ≡ 1 (mod 4) by factoring p−1 = 2^s · q with q odd and applying the Tonelli–Shanks-style algorithm using a quadratic non-residue witness; the seed for the sum-of-two-squares descent.

nodes.name: mod_pow
nodes.summary: Pure-Rust modular exponentiation (base^exp mod m) via iterative square-and-multiply with u64 arithmetic; the building block for the Tonelli-Shanks step in find_sqrt_minus_one.

nodes.name: verify_pigeonhole_bound
nodes.summary: Audit helper: asserts that a PigeonholeResult's generated unit count meets or exceeds the analytic lower bound, returning a boolean consumed by CmField::verify_all's GOAT gate.

nodes.name: tower_search.rs
nodes.summary: Model-based UCB1 bandit search over CM-field tower parameters: generates a family of TowerArm candidates (prime-pair exponent variations), evaluates each arm's δ via a full CmField construction, and runs a TowerBandit (UCB1 with exploration constant) to converge on the highest-δ tower construction.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements the model-based T5 layer: arms materialize full CmField instances per pull, so each evaluation is a full lattice + pigeonhole construction rather than a closed-form score.

nodes.name: TowerArm
nodes.summary: A single candidate tower specification: a TowerFamily plus split primes and per-prime exponents; knows how to convert itself to CmFieldParams, build a full CmField, compute its δ, and produce a human-readable label.

nodes.name: TowerFamily
nodes.summary: Enum identifying the CM-field family (Q(i), Q(√5,i), Pro-2 tower base); carries family-level defaults for root discriminant, class number, and field degree used to seed arm generation.

nodes.name: TowerBandit
nodes.summary: UCB1 multi-armed bandit over TowerArms: tracks per-arm pull counts and cumulative rewards (δ values), selects arms via the upper-confidence-bound rule with a configurable exploration constant, and exposes best_arm / best_delta / top_k aggregations.

nodes.name: TowerSearchConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for a tower-search run: the family to search, number of arms (split-prime exponent variations), exploration constant, and budget (total pulls); ships a Default that searches the Q(√5,i) family.

nodes.name: TowerSearchResult
nodes.summary: Outcome record from a TowerSearch::run: the winning TowerArm, its δ value, total pulls, and the per-arm stats snapshot for post-hoc analysis.

nodes.name: TowerSearch
nodes.summary: Driver orchestrating a tower search: generate_arms produces the candidate TowerArm set, evaluate_arm materializes a CmField per pull to score δ, and run executes the UCB1 loop under a TowerSearchConfig budget.

nodes.name: generate_arms
nodes.summary: Static factory producing the candidate TowerArm set for a given TowerSearchConfig: enumerates split primes and constructs arms covering distinct per-prime exponent variations within the configured family.

nodes.name: evaluate_arm
nodes.summary: Materializes a TowerArm into a full CmField, runs verify_all/δ extraction, and returns the δ value used as the bandit reward signal; one full lattice + pigeonhole construction per call.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Top-level entry: builds the arm set, instantiates a TowerBandit, runs the UCB1 selection/observe loop for the configured budget, and returns a TowerSearchResult with the best arm and per-arm stats.

nodes.name: select
nodes.summary: UCB1 arm-selection rule: returns the arm index maximizing (mean_reward + c·√(ln(total_pulls)/arm_pulls)), with cold-start handling for never-pulled arms.

nodes.name: observe
nodes.summary: Updates the bandit's per-arm statistics after a pull: increments the arm's pull count and adds the observed δ to its cumulative reward.

nodes.name: top_k
nodes.summary: Returns the top-k arms by mean reward with their pull counts and δ values, for post-hoc analysis of the bandit's exploration distribution.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Shared types for the unit-distance proof: C64 (complex f64 with arithmetic, norm, conjugate, inverse), CmFieldParams (split primes + root discriminant + degree), PrimePair, PigeonholeResult, PointSet (with unit-distance density), DeltaEstimate (analytic δ from field params), and the count_unit_distances empirical counter.
nodes.languageNotes: C64 is a hand-rolled complex type (no num-complex dep) implementing Add/Sub/Mul/Neg + Display; methods reuse norm_sq to avoid a redundant sqrt.

nodes.name: C64
nodes.summary: Complex number type over f64 with constructors (new, real), magnitude helpers (norm, norm_sq), conjugate, argument, reciprocal, full Add/Sub/Mul/Neg arithmetic, scalar Mul, and a Display impl; the building block for all lattice and unit-element arithmetic in the crate.

nodes.name: CmFieldParams
nodes.summary: Parameter bundle describing a CM field: split primes, root discriminant, denominator, and field degree; exposes total_degree and complex_dim accessors used by lattice construction and δ estimation.

nodes.name: PrimePair
nodes.summary: Record pairing a split prime p with its exponent in the field factorization; feeds the ∏(eᵢ+1) pigeonhole bound and per-prime unit generation.

nodes.name: PigeonholeResult
nodes.summary: Summary record from ClassGroupPigeonhole::analyze: carries prime-pair count, total configurations, the unit-set lower bound, and the generated unit count — consumed by verify_pigeonhole_bound and CmField::verify_all.

nodes.name: PointSet
nodes.summary: Planar point set wrapper with length/is_empty accessors and a unit_distance_density helper computing the empirical unit-distance-to-point ratio; the output type of CmField::generate_point_set.

nodes.name: DeltaEstimate
nodes.summary: Analytic δ estimate derived from CmFieldParams via from_field_params: encodes the n^(1+δ) lower-bound exponent used to rank field constructions; carries an is_positive check used as one of the GOAT gates.

nodes.name: count_unit_distances
nodes.summary: Free function counting pairs of points in a planar set whose Euclidean distance is 1 within an epsilon tolerance; the empirical ν(n) measurement feeding the unit-distance-density statistic.

nodes.name: from_field_params
nodes.summary: Constructs a DeltaEstimate from CmFieldParams via the analytic class-number/discriminant formula, returning the δ exponent used to rank and compare field constructions; the closed-form reward signal alternative to materializing a full CmField.

nodes.name: architecture_root.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the CognitiveArchitectureRoot, a BLAKE3-based commitment hash binding together the proto-graph root, engram table id, shard set root, functor signature root, tick, and NPC id into a single verifiable digest.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses BLAKE3 XOF (finalize_xof + fill) to derive a fixed-width root digest from heterogeneous part tuples; verify_parts re-derives in place to avoid allocating a new hasher on the hot path.

nodes.name: CognitiveArchitectureRoot
nodes.summary: Value type wrapping a fixed-width BLAKE3 digest that uniquely identifies a cognitive architecture snapshot across all of its constituent parts.

nodes.name: from_parts
nodes.summary: Constructs a CognitiveArchitectureRoot by hashing all six component identifiers into a fresh BLAKE3 digest via write_root_into.

nodes.name: verify
nodes.summary: Reconstructs the expected root from the supplied parts and checks byte-equality against the stored digest.

nodes.name: write_root_into
nodes.summary: Feeds all six component parts into a BLAKE3 hasher and writes the resulting XOF digest into a caller-supplied output buffer.

nodes.name: verify_parts
nodes.summary: Free-function variant of verify that re-derives the root from individual parts and compares against a caller-provided root reference.

nodes.name: cache.rs
nodes.summary: Implements a Zipfian-skewed four-tier cache hierarchy (plasma / hot / warm / cold) over engram lookups, with adaptive resizing driven by observed plasma hit-rate and lock-free promotion of warm/cold hits into the plasma tier.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the papaya PapayaMap lock-free concurrent hash map for the plasma tier; tier counters are AtomicU64 so snapshots are taken without locks. maybe_resize grows/shrinks plasma capacity to track a target hit-rate.

nodes.name: ZipfianCacheHierarchy
nodes.summary: Lock-free four-tier cache coordinating a plasma ( hottest ) PapayaMap, an external warm source, and an optional cold fetcher with per-tier atomic hit counters.

nodes.name: lookup_cached
nodes.summary: Tier-falling lookup: checks plasma, then warm source, then cold fetcher, promoting any non-plasma hit into plasma and zero-filling output on a full miss.

nodes.name: promote_to_plasma
nodes.summary: Inserts a warmed slot into the plasma tier, evicting the oldest entry via generation stamps when capacity is exceeded.

nodes.name: maybe_resize
nodes.summary: Adapts plasma capacity up or down toward a target hit-rate, bounded by configured min/max sizes.

nodes.name: commitment.rs
nodes.summary: Provides the BLAKE3 Merkle-tree commitment for engram tables, exposing EngramTableId as a content-addressed identifier and build_merkle_root as the binary-tree reduction over slot hashes.
nodes.languageNotes: Handles non-power-of-two leaf counts by pairing remaining nodes per layer (div_ceil stride) rather than padding, producing a stable root for arbitrary slot counts.

nodes.name: EngramTableId
nodes.summary: Content-addressed wrapper around the Merkle root of an engram table, used to detect any bit-level drift between table versions.

nodes.name: build_merkle_root
nodes.summary: Binary Merkle-tree reduction: hashes each slot's pattern bytes leaf-wise with BLAKE3, then pairwise-reduces layer by layer until a single 32-byte root remains.

nodes.name: conv.rs
nodes.summary: Implements a single causal 1D convolution primitive used by the speculative-decoding drafter to mix a kernel over the latent v-tilde sequence.
nodes.languageNotes: Position-aligned causal convolution with optional dilation; the identity kernel ( [1.0] at tap 0 ) is a strict passthrough by construction, verified by tests.

nodes.name: conv_causal_into
nodes.summary: Applies a causal kernel with optional dilation over v_tilde, writing position-aligned weighted sums into the caller-supplied out slice with no internal allocation.

nodes.name: forward.rs
nodes.summary: Inference-only forward pass that fuses retrieved engram patterns into the transformer hidden state via top-k multi-head lookup and a sigmoid-gated addition, with a no-allocation hot path.

nodes.name: EngramConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration knob bundle holding the SigmoidFusionConfig and the k_heads limit applied during top-k retrieval.

nodes.name: fuse_into_hidden_state
nodes.summary: Top-k engram fusion: hashes the query, looks up to k_heads patterns, scales each by sigmoid gate, and accumulates them into the hidden state using caller-supplied scratch buffers.

nodes.name: hash.rs
nodes.summary: Multi-head universal hash family for engram key derivation: each head uses a distinct prime modulus and seed to project a canonical-id suffix into K_MAX independent bucket indices.
nodes.languageNotes: Per-head prime modulus picked from a small prime table; per-head seed mixed via wrapping_mul/xor for universal-hashing guarantees. Includes a chi-square uniformity test harness.

nodes.name: multi_head_hash
nodes.summary: Computes a K_MAX-length hash tuple by folding the suffix into each head's seed and reducing modulo that head's prime, returning one bucket index per head.

nodes.name: hotswap.rs
nodes.summary: Atomic RCU-style pointer-swap container for engram tables, allowing concurrent readers via with_table while a single writer swaps in a new table with generation-stamped commitment tracking and safe Drop reclamation.
nodes.languageNotes: Holds a Box<EngramTable> behind AtomicPtr; writers take an AtomicBool lock and swap the raw pointer, retiring the old box; readers spin-loop on the lock flag while the writer is mid-swap. Drop reclaims the live box to avoid leaks.

nodes.name: EngramHotSwap
nodes.summary: Concurrent engram-table holder supporting atomic table replacement with a try_lock-protected single-writer scheme and lock-free readers.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs an EngramHotSwap by boxing the initial table, computing its low-u64 commitment, and initializing the AtomicPtr/lock/commitment triple.

nodes.name: swap
nodes.summary: Atomically replaces the live table with new_table under the writer lock, retiring the old table and refreshing the cached commitment; returns Err if already locked.

nodes.name: with_table
nodes.summary: Invokes a closure with the currently-live table reference, spin-waiting on any in-flight writer so readers never observe a torn pointer.

nodes.name: kernel.rs
nodes.summary: SIMD-accelerated sigmoid-gated fusion kernels combining RMSNorm and dot-product attention into a single gate value per branch, used as the primitive selected by the forward pass.
nodes.languageNotes: All hot loops delegate to simd_sum_sq / simd_dot_f32 / fast_sigmoid primitives; sigmoid_fuse_into and sigmoid_fuse_multi_branch_into share an identical per-branch RMSNorm + dot + sigmoid recipe, the latter just unrolling it across multiple q/k branches.

nodes.name: SigmoidFusionConfig
nodes.summary: Holds the inverse-temperature tau and rmsnorm_eps constants that parameterise the sigmoid fusion kernels.

nodes.name: sigmoid_fuse_multi_branch_into
nodes.summary: Multi-branch variant: computes one sigmoid gate per q/k branch by RMSNorm-ing both, dot-producting them, scaling by tau and applying fast_sigmoid, writing gates into out_per_branch.

nodes.name: rmsnorm_into
nodes.summary: Standalone RMSNorm: divides x by the root-mean-square of its elements ( plus eps ), writing into out with no allocation.

nodes.name: sigmoid_fuse_into
nodes.summary: Single-branch sigmoid fusion: RMSNorm q and k, dot them, scale by tau, apply fast_sigmoid, and accumulate the gate into out.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module for the engram subsystem: declares the EngramHash / CanonicalId / TokenId newtypes and the EngramTable trait, and re-exports all sibling submodules.

nodes.name: EngramTable
nodes.summary: Trait abstracting an engram table's read-side: multi-head hash-key lookup into a caller-supplied output buffer, content-addressed commitment, slot count, and pattern dimensionality.

nodes.name: staging.rs
nodes.summary: Copy-on-write staging buffer over an EngramTable: accumulates update_slot / delete_slot mutations as a pending log and produces a fresh immutable table on commit, leaving the source untouched.
nodes.languageNotes: Builder-style chaining ( each mutator returns &mut Self ); commit clones the source slot slice into a boxed slice and replays pending mutations with last-write-wins for repeated slot indices.

nodes.name: StagingEngramTable
nodes.summary: Holds a reference to an immutable source table plus a Vec of PendingMutation entries that are replayed on commit to yield a new table.

nodes.name: update_slot
nodes.summary: Queues an in-place pattern replacement at the given slot index, validating bounds and pattern length against the source table's shape.

nodes.name: delete_slot
nodes.summary: Queues a slot zero-fill deletion, validating the slot index against the source table's slot count.

nodes.name: commit
nodes.summary: Materializes a new InMemoryEngramTable by cloning the source slots, replaying each pending mutation with last-write-wins semantics, and returning an error if no mutations are queued.

nodes.name: table.rs
nodes.summary: Concrete in-memory engram table storing flat f32 patterns contiguously behind multi-head hash keys, with a builder, cached Merkle commitment, and lock-free lookup_into.

nodes.name: InMemoryEngramTable
nodes.summary: Immutable flat-slot engram table: patterns stored contiguously in a boxed f32 slice, multi-head hash table for retrieval, commitment lazily cached in a OnceLock.

nodes.name: EngramTableBuilder
nodes.summary: Builder accumulating ( hash_key, pattern ) pairs plus a head configuration before constructing an immutable InMemoryEngramTable.

nodes.name: from_parts
nodes.summary: Constructs an InMemoryEngramTable directly from raw slots, heads, and dimensions, initializing the commitment OnceLock to empty.

nodes.name: lookup_into
nodes.summary: Retrieves up to K_MAX patterns matching each multi-head hash key, zero-filling unmatched slots and copying matched slot bytes into the caller-supplied output slice.

nodes.name: commitment
nodes.summary: Lazily computes and caches the table's Merkle commitment via the shared build_merkle_root helper.

nodes.name: tests.rs
nodes.summary: Integration tests for the full engram pipeline: hash-to-lookup determinism, sigmoid-gate boundary cases ( q==k, q==-k, q orthogonal k ), commitment content-addressing, k-head fusion limits, and zero-cost-newtype assertions.

nodes.name: tokenizer.rs
nodes.summary: Surjective tokenizer map collapsing raw token ids to canonical ids via Unicode NFKC normalization, lowercasing, trimming, and BLAKE3 hashing, with tamper-evident save/load via postcard + commitment tag.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses unicode-normalization's NFKC + BLAKE3 to canonicalize token byte strings into stable 64-bit ids; serialization layers a BLAKE3 commitment over postcard-encoded payload so load_from_bytes rejects tampered bytes.

nodes.name: SurjectiveMap
nodes.summary: Many-to-one raw-to-canonical id projection with vocabulary size, compression ratio, and tamper-evident save/load.

nodes.name: TokenizerSpec
nodes.summary: Trait describing a tokenizer's vocabulary size and per-id decode-to-bytes semantics, used as input to build_surjective_map.

nodes.name: save_to_bytes
nodes.summary: Serializes the raw-to-canonical table as a postcard payload prefixed by a BLAKE3 commitment so any later tampering is detectable on load.

nodes.name: build_surjective_map
nodes.summary: Constructs a SurjectiveMap by decoding each raw token id through the tokenizer and canonicalizing its bytes via canonicalize_bytes.

nodes.name: canonicalize_bytes
nodes.summary: Maps raw token bytes to a stable CanonicalId by NFKC-normalizing, lowercasing, trimming, and BLAKE3-hashing the resulting string.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for katgpt-tokenizer: a modelless BPE/ToaST/ConvexTok tokenizer library. Declares feature-gated modules (toast_tokenizer, convex_tok, datrie_vocab) and re-exports the public tokenizer types.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust crate root using `mod` + `pub use` with `#[cfg(feature = ...)]` gates; toast_tokenizer and convex_tok are opt-in features pulling good_lp/HiGHS.

nodes.name: bpe.rs
nodes.summary: Byte-Pair-Encoding encoder/decoder and trainer operating on token IDs end-to-end with zero per-pair String allocation in the merge loop.
nodes.languageNotes: Hot-path uses ID-keyed HashMaps (merge_ranks_id, merge_target_id) to avoid String allocation per merge pass, per AGENTS.md hot-loop rules.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Core BPE data model: BpeTokenizer struct (vocab maps, merge rules, ID-keyed lookup tables) and MergeRule, plus serde helpers for HashMap serialization.
nodes.languageNotes: Custom serde modules (map_serde, map_serde_bytes) serialize HashMap keys as hex strings for readability.

nodes.name: toast_types.rs
nodes.summary: ToaST split-tree tokenizer data model: SplitNode, SplitTree, and ToastTokenizer with threshold-routed double-array trie vocab lookup.
nodes.languageNotes: DatrieVocab is auto-built when vocab exceeds DATRIE_VOCAB_THRESHOLD (1024); otherwise HashMap lookup is used.

nodes.name: toast_builder.rs
nodes.summary: Builds ToaST split trees from byte n-gram frequency counts using a min(left_count, right_count) split heuristic with recursive descent.

nodes.name: toast_inference.rs
nodes.summary: ToaST inference engine: encodes text via whitespace pretokenization followed by recursive descent through pre-built split trees; decodes IDs back to UTF-8.

nodes.name: datrie.rs
nodes.summary: Double-array trie (Aoe 1989) for zero-alloc byte-key lookups, replacing HashMap<Vec<u8>, _>. Provides DatrieVocab for single-trie vocab lookup and DatrieTreeIndex for multi-trie split-tree indexing.
nodes.languageNotes: Invariant: child = base[s] + b, check[child] == s. Collision resolution relocates subtrees via find_new_base.

nodes.name: convex_types.rs
nodes.summary: ConvexTok data model: tokenisation graph (DAG with coloured edges), LP solution, rounded vocabulary, rounding scheme enum, and optimality certificate. Newtype IDs for vertices/edges/colours.
nodes.languageNotes: Models vocabulary optimization as flow conservation over a coloured DAG; coloured edges share a colour when they span identical byte substrings.

nodes.name: convex_graph.rs
nodes.summary: Builds the ConvexTok tokenisation DAG from pretokenized byte-strings: vertices for byte positions, free edges for single bytes, coloured priced edges for multi-byte token spans.

nodes.name: convex_solver.rs
nodes.summary: Formulates and solves the ConvexTok LP relaxation via good_lp/HiGHS: minimizes total path length subject to flow conservation, colour activation, and vocabulary budget constraints.
nodes.languageNotes: Decision variables f (free-edge flow), p (priced-edge flow), c (colour selection) all relaxed to [0,1]; solved with HiGHS backend.

nodes.name: convex_rounding.rs
nodes.summary: Converts fractional LP solutions to discrete vocabulary selections via three schemes (Det/Bias/Int), then recovers optimal path variables through DAG shortest-path computation.
nodes.languageNotes: Det picks top-K by LP value (BpB-optimal); Bias normalizes by token length (OOD-friendly); Int keeps only near-integral colours to reveal forced tokens.

nodes.name: convex_certify.rs
nodes.summary: Certifies tokenizer optimality by comparing achieved compression against the LP-proven lower bound, reporting the percentage gap and integrality fraction.

nodes.name: convex_toast_bridge.rs
nodes.summary: Bridges ConvexTok's LP-optimized vocabulary into a ToaST inference tokenizer: registers special tokens, single bytes, and selected multi-byte tokens, then builds split trees from n-gram counts.

nodes.name: BpeTokenizerImpl
nodes.summary: Stateless BPE encoder/decoder: encode runs iterative lowest-rank pair merging on Vec<usize> with ID-keyed lookup tables; decode maps IDs back through id_to_vocab.

nodes.name: BpeTrainer
nodes.summary: BPE trainer that learns merge rules from a corpus by repeatedly merging the most frequent adjacent symbol pair until the target vocabulary size is reached.

nodes.name: encode
nodes.summary: Encodes a string into BPE token IDs: maps chars to IDs up front, then iteratively merges the lowest-rank adjacent pair using ping-pong token buffers with no per-pair allocation.

nodes.name: train
nodes.summary: Learns BPE merge rules from a corpus by frequency counting adjacent symbol pairs and repeatedly merging the most common pair until the vocabulary budget is exhausted.

nodes.name: apply_merges
nodes.summary: Applies learned merge rules to a token sequence, used by the trainer to maintain the working token stream after each merge round.

nodes.name: BpeTokenizer
nodes.summary: BPE tokenizer data structure holding bidirectional vocab maps, ordered merge rules, and ID-keyed hot-path lookup tables (merge_ranks_id, merge_target_id) rebuilt by rebuild_ranks.

nodes.name: rebuild_ranks
nodes.summary: Rebuilds the string-keyed and ID-keyed merge lookup tables from the merges vector, resolving left/right/merged tokens to IDs so the encode hot path avoids String allocation.

nodes.name: ToastTokenizer
nodes.summary: ToaST tokenizer holding byte-keyed vocab maps, pre-built pretoken split trees, special token IDs, and an optional DatrieVocab built post-load when vocab exceeds the threshold.

nodes.name: SplitTreeBuilder
nodes.summary: Borrows byte n-gram frequency counts and builds a SplitTree per pretoken via recursive binary splitting using a min(left_count, right_count) score heuristic.

nodes.name: build
nodes.summary: Constructs a SplitTree for a pretoken: handles empty/single-byte cases directly, otherwise delegates to recursive splitting.

nodes.name: build_recursive
nodes.summary: Recursively splits a byte slice at the best n-gram-supported position, pushing SplitNodes in preorder with child indices filled in after child subtrees complete.

nodes.name: best_split
nodes.summary: Finds the split position maximizing min(left_count, right_count) over n-gram frequencies, filtering splits below min_count; falls back to longest known prefix.

nodes.name: ToastTokenizerImpl
nodes.summary: Stateless ToaST encoder/decoder: pretokenizes on whitespace, looks up whole pretokens, and falls back to recursive-descent through the split tree or byte-by-byte emission.

nodes.name: encode
nodes.summary: Encodes a string to ToaST token IDs by splitting on ASCII whitespace, encoding each word as a pretoken, and emitting whitespace bytes via routed vocab lookup.

nodes.name: encode_pretoken
nodes.summary: Encodes a single pretoken: emits the whole-span ID if known, otherwise descends the matching split tree, falling back to byte-by-byte lookup when no tree exists.

nodes.name: recursive_descent
nodes.summary: Walks a split tree from a node: emits the span's vocab ID if known, otherwise recurses into left/right children, with byte fallback at leaves via routed lookup.

nodes.name: DatrieVocab
nodes.summary: Single double-array trie over the full vocabulary providing build/lookup/longest_prefix/inner_bytes for zero-alloc byte-keyed token ID resolution.

nodes.name: DatrieTreeIndex
nodes.summary: Indexed collection of per-pretoken double-array tries supporting split-tree lookup by pretoken bytes, with build/lookup/len/is_empty.

nodes.name: insert
nodes.summary: Inserts a byte-key with an optional value into the double-array trie, growing the arrays and walking transitions, creating new states for missing byte edges.

nodes.name: resolve_collision
nodes.summary: Resolves a transition collision by relocating the loser subtree to a new base found via find_new_base, reparenting children so the invariant check[child]==parent holds.

nodes.name: find_new_base
nodes.summary: Searches for a base offset for a state such that all its child byte-transitions land on unoccupied slots, enabling collision-free relocation.

nodes.name: TokenisationGraph
nodes.summary: DAG encoding the tokenisation problem: vertices are byte positions, free edges span single bytes, priced edges span multi-byte substrings coloured by their byte content, plus a sparse flow-difference vector.

nodes.name: LpSolution
nodes.summary: Fractional LP solution holding f (free-edge flow), p (priced-edge flow), c (colour selection) variables, the LP objective value, and the budget K; reports integrality fraction.

nodes.name: RoundedVocabulary
nodes.summary: Output of rounding: the selected colour IDs, their byte substrings, the count, achieved compression value, and the rounding scheme used.

nodes.name: RoundingScheme
nodes.summary: Enum tagging which rounding strategy was applied (Det/Bias/Int) with a Display implementation describing each variant.

nodes.name: OptimalityCert
nodes.summary: Optimality certificate reporting the LP lower bound, achieved compression, percentage gap, integrality fraction, and a within-one-percent flag, with Display formatting.

nodes.name: GraphBuilder
nodes.summary: Constructs a TokenisationGraph from pretokenized byte-strings by laying out vertices per byte position, adding free byte-edges and coloured priced multi-byte edges, then assembling the flow vector.

nodes.name: build
nodes.summary: Builds the tokenisation DAG: creates n+1 vertices per byte-string (merging adjacent string boundaries), wires free byte-edges, enumerates priced spans up to max_token_len, and groups them by colour via a HashMap.

nodes.name: ConvexSolver
nodes.summary: LP solver facade: formulates the tokenisation vocabulary LP (flow conservation, colour activation, budget) and dispatches to good_lp/HiGHS, returning the fractional LpSolution.

nodes.name: solve
nodes.summary: Solves the LP relaxation: declares f/p/c variables in [0,1], builds the flow-conservation and colour-activation constraints, adds the vocabulary budget, and minimizes total path length via HiGHS.

nodes.name: add_flow_constraints
nodes.summary: Adds per-vertex flow-conservation constraints (incoming flow equals outgoing flow adjusted by the flow_diff vector) to the LP model for both free and priced edge variables.

nodes.name: Rounder
nodes.summary: Rounding engine exposing Det/Bias/Int vocabulary selection strategies and the build_vocabulary helper that recovers the discrete vocabulary and its compression via DAG shortest path.

nodes.name: det
nodes.summary: Deterministic rounding: selects the top-K colours by fractional LP value c, the simplest scheme and typically BpB-optimal.

nodes.name: bias
nodes.summary: Biased rounding: selects top-K colours ranked by c divided by token length, favouring shorter tokens for better out-of-distribution generalization.

nodes.name: int
nodes.summary: Integral-only rounding: keeps colours with c >= 0.999, revealing the set of tokens the LP considers essentially forced regardless of budget.

nodes.name: build_vocabulary
nodes.summary: Materializes a RoundedVocabulary from a selected colour set: collects their byte substrings, computes compression via shortest path, and tags the scheme.

nodes.name: dag_shortest_path
nodes.summary: Computes the shortest path (minimum total edges) from source to sink over the DAG restricted to selected colours, yielding the optimal tokenization compression for the rounded vocabulary.

nodes.name: Certifier
nodes.summary: Optimality certifier comparing achieved compression against the LP-proven lower bound, exposing certify for ConvexTok vocabularies and certify_external for arbitrary tokenizers like BPE.

nodes.name: certify
nodes.summary: Certifies a RoundedVocabulary against its LP solution: computes the percentage gap and integrality fraction, flagging whether the rounding is within one percent of optimal.

nodes.name: certify_external
nodes.summary: Certifies an arbitrary external tokenizer's compression against the LP lower bound, used to compare BPE or other baselines to the ConvexTok optimum.

nodes.name: SpecialTokens
nodes.summary: Container for the four special token byte sequences (BOS/EOS/PAD/UNK) with a Default producing the standard angle-bracket byte encodings.

nodes.name: ConvexToToastBridge
nodes.summary: Bridge facade exposing to_toast_tokenizer and variants that convert a ConvexTok rounded vocabulary into an inference-ready ToastTokenizer with split trees built from n-gram counts.

nodes.name: to_toast_tokenizer_with_min_count
nodes.summary: Core bridge routine: registers special tokens, all 256 single bytes, and the selected ConvexTok multi-byte tokens, then builds a split tree per token using n-gram counts above min_count.

nodes.name: to_toast_tokenizer
nodes.summary: Convenience wrapper delegating to to_toast_tokenizer_with_min_count with the default minimum n-gram count of 10.

nodes.name: audit.rs
nodes.summary: POD-safe audit records for compaction decisions: PredicateAudit, DecisionKind, FireRuleEval, and CompactionAuditRecord. All types are bytemuck Zeroable/Pod so audit records can cross thread/process boundaries as raw bytes.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses #[repr(C)] and bytemuck derives (Pod, Zeroable) to guarantee stable byte layouts for cross-boundary transfer of audit state.

nodes.name: backstop.rs
nodes.summary: Backstop policy enum (None/TokenPct/Never) that forces compaction when prompt token usage crosses a configurable percentage of the context window, overriding the rubric.

nodes.name: decision.rs
nodes.summary: CompactionDecision enum (Compress/Continue/Forced) carrying an audit record, with accessor predicates that distinguish voluntary compression from forced backstop triggers.

nodes.name: fire_rule.rs
nodes.summary: Boolean combinator tree (FireRule: And/Or/Not/Box) over rubric predicate masks, with paper-derived factory rules search_rule_4, math_rule_3, and shard_freeze_rule_2 that encode the Section-3 firing conditions.
nodes.languageNotes: FireRule is a recursive enum using Box<Self> for the Not/combining variants, evaluated via evaluate_mask over a packed u32 yes-mask.

nodes.name: gate.rs
nodes.summary: Main orchestrator ClosedUnitCompactionGate that combines a rubric, fire rule, backstop, and skip-if-reliable policy to produce a deterministic CompactionDecision with a POD audit record. Provides a builder API and is the single entry point for the compaction pipeline.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel for the compaction subsystem, re-exporting audit, backstop, decision, fire_rule, gate, probe, rubric, and rubrics. Also hosts full-pipeline integration tests proving the audit record crosses the sync boundary as POD bytes.

nodes.name: probe.rs
nodes.summary: CacheReuseProbe and ProbeToken implementing append/revert semantics for speculative trajectory probing. Probes extend the trajectory in place and revert by truncating to the recorded pre-len, giving O(1) probe latency independent of trajectory length.
nodes.languageNotes: Probe revert is plain Vec::truncate to a stashed length — no copy, no allocation, naturally LIFO for nested probes.

nodes.name: rubric.rs
nodes.summary: Core rubric abstractions: PredicateResult (Yes/No), PredicateReason (byte-serializable enum), const-generic RubricVerdict<N>, RubricScratch reusable f32/usize buffers, and the Rubric trait that each domain rubric implements.
nodes.languageNotes: RubricVerdict<const N: usize> packs N predicate results into a fixed array; yes_mask bit-packs them LSB-first into u32 for the FireRule evaluator.

nodes.name: math.rs
nodes.summary: MathRubric implementing the Rubric trait with three paper-derived predicates: q1 (answer confidence above tau), q2 (fact novelty), q3 (next-step certainty). Reads features from RubricScratch and ships paper-default PredicateParams.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module re-exporting the math, search, and shard_freeze domain rubric implementations.

nodes.name: search.rs
nodes.summary: SearchRubric implementing the Rubric trait with four predicates (c1 coherence gate, c2 intrinsic-rank gate, c3 divergence gate, n1 novelty gate), each driven by affine PredicateParams (beta, tau). Includes the Figure-1 reproduction test that measures recall and false-discovery rate on a synthetic trajectory.

nodes.name: shard_freeze.rs
nodes.summary: ShardFreezeRubric implementing the Rubric trait with two predicates: p0 (wake-events >= intrinsic-dim, i.e. convergence) and p1 (spectral-flatness below threshold, i.e. output converged). Produces FreezeReportFields for the shard-freeze decision.

nodes.name: PredicateAudit
nodes.summary: POD record capturing a single predicate's yes/no verdict with reason byte and an optional quote span. Constructor methods yes()/no()/default() make the on-the-wire byte layout explicit.

nodes.name: DecisionKind
nodes.summary: Three-variant enum (Continue/Compress/Forced) serialized to a single byte via to_byte/from_byte round-trip, embedded in the audit record.

nodes.name: Backstop
nodes.summary: Policy enum (None/TokenPct/Never) with token_pct() constructor that clamps the percentage and should_force() that triggers when prompt_len/ctx_window crosses the threshold.

nodes.name: CompactionDecision
nodes.summary: Top-level decision enum (Compress/Continue/Forced) wrapping a CompactionAuditRecord. Variant predicates is_compress/is_continue/is_forced distinguish voluntary from backstop-driven outcomes.

nodes.name: FireRule
nodes.summary: Recursive boolean combinator (And/Or/Not/Box) over predicate masks. evaluate_mask walks the tree and combines child u32 masks; the paper rule factories search_rule_4, math_rule_3, shard_freeze_rule_2 build the canonical trees.

nodes.name: search_rule_4
nodes.summary: Factory for the search rubric's 4-predicate firing rule: fires only when c1 AND c2 AND c3 are yes AND n1 is no (i.e. safe point reached and novelty exhausted).

nodes.name: math_rule_3
nodes.summary: Factory for the math rubric's 3-predicate firing rule: fires when q1 is yes OR (q2 AND q3) — either the answer is confident or the trajectory is both novel and has a clear next step.

nodes.name: shard_freeze_rule_2
nodes.summary: Factory for the shard-freeze rubric's strict-AND 2-predicate rule: fires only when both p0 (input sufficient) and p1 (output converged) are yes.

nodes.name: ClosedUnitCompactionGate
nodes.summary: Closed (deterministic) compaction gate holding a rubric, fire rule, backstop, skip-if-reliable threshold, and probe interval. The evaluate() method is the single entry point that produces a CompactionDecision plus audit record.

nodes.name: ClosedUnitCompactionGateBuilder
nodes.summary: Builder for ClosedUnitCompactionGate with paper-default fire rule (And of search/math/shard-freeze) and Backstop::default; lets callers override fire_rule, backstop, skip_if_reliable, and probe_interval_tokens.

nodes.name: evaluate
nodes.summary: Main pipeline: checks backstop first (forces on threshold breach), then runs the rubric and fire_rule over the verdict mask, then optionally suppresses Compress via skip-if-reliable when the CLR vote is high. Returns CompactionDecision::Forced/Compress/Continue with a populated audit record.

nodes.name: build_audit
nodes.summary: Projects a RubricVerdict into the POD CompactionAuditRecord by iterating predicates, calling project_predicate on each, and packing yes_mask/fired/backstop/skip flags into fixed byte offsets.

nodes.name: CacheReuseProbe
nodes.summary: Probe state holding a stack of ProbeTokens. probe_append extends the trajectory and records the pre-len; revert truncates back to that len, giving cheap speculative exploration that the KV cache can reuse.

nodes.name: probe_append
nodes.summary: Extends the trajectory in place with the probe prompt and pushes a ProbeToken recording the pre-length so the probe can be reverted.

nodes.name: revert
nodes.summary: Truncates the trajectory back to the ProbeToken's recorded pre-len, discarding the speculative suffix without reallocation.

nodes.name: PredicateResult
nodes.summary: Two-variant predicate outcome (Yes/No) carrying a PredicateReason. is_yes/is_no accessors and a default of No-with-Unset make absent features safe-by-default.

nodes.name: PredicateReason
nodes.summary: Stable byte-encoding of why a predicate returned No (Unset/NotClosedUnit/TooHighRank/NoProgress/StillNovel/Custom). discriminant_byte/from_byte round-trip the reason across the sync boundary.

nodes.name: RubricScratch
nodes.summary: Reusable scratch buffers (f32_buf, usize_buf) that callers fill with extracted trajectory features; clear() preserves capacity to keep the evaluation loop allocation-free.

nodes.name: Rubric
nodes.summary: Trait unifying all domain rubrics (search, math, shard_freeze). Implementors read features from a RubricScratch over a trajectory slice and return a RubricVerdict; the gate invokes this via trait object.

nodes.name: yes_mask
nodes.summary: Bit-packs the RubricVerdict's predicate yes/no bits LSB-first into a u32 mask consumed by FireRule::evaluate_mask.

nodes.name: MathRubric
nodes.summary: Rubric impl with three PredicateParams (q1/q2/q3) over MathTrajectoryFeatures. evaluate_features runs each predicate as an affine beta*x vs tau comparison and packs the verdict; evaluate pulls features from RubricScratch.

nodes.name: evaluate_features
nodes.summary: Runs the three math predicates (answer confidence, fact novelty, next-step certainty) against MathTrajectoryFeatures and returns a 3-element RubricVerdict with reason bytes set.

nodes.name: evaluate
nodes.summary: Trait-object entry: reads answer_confidence/fact_novelty_rate/next_step_certainty from RubricScratch, builds MathTrajectoryFeatures, and delegates to evaluate_features.

nodes.name: SearchRubric
nodes.summary: Rubric impl with four PredicateParams (c1/c2/c3 coherence/rank/divergence gates and n1 novelty gate) driven by paper defaults. evaluate_features runs all four and returns a 4-element RubricVerdict.

nodes.name: TrajectoryFeatures
nodes.summary: Feature bundle (coherence, intrinsic_rank, divergence_since_last, novelty_rate) extracted from the trajectory and fed to the search predicates.

nodes.name: PredicateParams
nodes.summary: Affine predicate parameters (beta, tau). fires() returns Yes when beta*feature crosses tau in the sign-correct direction, treating NaN features as No.

nodes.name: SearchRubricConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration bundle of four PredicateParams (c1, c2, c3, n1) with paper_defaults() returning the values reported in the Section-3 reproduction.

nodes.name: evaluate_features
nodes.summary: Runs the four search predicates (c1 coherence, c2 rank, c3 divergence, n1 novelty) against TrajectoryFeatures and packs the results into a 4-element RubricVerdict with reason bytes.

nodes.name: evaluate
nodes.summary: Trait-object entry: reads coherence/rank/divergence/novelty from RubricScratch, builds TrajectoryFeatures, and delegates to evaluate_features.

nodes.name: fires
nodes.summary: Affine firing test: Yes when beta*feature crosses tau (sign-aware), No on NaN features or beta=0. Used by every search/math predicate.

nodes.name: ShardFreezeRubric
nodes.summary: Rubric impl with two predicates: p0 (wake-events >= intrinsic-dim, input sufficient) and p1 (spectral-flatness strictly below threshold, output converged). Also exposes freeze_report_fields for the freeze decision report.

nodes.name: ShardFreezeFeatures
nodes.summary: Feature bundle (n_wake_events, intrinsic_dim, spectral_flatness) extracted from the shard and fed to the freeze predicates.

nodes.name: FreezeReportFields
nodes.summary: Report struct (n_wake_events, intrinsic_dim, input_sufficient, output_flatness, output_converged, can_freeze) consumed by the freeze decision UI/log.

nodes.name: evaluate_features
nodes.summary: Runs the two freeze predicates: p0 = (n_wake_events >= intrinsic_dim), p1 = (spectral_flatness < threshold, strict). NaN flatness yields No.

nodes.name: freeze_report_fields
nodes.summary: Projects a ShardFreeze verdict plus features into a FreezeReportFields struct for the freeze/continue decision report.

nodes.name: buffer.rs
nodes.summary: Runtime manager for MUX-Latent compressed context — wraps the encoder pipeline with latent-slot budgeting, eviction policies (FIFO / lowest-energy), adaptive SLoD compression, and segment-level access for the decoder-side injection path.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses cfg(feature="lclm_adaptive_lod") to gate the SLoD-aware constructor.

nodes.name: LatentContextBuffer
nodes.summary: Core runtime struct holding a CompressedContext plus latent budget, eviction policy, and optional SpectralLOD analyzer; exposes encode-on-construct, query-based segment retrieval, and in-place eviction.

nodes.name: EvictionPolicy
nodes.summary: repr(u8) enum selecting between OldestFirst (FIFO) and LowestEnergy (spectral-importance) eviction when the latent budget is exceeded.

nodes.name: BufferStats
nodes.summary: Copyable snapshot of buffer telemetry: total input tokens, latent slots used/budget, raw segment count, achieved compression ratio, and memory savings fraction.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a LatentContextBuffer by running the MuxLatentEncoder over the input tokens and deriving the latent budget from config.max_latent_slots or the produced slot count.

nodes.name: new_adaptive
nodes.summary: Builds a buffer with per-window adaptive compression ratios chosen by the SpectralLOD analyzer, re-encoding each window with its selected CompressionRatio (lclm_adaptive_lod feature only).

nodes.name: enforce_budget
nodes.summary: Trims compressed segments until latent_slot_count fits within latent_budget, picking victims via the active EvictionPolicy (FIFO order or lowest spectral energy).

nodes.name: evict_segments
nodes.summary: Evicts an explicit list of segment indices from the underlying CompressedContext and updates the latent slot counter accordingly.

nodes.name: append
nodes.summary: Appends new tokens to the buffer by encoding them into segments and triggering enforce_budget to maintain the latent slot cap.

nodes.name: config.rs
nodes.summary: Defines MuxLatentConfig and the CompressionRatio enum (X4/X8/X16) controlling window size, decay, max latent slots, instruction preservation, and injection layer — all inference-time parameters with no training.
nodes.languageNotes: CompressionRatio uses #[default] on X8 and a span_size() derived from the enum discriminant.

nodes.name: CompressionRatio
nodes.summary: Copy enum with variants X4, X8 (default), X16 exposing span_size() (tokens-per-latent-slot) via the discriminant value.

nodes.name: MuxLatentConfig
nodes.summary: Primary configuration struct with fast() / quality() presets plus latent_slot_count() and window_count() calculators used throughout the encoder and buffer layers.

nodes.name: context.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the CompressedContext and LatentSegment types produced by the MUX-Latent encoder — the hybrid raw + latent representation consumed by the expand, inject, and patcher paths.

nodes.name: LatentSegment
nodes.summary: Tagged enum holding either a Compressed span (segment_id, decay-weighted superposition weights, original_tokens for EXPAND recovery) or Raw uncompressed tokens; exposes latent_count, original_token_count, and segment_id accessors.

nodes.name: CompressedContext
nodes.summary: Owns the ordered segment vector plus original_token_count, latent_slot_count, and source MuxLatentConfig; provides compression_ratio, expand, decoder_budget, and memory_savings aggregates.

nodes.name: encoder.rs
nodes.summary: Inference-time MUX-Latent encoder that compresses token spans into single latent slots via position-weighted geometric-decay superposition (latent_slot[i] = Σ decay^j · onehot(token[j])) with zero training and MUX's lossless separation guarantee.
nodes.languageNotes: Encoder is a deterministic function of decay + span_size, explicitly avoiding any trained parameters.

nodes.name: MuxLatentEncoder
nodes.summary: Stateless wrapper around MuxLatentConfig that produces CompressedContext from raw token slices via windowed + span-wise superposition encoding, plus encode_span, encode_latents_only, and superposition_logits helpers.

nodes.name: encode
nodes.summary: Splits an input token slice into windows (per window_size) then spans (per compression_ratio), encoding each span into a single Compressed LatentSegment and preserving instructions when configured.

nodes.name: encode_span
nodes.summary: Encodes a single token span into one latent slot by computing decay-weighted superposition weights over the span tokens.

nodes.name: superposition_logits
nodes.summary: Projects a token span onto a vocabulary-sized logit vector via superposition, used for decoder-side logit blending against a target vocab_size.

nodes.name: expand.rs
nodes.summary: EXPAND(i) tool — inference-time selective decompression of latent context segments, the analog of LCLM's agent scaffolding. Because MUX stores original_tokens alongside weights, expansion is O(1) per segment.

nodes.name: expand_segment
nodes.summary: Recovers the original tokens and weights for a single compressed segment by ID, returning None if the segment is missing or already raw.

nodes.name: expand_all
nodes.summary: Fully decompresses a CompressedContext back into its original token sequence — used for verification or fallback paths.

nodes.name: select_segments_to_expand
nodes.summary: Token-overlap relevance scorer that ranks compressed segments against a query token set and returns the top_k segment IDs to expand — a baseline retriever for query-aware decompression.

nodes.name: inject.rs
nodes.summary: Decoder-side injection bridge that converts a CompressedContext into a MixedPrefillSequence of raw + latent entries so that compressed spans occupy a single KV cache slot each — the source of the memory savings during prefill.

nodes.name: LatentPrefillAdapter
nodes.summary: Adapter converting CompressedContext into a MixedPrefillSequence, exposing to_prefill_sequence, raw_token_ids, kv_savings, and latent_indices used by the prefill bridge.

nodes.name: CompressionSummary
nodes.summary: Telemetry struct (original_tokens, effective_entries, latent_slots, raw_tokens, kv_savings, estimated_ttft_reduction) with from_sequence and compression_ratio reporters.

nodes.name: to_prefill_sequence
nodes.summary: Builds a MixedPrefillSequence by expanding raw segments into PrefillEntry::Raw items and collapsing each compressed segment into a single PrefillEntry::Latent item, preallocating capacity to avoid realloc churn.

nodes.name: from_sequence
nodes.summary: CompressionSummary factory that walks a MixedPrefillSequence and computes entry counts, latent slots, raw tokens, and estimated KV-cache savings versus the uncompressed baseline.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel for the MUX-Latent context compression subsystem — declares all child modules (gating octree_bridge, patcher, and wire behind the mux_latent_wire feature) and re-exports the public types and functions used by the rest of katgpt-core.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses #[cfg(feature = "mux_latent_wire")] to conditionally compile the wire-patching subsystem.

nodes.name: octree_bridge.rs
nodes.summary: Bridges the KG Latent Octree (2-bit ternary leaf nodes {-1, 0, +1}) and MUX Latent patches — a depth-7 octree (128 nodes, 32 bytes) maps 1:1 to a single X8 latent slot, with Morton codes for segment_id ↔ (x,y) coordinates and OctreeLod depth/ratio mapping.
nodes.languageNotes: TernaryDir packs 128 ternary values into 4 × u64 (256 bits) using 2 bits per node.

nodes.name: TernaryValue
nodes.summary: repr(i8) enum of {-1, 0, +1} with to_weight / from_weight conversions against the f32 MUX-latent weight space (threshold ±0.5).

nodes.name: TernaryDir
nodes.summary: 32-byte packed octree leaf carrying 128 ternary nodes as a 4 × u64 bitmask, with get/set accessors and bulk to_weights / from_weights conversions used by the octree↔patch bridge functions.

nodes.name: MortonCode
nodes.summary: Utility struct exposing encode(x, y) → segment_id and decode(morton) → (x, y) for mapping 2D octree coordinates into the linear LatentSegment ID space (up to 16 bits per axis).

nodes.name: OctreeLod
nodes.summary: Level-of-detail mapper between octree depth and CompressionRatio (depth 3 → X16, 5 → X8, 7 → X4) with slot_count(depth) for latent slot provisioning.

nodes.name: encode
nodes.summary: Interleaves the bits of x and y coordinates into a Morton (Z-order) code, yielding the segment_id for an octree position.

nodes.name: decode
nodes.summary: Deinterleaves a Morton code back into its (x, y) coordinate pair — the inverse of encode().

nodes.name: patcher.rs
nodes.summary: Latent-to-latent patch protocol — applies BLAKE3-committed LatentPatch updates directly to a CompressedContext's segment weights with no decompress/recompress round-trip, plus a DirtyTracker for change-set accounting.

nodes.name: DirtyTracker
nodes.summary: HashSet-backed tracker recording which segment_ids have been modified since the last flush, with mark / is_dirty / dirty_ids / clear helpers.

nodes.name: LatentPatcher
nodes.summary: Stateless service applying single and batched LatentPatch updates to a CompressedContext, validating finite weights and BLAKE3 commitments and returning PatchReceipt / PatchRejection outcomes.

nodes.name: patch
nodes.summary: Applies one LatentPatch in-place — verifies finite weights, recomputes and compares the BLAKE3 commitment, locates the target Compressed segment, and overwrites its weights (truncating or padding to span size).

nodes.name: patch_batch
nodes.summary: SIMD-friendly batched patch application that processes patches in chunks of 4 and aggregates per-segment committed/rejected results into a PatchReceipt.

nodes.name: prefill.rs
nodes.summary: Phase-3 bridge that decomposes a MixedPrefillSequence into a CompressedPrefillPlan (raw token IDs plus CompressionMetadata) ready to feed into the existing forward_prefill path, recording which positions correspond to latent slots for future mid-layer injection.

nodes.name: CompressionMetadata
nodes.summary: Sidecar metadata recording which prefill positions are latent slots, the original token counts, segment IDs, and superposition weights they carry, plus a CompressionSummary for telemetry.

nodes.name: forward_prefill_with_compression
nodes.summary: Main bridge function — extracts raw token IDs via LatentPrefillAdapter, walks entries to build latent_indices/segment_ids/weights metadata, and returns a CompressedPrefillPlan for the standard forward_prefill path.

nodes.name: spectral_lod.rs
nodes.summary: Spectral Level-of-Detail (SLoD) analyzer that picks per-window compression ratios by estimating information density from token-ID spectral energy concentration, maintaining a target average ratio across all windows (Plan 235).
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a token-ID-difference heuristic as a zero-allocation proxy for FFT-based spectral analysis.

nodes.name: SpectralLOD
nodes.summary: Analyzer struct (fft_size, high_detail_threshold) exposing energy_concentration, optimal_ratio, and adaptive_ratios for per-window compression selection.

nodes.name: energy_concentration
nodes.summary: Computes a [0,1] spectral energy concentration score for a token window using token-ID differences as a zero-allocation density proxy (1.0 = information-dense, 0.0 = redundant).

nodes.name: adaptive_ratios
nodes.summary: Selects a per-window CompressionRatio so that information-dense windows get less compression (X4) and redundant ones get more (X16), while hitting the target average ratio across the whole window set.

nodes.name: wire.rs
nodes.summary: Wire-level patch protocol — defines a 68-byte #[repr(C)] LatentPatch (segment_id + 8 × f32 weights + BLAKE3 commitment) plus LatentPatchBatch, PatchReceipt, and PatchRejection for committing latent-to-latent updates over the wire without decompress/recompress.
nodes.languageNotes: LatentPatch is repr(C) at 68 bytes to fit a single cache line; commitment uses BLAKE3.

nodes.name: LatentPatch
nodes.summary: Wire unit for a single latent-segment weight overwrite — carries segment_id, fixed-size [f32; 8] weights for SIMD, and a BLAKE3 commitment with new / compute_commitment / verify_commitment / weights_finite helpers.

nodes.name: LatentPatchBatch
nodes.summary: SIMD-friendly batch of LatentPatch entries plus total_segments, compression_ratio, tick, and validation_mod — provides verify_all_commitments and assert_chain_safe for chain-layer validation.

nodes.name: PatchReceipt
nodes.summary: Outcome struct separating committed segment IDs from rejected ones, with all_committed() helper for quick success checks.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: LatentPatch constructor that computes the BLAKE3 commitment over segment_id + weights at creation time so receivers can verify integrity.

nodes.name: compute_commitment
nodes.summary: BLAKE3 hasher over little-endian segment_id bytes followed by each weight's bytes, returning the 32-byte commitment used for tamper detection.

nodes.name: verify_all_commitments
nodes.summary: Validates every patch in a LatentPatchBatch — checks finite weights, recomputes BLAKE3 commitments, and assembles a PatchReceipt of committed vs rejected (CommitmentMismatch / NonFiniteWeights / SegmentNotCompressible / OutOfRange) entries.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for the faithfulness diagnostic suite — re-exports gate, types, and (feature-gated) probe, perturb, attribution, smear, and goat_gate submodules. Implements the GOAT-proved causal-intervention framework from Zhao et al. 2026.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses #[cfg(feature = ...)] gates: `faithfulness_probe` (opt-in diagnostic), `triggered_injection` (default-on hot path), and `smear_classifier` (ternary classification Phase 2).

nodes.name: attribution.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the AttributionProbe trait and a finite-difference implementation that estimates per-segment memory attribution via symmetric +/- epsilon perturbation, returning an L2 norm of the behavioral gradient.

nodes.name: gate.rs
nodes.summary: Hot-path injection gate — EntropyThresholdGate uses a sigmoid on (uncertainty - tau) scaled by lambda to decide whether to inject memory on a given tick. Targets sub-10ns zero-alloc decisioning for the triggered_injection feature.
nodes.languageNotes: Delegates sigmoid evaluation to crate::simd::fast_sigmoid; gate structs are Copy for in-place hot-path usage.

nodes.name: goat_gate.rs
nodes.summary: GOAT verdict test harness — exercises G1 (faithful vs unfaithful detection ≥99%), G2 (Spearman ρ ≥0.8 between finite-difference attribution and exact gradient), G3 (triggered injection skip rate ≥50% with quality parity), and G8 (static invariant) properties of the faithfulness suite. Includes random consumer fixtures and rank-correlation helpers.
nodes.languageNotes: Only compiled under #[cfg(all(test, feature = "faithfulness_probe"))]; uses seeded RNG for deterministic property tests with explicit detection-rate thresholds.

nodes.name: perturb.rs
nodes.summary: Causal intervention primitives — five perturbation strategies (empty, shuffle, corrupt, irrelevant-substitute, filler) applied to memory slices to measure how disrupting each segment changes consumer behavior.

nodes.name: probe.rs
nodes.summary: Core FaithfulnessProbe trait and DefaultFaithfulnessProbe implementation — orchestrates perturbation strategies across a ConsumerContext to produce a FaithfulnessProfile, with optional SmearSource integration for ternary classification reports.
nodes.languageNotes: Provides both alloc-free probe_intervention (hot path) and scratch-buffer probe_intervention_full (audit path) variants to keep per-tick work allocation-free.

nodes.name: smear.rs
nodes.summary: Ternary smear classifier (Plan 298) — CosineSmearClassifier categorizes latent-mass distribution across attention hypotheses as CoherentSingle, TokenSmear, or SequenceSmear using cosine similarity thresholds (epsilon, tau_same).
nodes.languageNotes: Uses simd_dot_f32 for hot-path dot products; SmearClass is a C-like enum with three variants covering the paper's vocabulary.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Foundational types for the faithfulness module — Intervention enum (Empty/Shuffle/Corrupt/Irrelevant/Filler), FaithfulnessProfile struct of per-intervention deltas, ConsumerContext trait, and MemorySlice trait (impl'd for Vec).

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for head substitution — re-exports HeadSubstitutionGate, worst_case_behavior_delta, and iou. Implements the control loop from Hayes et al. 2026 (arXiv:2606.19317) that gates when a FuncAttn surrogate substitutes for a real attention head, using a two-stage cadence (cheap IoU proxy per-call, expensive faithfulness veto cached at audit cadence).

nodes.name: gate.rs
nodes.summary: HeadSubstitutionGate decision struct — combines IoU threshold (tau_iou) with a cached faithfulness veto (tau_behavior on worst_case_behavior_delta) to decide whether a FuncAttn-style surrogate may replace a real attention head on the current forward pass.
nodes.languageNotes: Generic over FaithfulnessProfile<D>; alloc-free hot path (should_substitute is #[inline]); allocation only on refresh_cache/update_head audit-cadence paths.

nodes.name: iou.rs
nodes.summary: Intersection-over-Union (IoU) implementation for attention-row similarity — the cheap proxy that gates head substitution. Includes chunked-tail SIMD path and scalar fallback, validated against hand-computed overlap values.

nodes.name: attribution_norm
nodes.summary: Computes per-segment attribution via symmetric finite differences — clones memory twice, applies +/- epsilon to each segment, queries consumer.behavior_with_memory on both, and returns L2 norm of the resulting gradient vector.

nodes.name: should_inject
nodes.summary: Hot-path injection decision — returns true when sigmoid((uncertainty - tau) * lambda) exceeds 0.5, i.e. when entropy crosses the tau threshold with slope lambda. Designed for sub-10ns zero-alloc execution.

nodes.name: EntropyThresholdGate
nodes.summary: Sigmoid-gated entropy threshold gate parameterized by tau (threshold) and lambda (slope). Copy + Default; the default-on TriggeredInjectionGate implementation used on the per-tick hot path.

nodes.name: g1_g1b_extended_detection_rate_at_least_99_percent
nodes.summary: GOAT G1 property test — verifies DefaultFaithfulnessProbe correctly classifies faithful consumers (is_faithfully_used == true) and rejects unfaithful ones at ≥99% rate over many random trials with seeded RNG.

nodes.name: spearman_rho
nodes.summary: Computes Spearman rank-correlation coefficient between two f32 slices via the ranks helper — used by G2 attribution tests to measure finite-difference vs exact-gradient agreement.

nodes.name: ranks
nodes.summary: Ranks an f32 slice in ascending order using index-sort with total_cmp, returning 1-based rank positions. Used by spearman_rho for nonparametric correlation.

nodes.name: g2_attribution_spearman_rho_at_least_0p8_across_50_segments
nodes.summary: GOAT G2 property test — verifies FiniteDifferenceAttributionProbe's attribution_norm ranking correlates (Spearman ρ ≥0.8) with the exact gradient norm of a NonlinearConsumer across 50 randomly generated memory segments.

nodes.name: g2_attribution_spearman_rho_monotonic_stronger_segments
nodes.summary: GOAT G2 monotonicity companion — verifies that attribution ranking remains consistent (ρ ≥0.8) as segment magnitudes scale up, ensuring the probe is robust across signal strengths.

nodes.name: g3_triggered_injection_skips_at_least_50pct_with_quality_parity
nodes.summary: GOAT G3 property test — verifies EntropyThresholdGate::should_inject skips injection on ≥50% of low-uncertainty ticks while maintaining cosine-similarity quality parity with the always-inject baseline.

nodes.name: g3_triggered_injection_quality_floor
nodes.summary: GOAT G3 quality-floor companion — verifies that even when injection is skipped, gated predictions remain above an absolute cosine-similarity floor against ground truth, preventing quality collapse.

nodes.name: g8_static_invariants_when_features_on
nodes.summary: GOAT G8 static invariant test — verifies EntropyThresholdGate's sigmoid_value matches the closed-form 1/(1+exp(-lambda*(u-tau))) at boundary and mid-range values when the feature flag is enabled.

nodes.name: perturb_shuffle
nodes.summary: Fisher-Yates style in-place shuffle of memory elements — preserves the multiset of values while destroying positional/sequential structure. No-op for slices shorter than 2.

nodes.name: perturb_corrupt
nodes.summary: Corrupts memory by swapping random pairs of elements — preserves overall value set but disrupts local structure. Models token-level noise injection for the Corrupt intervention variant.

nodes.name: perturb_irrelevant
nodes.summary: Substitutes memory elements with random samples drawn from an irrelevant_pool — measures behavioral delta when the consumer is fed off-distribution inputs. No-op when pool is empty.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a DefaultFaithfulnessProbe from a ConsumerContext, irrelevant_pool, and filler_elem — initializes with no smear classifier (Some(...) set later via with_smear_classifier).

nodes.name: probe_intervention
nodes.summary: Apply a single Intervention variant to a memory clone, query consumer.behavior_with_memory, and return the behavioral delta vs baseline. Alloc-free hot-path variant used by the audit-cadence profiler.

nodes.name: faithfulness_profile
nodes.summary: Runs all five interventions (Empty, Shuffle, Corrupt, Irrelevant, Filler) on the given memory and assembles a FaithfulnessProfile of per-intervention behavioral deltas — the primary audit-cadence entry point.

nodes.name: probe_intervention_full
nodes.summary: Extended probe_intervention that also classifies the perturbed memory with an optional SmearClassifier, producing an InterventionOutcome combining behavioral delta and SmearReport. Uses a caller-provided scratch buffer to stay alloc-free.

nodes.name: faithfulness_profile_full
nodes.summary: Extended faithfulness_profile that produces FaithfulnessProfileFull combining the binary profile with a per-intervention SmearReport — used when smear_classifier feature is on for richer diagnostics.

nodes.name: FaithfulnessProbe
nodes.summary: Trait abstracting a faithfulness diagnostic — exposes probe_intervention (single intervention) and faithfulness_profile (full sweep). Implementers include DefaultFaithfulnessProbe; the trait allows mock/probabilistic implementations.

nodes.name: DefaultFaithfulnessProbe
nodes.summary: Canonical FaithfulnessProbe implementation — holds a ConsumerContext, irrelevant_pool, filler_elem, and an optional SmearClassifier. Drives the perturb::* functions and aggregates per-intervention deltas.

nodes.name: classify
nodes.summary: Core CosineSmearClassifier method — given attention weights, a hypothesis index k, embedding dim d, and a scratch buffer, computes pairwise cosine similarities and returns a SmearReport classified as CoherentSingle / TokenSmear / SequenceSmear using epsilon (low-norm filter) and tau_same (same-direction threshold).

nodes.name: CosineSmearClassifier
nodes.summary: Concrete SmearClassifier implementation — parameterized by epsilon (minimum hypothesis norm to consider) and tau_same (cosine threshold for same-direction). Default thresholds tuned for typical attention head geometry.

nodes.name: ConsumerContext
nodes.summary: Trait abstracting a memory-consuming model component — exposes baseline_behavior, behavior_with_memory (apply memory, get scalar), and behavior_delta (distance metric). Implemented by linear/nonlinear test consumers and by real attention heads.

nodes.name: MemorySlice
nodes.summary: Trait abstracting read/write access to a memory buffer — exposes mem_as_slice and mem_as_mut_slice. Blanket-implemented for Vec<T>, allowing perturb::* and probe::* to operate on owned vectors without generic bounds churn.

nodes.name: worst_case_behavior_delta
nodes.summary: Conservative substitution-cost proxy — returns the max of the three disruptive intervention deltas (shuffle_or_corrupt, irrelevant, filler), excluding empty_delta (the graceful-absence baseline). Used by HeadSubstitutionGate as the faithfulness veto signal.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a HeadSubstitutionGate with explicit tau_iou, tau_behavior thresholds and a pre-computed cached_faithfulness profile per head. Use empty() for lazy initialization followed by update_head calls.

nodes.name: should_substitute
nodes.summary: Hot-path substitution decision — accepts surrogate only when head_iou ≥ tau_iou AND worst_case_behavior_delta(cached_profile) ≤ tau_behavior. Alloc-free single-comparison fast path; designed to be inlined into the attention forward pass.

nodes.name: HeadSubstitutionGate
nodes.summary: Decision struct governing per-head surrogate substitution — holds tau_iou, tau_behavior thresholds and a Vec of cached FaithfulnessProfile entries. Implements the Plan 287 SinkAware two-stage cadence (cheap IoU proxy per-call, expensive faithfulness veto cached at audit cadence).

nodes.name: iou
nodes.summary: Intersection-over-Union similarity between two attention rows — treats each row as a set of (index, value) pairs and computes IoU via min/max aggregation. Returns 1.0 for identical rows, 0.0 for disjoint support. The cheap proxy that gates head substitution.
nodes.languageNotes: Includes a chunked-tail SIMD path for large rows; the scalar fallback handles short rows and tail remainders deterministically.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for katgpt-micro-belief that declares all submodules and exports two crate-local unsafe helpers (uninit_stack, assume_init_slice) for stack-allocated scratch buffers used by the SIMD recurrent kernels.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses const-generic MaybeUninit arrays on the stack to avoid heap allocation in hot kernel step paths; assume_init_slice reinterprets the buffer via from_raw_parts_mut.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the core MicroRecurrentBeliefState trait (dim/step/project_to_scalars/family), the RecurrenceFamily enum (Attractor/LatentThought/DeltaRule), the KernelConfig builder, and the shared project_to_scalars_bridge helper that all kernel families delegate to.
nodes.languageNotes: The trait is object-safe (used as dyn in tests.rs) and the bridge helper centralizes sigmoid-gated projection so each kernel family only implements step() differently.

nodes.name: bridge.rs
nodes.summary: Thin bridge wrapper that re-exports project_to_scalars as a standalone function delegating to the shared impl_bridge; all kernel families route their scalar projection through this module.

nodes.name: attractor.rs
nodes.summary: Implements AttractorKernel, the primary sigmoid-gated recurrent belief kernel with Xavier-scaled weights, SIMD dot products, stack-allocated scratch buffers, a precomputed-Wx fast path, depth-invariance auditing, and snapshot serialization.
nodes.languageNotes: step_with_precomputed_wx is a bit-identical optimization over step that hoists the Wx*x dot out for callers that can reuse it (used by LatentThoughtKernel); uninit_stack::<1024> avoids heap allocation in the hot path.

nodes.name: leaky.rs
nodes.summary: Implements LeakyIntegrator (the DeltaRule family), a clamped leaky accumulator delegating its inner step to katgpt_types::leaky_core::leaky_step, with an hla_default preset and depth-invariance auditing.
nodes.languageNotes: step clamps the delta to [-max_delta, max_delta] before applying it to the state, keeping the activation bounded in [-1, 1] without a sigmoid.

nodes.name: latent_thought.rs
nodes.summary: Wraps an AttractorKernel with k_iters of latent refinement per step: k=0 is a noop, k=1 is bit-identical to the underlying attractor, and higher k increases settling speed toward the fixed point.
nodes.languageNotes: Composes AttractorKernel via the inner field and reuses precompute_wx_dot + step_with_precomputed_wx so each refinement iteration is bit-identical to a fresh attractor step.

nodes.name: bom.rs
nodes.summary: Bayesian-of-Mind (BoM) hypothesis sampler: given a belief state and observation, draws k noisy state hypotheses via i.i.d. or Quasi-Monte-Carlo (Lattice/Stratified/Sobol) strategies, then selects the best by a configurable scorer. Includes a blake3-committed NoiseQueryConfig builder.
nodes.languageNotes: BoMSampler is a trait implemented per kernel family (attractor + leaky); NoiseQueryConfig::commit hashes sigma/k/seed_strategy/qmc_method with blake3 for reproducibility auditing.

nodes.name: bom_arena.rs
nodes.summary: Synthetic threat-avoidance arena and planner harness for the G2 benchmark suite: defines BoMMinimaxPlanner, BoMMeanPlanner, a DeterministicPlanner baseline, the SyntheticThreatArena environment, and run_arena_comparison / run_planner drivers that score win-rate, latency, and boundedness across episodes.
nodes.languageNotes: BeliefPlanner is an object-safe trait so planners can be swapped generically inside run_planner; the arena uses fastrand for deterministic episode reset.

nodes.name: snapshot.rs
nodes.summary: MicroRecurrentKernelSnapshot: a blake3-committed, tamper-evident, serde-serializable commitment over a kernel's family, dim, and weights_blob, with from_kernel / from_parts constructors and idempotent commit/verify.
nodes.languageNotes: commit and verify hash family||dim||weights_blob with blake3; version is intentionally excluded from the hash so format bumps remain content-addressable.

nodes.name: coherence_bench.rs
nodes.summary: G2.1 coherence benchmark: runs LeakyIntegrator, AttractorKernel, and LatentThoughtKernel over a 3-phase synthetic input sequence, measuring flip-flop count and ambiguous-window argmax variance to verify the attractor family is at least as coherent as the leaky baseline.

nodes.name: tests.rs
nodes.summary: G1 property test suite: determinism across instances, boundedness under extreme input, bridge ranking preservation, sub-100ns step latency budget, and a multi-threaded snapshot atomicity stress test using AtomicPtr + Arc clones.
nodes.languageNotes: g1_5_snapshot_atomicity spawns reader threads holding Arc clones while the writer swaps the boxed kernel through AtomicPtr::swap, exercising the lock-free snapshot read path.

nodes.name: AttractorKernel
nodes.summary: The primary micro-recurrent belief kernel: holds ws/wx/b weight matrices (Xavier-scaled from a seed), a clamp bound, and implements the full MicroRecurrentBeliefState trait with SIMD step, precomputed-Wx fast path, scalar projection, and snapshot serialization.

nodes.name: step
nodes.summary: Trait step implementation: computes Ws*state + Wx*input + bias via SIMD dots, applies the fused sigmoid-tanh clamp in place, writes the [-1,1]-clamped next state, and copies it back into the caller's buffer.

nodes.name: step_with_precomputed_wx
nodes.summary: Bit-identical fast path that skips the Wx*input dot when the caller has already precomputed it via precompute_wx_dot, used by LatentThoughtKernel to amortize the cost across k refinement iterations.

nodes.name: from_seed
nodes.summary: Deterministic constructor that seeds a fastrand RNG and fills ws/wx with Xavier-scaled uniform noise in [-scale, scale] where scale = sqrt(dim), leaving bias at zero.

nodes.name: audit_depth_invariance
nodes.summary: Drives the kernel over an input chain with two buffers and pipes the resulting activation chain through katgpt_types::depth_invariance::classify_chain to verify the kernel does not exhibit depth-dependent drift.

nodes.name: NoiseQueryConfig
nodes.summary: Builder-style configuration for the BoM sampler covering k (hypothesis count), sigma (noise scale), seed strategy (PerNpc/PerClass), and qmc method (Lattice/Stratified/Sobol); commit() returns a blake3 commitment of all fields for reproducibility.

nodes.name: BoMSampler
nodes.summary: Trait abstracting k-state hypothesis sampling + best-state selection over any MicroRecurrentBeliefState kernel; implemented separately for the attractor and leaky families with shared select_best_generic ranking.

nodes.name: sample_k_states
nodes.summary: Core BoM sampler for the attractor family: draws k Gaussian-noised queries, steps each hypothesis forward through the kernel with the clamped sigmoid update, and writes the resulting k candidate states into the output buffer.

nodes.name: select_best_generic
nodes.summary: Generic ranker that scores each hypothesis with a caller-supplied scorer (e.g. dot_product_scorer) and returns the index of the maximum, breaking ties toward the lowest index for determinism.

nodes.name: BoMMinimaxPlanner
nodes.summary: BoM planner that samples k hypotheses each tick and selects the action evading the worst-case (minimax) hypothesized threat direction; used as the candidate in the G2a/G2b arena comparison.

nodes.name: BoMMeanPlanner
nodes.summary: BoM planner that averages the k sampled hypotheses into a mean belief vector before choosing an evade action; serves as the weaker baseline that BoMMinimaxPlanner must beat in G2d.

nodes.name: SyntheticThreatArena
nodes.summary: Deterministic synthetic environment emitting a 2D threat vector plus scalar features each tick, applying evade actions, accumulating hit penalties, and terminating after max_ticks or max_hits; the standard testbed for the G2 planner suite.

nodes.name: run_planner
nodes.summary: Episode driver that resets the environment per seed, runs the planner's plan_action each tick until terminal, and returns a PlannerOutcome with mean score, win-rate, and total micros.

nodes.name: run_arena_comparison
nodes.summary: Convenience wrapper that runs baseline and candidate planners over the same episode seeds and returns a ComparisonResult with win-rate delta and latency ratio for G2 pass/fail verdicts.

nodes.name: LatentThoughtKernel
nodes.summary: Wrapper kernel that runs k_iters of latent refinement per step by calling precompute_wx_dot once and feeding the result through step_with_precomputed_wx k times; k=1 reduces to the plain AttractorKernel.

nodes.name: step
nodes.summary: Runs the inner attractor step once, then iterates precompute_wx_dot + step_with_precomputed_wx for the remaining k_iters-1 refinements so each latent iteration reuses the same Wx*x dot product.

nodes.name: LeakyIntegrator
nodes.summary: DeltaRule family kernel: clamped leaky accumulator that delegates its inner update to katgpt_types::leaky_core::leaky_step, providing hla_default presets, scalar projection via the bridge, and depth-invariance auditing.

nodes.name: step
nodes.summary: Sums the input vector and delegates to leaky_step which applies lr*sum clamped to [-max_delta, max_delta] to the running state, keeping activations in [-1, 1].

nodes.name: audit_depth_invariance
nodes.summary: Drives the leaky kernel over an input chain and pipes the resulting activation chain through katgpt_types::depth_invariance::classify_chain to check for drift, mirroring the AttractorKernel audit.

nodes.name: MicroRecurrentKernelSnapshot
nodes.summary: Tamper-evident kernel commitment: stores family, dim, weights_blob, a version, and a blake3 hash; from_kernel builds and auto-commits, from_parts accepts a pre-computed hash, and verify recomputes the hash to detect blob mutation.

nodes.name: CoherenceReport
nodes.summary: Holds KernelRunReports for leaky, attractor, and latent-thought kernels and renders a verdict table comparing flip-flop counts and ambiguous-window argmax variance side by side.

nodes.name: run_kernel
nodes.summary: Runs a single kernel over the 3-phase input sequence, stepping and projecting to scalars each tick while counting flip-flops in the stable phases and recording argmax variance across the ambiguous window.

nodes.name: run_g2_1_coherence_benchmark
