nodes.summary: Builds the deterministic input sequence, constructs LeakyIntegrator, AttractorKernel, and LatentThoughtKernel with default seeds, runs each through run_kernel, and returns a CoherenceReport.

nodes.name: MicroRecurrentBeliefState
nodes.summary: Object-safe trait unifying all micro-recurrent belief kernels behind dim/step/project_to_scalars/family, enabling dyn dispatch in tests and a single BoMSampler implementation per family.

nodes.name: KernelConfig
nodes.summary: Builder-style configuration (dim, family, clamp, seed) used by AttractorKernel::from_config and the arena factory functions to construct kernels from a single parameter struct.

nodes.name: uninit_stack
nodes.summary: Returns a const-N MaybeUninit<[f32; N]> allocated on the stack, used by the SIMD step paths to avoid heap allocation of scratch dot-product buffers.

nodes.name: assume_init_slice
nodes.summary: Reinterprets a MaybeUninit buffer of length len as an &mut [f32] via from_raw_parts_mut after the caller has fully initialized it.

nodes.name: chain.rs
nodes.summary: Composes multiple compiled specs into a chain combined with AND/OR operators, validating tokens against the intersection or union of member spec bitmaps. Includes a blake3-based chain hash for deterministic identity and batch validation over candidate token sets.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses CompactBitmap union/intersect operations and binary-search-based sorted-index intersection for combining member spec allowed/blocked sets.

nodes.name: compiler.rs
nodes.summary: SpecCompiler translates natural-language spec strings (classification, extraction, format-repair) into CompiledSpec rule sets by classifying intent, extracting labels, and building CompactBitmap allowed/blocked token sets. Produces a blake3 spec hash and byte-size estimate for each compilation.
nodes.languageNotes: Keyword-based classify_spec walks a lowercase containment ladder to map spec strings onto SpecType variants; extract_classification_labels parses 'or'-separated and colon-delimited label grammars.

nodes.name: dfa.rs
nodes.summary: Deterministic finite automaton engine for format-constrained generation, with hand-built DFAs for email, phone, date, and URL formats. Provides BFS-based completion-distance horizons and singular-span analysis for speculative-decoding guidance.
nodes.languageNotes: Transitions are sorted by from_state for binary_search_by lookup; FormatDfaBuilder constructs DFAs imperatively via CompactBitmap char-class bitmaps and accept-state sets.

nodes.name: marginals.rs
nodes.summary: SpecMarginals converts a CompiledSpec into additive token biases applied to logits during inference, aggregating allowed/blocked tokens into a sorted bias map with top-k selection and in-place logit mutation.
nodes.languageNotes: Bias map is sorted by token_idx then dedup_sum'd; binary_search_by_key gives O(log n) bias_for_token lookup; apply_to_logits mutates a slice in-place with a fast-path for empty bias sets.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel for the spec_compile subsystem, re-exporting the chain, compiler, DFA, marginals, proof, pruner, router, screening, and types submodules.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust module root that declares submodules and re-exports their public items.

nodes.name: ChainOp
nodes.summary: Enum selecting how consecutive specs in a SpecChain are combined: And intersects allowed sets and unions blocked sets; Or unions allowed sets and intersects blocked sets.

nodes.name: SpecChain
nodes.summary: Composes an ordered list of CompiledSpecs with per-pair ChainOp operators, caching a blake3 chain_hash and delegating is_valid/batch_is_valid/relevance across all members according to the operator sequence.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a SpecChain from specs and per-pair operators, asserting non-empty specs and matching op length, then computing and caching the deterministic chain hash.

nodes.name: combine_bitmaps
nodes.summary: Folds the chain's member global_allowed/global_blocked bitmaps into a single pair using AND-intersect / OR-union semantics driven by the ChainOp sequence.

nodes.name: is_valid
nodes.summary: Checks token validity by short-circuiting across all member specs: every member must accept for AND chains, and the first member sets the baseline for subsequent operators.

nodes.name: batch_is_valid
nodes.summary: Batch validity check that threads a candidate token array through every member spec's batch_is_valid, AND/OR-combining the results vector in place for speculative-decoding acceptance.

nodes.name: relevance
nodes.summary: Computes aggregate soft relevance for a token across chain members by taking the min for AND pairs and the max for OR pairs of per-spec relevance scores.

nodes.name: spec_relevance
nodes.summary: Helper returning a single member spec's relevance for a token, defaulting to 1.0 when the spec has no applicable rule and 0.0 when the token is hard-rejected.

nodes.name: bitmap_intersect
nodes.summary: Computes the sorted-index intersection of two CompactBitmaps via a two-pointer merge over their sparse arrays, rebuilding a Sparse or Dense result and falling back to a Box<[u64]> dense form for large ranges.

nodes.name: compute_chain_hash
nodes.summary: Derives a deterministic blake3 digest over the chain's spec hashes and operator tags so two chains with identical members and operators compare equal.

nodes.name: SpecCompiler
nodes.summary: Stateful compiler holding a vocab_size that dispatches spec strings through classification, extraction, and format-repair compilation paths into CompiledSpec rule sets with a spec hash and size estimate.

nodes.name: compile
nodes.summary: Top-level entry that hashes the spec string, classifies it, extracts labels, dispatches to the matching compile_* path, and packages the resulting rules into a CompilationResult with vocab bounds and a size estimate.

nodes.name: compile_classification
nodes.summary: Builds a depth-0 allowlist rule whose allowed bitmap contains the byte-token indices of every character in each classification label string, treating each label as an alternative token sequence.

nodes.name: compile_extraction
nodes.summary: Detects extraction target type (email/url/number/alphanumeric) from the spec text and emits a depth-0 rule whose allowed bitmap is the corresponding character class (letters, digits, separators).

nodes.name: compile_format_repair
nodes.summary: Emits format-repair rules keyed by detected format (JSON, CSV, generic printable), each with an allowed bitmap of valid structural and payload characters for that format's repair grammar.

nodes.name: classify_spec
nodes.summary: Maps a spec string to a SpecType variant via an ordered lowercase-substring containment ladder covering sentiment/return-only/extraction/format-repair/intent-routing keywords.

nodes.name: extract_labels
nodes.summary: Dispatches label extraction to extract_classification_labels for classification specs and returns an empty list for other spec types.

nodes.name: extract_classification_labels
nodes.summary: Parses classification labels from a spec string by trying colon-delimited, ' or '-separated, and comma-separated grammars, then falling back to single uppercase/alphanumeric word extraction with length and content filtering.

nodes.name: estimate_size
nodes.summary: Estimates the in-memory byte footprint of a rule set by summing SpecRule struct size, per-bitmap payload (sparse array length * 2 or dense 8 KiB), and prefix-entry arrays.

nodes.name: DfaTransition
nodes.summary: Edge record mapping a source state plus a CompactBitmap char class to a destination state, stored in a sort-by-from_state vector for binary lookup.

nodes.name: SpecDFA
nodes.summary: Compiled deterministic finite automaton over byte-valued tokens, exposing state traversal, BFS completion-distance horizons, singular-span analysis, and a SpecPruner-compatible is_valid for format-constrained generation.

nodes.name: SpecCompileError
nodes.summary: Error enum returned by compile_format_spec for unknown format names, over-complex DFAs, or invalid spec descriptions, with a Display implementation.

nodes.name: FormatDfaBuilder
nodes.summary: Factory exposing email_dfa, phone_dfa, date_dfa, and url_dfa constructors that imperatively assemble state machines from CompactBitmap char classes and accept-state sets.

nodes.name: current_state
nodes.summary: Walks the transition table from the start state consuming the provided byte sequence, returning the final state or a dead-state sentinel on any failed transition.

nodes.name: next_state
nodes.summary: Binary-searches the transition vector for edges leaving the given state whose char class contains the input byte, returning the destination state or None if no edge matches.

nodes.name: allowed_chars
nodes.summary: Computes the union bitmap of every char class on edges leaving the given state, yielding the set of bytes that would not immediately dead-end the automaton.

nodes.name: bfs_min_distance
nodes.summary: Breadth-first search from a state to the nearest accept state over the transition graph, returning the minimum number of additional tokens needed to reach acceptance (the speculative-decoding horizon).

nodes.name: singular_span_from
nodes.summary: Measures how many consecutive forced single-outgoing transitions follow from a state before the automaton branches, useful for detecting deterministic completion runs in format DFAs.

nodes.name: outgoing_count
nodes.summary: Counts edges leaving a state via binary search for the from_state range, used by singular_span_from and complexity heuristics.

nodes.name: is_valid
nodes.summary: SpecPruner-compatible validity check that projects parent_tokens to bytes, walks to the current state, and returns true only if the next token's byte has a valid outgoing edge.

nodes.name: min_completion_distance
nodes.summary: SpecPruner-compatible horizon query returning the BFS distance from the current state (after consuming parent_tokens plus the candidate token) to the nearest accept state, capped at a max sentinel.

nodes.name: singular_span_len
nodes.summary: SpecPruner-compatible wrapper that projects parent_tokens to bytes, walks to the current state, and delegates to singular_span_from to report the forced-completion run length.

nodes.name: email_dfa
nodes.summary: Builds the email-format DFA with states for local-part alphanumerics+symbols, the '@' separator, domain alphanumerics, the '.' separator, and a 2+ character alpha TLD accept state.

nodes.name: phone_dfa
nodes.summary: Builds the phone-number DFA accepting digit groups separated by dashes, spaces, dots, or parenthesised area codes, with multiple accept states for common grouping patterns.

nodes.name: date_dfa
nodes.summary: Builds the ISO-style date DFA requiring four-digit year, dash, two-digit month, dash, two-digit day, with a single accept state at the end of the run.

nodes.name: url_dfa
nodes.summary: Builds the URL DFA accepting an optional scheme, '://', alpha/alphanumeric host, optional port and path separators, with multiple accept states for host-only and fully-qualified URLs.

nodes.name: compile_format_spec
nodes.summary: Top-level format compiler that lowercases the format name, dispatches to the matching FormatDfaBuilder constructor, ensures transitions are sorted, and returns SpecCompileError on unknown names.

nodes.name: SpecMarginals
nodes.summary: Holds a sorted vector of TokenBias entries derived from a CompiledSpec, exposing bias_for_token lookup, apply_to_logits mutation, top-k selection, and a SpecPruner-compatible is_valid gate.

nodes.name: from_spec
nodes.summary: Constructs SpecMarginals by walking every SpecRule's allowed/blocked bitmaps, accumulating positive/negative biases per token index, then sorting and dedup-summing the bias map into the final TokenBias vector.

nodes.name: bias_for_token
nodes.summary: Returns the additive bias for a token via binary_search_by_key over the sorted biases vector, falling back to default_bias when the token has no explicit entry.

nodes.name: apply_to_logits
nodes.summary: Mutates a logits slice in place by adding per-token biases, using a fast no-op path when the bias set is empty and a merged walk of biases and logits otherwise.

nodes.name: top_k_biases
nodes.summary: Returns the k TokenBias entries with the largest bias values by collecting, sort_unstable_by descending bias, and taking the first k cloned entries.

nodes.name: dedup_sum
nodes.summary: Linear pass over a token-sorted bias map that merges duplicate token indices by summing their biases into a single entry, producing the canonical sorted bias vector.

nodes.name: proof.rs
nodes.summary: SpecProof and SpecCommitment provide blake3-based cryptographic commitments over compiled specs, enabling tamper detection on rules, prefixes, vocab size, and global bitmaps, plus source-string verification.
nodes.languageNotes: Hashes every spec field (vocab_size, global bitmaps, each rule with depth/prefix/allowed/is_allowlist) into a single blake3 digest; verify recomputes and compares in constant time via digest equality.

nodes.name: pruner.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the SpecPruner validation interface on CompiledSpec, checking token validity against depth-keyed rules, prefix context, and global allowed/blocked bitmaps with batch candidate screening.
nodes.languageNotes: find_rule linearly scans rules matching by prefix; batch_is_valid intersects rule-level binary_search membership with global allow/block fast paths to avoid redundant scans.

nodes.name: router.rs
nodes.summary: SpecRouter classifies compiled specs by complexity (Simple/Medium/Fuzzy) using rule count, bitmap size, and depth-diversity heuristics, then routes each to a compute tier (CPU/SIMD/GPU/ANE) with latency-aware overrides.
nodes.languageNotes: classify_complexity thresholds on max-rule-count (<=4 Simple, <=32 Medium) and max-bitmap-size (<=128 Simple, <=1024 Medium) and distinct-depth-count (<=1 Simple); route_with_latency downgrades Fuzzy to SIMD when latency-critical.

nodes.name: screening.rs
nodes.summary: Implements soft relevance scoring on CompiledSpec, returning sigmoid-graded [0,1] relevance for tokens in ambiguous rule contexts and binary 0/1 for hard allow/block decisions, enabling speculative-decoding acceptance gating.
nodes.languageNotes: relevance short-circuits to 0.0 for global-blocked tokens and 1.0 for empty specs; ambiguous (rule with prefix match but no depth) cases fall through to a sigmoid smoothing of the binary membership signal.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Core data model for the spec_compile subsystem: SpecRule, PrefixEntry, CompiledSpec, CompactBitmap (a three-variant Empty/Sparse/Dense bitmap with binary-search membership), SpecType enum, and CompilationResult.
nodes.languageNotes: CompactBitmap auto-promotes from Empty to Sparse (Box<[u16]>) to Dense (Box<[u64]>) as membership grows; from_sorted_indices picks Sparse below a 1/8 density threshold and Dense above.

nodes.name: SpecProof
nodes.summary: Cryptographic commitment record capturing the blake3 digest of a compiled spec along with its rule_count, total allowed/blocked counts, and the original spec source string for re-verification.

nodes.name: SpecCommitment
nodes.summary: Timestamped wrapper around SpecProof that records when the commitment was sealed, supporting from_spec construction and delegated verify against a later spec instance.

nodes.name: from_spec
nodes.summary: Constructs a SpecProof by computing the blake3 commitment over the spec, summing per-rule allowed counts into total_allowed/total_blocked, and storing the source string for later verification.

nodes.name: compute_commitment
nodes.summary: Feeds vocab_size, global_allowed, global_blocked, and every rule (via hash_rule) into a blake3 hasher to derive the canonical 32-byte spec commitment digest.

nodes.name: hash_rule
nodes.summary: Hashes a single SpecRule's depth, is_allowlist flag, allowed/blocked bitmaps, and prefix entries (depth + token_idx each) into the running hasher so any rule mutation changes the digest.

nodes.name: hash_bitmap
nodes.summary: Feeds a CompactBitmap's variant tag plus its payload (sparse indices or dense 64-bit words) into the hasher, covering Empty/Sparse/Dense forms so bitmap edits are detectable.

nodes.name: is_valid
nodes.summary: Checks whether a token is valid at the given depth by finding the first matching rule (by prefix), testing allowed-list membership, then enforcing global blocked/allowed bitmaps as fallback gates.

nodes.name: batch_is_valid
nodes.summary: Batch-screens a candidate token array in one pass: resolves the applicable rule once, binary-searches the allowed array for each candidate, and overlays global allow/block gates into the results vector.

nodes.name: find_rule
nodes.summary: Linear scan returning the first SpecRule whose prefix matches the parent token context (or the first prefix-less rule), used to locate the applicable allow/block bitmap for a given position.

nodes.name: prefix_matches
nodes.summary: Element-wise compares a rule's prefix entry vector against the trailing parent_tokens slice, returning true when every prefix depth/token_idx lines up with the corresponding parent position.

nodes.name: SpecComplexity
nodes.summary: Three-level complexity enum (Simple, Medium, Fuzzy) assigned by classify_complexity based on rule count, max bitmap size, and distinct-depth diversity of a compiled spec.

nodes.name: ComputeTier
nodes.summary: Enum of target execution backends (Cpu, Simd, Gpu, Ane) that route selects based on spec complexity, with the Apple Neural Engine as the highest-throughput option for fuzzy workloads.

nodes.name: SpecRouter
nodes.summary: Stateless router exposing classify_complexity, route, route_batch, and route_with_latency to map compiled specs onto ComputeTiers, with a latency-critical override that pulls Fuzzy down to SIMD.

nodes.name: classify_complexity
nodes.summary: Scores a spec as Simple/Medium/Fuzzy from three signals: max rule count across rules+globals (thresholds 4/32), max bitmap size (128/1024), and number of distinct rule depths (>1 forces Medium+).

nodes.name: route_with_latency
nodes.summary: Routes a spec to a ComputeTier with a latency_critical flag: when critical, Fuzzy is downgraded to SIMD and Medium to CPU to keep per-token overhead bounded for interactive decoding.

nodes.name: relevance
nodes.summary: Returns a soft [0,1] relevance score for a token: 0.0 if globally blocked, 1.0 if no rules apply, the rule's hard membership (1.0/0.0) when a rule cleanly accepts/rejects, or a sigmoid-smoothed value for ambiguous prefix-matched rules.

nodes.name: prefix_matches
nodes.summary: Checks whether a rule's prefix entries align with the trailing parent_tokens context, mirroring pruner.rs prefix matching for relevance rule selection.

nodes.name: SpecRule
nodes.summary: A single constraint rule carrying an optional depth, a prefix-entry context vector, an allowed CompactBitmap, and an is_allowlist flag selecting whether the bitmap denotes allowed or blocked tokens.

nodes.name: CompiledSpec
nodes.summary: Top-level compiled-spec container holding a blake3 spec_hash, the rule vector, vocab_size, and global_allowed/global_blocked CompactBitmaps that apply at every depth as fallback membership gates.

nodes.name: CompactBitmap
nodes.summary: Three-variant token-set bitmap (Empty, Sparse Box<[u16]>, Dense Box<[u64]>) with binary-search membership, sorted-index construction, insert with auto-promotion, and union_with merging; the workhorse set type across the spec_compile subsystem.

nodes.name: SpecType
nodes.summary: Enum tagging the inferred purpose of a spec string: Classification, Extraction, FormatRepair, IntentRouting, or Unknown, driving dispatch in the compiler and router.

nodes.name: CompilationResult
nodes.summary: Bundle returned by SpecCompiler::compile containing the CompiledSpec, inferred SpecType, rule_count, estimated size_bytes, and an is_exact flag indicating whether the constraint is a hard allowlist.

nodes.name: from_sorted_indices
nodes.summary: Constructs a CompactBitmap from a pre-sorted index slice, choosing Sparse (Box<[u16]>) when indices fit u16 and are sparse, or Dense (Box<[u64]>) when the index range exceeds the density threshold.

nodes.name: from_token_indices
nodes.summary: Filters an arbitrary token-index iterator to u16 range, sorts and dedups the collected values, then delegates to from_sorted_indices to build the bitmap.

nodes.name: all_set
nodes.summary: Builds a bitmap representing the contiguous range [0, count), choosing Sparse for small counts and Dense with a packed-bitword array for larger ones.

nodes.name: contains
nodes.summary: Membership test dispatching on bitmap variant: binary_search over the Sparse u16 array, bitword mask test for Dense, and constant false for Empty.

nodes.name: insert
nodes.summary: Inserts an index into the bitmap, binary-searching the Sparse array and promoting to Dense via from_sorted_indices when the sparse form grows past the density threshold.

nodes.name: union_with
nodes.summary: In-place union of another bitmap into self, dispatching on variant pairs: Dense|Dense ORs bitwords in place, Sparse targets insert each source index with auto-promotion, and Empty takes the other bitmap wholesale.

nodes.name: fmt
nodes.summary: Display implementation for CompactBitmap rendering the variant name and popcount (sum of count_ones over dense bitwords or sparse array length) for debugging.

nodes.name: bandit.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the ruliology multi-armed bandit: each enumerated simple-program strategy becomes an arm with UCB1 scoring, plus an absorb/compress layer that promotes statistically dominant arms for KV-cache-style compression.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses incremental-mean reward updates and is_multiple_of check_interval for triggering compression passes.

nodes.name: ca.rs
nodes.summary: Cellular-automaton strategy (Wolfram 1D rules 0..255) implementing the SimpleProgram trait, with full rule enumeration and a distinctness filter keyed on blake3 fingerprints of the runtime trace.

nodes.name: fsm.rs
nodes.summary: Core FSM(N) strategy and enumerator — exhaustive enumeration of deterministic finite-state machines over N states, with a round-robin tournament runner that produces a WinMatrix.
nodes.languageNotes: FsmEnumerator is a unit struct used purely as a namespace for associated functions, a common Rust pattern for grouping stateless constructors.

nodes.name: irreducibility.rs
nodes.summary: IrreducibilityGate that quantizes a payoff matrix to bytes and uses Shannon entropy plus RLE compression ratio to decide whether a tournament outcome is algorithmically reducible (skippable) or irreducible (needs full simulation).
nodes.languageNotes: Combines two compressibility signals (entropy < 4 bits => use normalized entropy, else use RLE ratio) — a hybrid Kolmogorov-complexity estimator.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for katgpt-ruliology — declares all submodules and re-exports the public API surface (FSM/CA/TM strategies, enumerators, gates, bandit, and pruner).
nodes.languageNotes: Standard Rust crate-root pattern: pub mod declarations plus pub use re-exports to flatten the public namespace.

nodes.name: mutation.rs
nodes.summary: FSM template proposer and co-evolution driver — mutates strategies (output flip / edge reroute), runs blind and delta-gated hill-climbing against an opponent pool, and returns the best-evolved FSM with acceptance history.
nodes.languageNotes: Delta-gated variant rejects proposed mutants whose payoff delta is below a configurable threshold — an inference-time analog to simulated annealing acceptance.

nodes.name: payoff.rs
nodes.summary: Canonical 2x2 game payoff functions (matching pennies and prisoner's dilemma) used as the scoring function supplied to tournaments and co-evolution.

nodes.name: simulation_gate.rs
nodes.summary: SimulationGate router that classifies a payoff matrix as reducible (analytical shortcut), lightweight, or irreducible (full simulation) by delegating to IrreducibilityGate, returning a strategy + recommended round count.

nodes.name: tm.rs
nodes.summary: Turing-machine strategy with a 1-state enumeration space (read/write/move triples on a bounded tape) implementing the SimpleProgram trait for use as a bandit arm.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Shared ruliology types — the SimpleProgram trait, WinMatrix tournament result with Pareto-front extraction, and RuliologyPruner that filters strategies by payoff and complexity thresholds.

nodes.name: RuliologyArm
nodes.summary: Single bandit arm wrapping a strategy with an incremental-mean payoff estimate, pull count, and UCB1 upper-confidence-bound score.

nodes.name: RuliologyBandit
nodes.summary: Multi-armed bandit over ruliology strategies — constructed from a Pareto-filtered strategy pool via FsmEnumerator tournament results, exposes UCB1-based arm selection and incremental updates.

nodes.name: RuliologyPromoteConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for arm promotion — min visits, payoff threshold, max promotions, and check interval that gate when an arm graduates to compression candidacy.

nodes.name: RuliologyAbsorbCompress
nodes.summary: Absorb-then-compress driver that wraps a RuliologyBandit, periodically promoting arms meeting min-visit and payoff thresholds and returning the single promoted winner when one emerges.

nodes.name: from_strategies
nodes.summary: Constructs a RuliologyBandit by running an FSM tournament over the given strategies, computing their Pareto front, and seeding arms from strategies that clear payoff and complexity thresholds.

nodes.name: select_arm
nodes.summary: Selects the next arm to pull using the UCB1 rule (argmax over each arm's ucb1_score), with unvisited arms scoring +infinity so they are tried first.

nodes.name: best_arm
nodes.summary: Returns the index of the arm with the highest empirical payoff using total_cmp for NaN-safe f64 comparison.

nodes.name: best_unpromoted_arm
nodes.summary: Returns the highest-payoff arm index excluding those already promoted, used to pick the next compression candidate.

nodes.name: compress
nodes.summary: Runs a promotion pass over the bandit arms, elevating any arm that exceeds min_visits and payoff_threshold into the promoted set (bounded by max_promotions).

nodes.name: promoted_winner
nodes.summary: Returns the single highest-payoff promoted arm index (or None) — the canonical winner once the absorb/compress cycle converges.

nodes.name: CaStrategy
nodes.summary: Wolfram elementary cellular-automaton strategy — a single u8 rule number applied to a bounded tape, with full 0..255 enumeration and a fingerprinted distinctness deduper.

nodes.name: enumerate_distinct
nodes.summary: Enumerates all 256 elementary CA rules, runs each for a fixed number of steps, and returns the distinct ones by hashing their trace fingerprint with blake3.

nodes.name: next_action
nodes.summary: Advances the CA one step using the recent opponent history as tape input, returning the next binary action (cooperate/defect).

nodes.name: step_into
nodes.summary: In-place Wolfram-rule application over a tape buffer, writing the next generation into the provided out slice.

nodes.name: FsmStrategy
nodes.summary: Deterministic finite-state machine strategy parameterized by a transition table and per-state output table, with blake3-hashed identity and computed Kolmogorov-style complexity.

nodes.name: compute_complexity
nodes.summary: Computes a normalized complexity score for an FSM by collecting and deduplicating its transition/output values, returning the distinct-value count as a proxy for algorithmic complexity.

nodes.name: enumerate
nodes.summary: Exhaustively enumerates all FSMs over n_states, deduplicating by a blake3-hashed behavioral fingerprint obtained by exercising each machine against a synthetic opponent history.

nodes.name: enumerate_raw
nodes.summary: Lower-level enumeration that walks the full n^(n*n) transition-output space for a given state count and pushes every distinct FsmStrategy into the output buffer without deduplication.

nodes.name: tournament
nodes.summary: Runs an all-pairs round-robin tournament over the supplied strategies for the given round count, applying the provided payoff function and returning a ranked WinMatrix.

nodes.name: IrreducibilityGate
nodes.summary: Gate that decides whether a payoff matrix is algorithmically reducible by quantizing it to bytes and combining Shannon entropy with RLE compression ratio against a configurable threshold.

nodes.name: analyze
nodes.summary: Quantizes the matrix payoffs to a byte stream, computes byte-distribution Shannon entropy and RLE ratio, then selects the more informative compression ratio and compares it against the gate threshold to flag reducibility.

nodes.name: rle_compress
nodes.summary: Run-length encodes a byte slice into (value, count) pairs — a secondary compressibility signal used by analyze when entropy alone is inconclusive.

nodes.name: FsmTemplateProposer
nodes.summary: Proposes mutated FSM variants by stochastically flipping per-state outputs and rerouting transition edges, parameterized by state count and a mutation rate.

nodes.name: propose
nodes.summary: Randomly mutates an FSM's transition edges and outputs according to the configured mutation_rate, returning a new candidate FsmStrategy.

nodes.name: mutate_specific
nodes.summary: Applies a single specific MutationType (OutputFlip or EdgeReroute) at a chosen state index, used for deterministic mutation testing and analysis.

nodes.name: co_evolve
nodes.summary: Blind hill-climbing co-evolution — repeatedly proposes mutated children of a seed strategy, evaluates them against an opponent pool, and accepts any improvement regardless of step size.

nodes.name: delta_gated_co_evolve
nodes.summary: Delta-gated variant of co_evolve that rejects proposed mutants whose payoff improvement falls below a configurable threshold, reducing wasted evaluations on near-zero gains.

nodes.name: evaluate_vs_opponents
nodes.summary: Evaluates a candidate strategy's average payoff against a pool of opponent strategies by playing a round-robin match with the given payoff function.

nodes.name: prisoners_dilemma
nodes.summary: Classic prisoner's dilemma payoff function returning (T,R,P,S) rewards for temptation, reward, punishment, and sucker outcomes — used as the default scoring kernel for tournaments.

nodes.name: SimulationGate
nodes.summary: Top-level gate that wraps IrreducibilityGate and routes a payoff matrix to one of three simulation strategies (analytical shortcut, lightweight, full) with a recommended round count.

nodes.name: SimulationGateConfig
nodes.summary: Threshold configuration for the SimulationGate — reducible/irreducible compression-ratio boundaries plus recommended round counts for the lightweight and full simulation branches.

nodes.name: route
nodes.summary: Routes a payoff matrix to AnalyticalShortcut, LightweightSimulation, or FullSimulation based on its IrreducibilityResult compression ratio falling below/above the configured thresholds.

nodes.name: TmStrategy
nodes.summary: Turing-machine strategy — bounded tape, head position, current state, and a transition table; supports 1-state enumeration and stepwise action generation against opponent history.

nodes.name: next_action
nodes.summary: Generates the next binary action by reading the opponent's last move onto the tape, executing the matching TM transition (write + head move + state change), and emitting the written symbol.

nodes.name: enumerate_1_state
nodes.summary: Enumerates all 1-state Turing machines by decoding every transition configuration into a TmStrategy, returning the full enumeration space for tournament seeding.

nodes.name: compute_complexity
nodes.summary: Computes a complexity proxy for a TM by collecting and deduplicating its transition triples (write/move/target) and returning the distinct count.

nodes.name: SimpleProgram
nodes.summary: Trait unifying all enumerable simple-program strategies (FSM, CA, TM) — requires next_action generation, a blake3-derived identity u64, and a complexity score.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust trait used as a structural interface — strategies implement it so they can be uniformly enumerated and ranked by the bandit/tournament layer.

nodes.name: WinMatrix
nodes.summary: Tournament result holder storing per-strategy payoff rows and an id ranking, with Pareto-front extraction that filters out complexity-dominated strategies.

nodes.name: RuliologyPruner
nodes.summary: Strategy pruner that filters a WinMatrix by minimum average payoff and maximum complexity thresholds, returning the surviving strategy ids.

nodes.name: pareto_front
nodes.summary: Computes the Pareto front of strategies on the (avg payoff, complexity) axes, keeping only strategies not dominated by any other and returning them sorted by payoff descending.

nodes.name: filter
nodes.summary: Returns the strategy ids whose average payoff clears the payoff_threshold and whose complexity is below the complexity_threshold.

nodes.name: conjecturer.rs
nodes.summary: Pool-based curiosity conjecturer that samples candidate directions proportional to bandit priorities via an inverse-CDF walk, using an embedded xorshift64* RNG and optional magnitude-bounded perturbation of sampled directions.
nodes.languageNotes: Hosts an inline xorshift64* generator (next_u64) so sampling stays deterministic and allocation-free; sample_candidates reuses a caller-provided CDF scratch buffer to avoid per-cycle heap traffic.

nodes.name: PoolConjecturer
nodes.summary: Concrete CuriosityConjecturer over a fixed pool of Direction vectors; holds the RNG state and perturbation magnitude used by sample_candidates.

nodes.name: build_cdf
nodes.summary: Constructs a prefix-sum CDF over non-negative finite priorities into a reusable scratch buffer, normalizing by the total mass.

nodes.name: sample_index
nodes.summary: Inverse-CDF walk that maps a uniform u in [0, total) to a candidate arm index, saturating at the last slot for numerical safety.

nodes.name: sample_candidates
nodes.summary: Core conjecture routine: builds the priority CDF then draws k candidates, copying the chosen pool direction into each slot and optionally perturbing it with a uniform hypersphere offset.

nodes.name: derivative_curiosity.rs
nodes.summary: Curiosity driver that wraps a PoolConjecturer with a TemporalDerivativeKernel and a sigmoid surprise gate, exposing cycle_curiosity to observe preference drift, sample candidates, absorb rewards, and trigger collapse/recovery on the underlying bandit.
nodes.languageNotes: Wraps the lower-level PoolConjecturer via composition rather than generics, and feeds preference deltas through a TemporalDerivativeKernel before applying a sigmoid surprise nonlinearity — a GOAT-style 'interestingness' signal.

nodes.name: DerivativeCuriosity
nodes.summary: Holds a PoolConjecturer, TemporalDerivativeKernel, beta scale, fixed-size preference buffer, and last computed interestingness score; methods live in the surrounding impl block.

nodes.name: observe_interestingness
nodes.summary: Copies the latest priority vector into the preference buffer, feeds the delta through the temporal derivative kernel, and applies a sigmoid surprise gate to update last_interestingness.

nodes.name: cycle_curiosity
nodes.summary: Full curiosity cycle: samples candidates, scores them, absorbs rewards into the bandit, renormalizes priorities, computes entropy, and — if entropy collapses below tau — injects exploration and re-renormalizes. Returns updated priority state and entropy diagnostics.

nodes.name: sample_candidates
nodes.summary: Thin wrapper that first observes interestingness from the current priorities, then delegates the actual sampling to the inner PoolConjecturer.

nodes.name: dual_pool.rs
nodes.summary: Dual-pool (exploitation vs exploration) HintDeltaBandit with sigmoid-gated routing between the two pools, weighted update of pool-selection weights, periodic consolidation that promotes high-reward exploration arms into the exploitation pool, and a VecBandit reference implementation. Includes extensive GOAT-proof test gates (sigmoid routing, irreducibility, log-regret, e-pool growth, faithfulness).
nodes.languageNotes: Routing probability is computed as sigmoid(w_e - w_x), clamped to [min_exploration_prob, 1], which keeps the x_pool reachable even at extreme exploitation weights — a Markov-chain irreducibility property asserted by g1_markov_chain_irreducibility. Growth of the exploitation pool is gated by an external faithfulness probe via consolidate_growing_gated.

nodes.name: PoolId
nodes.summary: Enum tagging the active pool as either Exploitation or Exploration.

nodes.name: ReachableDualPoolRouter
nodes.summary: Helper that exposes route_select / route_update / consolidate / exploitation_probability / is_reachable, guaranteeing the exploration pool is never made unreachable by clamping the sigmoid routing probability.

nodes.name: DualPoolConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration record for DualPoolBandit: alpha update gain, weight decay, success threshold, consolidation cadence and blend factor, min exploration probability, RNG seed, growth toggle, promotion threshold, and max exploitation-pool size.

nodes.name: DualPoolBandit
nodes.summary: HintDeltaBandit implementation composed of two inner VecBandits (e_pool, x_pool), selection weights, per-pool reward accumulators, an exploration-arm reward window, and an embedded RNG; all routing and consolidation methods are defined in the surrounding impl block.

nodes.name: with_config
nodes.summary: Builds a DualPoolBandit from two inner bandits plus a DualPoolConfig, validating arm counts, seeding the RNG, and initializing reward-tracking buffers sized to the exploration pool.

nodes.name: begin_cycle
nodes.summary: Draws a fresh uniform and sets the active pool for the upcoming cycle using the sigmoid exploitation probability.

nodes.name: end_cycle
nodes.summary: Finalizes a cycle: routes the update into both pools with their rewards, bumps the consolidation counter, and triggers consolidation when the configured interval elapses.

nodes.name: consolidate_growing_gated
nodes.summary: Promotes the best-rewarded exploration arm into the exploitation pool only if the external faithfulness gate accepts it and capacity remains; drops the worst exploitation arm to make room.

nodes.name: absorb
nodes.summary: Forwards a reward update to the active pool's absorb, clamping against the per-arm reward ceiling, and accumulates the reward into the x-arm reward window when the exploration pool is hit.

nodes.name: route_select
nodes.summary: Sigmoid-gated pool router: returns (pool, arm) by flipping a biased coin for the pool, then inverse-CDF sampling the arm within that pool's priorities.

nodes.name: route_update
nodes.summary: Exponential moving-average update of w_e / w_x toward whichever pool produced the reward, clamped to a non-negative floor to preserve reachability.

nodes.name: consolidate
nodes.summary: Cycle-counted consolidation dispatcher: promotes exploration arms via consolidate_growing when growth is enabled, otherwise falls back to consolidate_blend, then decays the exploration pool's priorities.

nodes.name: sample_arm_from
nodes.summary: Inverse-CDF arm sampler over an arbitrary priority slice: sanitizes non-finite/non-positive masses to a tiny floor, accumulates the CDF inline, and returns the index where the running sum crosses the supplied uniform u.

nodes.name: filters.rs
nodes.summary: Admission gates for candidate batches: BreakevenDifficultyFilter rejects candidates whose estimated solve rate sits outside a configured [floor, ceiling] band, and ColinearityBatchGate flags whole batches as degenerate when any pair of admitted directions exceeds a cosine-similarity threshold.

nodes.name: BreakevenDifficultyFilter
nodes.summary: DifficultyFilter that admits a candidate iff its estimated solve rate is within [floor, ceiling]; all other candidates are pruned before the bandit sees them.

nodes.name: ColinearityBatchGate
nodes.summary: BatchQualityGate that marks a batch degenerate when any two admitted candidate directions are closer than the configured cosine threshold, forcing the loop to discard and resample.

nodes.name: is_degenerate
nodes.summary: Returns the index of the first pair of admitted candidates whose cosine similarity breaches the threshold (or None), short-circuiting the pairwise scan as soon as a collision is found.

nodes.name: guide.rs
nodes.summary: HLA (Hyperdimensional Latent Alignment) projection guide: scores a candidate against the target by combining a sigmoid-gated directional alignment term with a structural-complexity penalty (L2, disjunction, redundancy), producing a unit-interval QualityGuide output.

nodes.name: ComplexityWeights
nodes.summary: Weights for the structural-complexity penalty: disjunction, length, redundancy, and a nominal_length anchor used to compute the excess-length penalty term.

nodes.name: HlaProjectionGuide
nodes.summary: QualityGuide implementation that blends sigmoid(target·candidate) with a sigmoid-gated negative complexity penalty, controlled by lambda (alignment weight), alpha (blend), and ComplexityWeights.

nodes.name: structural_complexity
nodes.summary: Computes a non-negative complexity score for a Direction as a weighted sum of three terms: excess L2 norm over nominal_length, max-coordinate disjunction, and redundancy above the 1/n uniform floor.

nodes.name: loop_.rs
nodes.summary: Top-level CGSP orchestrator: defines CgspLoop (the好奇 cycle driver), CgspConfig, EntropyCollapse (entropy-floor exploration injection), and the KnpcSelector/KnpcDecision k_npc adaptive-loop halter. The cycle() method wires conjecturer -> guide -> difficulty filter -> solver -> bandit absorb -> entropy collapse into a single no-panic/no-NaN step, with snapshot/restore for persistence and run_with_snapshotting for long-running drivers.
nodes.languageNotes: cycle() is a 157-line monolith that threads mutable borrows through six trait objects; renormalize_priorities is exported as a free function so external bandit implementations can reuse the same finite/non-negative normalization invariant.

nodes.name: CgspConfig
nodes.summary: Tunable parameters for CgspLoop: candidate count k, entropy-floor tau_low, exploration injection magnitude, solve-rate admission band, k_npc adaptive planning horizon, and staleness decay lambda.

nodes.name: CgspLoop
nodes.summary: Top-level CGSP driver composed of a CuriosityConjecturer, QualityGuide, Solver, HintDeltaBandit, optional CollapseSignal / DifficultyFilter / BatchQualityGate, CgspConfig, and RNG state.

nodes.name: EntropyCollapse
nodes.summary: CollapseSignal implementation that triggers exploration injection when bandit priority entropy falls below tau_low, then mixes uniform mass into each arm and re-renormalizes.

nodes.name: KnpcDecision
nodes.summary: Enum returned by KnpcSelector: either Continue the current planning run or PlanInterval (halt and re-plan).

nodes.name: KnpcSelector
nodes.summary: Adaptive k_npc selector that wraps a GainCostLoopHalter, observes per-cycle gain/cost/cos_theta signals, and adjusts the planning horizon tau between [k_min, k_max].

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: CgspLoop constructor: wires the conjecturer, guide, solver, bandit, and config, installs a default EntropyCollapse, and seeds the RNG.

nodes.name: with_collapse
nodes.summary: Builder that overrides the default CollapseSignal with a caller-supplied implementation (e.g., a custom EntropyCollapse threshold).

nodes.name: with_difficulty_filter
nodes.summary: Builder that installs a DifficultyFilter used to prune candidates whose estimated solve rate is outside the admission band.

nodes.name: with_batch_gate
nodes.summary: Builder that installs a BatchQualityGate used to reject degenerate candidate batches (e.g., colinear directions).

nodes.name: cycle
nodes.summary: Single CGSP cycle: samples k candidates, scores each with the guide, filters by difficulty, runs the solver per admitted candidate, computes staleness-weighted rewards, absorbs into the bandit, renormalizes priorities, computes entropy, and triggers EntropyCollapse injection when below tau_low. Returns a CycleResult with stats.

nodes.name: snapshot
nodes.summary: Captures the current pool directions and bandit priorities into a CuriosityPrioritySnapshot, padding directions with zeros when the bandit has grown beyond the conjecturer pool.

nodes.name: restore
nodes.summary: Restores bandit priorities from a CuriosityPrioritySnapshot, validating arm-count and slice-length compatibility and returning an error rather than panicking on mismatch.

nodes.name: run_with_snapshotting
nodes.summary: Runs n consecutive cycles, invoking a snapshot sink every n-th cycle for downstream persistence/inspection.

nodes.name: renormalize_priorities
nodes.summary: Re-normalizes a priority slice in place to a valid probability distribution: replaces non-finite/negative entries with a uniform floor and divides by the finite sum, falling back to uniform when the mass is non-finite.

nodes.name: observe_cycle
nodes.summary: KnpcSelector::observe_cycle: queries the wrapped GainCostLoopHalter for a halt decision, accumulates the planning horizon tau upward on healthy signals, and clamps into [k_min, k_max].

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel for the cgsp (Curiosity-Gated Speculative Pruning) subsystem: re-exports the public API from conjecturer, derivative_curiosity, dual_pool, filters, guide, loop_, traits, and types, and hosts inline integration tests (full-cycle no-panic, priority convergence, snapshot persistence, collapse recovery) plus a stub VecBandit for test scaffolding.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust module root that aggregates leaf modules via pub mod + pub use; the inline integration tests construct a full CgspLoop with default components and exercise the cycle/snapshot/encode/decode pipeline end-to-end.

nodes.name: traits.rs
nodes.summary: Trait surface for the cgsp subsystem: CuriosityConjecturer, QualityGuide, Solver, HintDeltaBandit, BatchQualityGate, CollapseSignal, DifficultyFilter, plus NoOpBatchGate and NoOpDifficultyFilter defaults. Also includes a VecBandit stub used as the canonical HintDeltaBandit implementation in tests.
nodes.languageNotes: HintDeltaBandit exposes num_arms/push_arm/is_growing with default bodies that delegate to priorities() / priorities_mut(), so concrete bandits only need to implement the storage accessors.

nodes.name: CuriosityConjecturer
nodes.summary: Trait for sampling k candidate Directions from a pool given the current bandit priorities; exposes pool_size and pool_directions for snapshotting.

nodes.name: QualityGuide
nodes.summary: Trait that scores a Candidate against the current Target, returning a unit-interval quality score.

nodes.name: Solver
nodes.summary: Trait that attempts to solve a target with a candidate direction, returning a synthetic SolveRate and a HintPolicy controlling whether the result feeds back into the bandit.

nodes.name: HintDeltaBandit
nodes.summary: Multi-armed bandit trait over hint deltas: absorb(priority, reward), priority/priorities accessors, num_arms, push_arm, and is_growing — the storage interface used by DualPoolBandit and the test VecBandit.

nodes.name: BatchQualityGate
nodes.summary: Trait that inspects a sampled batch and returns the index of a degenerate pair (or None), allowing the loop to discard and resample.

nodes.name: CollapseSignal
nodes.summary: Trait that decides whether the bandit has collapsed (low entropy) and, if so, injects exploration mass into the priorities.

nodes.name: DifficultyFilter
nodes.summary: Trait that admits or rejects a candidate based on guide score and estimated solve rate before the solver runs.

nodes.name: NoOpBatchGate
nodes.summary: Default BatchQualityGate that never flags a batch as degenerate.

nodes.name: NoOpDifficultyFilter
nodes.summary: Default DifficultyFilter that admits every candidate.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Core value types for cgsp: Direction (f32 vector with dot/norm), Target, Candidate, SolveRate newtype, HintPolicy/CycleStats/CycleResult records, ScratchBuffers (reusable per-cycle storage), and CuriosityPrioritySnapshot with hand-rolled little-endian encode/decode plus blake3 content hashing. Also exports sigmoid and entropy_nats math helpers used across the subsystem.
nodes.languageNotes: CuriosityPrioritySnapshot implements a manual binary protocol (magic + version + dim + pool_size + 16-byte snapshot_id + directions + priorities) with strict length checks; blake3_hash provides content-addressed identity for snapshot deduplication.

nodes.name: Direction
nodes.summary: Owned f32 coordinate vector with zeros/from_slice constructors, dim, dot (mul_add accumulation), norm_sq, and slice accessors — the fundamental unit of cgsp search directions.

nodes.name: Target
nodes.summary: Goal direction with an optional clamped priority_hint in [0, 1] used to bias conjecturer sampling.

nodes.name: Candidate
nodes.summary: A sampled Direction paired with its pool_index, so the bandit can credit rewards back to the originating arm.

nodes.name: SolveRate
nodes.summary: Newtype wrapping a clamped f32 in [0, 1] representing the synthetic solve rate returned by a Solver.

nodes.name: HintPolicy
nodes.summary: Enum controlling how a Solver's result feeds back: OrderOnly (default), PhaseInit (initialization phase), or Skip (do not absorb into the bandit).

nodes.name: CycleStats
nodes.summary: Aggregated statistics for one cycle: candidates sampled/admitted/solved, mean guide score, mean synthetic reward, and priority entropy.

nodes.name: CycleResult
nodes.summary: Outcome of a single CgspLoop::cycle: collapse_triggered flag, batch_degenerate flag, and the CycleStats.

nodes.name: ScratchBuffers
nodes.summary: Reusable per-cycle buffers (candidates, guide_scores, admitted flags, solve_rates, r_synth, cdf_scratch) that the loop grows once and clears each cycle to avoid allocation churn.

nodes.name: CuriosityPrioritySnapshot
nodes.summary: Persisted snapshot of the cgsp bandit state: directions, priorities, dimension, snapshot_id; supports binary encode_to/decode and blake3 content hashing.

nodes.name: dot
nodes.summary: Computes the inner product of two Direction vectors using mul_add for numerical stability and panicking on length mismatch.

nodes.name: ensure_len
nodes.summary: Grows or truncates the ScratchBuffers' candidate vector to exactly k entries, resizing each candidate's coordinate vector to dim and resizing all parallel arrays to match.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: CuriosityPrioritySnapshot constructor: infers dim from the first direction, assigns a fresh snapshot_id via snapshot_id_now, and stores the directions and priorities.

nodes.name: encode_to
nodes.summary: Serializes the snapshot to a little-endian byte buffer: magic, version, dim, pool_size, 16-byte snapshot_id, direction coordinates (zero-padded to dim), then priorities.

nodes.name: decode
nodes.summary: Deserializes a CuriosityPrioritySnapshot from a little-endian byte slice, validating the magic header and length invariants; returns a typed error on truncated or malformed input rather than panicking.

nodes.name: snapshot_id_now
nodes.summary: Generates a 16-byte unique snapshot id by combining the current UNIX-time milliseconds with fastrand-randomized bytes in the trailing slots.

nodes.name: entropy_nats
nodes.summary: Computes Shannon entropy in nats over a priority slice, treating it as a probability distribution after summing the total mass; returns 0 for empty input.

nodes.name: bake.rs
nodes.summary: BAKE precision-gated Bayesian embedding update: per-dimension precision tracking for KgEmbedding with monotonic precision growth, precision-weighted mean updates, regularization penalty, and (feature-gated under bake_precision) the lock-free BakePrecisionStore and session-boundary BakeSession for batched updates.
nodes.languageNotes: Operates on [f32; 8] fixed-size arrays for SIMD auto-vectorization; uses papaya lock-free HashMap for the precision store (feature-gated under bake_precision).

nodes.name: bake_update_precision
nodes.summary: BAKE eq 2 precision update: lambda_new = lambda_old + lambda_obs per dimension, monotonically accumulating precision across the 8-dim latent embedding.

nodes.name: bake_update_mean
nodes.summary: BAKE eq 3 precision-weighted mean update: mu_new = (lambda_old * mu_old + lambda_obs * obs) / lambda_new computed elementwise over the 8-dim embedding.

nodes.name: bake_update
nodes.summary: Combined BAKE update returning both new mean and new precision in a single pass; the canonical embedding-update entry point used by BakePrecisionStore.

nodes.name: bake_regularize
nodes.summary: BAKE eq 4 precision-weighted regularization penalty beta * sum |diff_d| * sqrt(lambda_d); hoists the sqrt out of the (lambda*diff^2)*sqrt chain so the FPU pipelines sqrt in parallel with the subtract.

nodes.name: precision_to_confidence
nodes.summary: Maps a precision vector to a scalar confidence via sigmoid(mean(lambda) - 1) using katgpt_types::simd::simd_sum_f32, providing the per-entity confidence signal consumed by the octree builder.

nodes.name: exploration_priority_with_max
nodes.summary: Per-dimension exploration priority in [0,1]: 1 - lambda_d / max(lambda), so low-precision dimensions absorb observations preferentially; takes a pre-computed max to avoid the O(8) scan per call.

nodes.name: informed_prior_precision
nodes.summary: Computes an informed prior precision vector lambda_init = class_count / (1 + class_count) in [0,1) from schema-class density, so dense classes start BAKE with higher precision.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for katgpt-sense: re-exports the BAKE, octree, reconstruction, LOD, schema-centroid, sector, and serialize sub-modules behind feature flags, with zero katgpt-core dependency (cycle broken).
nodes.languageNotes: Each sub-module is gated by a cargo feature (sense_lod, depth_invariance, schema_centroid, sector_projection, bake_precision), keeping unused substrates at zero cost.

nodes.name: lod.rs
nodes.summary: Level-of-detail routing for sense modules based on spectral scale boundaries: routes NPC-to-target distance to Full/Compressed/Minimal LOD levels and provides a fast boolean SenseLodMask indexed by SenseKind discriminant for activation filtering.

nodes.name: SenseLodLevel
nodes.summary: Three-level enum (Full/Compressed/Minimal) selecting which SenseKind modules stay active at each LOD tier; Full activates all six, Compressed keeps Common/Fighter/Spatial, Minimal keeps only Spatial.

nodes.name: SenseLodRouter
nodes.summary: Routes a scalar distance to a SenseLodLevel using two spectral sigma boundaries; supports batch assignment and a zero-alloc assign_lods_into variant that writes into a caller-owned buffer.

nodes.name: SenseLodMask
nodes.summary: Fast boolean activation mask indexed by SenseKind discriminant, with pre-computed const MASKS per LOD level (built once) and O(1) is_active / active_count queries used in the ~45ns/tick hot path.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a const MASKS array built once at compile time — one of the few places the codebase relies on Rust const-eval for runtime-zero-cost lookup.

nodes.name: module_mask
nodes.summary: Returns the static slice of SenseKind modules active at this LOD level: all six at Full, three at Compressed (Common/Fighter/Spatial), and only Spatial at Minimal.

nodes.name: route
nodes.summary: Maps a single distance to a SenseLodLevel by comparing against sigma1 and sigma2 thresholds, returning Full/Compressed/Minimal in O(1).

nodes.name: from_boundaries
nodes.summary: Constructs a SenseLodRouter from a ScaleBoundary slice by extracting the first two sigmas; returns None when fewer than two boundaries are supplied.

nodes.name: assign_lods_into
nodes.summary: Zero-alloc batch LOD assignment: writes SenseLodLevel for each distance into a pre-allocated output buffer, panicking on length mismatch.

nodes.name: octree.rs
nodes.summary: SenseOctreeBuilder: converts KG embeddings into bit-plane SenseModule octrees for ternary-direction lookup, including centroid-seeded construction from class hashes and Merkle-rooted variants for content-addressed snapshots.

nodes.name: KgEmbedding
nodes.summary: Lightweight KG embedding input record: entity_hash, relation_hash, 8-dim embedding vector, scalar confidence, and sign bit consumed by the octree builder.

nodes.name: SenseOctreeBuilder
nodes.summary: Builder that constructs SenseModule octrees from KG embeddings, capped at max_depth 3, supporting direct embedding input, centroid-seeded init via SchemaCentroidCache, and Merkle-rooted variants.

nodes.name: build
nodes.summary: Builds a SenseModule of the given SenseKind from a KgEmbedding slice: computes module confidence as the mean of per-embedding confidences (KG weight bridge, 0.5 fallback), then folds each embedding's ternary direction into the octree bit-planes.

nodes.name: build_from_centroid
nodes.summary: Centroid-seeded octree construction: synthesizes KgEmbeddings from per-class hashes via the SchemaCentroidCache and an RNG, then delegates to build() — used for cold-start entity init.

nodes.name: embedding_to_ternary
nodes.summary: Quantizes an 8-dim embedding into a ternary direction vector ({-1, 0, +1}) plus a sign bit, mapping continuous latent values onto the octree's discrete bit-plane encoding.

nodes.name: build_with_merkle
nodes.summary: Builds a SenseModule and attaches a Merkle root over its octree bit-planes for content-addressed snapshot verification.

nodes.name: build_merkle_only
nodes.summary: Computes only the Merkle root of an embedding set's octree bit-planes without retaining the full SenseModule, used for lightweight snapshot identity checks.

nodes.name: reconstruction.rs
nodes.summary: Reconstructive Memory Navigation (OctreeCTC, Plan 248): multi-step active reconstruction over KG-Latent-Octree sense modules, distilled from MRAgent (ICML 2026). The HLA state evolves with accumulated TripleEvidence under an entropy/advantage bandit, exposing scalar, SIMD, and pre-weighted matvec kernels plus a depth-invariance-aware surprise channel (Plan 277 Fusion F1).
nodes.languageNotes: Three expand/route/evolve kernel variants (scalar, SIMD, matvec) are kept in parallel so callers can pick the optimal backend per brain size; reconstruct_inner auto-selects via simd_beneficial().

nodes.name: OctreeNodeId
nodes.summary: Morton-code identifier (transparent u32 wrapper) for octree nodes; provides O(1) child, parent, and depth derivation via leading-zero count and integer log_8 — no node table needed.

nodes.name: TraversalAction
nodes.summary: Discriminated union for one reconstruction step: Forward (cue->tag->content with a tag_idx), Reverse (content->cue+tag with content_idx), or Halt when evidence is sufficient.

nodes.name: ReconstructionConfig
nodes.summary: Copy + Clone config knob bundle: max_steps (default 3, MRAgent diminishing-returns cutoff), LOD-adaptive pruning toggle, HLA learning rate, entropy threshold, max HLA delta, dual-EMA temporal-derivative alphas, and advantage-margin threshold.

nodes.name: TripleEvidence
nodes.summary: Accumulated evidence H(t) for a reconstruction pass: per-kind activations, confidence sum, sample count; supports merge, mean_confidence, activation_entropy, and SIMD-friendly kind_activations_padded.

nodes.name: ReconstructionState
nodes.summary: Core mutable reconstruction state: evolving HLA cue vector, accumulated TripleEvidence, config, lazy-init ProjectionWeights cache, active octree node set, step counter, and (feature-gated) dual-EMA TemporalDerivativeKernel surprise tracker. Exposes 28 expand/route/evolve/reconstruct variants and an hla_mut hook for post-evolve latent steering (Plan 309 Phase 5).
nodes.languageNotes: The surprise kernel and cached_weights fields are feature-gated for byte-identical layout when the feature is OFF, so the struct size shrinks at compile time.

nodes.name: ReconstructionResult
nodes.summary: Diagnostic result of a reconstruction pass: passive vs active retrieval outcomes, HLA delta, evidence snapshot, and step count; produced by compare_reconstruction for A/B benchmarking.

nodes.name: default
nodes.summary: ReconstructionConfig::default — canonical defaults: max_steps=3, LOD-adaptive pruning on, HLA learning rate, entropy threshold, max HLA delta, and dual-EMA temporal-derivative alphas matching the Plan 277 tuning.

nodes.name: from_modules
nodes.summary: ProjectionWeights::from_modules — pre-computes the (module x entity) projection matrix and per-module confidence vector from a SenseModule slice, enabling the fast expand_matvec / reconstruct_matvec paths.

nodes.name: expand_batch
nodes.summary: BatchProjectionWeights::expand_batch — applies the pre-computed projection matrix to a batch of HLA cues, writing per-batch activations into a caller-supplied output buffer in a single cache-friendly pass.

nodes.name: with_config
nodes.summary: ReconstructionState::with_config — constructs the state with a custom config, initializes active_nodes with the octree root, and (under temporal_deriv) builds the dual-EMA surprise kernel from config alphas.

nodes.name: evolve_hla
nodes.summary: Scalar HLA evolution kernel: applies the leaky integrator to fold accumulated kind activations into the HLA cue under the configured learning rate and max-delta clamp, then (under temporal_deriv) feeds the result to the surprise kernel.

nodes.name: evolve_hla_simd
nodes.summary: SIMD-vectorized HLA evolution kernel: same semantics as evolve_hla but maps the 8-dim leaky integrator onto explicit SIMD lanes (NEON/AVX2 FMA chain) for the ~45ns/tick hot path.
nodes.languageNotes: Hand-written SIMD intrinsic path avoids the auto-vectorizer's dependency on LLVM's reduction unrolling.

nodes.name: expand
nodes.summary: Scalar expand step: projects the current HLA cue across all active sense modules, producing per-module activations for the subsequent route step.

nodes.name: expand_simd
nodes.summary: SIMD expand step: vectorized projection of the HLA cue across sense modules, used when simd_beneficial() indicates enough modules to amortize the SIMD setup cost.

nodes.name: expand_with_weights
nodes.summary: Pre-weighted expand step: uses a pre-computed ProjectionWeights matrix to skip per-module direction traversal, falling between expand and expand_matvec in cost.

nodes.name: route
nodes.summary: Scalar route step: argmax selection over expanded activations to pick the next octree traversal direction (cue->tag->content), advancing the active node set under the entropy bandit.

nodes.name: route_simd
nodes.summary: SIMD route step: vectorized argmax over expanded activations for the hot path; uses a fixed 6-lane reduction matching the SenseKind discriminant count.

nodes.name: reconstruct_matvec
nodes.summary: Matvec reconstruction kernel: runs the full expand->route->evolve loop using pre-computed ProjectionWeights, optimal for brains with many modules where the matvec beats the per-module scalar loop.

nodes.name: reconstruct_with_weights
nodes.summary: Reconstruction pass with caller-supplied weights: drives one full multi-step reconstruction using a ProjectionWeights the caller already built, avoiding re-precompute across repeated passes.

nodes.name: reconstruct_inner
nodes.summary: Inner multi-step reconstruction loop shared by reconstruct / reconstruct_simd / reconstruct_matvec: iterates expand->route->accumulate->evolve_hla until sufficient evidence or max_steps, with auto SIMD selection. The core of active retrieval.

nodes.name: argmax6
nodes.summary: Fixed 6-lane argmax over a SenseKind activation slice (returns winning index + value); used by route to pick the next traversal direction without the overhead of a general-purpose argmax.

nodes.name: log_softmax_into6
nodes.summary: Fixed 6-lane log-softmax writing into a caller-owned buffer, used to normalize SenseKind activations into a log-probability distribution for the entropy bandit's advantage computation.

nodes.name: advantage_margin_hla
nodes.summary: Computes the advantage margin between the current HLA state and a candidate direction using log-softmax normalization over a caller-owned scratch buffer; drives the advantage-gated halt decision.

nodes.name: advantage_gate_halt
nodes.summary: Decides whether to halt reconstruction based on the advantage margin between the previous and current HLA state; returns true when further steps would not improve the retrieval meaningfully.

nodes.name: compare_reconstruction
nodes.summary: A/B benchmark harness: runs passive single-shot projection and active multi-step reconstruction over the same brain and returns a ReconstructionResult capturing HLA delta, evidence delta, and step count for offline comparison.

nodes.name: reconstruction_depth_invariance.rs
nodes.summary: Plan 331 Phase 1 depth-invariance audit and RmsNorm-wrapped HLA evolution: additive sibling methods on ReconstructionState (gated by depth_invariance feature) that exercise the leaky evolve_hla kernel under Constant or AlternatingSign stimulus schedules and classify the resulting HLA chain for attention-drift, leaving the raw kernel unchanged.
nodes.languageNotes: The raw evolve_hla kernel is intentionally left unchanged; these are opt-in defense-in-depth entry points (Research 151 / Plan 331 / arXiv:2605.09992 sec 4.4).

nodes.name: AuditStimulus
nodes.summary: Field-less repr(u8) enum selecting the per-tick drive schedule for audit_depth_invariance: Constant applies the same 6-kind activations each tick, AlternatingSign flips between positive/negative on even/odd ticks to surface unbounded accumulation under sign-flipping drive.

nodes.name: audit_depth_invariance
nodes.summary: Runs evolve_hla for k ticks under the supplied AuditStimulus schedule, capturing the (k+1)*8 HLA chain into a caller-owned buffer and classifying it via katgpt_types::classify_chain; leaves the chain populated for re-classification under alternative thresholds.

nodes.name: evolve_hla_regularized
nodes.summary: Regularized variant of evolve_hla: runs the raw leaky update then applies katgpt_types::apply_magnitude_regularization (RmsNorm-style) directly to the latent 8-vector as defense-in-depth magnitude hygiene, distinct from the downstream raw-scalar clamp bridge.

nodes.name: schema_centroid.rs
nodes.summary: Schema-Centroid Informed KG Embedding Initialization (Plan 237): pre-computes per-class centroid statistics (mean, std_dev, count) from KG snapshots using Welford's online algorithm, then initializes new entity embeddings near their class centroid with controlled perturbation to avoid cold-start randomness; integrates with BAKE informed priors when both features are enabled.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Welford's single-pass algorithm for numerically stable online mean+variance; the SchemaCentroidCache uses papaya lock-free HashMap for concurrent reads.

nodes.name: CentroidStats
nodes.summary: Pre-computed per-class centroid record: 8-dim mean vector, 8-dim per-dimension std_dev, and entity count; Copy + Clone, keyed by blake3 class hash in SchemaCentroidCache.

nodes.name: SchemaCentroidCache
nodes.summary: Lock-free cache of CentroidStats keyed by class hash (papaya HashMap); pre-computed once per KG snapshot update for O(1) lookup at entity init time, with compute_and_insert for incremental updates.

nodes.name: compute_centroid
nodes.summary: Computes CentroidStats from a same-class KgEmbedding slice in a single pass via Welford's online algorithm (mean + variance), returning None for an empty (degenerate) class; O(d*|E_c|) pure arithmetic, zero allocation beyond the return value.

nodes.name: schema_init_entity
nodes.summary: Initializes a new entity's 8-dim embedding near the weighted-mean centroid of its schema classes with gamma-scaled per-dimension noise, falling back to random init in [-0.5, 0.5] when no class is cached; uses a single papaya pin across all class lookups.

nodes.name: schema_init_with_precision
nodes.summary: Joint schema-centroid + BAKE informed-prior initializer (gated by schema_centroid + bake_precision): returns (mean, precision) where mean = schema_init_entity(...) and precision = informed_prior_precision(class_count), upgrading BAKE's uninformative prior to an informed prior for faster convergence.

nodes.name: sector.rs
nodes.summary: SectorProjection (Plan 262): const-generic multi-sector spatial projection that divides space around an NPC into N sectors and projects each into a latent score via sigmoid(dot(observation, direction_i)) using pre-converted f32 direction vectors. Zero-allocation, fixed-size, sigmoid-only (never softmax).
nodes.languageNotes: Direction vectors are stored as f32 (not the input i8 ternary) so the dot-product inner loop auto-vectorizes as a plain FMA chain — the earlier i8-as-f32 cast defeated LLVM's vectorizer.

nodes.name: SectorProjection
nodes.summary: Const-generic struct parameterized by (N sectors, D dimensions) holding pre-converted f32 direction vectors and the last computed scores; immutable after new()/update_directions() so the f32 representation is canonical.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructor: takes i8 ternary direction vectors {-1, 0, +1} and converts them once to f32 to enable SIMD-friendly dot products on every subsequent project() call; initializes scores to zero.

nodes.name: project
nodes.summary: Projects an observation vector into per-sector latent scores: scores[i] = sigmoid(dot(observation, sector_directions[i])) via a plain f32 FMA chain that LLVM maps to SIMD lanes; zero allocation, writes into the internal fixed-size buffer.

nodes.name: update_directions
nodes.summary: Replaces the sector direction vectors post-construction with a new i8 ternary set, re-converting to f32 in place; preserves the scores buffer untouched.

nodes.name: serialize.rs
nodes.summary: Binary serialization for SenseModule with BLAKE3 verification: save_module writes an SNSE magic + version + kind header followed by the repr(C) struct bytes with zeroed padding; load_module round-trips and verifies the embedded BLAKE3 checksum.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses MaybeUninit + ptr::copy_nonoverlapping to zero SenseModule padding without cloning the full struct; relies on SenseModule being repr(C) and Drop-less.

nodes.name: save_module
nodes.summary: Serializes a SenseModule to a writer: emits SNSE magic, version byte, kind byte, then the struct's raw bytes with padding zeroed (via a MaybeUninit copy) so the byte stream is deterministic.

nodes.name: load_module
nodes.summary: Deserializes a SenseModule from a reader: validates SNSE magic and version, reads the struct bytes into a zero-initialized buffer, reconstructs via ptr::read (SenseModule is repr(C) and valid for any bit pattern), and verifies the embedded BLAKE3 checksum.

nodes.name: graph.rs
nodes.summary: Core Progressive Monte-Carlo Graph Search (MCGS) data structure: a branch-aware graph that distinguishes primary tree edges from cross-branch reference edges, with LRU eviction, backprop along the primary chain only, and per-branch / global best tracking.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses parallel SoA-style Vecs (payloads, primary_parent, primary_children, branch_id, reference_edges, visits, cumulative_reward) indexed by a NodeId newtype for cache-friendly iteration; reference_edges are capped per node via LRU eviction rather than dedup-only.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for the progressive_mcgs subsystem; re-exports the graph, scheduler, stagnation gate, UCT, operators, search driver, types, and the test module that together implement branch-aware MCTS-style search.

nodes.name: operators.rs
nodes.summary: Reference-edge construction operators invoked when stagnation triggers fire: intra-branch ancestry walk, cross-branch top-N selection by Q-value, and multi-branch aggregation that picks the top node per branch.

nodes.name: scheduler.rs
nodes.summary: Entropy-gated selection scheduler that interpolates between pure UCT and Elite sampling as the search progresses (weight w decays across a normalized time window), plus diagnostic entropy / effective-branch-count helpers and a tiny fastrand-backed RngLite.
nodes.languageNotes: The UCT-to-Elite interpolation weight w is computed by smoothstepping between switch_start and switch_end in normalized search-progress time, giving a deterministic schedule rather than a learned one.

nodes.name: search.rs
nodes.summary: Top-level search driver that wires the graph, entropy-gated scheduler, stagnation gate and UCT descent into a single step() loop: each step picks a branch, descends to a leaf, expands via a SearchDomain, classifies the reward, backprops, and conditionally adds reference edges from stagnation triggers.
nodes.languageNotes: Exposes a SearchDomain trait (propose + evaluate) so the search is domain-agnostic; the StepResult carries reward classification (Failure/Progress/Breakthrough) plus the stagnation triggers that fired.

nodes.name: stagnation.rs
nodes.summary: Stagnation gate tracking steps-since-improvement per branch and globally, emitting StagnationTrigger variants (IntraBranchEvolve, CrossBranchReference, MultiBranchAggregation) once thresholds are crossed; resets on progress / breakthrough and supports dynamic branch growth.
nodes.languageNotes: Caps the trigger queue at length 3 (rolling) and exposes a hand-written StagnationTriggersIter to avoid allocating a Vec iterator in the hot path.

nodes.name: tests.rs
nodes.summary: Integration tests for the progressive_mcgs module covering GOAT guarantees (backprop isolation across reference edges, entropy diagnostics, stagnation trigger firing), a full search smoke cycle, deterministic replay, and operator / UCT smoke checks.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Foundational newtypes and enums for the MCGS module: NodeId and BranchId indices, EdgeKind (Primary vs Reference), a four-level Reward classification with float / improvement predicates, and ProgressiveMcgsConfig with a validate() method.

nodes.name: uct.rs
nodes.summary: UCT (Upper Confidence Bound for Trees) child-selection primitives: a schedule-aware exploration_constant that decays c_0 toward c_min across a time window, uct_select_child picking the argmax UCB1 score, and uct_descend_to_leaf that repeatedly applies it.

nodes.name: ProgressiveMcgs
nodes.summary: The branch-aware graph struct: parallel Vecs for payloads, primary parent / children, branch ids, reference edges (capped per node), visit counts, cumulative rewards, and per-branch / global best reward caches.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs an empty ProgressiveMcgs with preallocated capacity for max_nodes payloads and a per-node reference-edge ceiling of max_refs_per_node.

nodes.name: push_node
nodes.summary: Internal appender that pushes a new node onto every parallel Vec, lazily resizes the per-branch best cache to cover the node's branch, and registers the node in its parent's primary-children list.

nodes.name: add_reference
nodes.summary: Adds a non-primary reference edge from child to referenced, deduplicating and evicting the least-recently-used edge when the per-node cap is exceeded.

nodes.name: backprop
nodes.summary: Walks the primary-parent chain from a leaf upward, incrementing visits and adding the reward's f32 value to cumulative_reward at each ancestor — reference edges are deliberately excluded so backprop stays tree-shaped.

nodes.name: set_branch_best
nodes.summary: Updates the cached best reward for a branch (lazily resizing the branch_best vector) only if the new reward strictly exceeds the prior best, preserving monotonicity.

nodes.name: intra_branch_history
nodes.summary: Walks the primary-parent chain from a node upward, collecting up to k ancestors that share the same BranchId, stopping at the branch boundary.

nodes.name: cross_branch_top_n
nodes.summary: Returns the top-N nodes by Q-value that live in branches other than current_branch, giving the search cross-branch reference candidates ranked by estimated value.

nodes.name: multi_branch_aggregate
nodes.summary: Across every active branch, collects the top per_branch nodes by Q-value into a single flat list, used by the MultiBranchAggregation stagnation trigger to seed reference edges.

nodes.name: SelectMode
nodes.summary: Two-variant enum tagging whether a selection step used pure UCT descent or Elite-sampling.

nodes.name: EntropyGatedScheduler
nodes.summary: Scheduler holding the UCT-to-Elite interpolation parameters (w_min, switch window, elite_topk); exposes pick_mode, elite_sample, and branch-selection entropy / effective-branch-count diagnostics.

nodes.name: with_config
nodes.summary: Constructor that overrides the default scheduler parameters (w_min, switch_start, switch_end, elite_topk).

nodes.name: w
nodes.summary: Computes the UCT-vs-Elite interpolation weight for a normalized time t_norm: 1.0 (pure UCT) before switch_start, w_min after switch_end, smoothstep-interpolated inside the window.

nodes.name: elite_sample
nodes.summary: Samples one node from the top-k elite slice of ranked_nodes using a cumulative-distribution draw skewed toward higher ranks; returns None on empty input.

nodes.name: branch_selection_entropy
nodes.summary: Computes the Shannon entropy (in nats) of the branch-selection count distribution, used as a diversity / collapse diagnostic during search.

nodes.name: SearchDomain
nodes.summary: Trait abstracting the problem being searched: propose() generates a child payload from a parent and reference set, and evaluate() maps the resulting trajectory to a Reward classification.

nodes.name: StepResult
nodes.summary: Value object returned by step(): carries the new node id, branch, parent, select mode, classified reward, fired stagnation triggers, and how many reference edges were added.

nodes.name: ProgressiveMcgsSearch
nodes.summary: Top-level search driver struct bundling the graph, entropy-gated scheduler, stagnation gate, config, branch-selection counters, step count, and max-expansions budget.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a ProgressiveMcgsSearch: validates config, builds the EntropyGatedScheduler from entropy parameters, instantiates the StagnationGate, and allocates the underlying ProgressiveMcgs graph sized to config.max_nodes / n_branches.

nodes.name: step
nodes.summary: One MCTS iteration: pick a selection mode and branch, descend to a leaf, gather stagnation triggers, build the reference set, ask the SearchDomain to propose + evaluate, expand the graph, classify reward, backprop, update branch / global bests, observe the expansion at the stagnation gate, and add reference edges from the trigger-driven reference set; returns None once the expansion budget is exhausted.

nodes.name: pick_branch
nodes.summary: Selects the next branch to expand: under Elite mode it samples a branch proportional to top-node Q-values; under UCT mode it picks uniformly at random across the active branch count.

nodes.name: descend_to_leaf_in_branch
nodes.summary: Walks down a single branch's primary children using an inline UCB1 score with a schedule-aware exploration constant, stopping at the first leaf within the branch.

nodes.name: build_reference_set
nodes.summary: Materializes the reference-node set for an expansion from the fired stagnation triggers: pulls intra-branch history, cross-branch top-N, or multi-branch aggregate candidates, then sorts and dedups them.

nodes.name: StagnationTrigger
