nodes.summary: Enum of stagnation-recovery actions: IntraBranchEvolve, CrossBranchReference, and MultiBranchAggregation, each mapping to a different operator invocation downstream.

nodes.name: StagnationGate
nodes.summary: Per-branch and global steps-since-improvement tracker with firing thresholds; observe_expansion updates counters and check() emits the matching StagnationTrigger set.

nodes.name: observe_expansion
nodes.summary: Feeds an expansion result into the gate: increments the branch counter (or resets it on improvement) and the global counter (or resets it on breakthrough), growing the branch-state vector as needed.

nodes.name: check
nodes.summary: Returns the list of stagnation triggers currently firing for a branch: IntraBranchEvolve when the branch counter crosses its threshold, CrossBranchReference when the branch threshold is exceeded but global stagnation has not, and MultiBranchAggregation when the global threshold is crossed.

nodes.name: NodeId
nodes.summary: Opaque newtype wrapping a u32 graph node index, with idx() / From conversions to recover the raw index.

nodes.name: BranchId
nodes.summary: Newtype wrapping a u32 branch index, including a NONE sentinel for the root; used to partition the graph into exploration branches.

nodes.name: Reward
nodes.summary: Four-level reward classification (Failure, Neutral, Progress, Breakthrough) with as_f32() for backprop weighting and is_improvement() / is_breakthrough() predicates for stagnation logic.

nodes.name: ProgressiveMcgsConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration bundle for the whole MCGS subsystem: graph sizing caps, UCT exploration schedule, stagnation thresholds, entropy-gate window, and elite top-k; validated at construction.

nodes.name: exploration_constant
nodes.summary: Computes the UCT exploration constant for a normalized time t_norm: c_0 before switch_start, c_min after switch_end, smoothstep-interpolated between — giving more exploration early and more exploitation late.

nodes.name: uct_select_child
nodes.summary: Picks the child maximizing the UCB1 score Q(child) + c * sqrt(ln(N(parent)) / (N(child) + epsilon)); returns None if the parent has no children.

nodes.name: uct_descend_to_leaf
nodes.summary: Repeatedly applies uct_select_child from a root until it reaches a leaf (a node with no primary children).

nodes.name: cost_model.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the SpecHop cost-model theorems (arXiv:2605.21965): optimal thread count k* = ceil((1+beta)/(alpha+beta)), oracle/bounded relative latency, starvation probability, and an InferenceStats estimator that adapts k from observed speculator/target latencies.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses debug_assert for theorem preconditions (alpha in (0,1), beta > 0) and a normal_cdf helper for starvation probability under volatility bounds.

nodes.name: compute_optimal_k
nodes.summary: Theorem 2: optimal speculative thread count k* = ceil((1+beta)/(alpha+beta)) — more threads when the speculator is cheap or decode is short.

nodes.name: oracle_rel_lat
nodes.summary: Theorem 3: oracle (unbounded-k) relative latency upper bound RelLat* = 1 - p(1-alpha)/(1+beta), the theoretical best-case speedup.

nodes.name: bounded_rel_lat
nodes.summary: Finite-window relative latency RelLat_k for a bounded thread count k, returning the realized speedup ratio in (0, 1].

nodes.name: starvation_prob
nodes.summary: Theorem 4: probability that all k speculative threads starve waiting for a target tool response, bounded by the configured volatility parameter.

nodes.name: InferenceStats
nodes.summary: Online estimator of speculator/target/decode latencies and hit rate; provides empirical alpha, beta, p, and an auto-tuned k for adaptive thread sizing.

nodes.name: observe
nodes.summary: InferenceStats::observe — records a new (spec_latency, target_latency, decode_latency, hit) sample and updates running averages used to derive alpha/beta/p.

nodes.name: spechop_configurator_reward
nodes.summary: Reward signal for the configurator bandit: combines realized relative-latency improvement with a starvation penalty to drive SpecHop on/off decisions.

nodes.name: should_activate_spechop
nodes.summary: Policy gate: decides whether to activate SpecHop for the current regime using InferenceStats and a normal-CDF confidence test on the expected latency improvement.

nodes.name: hop_tree.rs
nodes.summary: Hop-level speculative decoding tree (DDTree): builds a best-first search tree over (action, predicted observation) branches scored by speculator confidence, extracts the highest-scoring path, and verifies branches via the fuzzy ObservationVerifier.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses std::collections::BinaryHeap for best-first expansion; nodes carry parent_idx (Option<usize>) instead of the token-level u128 bitfield because hop payloads are full String observations.

nodes.name: HopTreeNode
nodes.summary: A node in the hop-level DDTree: stores action + predicted observation strings, speculator confidence score, parent index, depth, and verification state; ordered by score for heap-driven best-first expansion.

nodes.name: HopCandidate
nodes.summary: A single candidate observation for a hop with an associated confidence; provides log_confidence for numerically stable summation during tree scoring.

nodes.name: VerifiedHopPath
nodes.summary: Result of verifying a hop tree against the actual target trajectory: holds the verified path plus counts of commits, rollbacks, direct commits, and total hops, with accuracy() reporting the commit ratio.

nodes.name: build_hop_dd_tree
nodes.summary: Constructs a hop-level DDTree from per-hop marginals using best-first search under a tree budget, expanding the highest-confidence (action, observation) branches first.

nodes.name: build_hop_dd_tree_with_schedule
nodes.summary: Variant of build_hop_dd_tree that applies a ScreeningPruner schedule (Uniform or FrozenBaseGuard) per hop, so intermediate hops can skip full screening for speed while the final hop preserves quality.

nodes.name: extract_best_hop_path
nodes.summary: Walks the verified hop tree to extract the highest-cumulative-score path from root to its highest-scoring leaf.

nodes.name: extract_deepest_hop_path
nodes.summary: Extracts the deepest verified path in the hop tree (maximum hop count), useful for measuring how far speculation successfully extended.

nodes.name: reconstruct_path
nodes.summary: Internal helper: reconstructs the root-to-leaf path by walking parent_idx links backward from a given leaf node.

nodes.name: verify_hop_tree
nodes.summary: Verifies each tree node's predicted observation against the actual target trajectory using the ObservationVerifier, marking branches Committed or RolledBack and producing a VerifiedHopPath summary.

nodes.name: build_and_verify_hop_tree
nodes.summary: Convenience wrapper: builds a hop tree from a speculator+config+trajectory and immediately verifies it, returning the VerifiedHopPath in one call.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel for the spechop subsystem (Plan 131): re-exports the cost model, hop tree, pipeline, speculator, verifier, window, types, and conditionally the segment_match and BanditSpeculator/CrossHopConfig features; defines the SpechopSchedule pruning-schedule enum used by FrozenBaseGuard.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy use of #[cfg(feature = ...)] gating: segment_match requires spechop+cache_prune, build_hop_dd_tree_with_schedule requires thinking_prune, BanditSpeculator requires bandit, CrossHopConfig/observation_velocity require recfm.

nodes.name: pipeline.rs
nodes.summary: Implements Algorithm 1 of the SpecHop paper: a continuous multi-hop speculation pipeline that extends the speculative window, verifies the earliest pending thread against the returned target, commits/rolls back, and drains committed observations until trajectory completion or early termination.
nodes.languageNotes: SpecHopPipeline is generic over S: HopSpeculator and V: ObservationVerifier for testability; the early-termination check fires on TrajectoryHop::is_final with a configurable early_stop_pattern.

nodes.name: TrajectoryHop
nodes.summary: A single (action, target observation) hop in a tool-use trajectory; the is_final flag triggers the pipeline's early-termination check.

nodes.name: PipelineResult
nodes.summary: Aggregated result of a pipeline run: committed observations in trajectory order plus hits/misses/direct-commits/total-hops counters, exposing accuracy, coverage, and total_committed metrics.

nodes.name: SpecHopPipeline
nodes.summary: The orchestrator generic over speculator S and verifier V: drives the extend-window/verify-earliest/commit-rollback loop over a trajectory slice and returns a PipelineResult.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: SpecHopPipeline::new — constructs the pipeline from a SpecHopConfig, speculator, and verifier, initializing an empty SpecWindow sized to effective_k.

nodes.name: execute
nodes.summary: Runs the SpecHop Algorithm 1 loop over a trajectory: for each hop, extend the window with a speculator prediction, verify the earliest pending thread, commit/rollback, drain committed observations, and check early termination on the final hop.

nodes.name: extend_window
nodes.summary: Asks the speculator for a prediction on the next action and, on success, pushes a Speculating HopObservation onto the window (if capacity remains).

nodes.name: verify_earliest
nodes.summary: Delegates to window.verify_earliest with the verifier; on Commit feeds the observation back to the speculator, on Rollback discards all downstream speculation and still commits the correct observation.

nodes.name: segment_match.rs
nodes.summary: Rolling-hash segment index over previously seen hop observations: supports O(n) prefix and substring matching across hops to detect reused observation patterns during speculation. Built on katgpt_kv::cache_prune::RollingHash with blake3 verification.
nodes.languageNotes: Gated by both spechop and cache_prune features; stores prefix_hashes per IndexedSegment to avoid O(seg_len) recomputation on every query.

nodes.name: HopSegmentIndex
nodes.summary: Pool of previously indexed hop token sequences with rolling-hash-powered prefix and substring matching, bounded by max_segments (default 1024).

nodes.name: index_observation
nodes.summary: Tokenizes and indexes a hop observation: computes rolling, full blake3, and prefix hashes, then appends an IndexedSegment to the pool (evicting oldest past max_segments).

nodes.name: find_matching_prefix
nodes.summary: Checks whether any indexed segment shares a token prefix with the query, returning the source hop and match length when a prefix is found.

nodes.name: find_substring_match
nodes.summary: O(n) substring search across all indexed segments using the Mersenne-prime rolling hash, with blake3 verification of any hash collision before returning a SegmentMatch.

nodes.name: speculator.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the HopSpeculator trait and two implementations: CacheSpeculator (modelless HashMap lookup) and BanditSpeculator (gates predictions on ScreeningPruner relevance). Also provides RecFM cross-hop observation_velocity and CrossHopConfig under the recfm feature.
nodes.languageNotes: BanditSpeculator requires the bandit feature; CrossHopConfig/observation_velocity are gated by recfm and provide a modelless-to-model-based bridge via ScreeningPruner relevance scores.

nodes.name: CacheSpeculator
nodes.summary: Modelless HopSpeculator backed by a HashMap: speculate() returns a cached observation or CacheMiss, observe() records the actual observation for future hits.

nodes.name: BanditSpeculator
nodes.summary: HopSpeculator that consults a ScreeningPruner before returning a cached observation: predictions with relevance below confidence_threshold return LowConfidence, providing a modelless-to-model-based bridge.

nodes.name: observation_velocity
nodes.summary: Computes normalized observation velocity between two consecutive hop observations (1.0 - token overlap ratio): 0.0 means converged, 1.0 means fully diverged.

nodes.name: with_entries
nodes.summary: CacheSpeculator::with_entries — bulk-seeds the cache from an iterator of (action, observation) pairs, used to warm the speculator before a trajectory run.

nodes.name: with_entry
nodes.summary: BanditSpeculator::with_entry — adds a single cached observation enriched with depth and token_idx metadata used by the pruner's relevance scoring.

nodes.name: speculate
nodes.summary: BanditSpeculator::speculate — looks up the cached observation and consults the ScreeningPruner; returns LowConfidence when the pruner rejects the prediction.

nodes.name: observe
nodes.summary: BanditSpeculator::observe — records the actual observation in the cache and updates pruner credits based on whether the prior speculation was a hit or miss.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Core type definitions for the SpecHop pipeline: SpecOutcome/HopState enums (Commit/Rollback, AwaitingTarget/Speculating/Committed/RolledBack), the SpecError error type, SpecHopConfig (alpha, beta, p, k, volatility with optimal_k computation), and HopObservation state machine.
nodes.languageNotes: SpecOutcome and HopState are #[repr(u8)] for cheap copy; SpecHopConfig::optimal_k implements Theorem 2 (k* = ceil((1+beta)/(alpha+beta))).

nodes.name: SpecError
nodes.summary: Error enum for speculator operations: CacheMiss, LowConfidence (below threshold), and CapacityExhausted (k threads active); implements Display and std::error::Error.

nodes.name: SpecHopConfig
nodes.summary: SpecHop paper parameters: alpha (relative speculator latency), beta (decode-to-tool ratio), p (per-hop success probability), k (max threads, None=auto), and volatility (starvation bound). Provides validate, effective_k, and optimal_k.

nodes.name: validate
nodes.summary: SpecHopConfig::validate — checks alpha in (0,1), beta > 0, p in (0,1], volatility > 0, and k >= 1 when specified; returns the first violation as a human-readable error string.

nodes.name: HopObservation
nodes.summary: A single hop observation pair (action, o_target, o_spec) with HopState; provides the speculating/awaiting/commit/rollback state transitions used by the pipeline and window.

nodes.name: verifier.rs
nodes.summary: Observation verification layer (paper Appendix D.4): trait ObservationVerifier plus RuleBasedVerifier implementing exact/short-answer match after normalization, numeric consistency, substring match, token-set Jaccard similarity (>= 0.55), and refusal-pattern detection.
nodes.languageNotes: Hot-path *_scratch variants reuse preallocated buffers to avoid allocation per verify call; refusal patterns are stored in a LazyLock'd slice.

nodes.name: RuleBasedVerifier
nodes.summary: Default ObservationVerifier combining normalized exact match, short-answer match, numeric consistency, substring match, and Jaccard similarity above jaccard_threshold; configurable short_answer_max_len.

nodes.name: verify
nodes.summary: RuleBasedVerifier::verify — runs the full verification cascade (refusal detection, exact match, short-answer, numeric, substring, Jaccard) and returns true on the first passing rule.

nodes.name: normalize_into
nodes.summary: Zero-alloc normalizer: lowercases, strips punctuation/whitespace, and writes the normalized form into a caller-supplied String buffer for reuse across verify calls.

nodes.name: extract_numbers_into
nodes.summary: Extracts all numeric tokens from text into a caller-supplied accumulator, used by numeric_consistent to compare answers irrespective of formatting differences.

nodes.name: numeric_consistent_scratch
nodes.summary: Allocation-free numeric consistency check: returns true if target and spec contain the same multiset of numbers (reusing scratch buffers).

nodes.name: numeric_consistent
nodes.summary: Allocating wrapper around numeric_consistent_scratch for one-off callers that don't maintain scratch buffers.

nodes.name: token_set_jaccard_scratch
nodes.summary: Zero-alloc Jaccard similarity over token sets: tokenizes both inputs into reusable HashSet scratch buffers and returns the intersection-over-union ratio.

nodes.name: token_set_jaccard
nodes.summary: Public allocating wrapper for token_set_jaccard_scratch; the single Jaccard helper re-exported at module level for external callers.

nodes.name: window.rs
nodes.summary: SpecWindow: a FIFO ring of up to k concurrent speculative HopObservation threads. Supports push_thread, verify_earliest (commit/rollback the oldest pending thread), drain_committed, and rollback_all for downstream speculation discard.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses pending_start index to avoid shifting the Vec on every commit; threads stay in the window until explicitly drained.

nodes.name: SpecWindow
nodes.summary: Bounded FIFO window of speculative threads: pending threads live at the tail past pending_start, committed threads stay until drained, and rollback_all discards everything past the last commit.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: SpecWindow::new — constructs an empty window with the given max thread capacity (k from SpecHopConfig::effective_k); asserts max_threads >= 1.

nodes.name: verify_earliest
nodes.summary: Verifies the oldest pending thread against the returned target using the verifier: on match transitions to Committed and advances pending_start; on mismatch transitions to RolledBack and returns SpecOutcome::Rollback for the caller to roll back downstream work.

nodes.name: bank.rs
nodes.summary: BranchBank: a bounded, pre-allocated bank of cognitive branches with free-list slot reuse and spawn/merge/prune lifecycle, plus episodic write and stale-prune sweeps.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses split_at_mut to borrow two distinct bank slots simultaneously during merge; free-list slot recycling avoids reallocation.

nodes.name: BranchBank
nodes.summary: Container holding a fixed-capacity Vec of CognitiveBranch slots plus a free-list of reusable slot indices; exposes spawn/prune/merge and bookkeeping sweeps.

nodes.name: spawn
nodes.summary: Allocates a new CognitiveBranch in a recycled free-slot (or appends when capacity remains), keyed by the caller's spawn_anchor embedding.

nodes.name: prune
nodes.summary: Clears a branch's episodic/procedural/failure stores, marks the slot Removed, and returns its index to the free-list for reuse.

nodes.name: merge
nodes.summary: Moves episodic/procedural/failure memory and unions spawn_anchor/token_signature from a source branch into a target, then prunes the source; uses split_at_mut for safe aliasing.

nodes.name: merge_sweep
nodes.summary: Scans all active branches and merges any pair whose centroid cosine similarity exceeds the cos_threshold, collapsing redundant branches.

nodes.name: prune_sweep
nodes.summary: Bulk-prunes branches that are simultaneously stale, low-volume, and below the min_examples threshold.

nodes.name: write_episodic
nodes.summary: Appends an EpisodicEntry (embedding, payload, reward, scope, tick) to a routable branch and updates its write statistics.

nodes.name: sorted_union
nodes.summary: Merges two ascending-sorted vectors into a deduplicated sorted vector via two-pointer merge; used by BranchBank::merge for anchor/token-signature unions.

nodes.name: compiler.rs
nodes.summary: BudgetCompiler: compiles retrieved memory materials into a fixed-byte-budget CompiledContext by admitting items in priority-tier order (scope_ctx → procedural → episodic → cross-positive → failures → working_memory → query) with atomic admission and priority-cascade overflow drops.
nodes.languageNotes: RetrievedMaterials and CompiledContext are generic over multiple payload types; compile takes 14 closure/array parameters to support both pre-computed byte slices and lazy per-item sizing closures.

nodes.name: PriorityTier
nodes.summary: Seven-tier priority enum (Query highest, ScopeCtx lowest) that drives the order in which materials are admitted into the compiled context.

nodes.name: CompiledItem
nodes.summary: A single admitted entry in CompiledContext: a PriorityTier tag, a byte-cost, and a generic payload.

nodes.name: RetrievedMaterials
nodes.summary: Generic input bundle of all retrieved memory classes (scope context, procedural rules, episodic entries, cross-branch positives, failures, working memory, query) fed into the BudgetCompiler.

nodes.name: CompiledContext
nodes.summary: Output of the compiler: a Vec of CompiledItem plus byte-usage accounting and per-tier admit/drop counters, reusable across compiles via reset().

nodes.name: BudgetCompiler
nodes.summary: Stateless compiler holding only a byte budget; its compile() method folds RetrievedMaterials into a budget-respecting CompiledContext using the priority cascade.

nodes.name: compile
nodes.summary: Core compile routine: walks materials in strict priority-tier order, attempts atomic admission of each item, and on budget overflow drops the lowest-priority tier first; accepts parallel byte arrays when lengths match, else falls back to per-item sizing closures.

nodes.name: as_str
nodes.summary: Returns the string label for a PriorityTier variant, used for debugging and tier accounting.

nodes.name: composition.rs
nodes.summary: Phase 4 cross-module composition tests verifying the five branching primitives compose cleanly with arg_protocol (lifecycle type alias + RedirectTable), CLR (should_write_composed gate), engram (hash-anchored routing), and closure (PTG motif embeddings as projection directions).
nodes.languageNotes: Test modules are conditionally compiled per feature (arg_protocol, clr, engram, closure); CLR is simulated via a local closure because the real CLR lives in the riir-ai runtime, not katgpt-core.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel for the non-interference memory branches primitive (Plan 329 / RIZZ): declares the seven submodules and re-exports the public API surface (BranchBank, BranchRouter, VerifierGate, NonInterferenceProjection, BudgetCompiler, and core types) at the module root.
nodes.languageNotes: Entire module is feature-gated behind `#[cfg(feature = "non_interference_branches")]`; BranchLifecycle becomes a type alias for arg::LifecycleState when arg_protocol is also enabled.

nodes.name: projection.rs
nodes.summary: NonInterferenceProjection: assigns each branch a D-dimensional unit direction vector and enforces pairwise near-orthogonality (interference = |dot(dir_i, dir_j)|), rejecting assignments whose interference exceeds an epsilon threshold.
nodes.languageNotes: Generic over compile-time dimension D as a const generic; max_orthogonal_branches(D) gives the theoretical cap of floor((D+1)/2) for ±45-degree non-interference.

nodes.name: AssignError
nodes.summary: Error enum returned by assign_direction: WrongDimension, ZeroMagnitude, or Interferes (with the conflicting branch id and measured interference).

nodes.name: AssignResult
nodes.summary: Result struct for assign_direction carrying an optional AssignError plus conflict-branch id and interference magnitude; constructor helpers (ok/wrong_dimension/zero_magnitude/interferes) build the common cases.

nodes.name: NonInterferenceProjection
nodes.summary: Holds a Vec of D-dimensional direction rows (one per branch slot) plus an orthogonal_epsilon and assign_max_interference threshold; provides assign/project/interference/clear/grow operations.

nodes.name: assign_direction
nodes.summary: Validates a candidate direction (dimension match, non-zero magnitude), L2-normalizes it, then verifies it is sufficiently orthogonal to all currently assigned directions before storing it for the branch; returns the worst-case interference and conflicting branch on failure.

nodes.name: is_non_interfering_with_all
nodes.summary: Checks that a target direction maintains |dot| below the epsilon threshold against every currently assigned direction.

nodes.name: router.rs
nodes.summary: BranchRouter: zero-alloc snap routing that picks an existing branch by cosine dot-product against the query embedding, with an optional Jaccard token-overlap fallback; returns Reuse / Spawn / Frozen depending on thresholds and bank capacity.
nodes.languageNotes: Hot path is allocation-free; snap_dot/snap_jaccard iterate active_branches() without intermediate Vec construction.

nodes.name: RouteMode
nodes.summary: Three-variant enum describing the routing outcome: Reuse (snap to existing branch), Spawn (create a new branch), or Frozen (bank at capacity, no admission).

nodes.name: RouteResult
nodes.summary: Structured routing outcome carrying the resolved RouteMode and an optional BranchId for Reuse results.

nodes.name: BranchRouter
nodes.summary: Holds three snap thresholds (tau_snap for cosine, tau_jaccard for token overlap, tau_spawn as a fallback floor) and exposes route() and route_with_tokens() against a Borrowed BranchBank.

nodes.name: route
nodes.summary: Embedding-only routing entry point: snaps to the best dot-product match if above tau_snap, otherwise spawns if the bank has capacity, else returns Frozen.

nodes.name: route_with_tokens
nodes.summary: Two-stage routing: tries dot-product snap first, then falls back to Jaccard token-overlap snap when query_tokens are non-empty; otherwise follows the spawn/frozen logic of route().

nodes.name: snap_dot
nodes.summary: Iterates active branches and returns the BranchId with the highest cosine similarity to the query embedding, provided it exceeds tau_snap.

nodes.name: snap_jaccard
nodes.summary: Token-overlap fallback: computes Jaccard similarity between query_tokens and each branch's sorted token_signature, returning the best match above tau_jaccard.

nodes.name: jaccard
nodes.summary: Two-pointer Jaccard similarity over sorted token slices, computing |intersection| / |union| with O(n+m) cost and early-out on empty inputs.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Core data types for the branching subsystem: BranchId, BranchLifecycle, CognitiveBranch, EpisodicEntry, ProceduralRule, FailureEntry, and BranchStats with their credit/staleness bookkeeping helpers.
nodes.languageNotes: All types are generic over a caller-supplied payload P; CognitiveBranch::new pre-allocates four Vecs and default-initializes stats and lifecycle.

nodes.name: BranchId
nodes.summary: Lightweight newtype around a usize slot index with a sentinel value; distinguishes routable ids from unassigned/invalid markers.

nodes.name: BranchLifecycle
nodes.summary: Four-state lifecycle enum (Active, Shadow, Deprecated, Removed) with is_routable() and requires_redirect() predicates; becomes a type alias for arg::LifecycleState when arg_protocol is enabled.

nodes.name: EpisodicEntry
nodes.summary: A single episodic memory record: embedding, caller-defined payload, scalar reward, scope tag, and the tick at which it was written.

nodes.name: ProceduralRule
nodes.summary: A procedural rule with a direction vector, antecedent, strategy label, and saturating helpful/harmful counters exposing net_credit().

nodes.name: FailureEntry
nodes.summary: Record of a failure (embedding, payload, tick) stored in a branch's failures Vec for negative-reuse during retrieval.

nodes.name: BranchStats
nodes.summary: Per-branch counters (writes, reads, incremental avg_reward, last_touch_tick) with record_write/record_read/is_stale helpers used by prune_sweep.

nodes.name: CognitiveBranch
nodes.summary: Top-level branch aggregate: id, spawn_anchor embedding, sorted token_signature, and the four memory stores (episodic, procedural, failures, scope_ctx) plus stats and lifecycle.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: CognitiveBranch::new constructor: assigns id and spawn_anchor, pre-allocates the four memory Vecs, and defaults stats/lifecycle.

nodes.name: push_token
nodes.summary: Inserts a token into the branch's token_signature keeping it sorted and deduplicated via binary_search, used by snap_jaccard routing.

nodes.name: verifier.rs
nodes.summary: VerifierGate: a three-input write gate combining reward threshold, curiosity threshold, and branch-centroid similarity to decide Write / Quarantine / Reject; provides a CLR-composed variant that short-circuits on upstream CLR rejection.

nodes.name: WriteDecision
nodes.summary: Three-variant write decision enum (Write, Quarantine, Reject) with classification helpers is_write / is_quarantine / is_reject / is_blocked.

nodes.name: VerifierGate
nodes.summary: Threshold container (tau_write, tau_curiosity, quarantine_centroid_thresh) exposing should_write for the direct gate and should_write_composed for the CLR-composed gate.

nodes.name: should_write
nodes.summary: Direct three-input gate: returns Reject unless reward and curiosity both clear their thresholds; returns Quarantine when thresholds pass but the branch-centroid similarity is below the quarantine cutoff; otherwise Write.

nodes.name: should_write_composed
nodes.summary: CLR-composed gate: short-circuits to Reject when the upstream clr_allows flag is false, otherwise delegates the centroid-similarity quarantine check to the direct gate.

nodes.name: admit.rs
nodes.summary: Motif admission gate that decides whether a mined motif earns a permanent primitive slot, applying PRI (primitive reuse index), occurrence-count, and MDL cost thresholds.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses bit-packed FixedU32Set<16> for task-family tracking and a u32-derived deterministic primitive id from the motif's subgraph hash prefix.

nodes.name: bridge.rs
nodes.summary: Bridges Primitive Transition Graphs to scalar motif embeddings and TAR (transfer-of-abstraction-responsibility) scores via SIMD dot products and a sigmoid head.
nodes.languageNotes: Inline sigmoid handles both positive and negative branches for numerical stability; relies on simd_dot_f32 from the wider crate.

nodes.name: functor_edge.rs
nodes.summary: Attaches learnable functor parameters to PTG edges and applies them as sigmoid-gated state updates using cosine-coherence between direction and state vectors.
nodes.languageNotes: FunctorPtg is a postcard-serializable wrapper that round-trips byte-identically to its inner PrimitiveTransitionGraph when no functors are set.

nodes.name: metrics.rs
nodes.summary: Computes the three closure health metrics — PRI (per-primitive reuse across task families), CDG (composition-depth generalization EMA), and TAR (Jaccard overlap of motif multisets between baseline and perturbed corpora).
nodes.languageNotes: PRI packs task-family presence into a bit matrix (>64 families handled via u64 generations) and reports per-primitive population counts.

nodes.name: mining.rs
nodes.summary: Orchestrates a single sleep-cycle closure step: mines the recent PTG buffer, admits motifs through the gate, and folds CDG from observed train depths.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Root of the closure module: defines PrimitiveKind, OperatorKind, PtgNode/PtgEdge, PrimitiveTransitionGraph core types plus postcard serde and the blake3 commitment hash, and re-exports all submodules.
nodes.languageNotes: Module barrel for the closure submodule; commitment() hashes the postcard-serialized PTG with blake3 to produce a content-addressed identifier.

nodes.name: motif.rs
nodes.summary: Motif mining core: FixedU32Set compact family set, Motif struct with canonical blake3 subgraph hash, MotifMiner with a FIFO ring buffer and parallel batch mining over chain subgraphs.
nodes.languageNotes: Canonical hash sorts node and edge kind buffers before varint-encoding and blake3 hashing to ensure isomorphic subgraphs collide; mine_batch uses rayon par_iter with a papaya concurrent map.

nodes.name: trace.rs
nodes.summary: PtgRecorder that incrementally builds a PrimitiveTransitionGraph from nested enter/exit calls during inference, materializing nodes and parent-child edges with operator annotations.
nodes.languageNotes: Node id equals its index in the nodes vector — an invariant tests explicitly assert; capacity hints avoid reallocations for short traces.

nodes.name: evaluate
nodes.summary: Gates a single mined motif: rejects for low PRI, insufficient task-family occurrences, or positive MDL cost; otherwise admits with a deterministic u32 primitive id derived from the subgraph hash prefix.

nodes.name: MotifAdmitter
nodes.summary: Configurable admission gate carrying the per-node bit cost used by the MDL branch of evaluate().

nodes.name: ptg_to_motif_embedding
nodes.summary: Projects a PTG onto a fixed-length embedding by SIMD-dotting each node's primitive against the corresponding direction row and squashing through sigmoid.

nodes.name: motif_embedding_to_tar_score
nodes.summary: Reduces a motif embedding vector to a single TAR score by taking the clamped mean over its components, yielding a scalar in the unit interval.

nodes.name: sigmoid
nodes.summary: Numerically stable logistic sigmoid that branches on the sign of the input to avoid overflow in exp().

nodes.name: MotifDirections
nodes.summary: Row-major k-by-n direction matrix used to project primitives into the motif embedding space, with checked from_flat construction and row slicing.

nodes.name: apply_functor_edge_into
nodes.summary: Writes the sigmoid-gated state update produced by a functor edge into a caller-supplied buffer, scaling the direction by the cosine coherence between state and direction.

nodes.name: functor_edge_gate
nodes.summary: Returns the scalar sigmoid gate value for a functor edge without mutating state, used for inspection and thresholding.

nodes.name: with_functors
nodes.summary: Constructs a FunctorPtg from a bare PTG plus a per-edge functor list, asserting length matches the underlying edge count.

nodes.name: ptg_commitment
nodes.summary: Delegates to crate::closure::commitment on the inner PTG so the functor wrapper inherits the same content-addressed hash.

nodes.name: FunctorEdgeParams
nodes.summary: Parameter bundle for a single functor edge: direction set reference, direction index, plus beta and tau shaping the sigmoid gate.

nodes.name: FunctorPtg
nodes.summary: Wraps a PrimitiveTransitionGraph with an optional per-edge FunctorEdgeParams slot vector, preserving the inner PTG's commitment and postcard bytes when no functors are bound.

nodes.name: compute_pri
nodes.summary: Computes the Primitive Reuse Index over a PTG corpus by bit-packing task-family presence into a u64 generation matrix (>64 families supported) and emitting per-primitive population counts.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses wrapping_add to rotate u64 generations when family count exceeds 64, then counts set bits per column to derive per-primitive scores.

nodes.name: compute_cdg
nodes.summary: Updates the Composition Depth Generalization EMA only when the test depth exceeds the max train depth seen, blending the clamped success rate into the running score.

nodes.name: compute_tar_score
nodes.summary: Computes the TAR score as the Jaccard overlap between motif multisets extracted from a baseline and a perturbed PTG corpus.

nodes.name: motif_multiset
nodes.summary: Aggregates canonical subgraph hashes across a corpus into a hash-count multimap used by the TAR Jaccard computation.

nodes.name: jaccard_multiset
nodes.summary: Generalized multiset Jaccard similarity summing per-key minima over maxima, returning zero when both inputs are empty.

nodes.name: PriScores
nodes.summary: Newtype wrapper around a primitive-to-score map with a defaulting get() lookup.

nodes.name: CdgScore
nodes.summary: CDG state carrying the EMA success rate at extrapolation depth and the maximum train depth observed so far.

nodes.name: mine_motifs_at_sleep_cycle
nodes.summary: Single sleep-cycle step: mines the miner's recent PTG buffer, computes PRI over the snapshot, evaluates the admitter on each motif, and returns a SleepCycleClosureReport of admitted motifs.

nodes.name: fold_cdg_at_sleep_cycle
nodes.summary: Extracts per-PTG node counts as proxy train depths and folds them into a CDG score against the previous EMA state.

nodes.name: count_distinct_task_families
nodes.summary: Internal helper counting unique task family ids across a corpus, used to feed the admitter's occurrence threshold.

nodes.name: SleepCycleClosureReport
nodes.summary: Result bundle of a sleep-cycle mining pass: mined motifs, PRI snapshot, PTG count, and number of admitted motifs.

nodes.name: commitment
nodes.summary: Content-addressed commitment hash of a PTG computed by blake3-hashing its postcard serialization.

nodes.name: serialize_postcard
nodes.summary: Serializes a PTG to a compact postcard byte buffer.

nodes.name: deserialize_postcard
nodes.summary: Deserializes a PTG from a postcard byte buffer.

nodes.name: empty
nodes.summary: Constructs an empty PrimitiveTransitionGraph tagged with a task family id.

nodes.name: PrimitiveKind
nodes.summary: Two-variant enum distinguishing user-defined leaf primitives from composite (motif-admitted) primitives, with u32 round-trip codecs for serialization.

nodes.name: PrimitiveTransitionGraph
nodes.summary: Core graph type: nodes tagged with a PrimitiveKind and tick, edges labeled with an OperatorKind, plus a root index and task family id.

nodes.name: OperatorKind
nodes.summary: Edge operator enum covering Sequence, Branch, Recurse, and ParallelJoin composition styles.

nodes.name: canonical_hash
nodes.summary: Computes a canonical blake3 hash for a subgraph by sorting node and edge kind buffers, varint-encoding them, and hashing the concatenation so isomorphic subgraphs collide.

nodes.name: enumerate_motifs_into
nodes.summary: Populates a motif multimap by enumerating node-pair and chain subgraphs of a PTG, hashing each canonically and recording task family ids.

nodes.name: enumerate_chains
nodes.summary: DFS over the adjacency list emitting canonical chain motifs up to a max depth, using an explicit stack to avoid recursion overhead.

nodes.name: mine_batch
nodes.summary: Parallel batch mine across the recent PTG ring buffer using rayon, merging enumerated motifs into a concurrent papaya map keyed by canonical hash.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses papaya's pinned guard for concurrent insertion and deduplication across rayon worker threads.

nodes.name: write_varint_u32
nodes.summary: Encodes a u32 as a little-endian varint into a byte buffer, used by canonical_hash to serialize sorted kind arrays.

nodes.name: primitive_reuse_index
nodes.summary: Returns the count of distinct task families that observed this motif, clamped to a u32, feeding the PRI component of the admission gate.

nodes.name: enumerate_subgraph_hashes
nodes.summary: Public entry point that materializes a motif multiset for a single PTG via enumerate_motifs_into.

nodes.name: deserialize
nodes.summary: Custom serde deserializer for FixedU32Set that reads a variable-length element stream and re-packs into the fixed array representation.

nodes.name: insert
nodes.summary: Inserts a value into the FixedU32Set without duplicates, maintaining the dense prefix invariant.

nodes.name: Motif
nodes.summary: A discovered motif: canonical subgraph hash, node/edge counts, occurrence count, and the FixedU32Set of task families that exhibited it.

nodes.name: MotifMiner
nodes.summary: Stateful miner holding a bounded FIFO ring buffer of recent PTGs and a concurrent motif index, exposing observe() and mine_batch() for sleep-cycle integration.

nodes.name: FixedU32Set
nodes.summary: Stack-allocated fixed-capacity set of u32 values with custom serde, used for compactly tracking up to N task family ids per motif.

nodes.name: enter
nodes.summary: Records a primitive invocation as a new PTG node, capturing its kind, tick, and optional blake3 input, and returns the node id.

nodes.name: exit
nodes.summary: Records a parent-to-child composition edge annotated with an OperatorKind.

nodes.name: finish
nodes.summary: Finalizes the recorder into an owned PrimitiveTransitionGraph tagged with the original task family id.

nodes.name: PtgRecorder
nodes.summary: Incremental builder for a PrimitiveTransitionGraph exposing enter/exit/finish to record nested primitive calls during inference.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Feature-gated barrel module for the MUX vocabulary-simplex superposition tree search, re-exporting the pruner, top-k, DD-tree, BFS, demux, bandit-width, and freeze/thaw submodules.
nodes.languageNotes: Each submodule is behind a Cargo feature flag (mux_pruner, mux_ddtree, mux_bfs, mux_demux, mux_bandit_width, mux_freeze_thaw) enabling minimal builds.

nodes.name: top_k.rs
nodes.summary: Foundational top-k peak extraction primitives shared across the MUX pipeline, providing both an allocating convenience API and a zero-allocation in-place variant backed by a fixed-size SoA buffer.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses select_nth_unstable_by for partial selection followed by sort_unstable_by on the truncated prefix to avoid full-sort cost; the in-place variant reuses a caller-provided MAX_TOP_K buffer to eliminate per-step heap allocation in the BFS hot path.

nodes.name: span_pruner.rs
nodes.summary: Geometric-decay span pruner that decides whether a top-k peak distribution is informative enough to expand, rejecting single-peak and sharp-drop spans before they waste DD-tree branching budget.
nodes.languageNotes: The pruner accepts peaks once their decay profile stays above decay_rate^k thresholds; the Default impl picks canonical (k, decay_rate) values used by MuxDdTree::new.

nodes.name: dd_tree.rs
nodes.summary: Core disjunctive-decision-tree (superposition tree) for MUX speculative decoding: each MuxNode holds a token superposition with weights, and the tree exposes entropy-driven compositional width detection, BFS frontier expansion, and flat SoA leaf-path collection for downstream consumers.
nodes.languageNotes: LeafPaths uses a contiguous buf + offsets SoA layout with extend_from_within to amortize path cloning; Arc<str> token storage enables cheap MuxNode cloning when expanding children; compositional_width normalizes Shannon entropy against the uniform upper bound to scale branching factor continuously in [1, k].

nodes.name: bfs.rs
nodes.summary: Dynamic-width BFS frontier driver over the MuxDdTree, extracting top-k peaks once per leaf and reusing them across width detection, span pruning, and node expansion; optionally modulates width via an NMDA-style dendritic gate.
nodes.languageNotes: Three step variants share the extract-once-reuse-everywhere pattern; step_dendritic is feature-gated behind dendritic_gate and scales width by gate.compute_gate() with a floor of 1.

nodes.name: demux.rs
nodes.summary: Demultiplexer verifier that collapses a token superposition back to a single canonical token via weight-sorted demultiplexing, detecting duplicates and providing the mux_demux round-trip correctness check.
nodes.languageNotes: Sorts (token, weight) pairs by total_cmp on f32 weights then by token id to break ties deterministically; DemuxResult surfaces is_unique so callers can detect ambiguous collapses.

nodes.name: bandit_width.rs
nodes.summary: UCB1-style multi-armed bandit (MuxBanditWidth) that adaptively selects the speculative expansion width per leaf based on accumulated reward signals, treating each candidate width as a bandit arm.
nodes.languageNotes: select_width implements the UCB1 upper-confidence bound sqrt(2 * ln(n) / pulls) with forced exploration of zero-pull arms; update routes reward back to the arm matching the chosen width.

nodes.name: freeze_thaw.rs
nodes.summary: Pattern store for modelless runtime reuse of MUX targets, allowing proven token/weight/depth triplets to be frozen under a named key and thawed later without re-running the search.
nodes.languageNotes: MuxPatternStore wraps a HashMap<String, Vec<MuxTarget>> so multiple targets can share a single key (pattern library semantics); thaw returns a slice reference to avoid clones on the read path.

nodes.name: MuxBanditWidth
nodes.summary: Multi-armed bandit over candidate MUX speculation widths, using UCB1 to balance exploration of under-pulled widths against exploitation of high-reward ones.

nodes.name: select_width
nodes.summary: Picks the next expansion width using the UCB1 upper-confidence bound, forcing exploration of any arm with zero pulls before falling back to the confidence-bounded argmax.

nodes.name: MuxBfs
nodes.summary: BFS engine that drives dynamic-width expansion of a MuxDdTree, exposing detect_width helpers and three step variants (plain, dendritic-gated, pre-collected leaves) that reuse extracted peaks across the prune/expand cycle.

nodes.name: detect_width_with_peaks
nodes.summary: Computes the effective branching width from pre-extracted top-k peaks, using compositional entropy scaling under the comp_width feature or a binary top-1 dominance threshold otherwise.

nodes.name: step
nodes.summary: Runs one BFS expansion pass over all leaves, extracting top-k peaks once per leaf and feeding them into width detection, pruning, and node expansion to avoid redundant extraction passes.

nodes.name: step_dendritic
nodes.summary: BFS step variant that modulates the base expansion width by an NMDA-style dendritic gate, combining entropy, leaf coincidence signals, and gate output to set per-leaf width with a floor of 1.

nodes.name: step_into
nodes.summary: BFS step variant that accepts a reusable LeafPaths buffer to avoid allocating fresh leaf-path vectors on every call, sharing the same extract-once prune/expand pipeline as step.

nodes.name: LeafPaths
nodes.summary: Structure-of-arrays leaf-path container (flat token buf plus offsets) that amortizes path materialization across BFS steps and supports zero-clone iteration via extend_from_within.

nodes.name: MuxNode
nodes.summary: Tree node holding a token superposition (tokens + weights) with optional children; leaf status is derived from whether children is empty.

nodes.name: MuxDdTree
nodes.summary: Root disjunctive-decision-tree type for MUX speculative decoding, owning the pruner, root node, branching factor k, and current depth, with APIs for root initialization, leaf enumeration, hypothesis coverage, node expansion, width detection, and flat leaf-path collection.

nodes.name: shannon_entropy
nodes.summary: Computes the Shannon entropy (in nats) of a peak probability distribution, used as the continuous signal driving compositional width selection.

nodes.name: compositional_width
nodes.summary: Maps a normalized Shannon entropy ratio in [0,1] onto a branching width in [1, base], rounding and clamping so peaked distributions shrink the tree while uniform distributions expand fully.

nodes.name: expand_node_with_peaks
nodes.summary: Expands the node at a given path with a fixed number of children derived from the provided peak distribution, distributing tokens across children and cloning the Arc'd token path-prefix to keep expansion cheap.

nodes.name: expand_bfs_frontier_into
nodes.summary: Drives a full BFS frontier expansion into a caller-provided LeafPaths buffer, per-leaf extracting peaks, detecting width, validating with the pruner, and expanding the node when the span is informative.

nodes.name: detect_width_with_peaks
nodes.summary: Tree-level width detection that delegates to compositional_width when the peaks carry meaningful entropy, falling back to a peaks.len()-derived cap for degenerate cases.

nodes.name: collect_leaf_paths_flat_into
nodes.summary: Iterative DFS that materializes all root-to-leaf token paths into a flat SoA LeafPaths buffer using extend_from_within to clone shared prefixes without reallocating.

nodes.name: collect_leaf_paths
nodes.summary: Allocating BFS variant of leaf-path collection that returns owned per-leaf token vectors, used by callers that prefer per-leaf ownership over SoA buffers.

nodes.name: MuxDemuxVerifier
nodes.summary: Verifier that collapses a token superposition to a canonical token via weight-sorted demultiplexing, exposing demux and demux_into variants plus a mux_demux round-trip helper.

nodes.name: demux
nodes.summary: Allocating demultiplexer that sorts the top-k token/weight pairs by descending weight then by token id, deduplicates, and returns a DemuxResult flagging whether the collapse was unambiguous.

nodes.name: demux_into
nodes.summary: In-place variant of demux that writes the collapsed tokens into a caller-provided buffer, clearing and repopulating it to avoid per-call heap allocation on the verification hot path.

nodes.name: MuxPatternStore
nodes.summary: HashMap-backed named pattern library of frozen MuxTargets, supporting multiple targets per key, capacity pre-allocation, and slice-returning thaw for zero-clone reads.

nodes.name: MuxSpanPruner
nodes.summary: Validates top-k peak distributions against a geometric-decay envelope, rejecting low-information spans (single peak, sharp drop) so the DD-tree does not waste branching budget on uninformative expansions.

nodes.name: is_valid_with_peaks
nodes.summary: Checks a pre-extracted top-k peak slice against the pruner's decay envelope, requiring both a minimum peak count and that each successive peak stays above decay_rate^(rank) of the top peak.

nodes.name: extract_top_k_peaks
nodes.summary: Allocating convenience API that returns an owned Vec of the top-k logit values via select_nth_unstable_by partial selection followed by a bounded sort.

nodes.name: extract_top_k_into
nodes.summary: Zero-allocation top-k extraction into a caller-provided fixed-size buffer, used in the BFS and span-pruner hot paths to eliminate per-step heap traffic.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel for the `proof` subsystem of katgpt-pruners, re-exporting the decision-tree goal cache, parallelism guard, Plackett-Luce rater, sketch population, sampler, and core sketch types.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust module root that aggregates the proof-search subsystem's public surface via `pub mod` declarations.

nodes.name: dtree_goal_cache.rs
nodes.summary: Decision-tree-scoped goal cache wrapping `ProofGoalCache` with deterministic byte-key encoding of (depth, token_idx, parent_tokens) tuples, plus per-tree branch counting and hit/miss stats.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses little-endian byte encoding (`to_le_bytes`) for stable cross-platform cache keys; the second half of the file is a comprehensive inline `#[cfg(test)]` module.

nodes.name: goal_cache.rs
nodes.summary: Defines `ProofGoalSnapshot`, a serializable summary of a proof goal cache (entries, hits, misses, hit rate, memory estimate) used by higher-level decision-tree caches and snapshots.

nodes.name: parallelism.rs
nodes.summary: Provides `ParallelismGuard` (detecting rayon thread pool size to gate population-based search) and `SketchSelectionStrategy` enum for switching between PopulationPucb, BasicUcb, and EpsilonGreedy modes.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses `rayon::current_num_threads()` to auto-detect parallelism; strategy is exposed as an enum with an `ALL` const slice for roundtrip display tests.

nodes.name: plackett_luce.rs
nodes.summary: Implements Plackett-Luce ranking with a Gibbs sampler to convert pairwise sketch rankings into per-sketch ELO ratings; includes Marsaglia-Tsang gamma sampling, Box-Muller normal sampling, lambda-to-ELO conversion, and random ranking generation.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a reusable `GibbsScratch` buffer to avoid per-iteration allocations in the hot Gibbs loop; gamma sampler is Marsaglia-Tsang with the standard 1e-30 floor to avoid `ln(0)`.

nodes.name: sketch_population.rs
nodes.summary: Manages an ELO-ordered, capacity-bounded population of `SketchEntry` records with deferred eviction: inserts can be batched, then `finalize_batch` evicts the lowest-ELO (visits as tiebreaker) sketches down to `top_k`.
nodes.languageNotes: Backed by `HashMap<SketchId, SketchEntry>`; eviction sorts by `(elo_rating desc, visits asc)` and `with_overshoot` allows temporary overshoot to defer eviction across a batch.

nodes.name: sketch_sampler.rs
nodes.summary: P-UCB and epsilon-greedy sampler over a `SketchPopulation`: prefers unvisited entries, falls back to a UCB1-style score when all entries are visited, and supports diversity injection returning a `DiversityHint` for decompose/combine/novel-approach strategies.
nodes.languageNotes: Switches between population-based and fallback UCB based on `should_use_population()` (rayon thread count); `sample_mut` returns a mutable entry to allow in-place visit recording.

nodes.name: sketch_types.rs
nodes.summary: Core data model for the proof-sketch subsystem: `SketchId` (blake3-hashed), `ProofState` (canonical bytes + hash), `Goal` (label + canonical), `SketchEntry` (state, pending goals, lessons, ELO, visits, age), plus `DiversityStrategy`/`DiversityHint` enums for exploration nudges.
nodes.languageNotes: `SketchId` uses an atomic counter + blake3 hash for uniqueness; pending goals are capped at `MAX_PENDING_GOALS` and lessons evicted FIFO via `VecDeque`; custom `Serialize`/`Deserialize` keep byte fields compact.

nodes.name: DTreeCacheSnapshot
nodes.summary: Serializable per-tree snapshot of a `DTreeGoalCache` capturing tree id, branch count, entry count, hits/misses, and hit rate for diagnostics and persistence.

nodes.name: DTreeGoalCache
nodes.summary: Decision-tree-scoped goal cache that wraps `ProofGoalCache`, keying verifications on (depth, token_idx, parent_tokens) and tracking per-tree branch counts separately from cache entries.

nodes.name: verify_constraint
nodes.summary: Looks up or computes a `GoalResult` for a (depth, token_idx, parent_tokens) constraint, deduplicating repeated verifications across branches via the underlying `ProofGoalCache::get_or_verify`.

nodes.name: encode_constraint_key
nodes.summary: Encodes a constraint triple into a deterministic little-endian byte vector (u64 depth, u64 token_idx, u16 parent tokens) used as the cache lookup key.

nodes.name: ProofGoalSnapshot
nodes.summary: Read-only summary of a proof goal cache exposing entry count, hit/miss counters, hit rate, and estimated memory footprint for logging, snapshots, and telemetry.

nodes.name: ParallelismGuard
nodes.summary: Detects the rayon thread pool size and decides whether population-based search is safe to run, returning a static fallback reason when only a single thread is available.

nodes.name: SketchSelectionStrategy
nodes.summary: Enum of sketch selection strategies (PopulationPucb, BasicUcb, EpsilonGreedy) with index/description roundtripping for configuration and display.

nodes.name: select_strategy
nodes.summary: Maps a `ParallelismGuard` to its active `SketchSelectionStrategy`, returning PopulationPucb when the population is enabled and BasicUcb otherwise.

nodes.name: PlackettLuceConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for the Plackett-Luce rater: match size, Gibbs sample count, burn-in, and ELO offset/scale, with validation helpers.

nodes.name: GibbsScratch
nodes.summary: Reusable scratch buffer (lambda, r, lambda_sum, appearances vectors) for the Gibbs sampling loop to avoid per-iteration heap allocations.

nodes.name: PlackettLuceRater
nodes.summary: Plackett-Luce ranking engine that converts sketch rankings into ELO ratings via Gibbs sampling, exposing both an allocating `rate` and a scratch-buffer `rate_with_scratch` entry point.

nodes.name: rate_with_scratch
nodes.summary: Runs the Gibbs sampler over per-sketch appearance rankings, updating lambda parameters via Marsaglia-Tsang gamma draws and producing per-sketch ELO ratings through lambda-to-ELO conversion.

nodes.name: compute_stats
nodes.summary: Computes per-position Plackett-Luce statistics (denominator sum of lambdas for remaining candidates) used by the Gibbs update step.

nodes.name: sample_gamma
nodes.summary: Marsaglia-Tsang gamma-distribution sampler with a 1e-30 floor on the uniform draws to avoid `ln(0)` and a fallback shape-rate parameterization for shape < 1.

nodes.name: generate_random_rankings
nodes.summary: Generates random partial rankings via Fisher-Yates partial shuffle for testing and warmup of the Plackett-Luce rater.

nodes.name: PopulationConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for `SketchPopulation` governing `top_k` retention target and optional overshoot capacity that delays eviction until batch finalize.

nodes.name: EvictionReport
nodes.summary: Result of an eviction pass listing evicted sketch ids and population size before/after, for observability and tests.

nodes.name: SketchPopulation
nodes.summary: ELO-ordered, capacity-bounded collection of `SketchEntry` records with batched insert, deferred eviction by lowest ELO (visits as tiebreaker), and aggregate statistics (avg/best/range ELO, total visits).

nodes.name: evict_to_capacity
nodes.summary: Sorts all sketches by (elo_rating asc, visits desc) and removes the lowest-ranking ones until the population fits `top_k`, returning an `EvictionReport`.

nodes.name: elo_range
nodes.summary: Returns the (min, max) ELO range across the population, or None if empty or non-finite values are encountered.

nodes.name: SketchSamplerConfig
nodes.summary: Tunable parameters for the sketch sampler: exploration constant `c` and epsilon for the epsilon-greedy fallback, with paper-default and builder-style constructors.

nodes.name: SketchSampler
nodes.summary: Samples sketches from a `SketchPopulation` using P-UCB (preferring unvisited then highest confidence bound) with epsilon-greedy, random, best-ELO, and fallback UCB1 strategies, plus diversity injection.

nodes.name: sample_p_ucb
nodes.summary: P-UCB selection: if any unvisited candidates exist pick one (highest ELO first), otherwise pick the candidate maximizing the P-UCB confidence-bound score.

nodes.name: sample_fallback_ucb
nodes.summary: UCB1-style fallback used when the population-based sampler is disabled: scores each entry by `sqrt(total / (visits+1))` and breaks ties randomly.

nodes.name: sample_epsilon_greedy
nodes.summary: Epsilon-greedy selection: with probability `epsilon` explores a random entry, otherwise exploits the highest-ELO entry.

nodes.name: inject_diversity_with_context
nodes.summary: Returns a `DiversityHint` with optional context derived from the currently selected entry, used to nudge the prover toward alternative proof strategies.

nodes.name: SketchId
nodes.summary: 32-byte blake3-hashed unique identifier for a sketch, generated from a monotonic atomic counter and supporting nil sentinel, byte roundtrip, and serde.

nodes.name: ProofState
nodes.summary: Canonical proof state bytes plus a `GoalHash` digest, with len/is_empty queries and a truncating Display implementation for diagnostics.

nodes.name: Goal
nodes.summary: A proof goal with a human-readable label and canonical byte form used for hashing and equality; constructable from either form.

nodes.name: DiversityStrategy
nodes.summary: Enum of diversity-injection strategies (Decompose, Combine, NovelApproach) with index/description roundtripping for serde and display.

nodes.name: DiversityHint
nodes.summary: A diversity nudge carrying a `DiversityStrategy` and optional context string, attached to sampled sketches to guide alternative exploration.

nodes.name: SketchEntry
nodes.summary: Per-sketch record holding id, proof state, capped pending goals, FIFO lesson log, ELO rating, visit count, and creation timestamp; exposes P-UCB scoring and age/visit mutation.

nodes.name: SketchEntry::new
nodes.summary: Constructs a fresh `SketchEntry` with a new `SketchId`, capped pending goals, empty lesson log, default ELO, zero visits, and current creation timestamp.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for the CCE (Coarse Correlated Equilibria) moderator primitives, re-exporting the Bregman potentials, ExternalRegret, CceLp, CcePrimalDual, PerPlayerGame, and core types as the public surface documented under Plan 295 / Research 274.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust module barrel using `pub mod` + `pub use` to flatten the submodule API into `crate::cce::*`.

nodes.name: bregman.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the BregmanPotential trait and two closed-form implementations (Euclidean half-squared-norm and KL divergence with log-domain floor) used by the primal-dual iterator as the mirror-descent distance-generating function.
nodes.languageNotes: Trait + impl pattern with const-generic-free f32 arithmetic; numerically guarded with `v.max(1e-12)` floors.

nodes.name: external_regret.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the closed-form external-regret functional ER(rho) = max_kappa (gamma - gamma_dev) over a finite deviation class, with uniqueness check, linear derivative, and per-player heterogeneous variants; backed by an extensive test suite covering canonical RPS, Chicken, and emission-abatement games.
nodes.languageNotes: Zero-sized `ExternalRegret` struct used purely as a method namespace; const generics `<N, A>` carry state/action cardinalities through the API.

nodes.name: heterogeneous.rs
nodes.summary: Provides the PerPlayerGame wrapper that adapts a Vec of per-player (PayoffTensor, DeviationClass) pairs into the HeterogeneousPayoff trait, enabling multi-NPC subjective-CCE solving; tested against Prisoner's Dilemma and emission-abatement scenarios.
nodes.languageNotes: Tuple-struct indexing (`self.players[player].0`) forwards calls to per-player payoff tensors and deviation classes.

nodes.name: lp.rs
nodes.summary: Exact finite-LP CCE solver (`CceLp`) that enumerates BFS basic feasible solutions via Gauss-Jordan elimination over deviation-class constraint rows, returning the minimum-cost occupation measure for both homogeneous and heterogeneous payoff tensors.
nodes.languageNotes: Hand-rolled BFS enumeration with partial-pivot Gaussian elimination; f64 internal precision downcast to f32 on output.

nodes.name: primal_dual.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the Bregman-regularized primal-dual iterator (`CcePrimalDual`) with averaged-iterate O(T^-1/2) convergence, simplex projection, and both homogeneous and heterogeneous step/run entry points; emits StepReport and ConvergenceReportRaw diagnostics per iteration.
nodes.languageNotes: Builder-style chain (`with_eta`, `with_initial_rho`, `with_initial_lambda`) on a const-generic struct; subgradient oracle delegated to ExternalRegret.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Core algebraic types for the CCE module: const-generic OccupationMeasure<N,A> with validation, Deviation/DeviationClass kernels, PayoffTensor trait with reward/gamma functionals, and HeterogeneousPayoff trait extending the API to per-player cost tables.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy const-generic usage (`OccupationMeasure<const N: usize, const A: usize>`); marker traits StateSpace/ActionSpace seal the const-generic axes.

nodes.name: BregmanPotential
nodes.summary: Trait abstraction over a Bregman divergence and its gradient, used by the primal-dual iterator as the mirror-descent distance-generating function.

nodes.name: Euclidean
nodes.summary: BregmanPotential implementation using the half-squared-Euclidean norm (D(rho,sigma) = 0.5 * ||rho - sigma||^2) with identity gradient.

nodes.name: Kl
nodes.summary: BregmanPotential implementation using KL divergence with a 1e-12 log-domain floor; gradient is log(rho) + 1.

nodes.name: ExternalRegret
nodes.summary: Zero-sized namespace struct exposing the external-regret functional ER(rho) = max over deviation class of (gamma - gamma_dev), plus uniqueness, linear-derivative, and heterogeneous variants used by the LP and primal-dual solvers.

nodes.name: er
nodes.summary: Computes the external regret ER(rho) by taking the max over the deviation class of (gamma(rho) - gamma_dev(rho, kappa)); ER=0 certifies CCE, ER<0 certifies strict CCE.

nodes.name: best_deviation
nodes.summary: Returns the deviation kappa* that attains the argmax of (gamma(rho) - gamma_dev(rho, kappa)), i.e. the most profitable unilateral deviation from rho.

nodes.name: is_unique_maximizer
nodes.summary: Checks Assumption 6.2 strict-convexity by sorting deviation gains and verifying a gap larger than eps between the top two values.

nodes.name: linear_derivative
nodes.summary: Computes the linear (subgradient) derivative of ER at rho in direction m, defined as reward_follow - reward_deviate evaluated at the best deviation; matches Lemma 6.5.

nodes.name: linear_derivative_heterogeneous
nodes.summary: Per-player generalization of linear_derivative that aggregates the subgradient contributions across all players in a HeterogeneousPayoff game.

nodes.name: er_heterogeneous
nodes.summary: Computes the maximum external regret across all players in a heterogeneous game, reducing to the homogeneous er when there is a single player.

nodes.name: PerPlayerGame
nodes.summary: Wraps a Vec of per-player (payoff, deviation-class) tuples into the HeterogeneousPayoff trait, forwarding reward and deviation queries to the appropriate player's components.

nodes.name: CceLpError
nodes.summary: Error enum returned by the CceLp solver, distinguishing Infeasible, Unbounded, and NumericalError outcomes of BFS enumeration.

nodes.name: CceLp
nodes.summary: Zero-sized namespace struct exposing the exact finite-LP CCE solver: solve, is_cce, and heterogeneous variants, all backed by BFS enumeration over the deviation-class constraint matrix.

nodes.name: solve
nodes.summary: Solves the homogeneous CCE LP by building one constraint row per deviation, invoking BFS enumeration to find the minimum-cost feasible rho, and normalizing the result onto the simplex.

nodes.name: is_cce
nodes.summary: Certificate check that a candidate rho is an epsilon-CCE by verifying ExternalRegret::er(rho) <= eps.

nodes.name: solve_heterogeneous
nodes.summary: Per-player generalization of solve that stacks one constraint row per (player, deviation) pair from a HeterogeneousPayoff game, then runs BFS enumeration and normalization to return the minimum-cost CCE.

nodes.name: is_heterogeneous_cce
nodes.summary: Certificate check that a candidate rho is an epsilon-CCE for a heterogeneous game by iterating players and confirming each player's regret is bounded.

nodes.name: enumerate_bfs
nodes.summary: Enumerates basic feasible solutions of an LP by iterating n_vars-sized combinations of constraint rows, solving each square subsystem, and keeping the minimum-objective feasible vertex.

nodes.name: solve_square_system
nodes.summary: Solves a square linear system via Gauss-Jordan elimination with partial pivoting and back-substitution, returning None on a (near-)singular diagonal.

nodes.name: next_combination
nodes.summary: Advances a combination vector in lexicographic order over n elements, returning false when the last combination has been reached; used as the driver of BFS enumeration.

nodes.name: StepReport
nodes.summary: Diagnostic snapshot returned by each primal-dual step, capturing the current rho, dual lambda, external regret ER, gamma0 cost, and step size eta.

nodes.name: CcePrimalDual
nodes.summary: Stateful primal-dual iterator carrying rho, rho_avg, lambda, the learning rate eta, and the chosen Bregman potential; exposes builder setters and step/run methods for both homogeneous and heterogeneous games.

nodes.name: ConvergenceReportRaw
nodes.summary: Final convergence report emitted by run/run_heterogeneous, averaging rho over all iterations and reporting the averaged gamma0 cost and external regret.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a default CcePrimalDual with uniform initial rho, zero dual lambda, and the Euclidean Bregman potential, parameterized by const-generic state/action dimensions.

nodes.name: step
nodes.summary: Advances one homogeneous primal-dual step: compute linear derivative via ExternalRegret, mirror-descent update with eta, project onto the simplex, update dual lambda via regret, and refresh the averaged rho.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Drives n_steps homogeneous primal-dual iterations, accumulating a StepReport history and emitting a ConvergenceReportRaw with averaged rho, gamma0, and ER.

nodes.name: step_heterogeneous
nodes.summary: Per-player generalization of step: aggregates per-player subgradients via linear_derivative_heterogeneous, applies a shared mirror-descent update, and updates a single dual variable from the maximum per-player regret.

nodes.name: run_heterogeneous
nodes.summary: Drives n_steps heterogeneous primal-dual iterations over a PerPlayerGame, emitting a ConvergenceReportRaw with averaged rho and the heterogeneous ER.

nodes.name: project_onto_simplex
nodes.summary: Euclidean projection of a vector onto the probability simplex (sum=1, entries>=0) using the classic sort-and-threshold algorithm.

nodes.name: StateSpace
nodes.summary: Const-generic marker trait sealing the state-cardinality axis N of OccupationMeasure and related types.

nodes.name: ActionSpace
nodes.summary: Const-generic marker trait sealing the action-cardinality axis A of OccupationMeasure and related types.

nodes.name: OccupationMeasure
nodes.summary: Const-generic probability distribution rho over (state, action) pairs with strict construction-time validation of length, non-negativity, and L1 normalization.

nodes.name: OccupationMeasureError
nodes.summary: Error enum returned by OccupationMeasure::new distinguishing WrongLength, NotNormalized, and NegativeEntry construction failures.

nodes.name: Deviation
nodes.summary: A single deviation kappa parameterized by an id and a per-state action kernel, constructable as constant, identity (when square), or from a raw kernel.

nodes.name: DeviationClass
nodes.summary: Collection of Deviation values that exposes the deviations list and an apply method that redistributes occupation-measure mass under a chosen deviation.

nodes.name: PayoffTensor
nodes.summary: Trait capturing the homogeneous cost functional gamma, deviation cost gamma_dev, baseline gamma0, and the linear gamma0_coeff used by both the LP and primal-dual solvers.

nodes.name: HeterogeneousPayoff
nodes.summary: Trait extending PayoffTensor to per-player heterogeneous cost tables, exposing n_players, deviations_for_player, per-player reward/gamma functionals, and a default gamma0 that averages across players.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Fallible constructor for OccupationMeasure that validates entry count, non-negativity, and L1 normalization before returning the typed distribution.

nodes.name: identity
nodes.summary: Builds a square identity deviation kernel (action a maps to itself) for use as the no-op deviation in a DeviationClass.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel for the skill_opt (SkillOpt) subsystem — declares all six submodules and re-exports their public types and functions (SkillEdit, apply_edits, ValidationGate, EditBudgetSchedule, RejectedEditBuffer, SkillOptimizer, Benchmark).
nodes.languageNotes: Rust module root using `pub mod` declarations plus `pub use` re-exports to flatten the public API.

nodes.name: apply.rs
nodes.summary: Deterministic text patching engine for skill documents — sorts edits by support_count, enforces an edit budget, blocks modifications inside `<!-- SLOW_UPDATE_START/END -->` protected ranges, and returns an ApplyResult of applied and skipped edits.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements four EditOp variants (Append/InsertAfter/Replace/Delete) with explicit budget and protected-section guards; ships inline tests covering each path.

nodes.name: buffer.rs
nodes.summary: FIFO ring buffer (RejectedEditBuffer) of rejected edits used as negative examples for the optimizer, with postcard-based binary serialization for JSONL-style persistence.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses postcard crate for compact binary serialization; length-prefixed frame encoding for round-trip persistence.

nodes.name: edit.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the three core data types for skill editing: EditOp (Append/InsertAfter/Replace/Delete), EditSource (Failure/Success/SlowUpdate/MetaSkill), and the SkillEdit struct carrying content, target, and provenance.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses `#[repr(u8)]` enums for compact serialization and orders SkillEdit fields to minimize struct padding.

nodes.name: gate.rs
nodes.summary: Validation gate that accepts candidate skills when their score exceeds the current score (delta > 0), plus the RejectedEdit record capturing the proposed edit, score delta, failure patterns, and training epoch/step.

nodes.name: optimizer.rs
nodes.summary: Trait contracts for skill optimization: SkillOptimizer proposes edits from scored trajectories (with rejected edits as negative examples) and validates candidates against a Benchmark; game-specific implementations live in the riir-ai crate.
nodes.languageNotes: Defines abstract Rust traits (`SkillOptimizer`, `Benchmark`) as an interface contract expected to be implemented downstream.

nodes.name: schedule.rs
nodes.summary: EditBudgetSchedule enum (Constant / Linear / Cosine / Autonomous) and budget_at_step method computing the per-step edit budget using constant, linear decay, or cosine annealing curves.
nodes.languageNotes: Cosine variant uses `std::f64::consts::PI` for annealing curves; Autonomous variant defers to an outer controller.

nodes.name: apply_edits
nodes.summary: Applies a batch of SkillEdits to a skill document in order of descending support_count, enforcing an edit budget and refusing edits whose target falls inside the protected SLOW_UPDATE section; returns ApplyResult with applied and skipped lists.

nodes.name: ApplyResult
nodes.summary: Return type of apply_edits carrying the new_skill text plus the lists of applied and skipped SkillEdits (skipped edits include a reason string).

nodes.name: RejectedEditBuffer
nodes.summary: Bounded FIFO ring buffer of rejected edits (negative examples) with push, iterate-from-oldest, clear, and binary persistence via to_bytes/from_bytes.
nodes.languageNotes: Ring buffer tracks head pointer and len separately to support overwrite-on-full behavior.

nodes.name: push
nodes.summary: Appends a RejectedEdit to the ring buffer, overwriting the oldest entry when the buffer is at capacity and advancing the head pointer.

nodes.name: from_bytes
nodes.summary: Reconstructs a RejectedEditBuffer from a length-prefixed postcard frame, validating frame boundaries and truncation, and restoring head/len/max_size state.

nodes.name: EditOp
nodes.summary: Four-variant enum (Append, InsertAfter, Replace, Delete) describing the text mutation to perform on a skill document; `#[repr(u8)]` for compact serialization.

nodes.name: EditSource
nodes.summary: Provenance enum for an edit proposal (Failure, Success, SlowUpdate, MetaSkill) used to set priority and trust level when sorting and applying edits.

nodes.name: SkillEdit
nodes.summary: Central data structure representing one proposed edit to a skill document: support_count, content, target, op, and source; fields ordered to minimize struct padding.

nodes.name: ValidationGate
nodes.summary: Copy-able result struct for skill validation carrying accepted flag, candidate_score, current_score, and the delta; constructed via ValidationGate::new which accepts iff delta > 0.

nodes.name: RejectedEdit
nodes.summary: Persistable record of a rejected SkillEdit capturing the edit itself, its score_delta, detected failure_patterns, and the training epoch/step at which it was proposed.

nodes.name: ScoredTrajectory
nodes.summary: Minimal trajectory record consumed by SkillOptimizer implementations: task_id, numeric score, raw text trace, and a success flag.

nodes.name: SkillOptimizer
nodes.summary: Trait contract implemented by game-specific optimizers (in riir-ai): propose_edits turns scored trajectories + rejected buffer into a batch of SkillEdits, and validate returns a ValidationGate via a Benchmark.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses `impl IntoIterator<Item = RejectedEdit>` to accept any iterable of negative examples, and `&mut dyn Benchmark` for trait-object dispatch.

nodes.name: Benchmark
nodes.summary: Trait contract for evaluating a candidate skill document and returning a numeric score (higher is better); concrete implementations live in the riir-ai crate.

nodes.name: EditBudgetSchedule
nodes.summary: Config enum selecting the per-step edit budget curve: Constant, Linear (ramped), Cosine (annealed), or Autonomous (deferred to an outer controller).

nodes.name: budget_at_step
nodes.summary: Computes the edit budget for a given step according to the active schedule variant — constant, linear ramp between peak and floor, or cosine-annealed between peak and floor.

nodes.name: kernel.rs
nodes.summary: Core PersonalityWeightedComposition kernel — composes N latent direction vectors via sigmoid-gated personality weights and updates them via an EMA on reward prediction error (modelless inference primitive, Plan 297).
nodes.languageNotes: Const-generic struct PersonalityWeightedComposition<const N: usize, const D: usize>; uses SIMD-accelerated fused scale-acc and dot primitives in compose_into/drift.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for katgpt-personality — declares modules, re-exports the public API, and pins const-generic layer-count aliases (SingleLayer/Quad/Hepta/EntityCognition N=9 D=32).
nodes.languageNotes: Rust barrel module: pub mod declarations plus pub use re-exports, with const-generic type aliases pinned to {1,4,7,9} per AGENTS.md monomorphisation budget.

nodes.name: sigmoid.rs
nodes.summary: Numerically stable branching sigmoid — handles large-magnitude inputs without overflow, exposed as both scalar sigmoid(x) and vectorized sigmoid_into(x, out).
nodes.languageNotes: Branching implementation selects the stable formula based on sign of x to avoid exp() overflow.

nodes.name: snapshot.rs
nodes.summary: PersonalitySnapshot — committed (BLAKE3-hashed) serialization of personality weights with archetype label, supporting to_bytes/from_bytes roundtrip, verify_blake3 tamper detection, and restore via from_parts/from_composition.
nodes.languageNotes: Const-generic over N (layer count) with fixed-width little-endian byte layout: 16-byte archetype || N*4-byte f32 weights || 32-byte blake3 || 8-byte u64 version.

nodes.name: tests.rs
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the personality kernel — covers compose (uniform/extreme weights, belief-confidence decay, tau=infinity G1 gate) and drift (positive/negative surprise, clamp, EMA tracking, empty recent direction).

nodes.name: trait_def.rs
nodes.summary: LayerDirectionSource trait — the abstraction a layer must satisfy to feed its direction, recent_direction, and belief_confidence into the PersonalityWeightedComposition kernel (file named trait_def to avoid the reserved 'trait' path keyword).
nodes.languageNotes: Rust reserves 'trait' as a module path component, so the file is named trait_def.rs while the declared item is the LayerDirectionSource trait.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Shared config and label types — PersonalityConfig (tau, alpha, w_max, ema_decay with is_valid sanity check) and the blake3-derived 16-byte ArchetypeLabel identity type.
nodes.languageNotes: ArchetypeLabel is a blake3-truncated newtype wrapping [u8; 16] with const-friendly constructors (new/from_str/empty/as_bytes).

nodes.name: PersonalityWeightedComposition
nodes.summary: Const-generic struct holding the personality weight vector w, PersonalityConfig, and per-layer expected-reward EMA r_expected; impl block provides compose_into, drift, and snapshot/restore accessors.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a PersonalityWeightedComposition from a PersonalityConfig and an initial weight vector w, initializing per-layer expected reward to zero.

nodes.name: compose_into
nodes.summary: Computes the composed behavior vector by summing sigmoid(w_i/tau) * belief_confidence_i * d_i across layers using SIMD-accelerated fused scale-accumulate, writing into the caller-provided out buffer.

nodes.name: drift
nodes.summary: Updates personality weights from observed reward via Δw_i = alpha * surprise_i * d_recent_i with clamping to ±w_max, and refreshes the per-layer expected-reward EMA — the modelless learning rule.

nodes.name: sigmoid
nodes.summary: Numerically stable scalar sigmoid — branches on sign of x to avoid exp() overflow, returning the standard 1/(1+e^-x) gating value used by the composition kernel.

nodes.name: sigmoid_into
